```ts
describe.skipIf(!enabled)('plan 3 migration one: calendar pass functions',()=>{
 const CAL='CN';
 type Token={market:string;pass_id:string;batch_id:string};
 // next_due_at far in the future: no facts sync in another suite ever picks these scope rows up
 const scopeRow=(iss:string)=>q(`insert into public.fact_sync_scope(issuer_id,market,reasons,priority,fetch_key,next_due_at) values($1,$2,'["test"]',5,'df3cal','2999-01-01') on conflict (issuer_id,market) do update set priority=5`,[iss,CAL]);
 const claimPass=async(b:string)=>(await q(`select public.claim_calendar_pass($1,$2) v`,[CAL,b]))[0].v as Token|null;
 const replace=async(tok:unknown,iss:string,rows:unknown,market=CAL)=>(await q(`select public.replace_filing_expectations($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4::jsonb) v`,[iss,market,JSON.stringify(rows),JSON.stringify(tok)]))[0].v as number;
 const failMember=(tok:unknown,iss:string,err='boom')=>q(`select public.fail_calendar_member($1::jsonb,$2,$3)`,[JSON.stringify(tok),iss,err]);
 const finish=async(tok:unknown)=>(await q(`select public.finish_calendar_pass($1::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify(tok)]))[0].v as string;
 const members=(passId:string)=>q(`select issuer_id,state,attempts,last_error from public.dq_calendar_pass_members where market=$1 and pass_id=$2 order by issuer_id`,[CAL,passId]);
 const member=async(passId:string,iss:string)=>(await members(passId)).find(m=>m.issuer_id===iss);
 /** In-scope issuers other suites created are members too: settle them with an empty replacement. */
 const drain=async(tok:Token,except:string[]=[])=>{for(const m of await members(tok.pass_id))if(m.state==='pending'&&!except.includes(m.issuer_id))await replace(tok,m.issuer_id,[]);};
 const expRow=(over:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({report_kind:'annual',period_end:'2025-12-31',period_end_estimated:false,deadline_state:'statutory',due_date:'2026-04-30',due_rule:'cn.annual.4m',expected_date:null,upstream_lookup:'ok',upstream_filed_date:null,disclosure_state:'pending',received_filing_id:null,received_date:null,profile_as_of:null,detail:{},...over});

 it('creates one pass per market, freezes the in-scope members and leases it to one worker',async()=>{
  await withCalendarLock(admin,async()=>{
   const i1=await issuer(),i2=await issuer();await scopeRow(i1);await scopeRow(i2);
   const b1=await batch(),b2=await batch();
   const tok=(await claimPass(b1))!;
   expect(tok).toEqual({market:CAL,pass_id:expect.any(String),batch_id:b1});
   for(const i of [i1,i2])expect(await member(tok.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'pending',attempts:0});
   expect(await claimPass(b2)).toBeNull();                                  // leased to b1
   expect((await claimPass(b1))!.pass_id).toBe(tok.pass_id);                // the holder renews its own lease
   expect(await q(`select (claim_until > clock_timestamp() + interval '9 minutes') fresh from public.dq_calendar_passes where market=$1 and pass_id=$2`,[CAL,tok.pass_id])).toEqual([{fresh:true}]);
   const i3=await issuer();await scopeRow(i3);
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,i3)).toBeUndefined();                    // frozen: scope changes wait for the next pass
   await drain(tok);
   expect(await finish(tok)).toBe('complete');
   const next=(await claimPass(b2))!;
   expect(next.pass_id).not.toBe(tok.pass_id);
   for(const i of [i1,i2,i3])expect(await member(next.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'pending'});
   await drain(next);await finish(next);
  });
 },60000);

 it('lets exactly one of two concurrent claimers create and lease the pass (advisory lock)',async()=>{
  await withCalendarLock(admin,async()=>{
   const i=await issuer();await scopeRow(i);
   const b1=await batch(),b2=await batch();
   const got=await Promise.all([claimPass(b1),claimPass(b2)]);
   expect(got.filter(Boolean)).toHaveLength(1);
   expect(await q(`select count(*)::int n from public.dq_calendar_passes where market=$1 and finished_at is null`,[CAL])).toEqual([{n:1}]);
   const tok=(got[0]??got[1])!;
   await drain(tok);await finish(tok);
  });
 });

 it("replace_filing_expectations swaps an issuer's rows atomically under the fence and marks the member done once",async()=>{
  await withCalendarLock(admin,async()=>{
   const i=await issuer(),j=await issuer();await scopeRow(i);await scopeRow(j);
   const b=await batch();
   const tok=(await claimPass(b))!;
   expect(await replace(tok,i,[expRow(),expRow({report_kind:'semiannual',period_end:'2025-06-30',due_date:'2025-08-31',due_rule:'cn.semiannual.2m'})])).toBe(2);
   expect(await q(`select report_kind,period_end::text,batch_id from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id=$1 and market=$2 order by period_end`,[i,CAL])).toEqual([
    {report_kind:'semiannual',period_end:'2025-06-30',batch_id:b},{report_kind:'annual',period_end:'2025-12-31',batch_id:b}]);
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'done',attempts:0});
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,i,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('member_not_claimable');        // done is final within a pass
   // invalid rows write nothing and keep the member pending
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,j,[expRow({deadline_state:'no_rule'})]))).message).toBe('invalid_rows');   // dfe_due_iff_known
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,j,[{...expRow(),issuer_id:i}]))).message).toBe('invalid_rows');            // a row for another issuer
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,j,[expRow(),expRow()]))).message).toBe('invalid_rows');                    // duplicate key in one call
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,j,{}))).message).toBe('invalid_rows');                                     // not an array
   expect(await q(`select count(*)::int n from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id=$1`,[j])).toEqual([{n:0}]);
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,j)).toMatchObject({state:'pending'});
   // not a member; another market in the call; a token naming another batch; a malformed token
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,await issuer(),[]))).message).toBe('member_not_claimable');
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,j,[],'US'))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   expect((await fails(replace({...tok,batch_id:randomUUID()},j,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   expect((await fails(replace({market:CAL},j,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   await drain(tok);
   expect(await finish(tok)).toBe('complete');
   // the next pass replaces the whole set for the issuer
   const tok2=(await claimPass(b))!;
   expect(await replace(tok2,i,[expRow({report_kind:'semiannual',period_end:'2026-06-30',due_date:'2026-08-31',due_rule:'cn.semiannual.2m'})])).toBe(1);
   expect(await q(`select period_end::text from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id=$1`,[i])).toEqual([{period_end:'2026-06-30'}]);
   await drain(tok2);await finish(tok2);
  });
 },60000);

 it('fail_calendar_member retries up to three attempts; finish_calendar_pass settles only from persisted state',async()=>{
  await withCalendarLock(admin,async()=>{
   const i=await issuer(),k=await issuer();await scopeRow(i);await scopeRow(k);
   const b=await batch();const tok=(await claimPass(b))!;
   await drain(tok,[i,k]);
   await failMember(tok,i,'sec_unavailable');
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'failed',attempts:1,last_error:'sec_unavailable'});
   expect((await fails(finish(tok))).message).toBe('pass_incomplete');      // i may still be retried, k is pending
   expect(await replace(tok,i,[expRow()])).toBe(1);                          // a retry that succeeds is simply done
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'done',attempts:1});
   for(let n=0;n<3;n++)await failMember(tok,k,`boom ${n}`);
   expect(await member(tok.pass_id,k)).toMatchObject({state:'failed',attempts:3,last_error:'boom 2'});
   expect((await fails(failMember(tok,k))).message).toBe('member_not_claimable');        // terminal
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,k,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('member_not_claimable');
   expect((await fails(failMember(tok,i))).message).toBe('member_not_claimable');        // done members cannot fail
   expect(await finish(tok)).toBe('complete_with_failures');
   expect(await q(`select status,(finished_at is not null) finished from public.dq_calendar_passes where market=$1 and pass_id=$2`,[CAL,tok.pass_id])).toEqual([{status:'complete_with_failures',finished:true}]);
   expect((await fails(finish(tok))).message).toBe('fence_failed');                       // a finished pass is closed to every function
   expect((await fails(replace(tok,i,[]))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
  });
 },60000);

 it('an expired worker cannot change the progress of the worker that took the pass over',async()=>{
  await withCalendarLock(admin,async()=>{
   const i=await issuer();await scopeRow(i);
   const b1=await batch(),b2=await batch();
   const old=(await claimPass(b1))!;
   await q(`update public.dq_calendar_passes set claim_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' where market=$1 and pass_id=$2`,[CAL,old.pass_id]);
   expect((await fails(replace(old,i,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('fence_failed');          // expired even before anyone takes over
   const cur=(await claimPass(b2))!;
   expect(cur).toEqual({market:CAL,pass_id:old.pass_id,batch_id:b2});                     // takeover keeps the pass and its frozen members
   expect((await fails(replace(old,i,[expRow()]))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   expect((await fails(failMember(old,i))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   expect((await fails(finish(old))).message).toBe('fence_failed');
   expect(await member(cur.pass_id,i)).toMatchObject({state:'pending',attempts:0});
   expect(await q(`select count(*)::int n from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id=$1`,[i])).toEqual([{n:0}]);
   expect(await replace(cur,i,[expRow()])).toBe(1);
   await drain(cur);
   expect(await finish(cur)).toBe('complete');
  });
 },60000);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 既有集成测试的拓扑写入改经开关**

迁移一的守卫会拒绝计划一测试里直接 `update public.issuers set status…/merged_into…` 的夹具写入（含期望 `issuers_merged_not_self` 的第 97 行：守卫在检查约束之前触发）。两文件各加 `topo` 助手并替换调用。

`src/lib/entities/issuers.integration.test.ts`：在 `const newIssuer=…};`（第 43 行）之后插入：
```ts
 // Plan 3 migration one guards issuers.status/merged_into (issuers_topology_guard): lifecycle fixtures
 // switch the transaction-local setting on, as set_merge/set_dissolved do. The plan-1 triggers still run.
 const topo=async(sql:string,params:unknown[]=[])=>{
  const c=await admin.connect();
  try{
   await c.query('begin');
   await c.query(`select set_config('entities.allow_topology_write','on',true)`);
   await c.query(sql,params);
   await c.query('commit');
  }catch(e){await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});throw e;}
  finally{c.release();}
 };
```
紧接着（`topo` 之后）再插入出生即非活跃的发行人夹具助手（守卫也挡 `insert`，接口对齐记录 #7）：
```ts
 // Inserts born merged/dissolved are guarded too (plan 3 接口对齐记录 #7): same fixture, inside a topo transaction.
 const newIssuerTopo=async(cols:string,vals:string,params:unknown[]=[])=>{
  const id=randomUUID();issuers.push(id);
  await topo(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en${cols}) values($1,'Test Co'${vals})`,[id,...params]);
  return id;
 };
```

```sql
-- ================================================================ functions (plan 3 Task 1b)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- claim/1 helpers (internal; §4.2.1)
-- claims.ts::validateClaimDetail mirrors identifier_claim_problem: keep the two in step.
create or replace function public.claim_text_is_date(p text) returns boolean
language plpgsql immutable set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if p is null or p !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then return false; end if;
  perform p::date;                                   -- rejects 2026-02-30
  return true;
exception when others then return false;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.claim_text_is_date(text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function public.claim_keys_within(p jsonb, p_allowed text[]) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce(bool_and(k = any(p_allowed)), true) from jsonb_object_keys(p) k
$$;
revoke execute on function public.claim_keys_within(jsonb, text[]) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function public.claim_evidence_ok(e jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce(e is not null and jsonb_typeof(e) = 'object'
    and jsonb_typeof(e -> 'source') = 'string' and length(e ->> 'source') between 1 and 64
    and public.claim_text_is_date(e ->> 'as_of')
    and coalesce(e ->> 'evidence_sha256', '') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and (not (e ? 'locator') or jsonb_typeof(e -> 'locator') = 'string')
    and (not (e ? 'note') or jsonb_typeof(e -> 'note') = 'string'), false)
$$;
revoke execute on function public.claim_evidence_ok(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- target_key = op ':' issuer_id, or op ':' issuer_id '|' ticker '|' valid_from (claims.ts::claimTargetKey).
create or replace function public.identifier_claim_target_key(p_op text, p_target jsonb) returns text
language sql immutable set search_path = public as $$
  select p_op || ':' || case when p_target ? 'ticker'
    then coalesce(p_target ->> 'issuer_id', '') || '|' || coalesce(p_target ->> 'ticker', '') || '|' || coalesce(p_target ->> 'valid_from', '')
    else coalesce(p_target ->> 'issuer_id', '') end
$$;
revoke execute on function public.identifier_claim_target_key(text, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- null when the (op, id_type, value, detail) is a valid claim/1 for issuer p_issuer, else the field at fault.
create or replace function public.identifier_claim_problem(p_op text, p_id_type text, p_value text, p_issuer uuid, p_detail jsonb)
returns text language plpgsql stable set search_path = public as $$
declare t jsonb; pa jsonb; pw jsonb; s jsonb; full_target boolean; allowed text[];
begin
  if p_detail is null or jsonb_typeof(p_detail) <> 'object' or p_detail ->> 'schema' is distinct from 'claim/1' then return 'schema'; end if;
  if coalesce(p_detail ->> 'evidence_kind', '') not in ('hard_identifier','official_list','name_match','filing_form','provider_mapping') then return 'evidence_kind'; end if;
  t := p_detail -> 'target'; pa := p_detail -> 'params'; pw := p_detail -> 'provenance_written';
  if t is null or jsonb_typeof(t) <> 'object' or t ->> 'issuer_id' is distinct from p_issuer::text then return 'target.issuer_id'; end if;
  if pa is null or jsonb_typeof(pa) <> 'object' then return 'params'; end if;
  if not public.claim_evidence_ok(p_detail -> 'evidence') then return 'evidence'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_detail -> 'sources') is distinct from 'array' then return 'sources'; end if;
  for s in select x from jsonb_array_elements(p_detail -> 'sources') x loop
    if not public.claim_evidence_ok(s) then return 'sources'; end if;
  end loop;
  if pw is not null and jsonb_typeof(pw) <> 'object' then return 'provenance_written'; end if;
  full_target := t ? 'ticker' or t ? 'valid_from';
  if full_target then
    if jsonb_typeof(t -> 'ticker') is distinct from 'string' or length(t ->> 'ticker') not between 1 and 32
       or not public.claim_text_is_date(t ->> 'valid_from')
       or not public.claim_keys_within(t, array['issuer_id','ticker','valid_from']) then return 'target'; end if;
  elsif not public.claim_keys_within(t, array['issuer_id']) then
    return 'target';
  end if;
  if p_op in ('set_identifier','correct_identifier') then
    if p_id_type in ('lei','cik','usci','cninfo_org_id') then
      if full_target then return 'target'; end if;
    elsif p_id_type in ('isin','figi') then
      if not full_target then return 'target'; end if;
    else
      return 'op_id_type';
    end if;
    if p_op = 'set_identifier' then
      if not public.claim_keys_within(pa, array['candidates','note'])
         or (pa ? 'candidates' and jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'candidates') <> 'array')
         or (pa ? 'note' and jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'note') <> 'string') then return 'params'; end if;
    else
      if not public.claim_keys_within(pa, array['expected_current','new_value','candidates','note'])
         or jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'expected_current') is distinct from 'string' or length(pa ->> 'expected_current') not between 1 and 64
         or jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'new_value') is distinct from 'string' or length(pa ->> 'new_value') not between 1 and 64
         or pa ->> 'expected_current' = pa ->> 'new_value' then return 'params'; end if;
      if pa ->> 'new_value' is distinct from p_value then return 'params.new_value'; end if;
    end if;
    allowed := array[p_id_type];
  elsif p_op = 'attach_security' then
    if p_id_type <> 'ticker' or full_target then return 'op_id_type'; end if;
    if not public.claim_keys_within(pa, array['share_class','valid_from','valid_from_method','source','isin','note'])
       or coalesce(pa ->> 'share_class', '') not in ('A','H','ADR','common','preferred','other','unknown')
       or not public.claim_text_is_date(pa ->> 'valid_from')
       or coalesce(pa ->> 'valid_from_method', '') not in ('first_observed','listing_date','ticker_change','curated')
       or jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'source') is distinct from 'string' or length(pa ->> 'source') not between 1 and 64
       or (pa ? 'isin' and coalesce(jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'isin'), '') not in ('string','null')) then return 'params'; end if;
    if jsonb_typeof(pa -> 'isin') = 'string' and (pa ->> 'isin') !~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{9}[0-9]$' then return 'params'; end if;
    allowed := array['isin','figi','valid_from'];
  elsif p_op in ('close_security','backdate_window') then
    if p_id_type <> 'ticker' or not full_target then return 'op_id_type'; end if;
    if t ->> 'ticker' is distinct from p_value then return 'target.ticker'; end if;
    if p_op = 'close_security' then
      if not public.claim_keys_within(pa, array['valid_to','valid_to_method','note'])
         or not public.claim_text_is_date(pa ->> 'valid_to')
         or coalesce(pa ->> 'valid_to_method', '') not in ('delisting','ticker_change','sec_file_absent','curated','merge_close','unrecorded') then return 'params'; end if;
      if (pa ->> 'valid_to')::date <= (t ->> 'valid_from')::date then return 'params'; end if;
      allowed := array['valid_to'];
    else
      if not public.claim_keys_within(pa, array['new_valid_from','valid_from_method','note'])
         or not public.claim_text_is_date(pa ->> 'new_valid_from')
         or coalesce(pa ->> 'valid_from_method', '') not in ('listing_date','ticker_change','curated') then return 'params'; end if;
      if (pa ->> 'new_valid_from')::date >= (t ->> 'valid_from')::date then return 'params'; end if;
      allowed := array['valid_from'];
    end if;
  elsif p_op = 'evidence_only' then
    if p_id_type <> 'ticker' or full_target then return 'op_id_type'; end if;
    if pa ? 'suggested_op' and coalesce(pa ->> 'suggested_op', '') not in ('attach_security','close_security','backdate_window') then return 'params.suggested_op'; end if;
    allowed := array[]::text[];
  else
    return 'op';
  end if;
  if pw is not null and not public.claim_keys_within(pw, allowed) then return 'provenance_written'; end if;
  return null;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.identifier_claim_problem(text, text, text, uuid, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- resolve_identifier_claim (§3.1, §4.2.1, §7.1)
-- Locks the claim; refuses non-pending (already_resolved), legacy (legacy_claim) and evidence_only
-- acceptance without an amend (amend_required); validates claim/1 and the stored target_key
-- (invalid_claim); 'rejected' only flips the status. 'accepted' performs the op's business write in
-- the same transaction with static SQL under a guard that must hit exactly one row of an active
-- issuer, merges detail.provenance_written (or, absent, the claim's evidence under the op's key) into
-- the target row's provenance, then records status/resolved_by/resolved_at. Any failure raises and
-- rolls back everything, so the claim stays pending.
create or replace function public.resolve_identifier_claim(p_id uuid, p_status text, p_resolved_by uuid, p_amend jsonb default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  c public.issuer_identifier_claims;
  v_op text; v_value text; v_detail jsonb; v_amended boolean := false; v_problem text;
  t jsonb; pa jsonb; v_pw jsonb; v_key text; v_status text; n int;
begin
  if p_status is null or p_status not in ('accepted','rejected') or p_resolved_by is null then
    raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  select * into c from public.issuer_identifier_claims where id = p_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'claim_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if c.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'already_resolved' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  if c.op = 'legacy' then raise exception 'legacy_claim' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  v_op := c.op; v_value := c.value; v_detail := c.detail;
  if p_amend is not null then
    -- Only an evidence_only claim is amended, only on acceptance, only into a ticker op (§4.2.1).
    if c.op <> 'evidence_only' or p_status <> 'accepted' or jsonb_typeof(p_amend) <> 'object'
       or coalesce(p_amend ->> 'op', '') not in ('attach_security','close_security','backdate_window')
       or jsonb_typeof(p_amend -> 'target') is distinct from 'object' or jsonb_typeof(p_amend -> 'params') is distinct from 'object' then
      raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    v_op := p_amend ->> 'op';
    v_detail := c.detail || jsonb_build_object('target', p_amend -> 'target', 'params', p_amend -> 'params',
      'original_op', c.op, 'original_target', c.detail -> 'target', 'original_params', c.detail -> 'params',
      'amended_by', p_resolved_by, 'amended_at', clock_timestamp());
    if (p_amend -> 'target') ? 'ticker' then v_value := p_amend -> 'target' ->> 'ticker'; end if;
    v_amended := true;
  elsif c.op = 'evidence_only' and p_status = 'accepted' then
    raise exception 'amend_required' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  v_problem := public.identifier_claim_problem(v_op, c.id_type, v_value, c.issuer_id, v_detail);
  if v_problem is not null then raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023', detail = v_problem; end if;
  if c.target_key is distinct from public.identifier_claim_target_key(c.op, c.detail -> 'target') then
    raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023', detail = 'target_key';
  end if;

  if p_status = 'rejected' then
    update public.issuer_identifier_claims set status = 'rejected', resolved_by = p_resolved_by, resolved_at = clock_timestamp() where id = p_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('op', c.op, 'applied', false, 'amended', false);
  end if;

  select status into v_status from public.issuers where issuer_id = c.issuer_id for update;
  if v_status is distinct from 'active' then raise exception 'issuer_not_active' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  t := v_detail -> 'target'; pa := v_detail -> 'params';
  v_key := case when v_op in ('set_identifier','correct_identifier') then c.id_type when v_op = 'close_security' then 'valid_to' else 'valid_from' end;
  v_pw := coalesce(v_detail -> 'provenance_written', jsonb_build_object(v_key, v_detail -> 'evidence'));

  begin
    if v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'lei' then
      update public.issuers set lei = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and lei is null;
    elsif v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'cik' then
      update public.issuers set cik = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and cik is null;
    elsif v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'usci' then
      update public.issuers set usci = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and usci is null;
    elsif v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'cninfo_org_id' then
      update public.issuers set cninfo_org_id = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and cninfo_org_id is null;
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'lei' then
      update public.issuers set lei = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and lei = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'cik' then
      update public.issuers set cik = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and cik = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'usci' then
      update public.issuers set usci = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and usci = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'cninfo_org_id' then
      update public.issuers set cninfo_org_id = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw, updated_at = now() where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and status = 'active' and cninfo_org_id = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'isin' then
      update public.issuer_securities set isin = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date and isin is null;
    elsif v_op = 'set_identifier' and c.id_type = 'figi' then
      update public.issuer_securities set figi = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date and figi is null;
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'isin' then
      update public.issuer_securities set isin = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date and isin = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'correct_identifier' and c.id_type = 'figi' then
      update public.issuer_securities set figi = v_value, provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date and figi = pa ->> 'expected_current';
    elsif v_op = 'attach_security' then
      insert into public.issuer_securities(issuer_id, ticker, isin, share_class, is_primary, valid_from, valid_to, valid_from_method, valid_to_method, source, provenance)
      values (c.issuer_id, v_value, nullif(pa ->> 'isin', ''), pa ->> 'share_class', false, (pa ->> 'valid_from')::date, null, pa ->> 'valid_from_method', null, pa ->> 'source', v_pw);
    elsif v_op = 'close_security' then
      update public.issuer_securities set valid_to = (pa ->> 'valid_to')::date, valid_to_method = pa ->> 'valid_to_method', provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date and valid_to is null;
    elsif v_op = 'backdate_window' then
      update public.issuer_securities set valid_from = (pa ->> 'new_valid_from')::date, valid_from_method = pa ->> 'valid_from_method', provenance = provenance || v_pw
      where issuer_id = c.issuer_id and ticker = t ->> 'ticker' and valid_from = (t ->> 'valid_from')::date;
    else
      raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
    get diagnostics n = row_count;
  exception
    when unique_violation or exclusion_violation then
      -- an issuer identifier held by another issuer; a security key/window/ISIN held by another row
      if v_op in ('set_identifier','correct_identifier') and c.id_type in ('lei','cik','usci','cninfo_org_id') then
        raise exception 'value_conflict' using errcode = 'P0001';
      end if;
      raise exception 'ownership_conflict' using errcode = 'P0001';
    when check_violation or foreign_key_violation or invalid_text_representation or not_null_violation then
      raise exception 'invalid_claim' using errcode = '22023';
  end;
  if n <> 1 then
    if v_op = 'close_security' then raise exception 'already_closed' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
    raise exception 'value_conflict' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  update public.issuer_identifier_claims
  set status = 'accepted', op = v_op, value = v_value, detail = v_detail,
      target_key = public.identifier_claim_target_key(v_op, v_detail -> 'target'),
      resolved_by = p_resolved_by, resolved_at = clock_timestamp()
  where id = p_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('op', v_op, 'applied', true, 'amended', v_amended);
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.resolve_identifier_claim(uuid, text, uuid, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.resolve_identifier_claim(uuid, text, uuid, jsonb) to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- calendar passes (§3.1, §6.2, T3/U1)
-- The pass token {market, pass_id, batch_id} fences every pass write: the pass row is locked and must
-- be leased to token.batch_id, unexpired and unfinished, else fence_failed with no write.
create or replace function public.dq_calendar_lock_pass(p_token jsonb) returns public.dq_calendar_passes
language plpgsql set search_path = public as $$
declare p public.dq_calendar_passes;
begin
  if p_token is null or jsonb_typeof(p_token) <> 'object'
     or coalesce(p_token ->> 'market', '') not in ('US','CN')
     or coalesce(p_token ->> 'pass_id', '') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
     or coalesce(p_token ->> 'batch_id', '') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then
    raise exception 'fence_failed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  select * into p from public.dq_calendar_passes where market = p_token ->> 'market' and pass_id = (p_token ->> 'pass_id')::uuid for update;
  if not found or p.claimed_by is distinct from (p_token ->> 'batch_id')::uuid
     or p.claim_until is null or p.claim_until <= clock_timestamp() or p.finished_at is not null then
    raise exception 'fence_failed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  return p;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.dq_calendar_lock_pass(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- U1: creation is serialised per market by a transaction advisory lock. No unfinished pass → create
-- it, freeze the in-scope active issuers as members, lease it to p_batch. An unfinished pass whose
-- lease is free, expired, or already p_batch's → (re)lease it to p_batch. Otherwise null.
create or replace function public.claim_calendar_pass(p_market text, p_batch uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare p public.dq_calendar_passes; v_pass uuid;
begin
  if p_market is null or p_market not in ('US','CN') then raise exception 'invalid_market' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  if p_batch is null then raise exception 'invalid_batch' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('dq_calendar_pass:' || p_market));
  select * into p from public.dq_calendar_passes where market = p_market and finished_at is null for update;
  if not found then
    v_pass := gen_random_uuid();
    insert into public.dq_calendar_passes(market, pass_id, started_at, claimed_by, claim_until, status)
    values (p_market, v_pass, clock_timestamp(), p_batch, clock_timestamp() + interval '10 minutes', 'running');
    insert into public.dq_calendar_pass_members(market, pass_id, issuer_id)
    select p_market, v_pass, s.issuer_id
    from public.fact_sync_scope s join public.issuers i on i.issuer_id = s.issuer_id
    where s.market = p_market and s.priority > 0 and i.status = 'active';
    return jsonb_build_object('market', p_market, 'pass_id', v_pass, 'batch_id', p_batch);
  end if;
  if p.claimed_by is null or p.claim_until is null or p.claim_until < clock_timestamp() or p.claimed_by = p_batch then
    update public.dq_calendar_passes set claimed_by = p_batch, claim_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '10 minutes'
    where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id;
    return jsonb_build_object('market', p_market, 'pass_id', p.pass_id, 'batch_id', p_batch);
  end if;
  return null;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.claim_calendar_pass(text, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.claim_calendar_pass(text, uuid) to service_role;

-- The only signature (no 3-arg overload). The member must belong to the pass and be pending, or
-- failed with attempts < 3; its rows for (issuer, market) are replaced atomically and it becomes done.
-- Rows carry the ExpectationRow columns (src/lib/dq/calendar.ts); computed_at and batch_id are set here.
create or replace function public.replace_filing_expectations(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_rows jsonb, p_pass_token jsonb)
returns int language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare p public.dq_calendar_passes; m public.dq_calendar_pass_members; n int;
begin
  p := public.dq_calendar_lock_pass(p_pass_token);
  if p_market is distinct from p.market then raise exception 'fence_failed' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;
  select * into m from public.dq_calendar_pass_members where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id and issuer_id = p_issuer for update;
  if not found or not (m.state = 'pending' or (m.state = 'failed' and m.attempts < 3)) then
    raise exception 'member_not_claimable' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  if p_rows is null or jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'
     or exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
                where jsonb_typeof(x) <> 'object'
                   or (x ? 'issuer_id' and x ->> 'issuer_id' is distinct from p_issuer::text)
                   or (x ? 'market' and x ->> 'market' is distinct from p_market)) then
    raise exception 'invalid_rows' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  begin
    delete from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id = p_issuer and market = p_market;
    insert into public.dq_filing_expectations(issuer_id, market, report_kind, period_end, period_end_estimated, deadline_state,
      due_date, due_rule, expected_date, upstream_lookup, upstream_filed_date, disclosure_state, received_filing_id, received_date,
      profile_as_of, detail, computed_at, batch_id)
    select p_issuer, p_market, x ->> 'report_kind', (x ->> 'period_end')::date, coalesce((x ->> 'period_end_estimated')::boolean, false),
      x ->> 'deadline_state', (x ->> 'due_date')::date, x ->> 'due_rule', (x ->> 'expected_date')::date, x ->> 'upstream_lookup',
      (x ->> 'upstream_filed_date')::date, x ->> 'disclosure_state', (x ->> 'received_filing_id')::uuid, (x ->> 'received_date')::date,
      (x ->> 'profile_as_of')::date, coalesce(x -> 'detail', '{}'::jsonb), clock_timestamp(), p.claimed_by
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x;
    get diagnostics n = row_count;
  exception when check_violation or not_null_violation or unique_violation or foreign_key_violation
              or invalid_text_representation or invalid_datetime_format or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_parameter_value then
    raise exception 'invalid_rows' using errcode = '22023';
  end;
  update public.dq_calendar_pass_members set state = 'done', done_at = clock_timestamp()
  where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id and issuer_id = p_issuer;
  update public.dq_calendar_passes set claim_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '10 minutes' where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id;
  return n;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.replace_filing_expectations(uuid, text, jsonb, jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.replace_filing_expectations(uuid, text, jsonb, jsonb) to service_role;

create or replace function public.fail_calendar_member(p_pass_token jsonb, p_issuer uuid, p_error text)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare p public.dq_calendar_passes; m public.dq_calendar_pass_members;
begin
  p := public.dq_calendar_lock_pass(p_pass_token);
  select * into m from public.dq_calendar_pass_members where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id and issuer_id = p_issuer for update;
  if not found or not (m.state = 'pending' or (m.state = 'failed' and m.attempts < 3)) then
    raise exception 'member_not_claimable' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  update public.dq_calendar_pass_members set state = 'failed', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = left(coalesce(p_error, 'unknown'), 1000)
  where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id and issuer_id = p_issuer;
  update public.dq_calendar_passes set claim_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '10 minutes' where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.fail_calendar_member(jsonb, uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.fail_calendar_member(jsonb, uuid, text) to service_role;

-- Settles only from persisted member state: anything still processable → pass_incomplete; else all
-- done → complete, otherwise complete_with_failures; both terminal states write finished_at.
create or replace function public.finish_calendar_pass(p_pass_token jsonb)
returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare p public.dq_calendar_passes; v_status text;
begin
  p := public.dq_calendar_lock_pass(p_pass_token);
  if exists (select 1 from public.dq_calendar_pass_members where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id
             and (state = 'pending' or (state = 'failed' and attempts < 3))) then
    raise exception 'pass_incomplete' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  v_status := case when exists (select 1 from public.dq_calendar_pass_members where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id and state <> 'done')
                   then 'complete_with_failures' else 'complete' end;
  update public.dq_calendar_passes set status = v_status, finished_at = clock_timestamp() where market = p.market and pass_id = p.pass_id;
  return v_status;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.finish_calendar_pass(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.finish_calendar_pass(jsonb) to service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- topology guard (§3.1, S1)
-- issuers.status/merged_into change only inside set_merge/set_dissolved (migration two), which switch
-- the transaction-local setting on and restore it on every exit path. A never-defined setting reads
-- NULL and the '' left after such a transaction both differ from 'on' and are refused (IS DISTINCT
-- FROM). The WHEN clause skips same-value writes. Named so it fires after the plan-1 lifecycle
-- triggers (BEFORE triggers run in name order), which keep reporting their own errors. A tripwire,
-- not a privilege boundary: any role can set the GUC. Inserts are guarded too (plan 3 接口对齐记录 #7):
-- an issuer born with status <> 'active' or merged_into set would add a lineage member without
-- set_merge's scope locks; plain active inserts pass.
create or replace function public.issuers_topology_guard() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if new.status is distinct from 'active' or new.merged_into is not null then
      if current_setting('entities.allow_topology_write', true) is distinct from 'on' then
        raise exception 'topology_write_forbidden' using errcode = '23514';
      end if;
    end if;
  elsif old.status is distinct from new.status or old.merged_into is distinct from new.merged_into then
    if current_setting('entities.allow_topology_write', true) is distinct from 'on' then
      raise exception 'topology_write_forbidden' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists issuers_topology_guard on public.issuers;
create trigger issuers_topology_guard before insert or update of status, merged_into on public.issuers
  for each row execute function public.issuers_topology_guard();
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/datasets.test.ts
import {readFileSync,readdirSync,statSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {CADENCES} from './freshness';
import {DATASETS,DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY,DQ_DATASET_NAMES,inventoryEntry} from './datasets';
import {RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS} from './reconcile/types';

// A dataset literal anywhere but the registry means a producer bypassed DATASETS (spec 3 §6.3).
const LITERAL=/(['"`])(entities\.(?:sec|research-link|identifiers|cninfo|ah-link|windows|sec-submissions)|facts\.(?:us|cn|acceptance)|dq\.(?:calendar\.(?:us|cn)|filer-categories)|reconcile\.[a-z][a-z_.]*)\1/;
// db-contract.ts is a test-fixture module (shared FactsDb contract cases), not a producer.
const EXEMPT=new Set(['src/lib/dq/datasets.ts','src/lib/facts/db-contract.ts']);
function sources(dir:string):string[]{
 const out:string[]=[];
 for(const name of readdirSync(dir)){
  if(name==='node_modules'||name==='fixtures')continue;
  const p=join(dir,name);
  if(statSync(p).isDirectory())out.push(...sources(p));
  else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(name)&&!/\.test\.tsx?$/.test(name))out.push(p.replaceAll('\\','/'));
 }
 return out;
}

describe('DATASETS / DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY',()=>{

   expect(e.dataset.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
   expect(e.dataset.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(64);

 });

   ...RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS.map(p=>DATASETS.reconcile(p)),DATASETS.calendar('US'),DATASETS.calendar('CN')];

 });
 it('runs the four cycle pairs weekly from the reconcile runner and records the inline pairs as events',()=>{

   expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.reconcile(p))).toEqual({dataset:`reconcile.${p}`,producer:'reconcile',cadence:'weekly'});
  expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.reconcile('sec.filing_date_vs_submissions'))).toEqual({dataset:'reconcile.sec.filing_date_vs_submissions',producer:'enrich-acceptance',cadence:'event'});
  expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.reconcile('sec.filer_category'))).toEqual({dataset:'reconcile.sec.filer_category',producer:'filer-categories',cadence:'event'});
  expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.reconcile('entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif'))).toEqual({dataset:'reconcile.entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif',producer:'fill-identifiers',cadence:'event'});
  expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.calendar('US'))).toEqual({dataset:'dq.calendar.us',producer:'filing-calendar',cadence:'daily'});
  expect(inventoryEntry(DATASETS.facts('CN'))).toEqual({dataset:'facts.cn',producer:'facts-sync',cadence:'daily'});
  expect(()=>inventoryEntry('macro.cpi')).toThrow('unknown_dataset:macro.cpi');
 });
 it('finds no hard-coded dataset literal outside the registry',()=>{
  const hits=[...sources('src'),...sources('scripts')].filter(p=>!EXEMPT.has(p)).flatMap(p=>
   readFileSync(p,'utf8').split('\n').flatMap((line,i)=>LITERAL.test(line)?[`${p}:${i+1}`]:[]));

 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/raw-store.test.ts
import {describe,it,expect,vi} from 'vitest';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {RAW_EXT,RECONCILE_RAW_BUCKET,RawStoreError,memoryRawStore,rawMetaPath,rawPath,sha256Hex,supabaseRawStore} from './raw-store';
import type {RawPut} from './raw-store';

const enc=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const dec=(b:Uint8Array|undefined)=>new TextDecoder().decode(b);
const sha=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
const item=(text:string,over:Partial<RawPut>={}):RawPut=>({kind:'sec-submissions',bytes:enc(text),contentType:'application/json',
 meta:{url:'https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000320193.json',fetched_at:'2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z',http_status:200},...over});
const budget=()=>({remainingMs:()=>60_000,signal:new AbortController().signal});
const aborted=()=>{const c=new AbortController();c.abort();return {remainingMs:()=>0,signal:c.signal};};

describe('raw paths',()=>{
 it('content-addresses <kind>/<sha256>.<ext> with a .meta.json sidecar and parses the sha back',()=>{
  const h=sha('{}');
  expect(sha256Hex(enc('{}'))).toBe(h);
  expect(rawPath('sec-submissions',h,'json')).toBe(`sec-submissions/${h}.json`);
  expect(rawMetaPath(`cn-gold-pdf/${h}.pdf`)).toBe(`cn-gold-pdf/${h}.meta.json`);
  expect(RAW_EXT).toEqual({'application/json':'json','text/html':'html','application/pdf':'pdf','text/csv':'csv','application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet':'xlsx','application/zip':'zip'});
  const store=memoryRawStore();
  expect(store.sha256Of(`hkex/${h}.xlsx`)).toBe(h);
  expect(supabaseRawStore({} as never).sha256Of(`gleif/${h}.csv`)).toBe(h);
  for(const bad of [`hkex/${h}.exe`,`nope/${h}.json`,`hkex/${h.slice(1)}.json`,`hkex/${h}.meta.json`,'../etc/passwd'])expect(()=>store.sha256Of(bad)).toThrow(RawStoreError);
 });
});

describe('memoryRawStore',()=>{
 it('stores once at the content address, answers exists on a repeat and keeps the first sidecar',async()=>{
  const store=memoryRawStore();
  const first=await store.put(item('{"a":1}'),budget());
  expect(first).toEqual({sha256:sha('{"a":1}'),path:`sec-submissions/${sha('{"a":1}')}.json`,status:'stored'});
  expect(await store.put(item('{"a":1}',{meta:{fetched_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z'}}))).toEqual({...first,status:'exists'});
  expect(store.objects.get(first.path)).toEqual(enc('{"a":1}'));
  expect(JSON.parse(dec(store.objects.get(rawMetaPath(first.path))))).toEqual({
   url:'https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000320193.json',fetched_at:'2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z',http_status:200,
   kind:'sec-submissions',sha256:first.sha256,bytes:7,content_type:'application/json',
  });
 });
 it('keeps its own copy of the bytes',async()=>{
  const store=memoryRawStore();const it1=item('{"a":1}');
  const {path}=await store.put(it1);
  it1.bytes[0]=0;
  expect(dec(store.objects.get(path))).toBe('{"a":1}');
 });
 it('stores every content type under its extension',async()=>{
  const store=memoryRawStore();
  expect((await store.put({kind:'cn-gold-pdf',bytes:enc('%PDF-1.7'),contentType:'application/pdf'})).path).toBe(`cn-gold-pdf/${sha('%PDF-1.7')}.pdf`);
  expect((await store.put({kind:'hkex',bytes:enc('PK'),contentType:'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'})).path).toBe(`hkex/${sha('PK')}.xlsx`);
 });
 it('refuses an unknown kind or content type, credential-like meta, a non-finite number and an exhausted budget',async()=>{
  const store=memoryRawStore();
  await expect(store.put(item('{}',{kind:'tickers' as never}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: kind:tickers');
  await expect(store.put(item('{}',{contentType:'image/png' as never}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: content_type:image/png');
  await expect(store.put(item('{}',{meta:{url:'https://api.example/x?token=abc'}}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: meta_credential:url');
  await expect(store.put(item('{}',{meta:{url:'https://user:pw@example.com/x'}}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: meta_credential:url');
  await expect(store.put(item('{}',{meta:{n:Number.NaN}}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: meta:n');
  await expect(store.put(item('{}'),aborted())).rejects.toThrow('raw_upload_failed: budget_exhausted');
  expect(store.objects.size).toBe(0);
 });
});

describe('supabaseRawStore',()=>{
 const fake=(upload:(path:string,body:unknown,opts:unknown)=>Promise<{error:unknown}>)=>{const from=vi.fn(()=>({upload}));return {admin:{storage:{from}} as never,from};};
 it('uploads the body then the sidecar with upsert:false into reconcile-raw',async()=>{
  const upload=vi.fn<(path:string,body:unknown,opts:unknown)=>Promise<{error:unknown}>>(async()=>({error:null}));const {admin,from}=fake(upload);
  const out=await supabaseRawStore(admin).put(item('<html/>',{kind:'sec-document',contentType:'text/html',meta:{accession:'0000320193-25-000079'}}),budget());
  expect(out).toEqual({sha256:sha('<html/>'),path:`sec-document/${sha('<html/>')}.html`,status:'stored'});
  expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith(RECONCILE_RAW_BUCKET);
  expect(upload).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  expect(upload.mock.calls[0]).toEqual([out.path,enc('<html/>'),{contentType:'text/html',upsert:false}]);
  expect(upload.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe(rawMetaPath(out.path));

 });
 it('maps 409 / already exists to exists and any other error to raw_upload_failed',async()=>{
  expect((await supabaseRawStore(fake(async()=>({error:{statusCode:'409',message:'The resource already exists'}})).admin).put(item('{}'))).status).toBe('exists');
  expect((await supabaseRawStore(fake(async()=>({error:{message:'Duplicate'}})).admin).put(item('{}'))).status).toBe('exists');
  const down=fake(async()=>({error:{statusCode:500,message:'storage down'}}));

  expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(RawStoreError);

 });
 it('rejects without waiting for a hung upload once the budget aborts',async()=>{

  c.abort();
  await expect(p).rejects.toThrow('raw_upload_failed: budget_exhausted');
 });
 it('validates before any upload',async()=>{

  await expect(supabaseRawStore(admin).put(item('{}',{meta:{u:'https://x.example/?api_key=1'}}))).rejects.toThrow('raw_invalid: meta_credential:u');
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/datasets.ts
// Typed dataset registry (spec 3 §6.3; plan 3 contract C1). Producers take dataset strings ONLY from
// DATASETS (datasets.test.ts scans the source tree for stray literals). DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY lists
// every dataset with its producer and freshness cadence, so the /admin/dq dropdown and the freshness
// panel show datasets that have not run yet, and producers read their cadence from inventoryEntry.
import type {Market} from '../facts/types';
import type {Cadence} from './freshness';
import {RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS,type ReconcilePairId} from './reconcile/types';

export const DATASETS={
 entities:{sec:'entities.sec',researchLink:'entities.research-link',identifiers:'entities.identifiers',cninfo:'entities.cninfo',ahLink:'entities.ah-link',windows:'entities.windows',submissions:'entities.sec-submissions'},
 facts:(m:Market)=>(m==='US'?'facts.us':'facts.cn') as 'facts.us'|'facts.cn',   // landed sync.ts identifiers (spec T4)
 acceptance:'facts.acceptance',
 filerCategories:'dq.filer-categories',
 reconcile:(p:ReconcilePairId)=>`reconcile.${p}` as const,
 calendar:(m:Market)=>(m==='US'?'dq.calendar.us':'dq.calendar.cn') as 'dq.calendar.us'|'dq.calendar.cn',
} as const;
export interface DatasetEntry{dataset:string;producer:string;cadence:Cadence}

const MARKETS:readonly Market[]=['US','CN'];
/** The four cycle pairs run weekly from the reconcile runner; the other three are recorded inline by their producers. */
const RECONCILE_PRODUCERS:Record<ReconcilePairId,{producer:string;cadence:Cadence}>={
 'us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl':{producer:'reconcile',cadence:'weekly'},
 'cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold':{producer:'reconcile',cadence:'weekly'},
 'us.companyfacts_vs_gold':{producer:'reconcile',cadence:'weekly'},
 'facts.lineage_same_day':{producer:'reconcile',cadence:'weekly'},
 'sec.filing_date_vs_submissions':{producer:'enrich-acceptance',cadence:'event'},
 'sec.filer_category':{producer:'filer-categories',cadence:'event'},
 'entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif':{producer:'fill-identifiers',cadence:'event'},
};

export const DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY:readonly DatasetEntry[]=[
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.sec,producer:'sec-company-tickers',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.researchLink,producer:'research-entity-link',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.identifiers,producer:'fill-identifiers',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.cninfo,producer:'fill-cninfo-org-id',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.ahLink,producer:'link-ah',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.windows,producer:'backfill-windows',cadence:'event'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.entities.submissions,producer:'sec-submissions',cadence:'event'},
 ...MARKETS.map((m):DatasetEntry=>({dataset:DATASETS.facts(m),producer:'facts-sync',cadence:'daily'})),
 {dataset:DATASETS.acceptance,producer:'enrich-acceptance',cadence:'daily'},
 {dataset:DATASETS.filerCategories,producer:'filer-categories',cadence:'event'},
 ...RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS.map((p):DatasetEntry=>({dataset:DATASETS.reconcile(p),...RECONCILE_PRODUCERS[p]})),
 ...MARKETS.map((m):DatasetEntry=>({dataset:DATASETS.calendar(m),producer:'filing-calendar',cadence:'daily'})),
];
export const DQ_DATASET_NAMES:readonly string[]=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.map(e=>e.dataset);

/** The registry entry for `dataset`; throws unknown_dataset:<d> for anything not registered. */
export function inventoryEntry(dataset:string):DatasetEntry{
 const e=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);
 if(!e)throw new Error(`unknown_dataset:${dataset}`);
 return e;
}
```

```ts
export type Cadence='daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'|'quarterly'|'event';
export type FreshnessStatus='fresh'|'stale'|'error'|'missing';
const DAY=86_400_000;
const WINDOW_MS:Record<Cadence,number|null>={daily:1*DAY,weekly:7*DAY,monthly:31*DAY,quarterly:92*DAY,event:null};
// Daily grace of 2d lets a weekday-only feed survive a weekend (Fri ok -> Mon is 3d <= 1d+2d); weekly
// (reconcile cycles, spec 3 §3.1) gets the same 2d so one late cron run does not flip it to stale.
const GRACE_MS:Record<Cadence,number>={daily:2*DAY,weekly:2*DAY,monthly:3*DAY,quarterly:3*DAY,event:0};
export const CADENCES:readonly Cadence[]=['daily','weekly','monthly','quarterly','event'];
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/raw-store.ts
// Raw evidence for identifiers, calendar and reconciliation (spec 3 §3.1 bucket reconcile-raw; plan 3
// contract C6). Content-addressed: put() hashes the bytes itself and stores them at
// <kind>/<sha256>.<ext> plus a <kind>/<sha256>.meta.json sidecar, both with upsert:false, so identical
// bytes fetched again answer 'exists' and stored evidence is never rewritten (the first sidecar wins).
// The sidecar holds metadata only: values that look like credentials (URL userinfo, token-like query
// parameters) are refused before any upload. Any other upload failure is
// RawStoreError('raw_upload_failed'): the caller marks that issuer/file failed and writes no row that
// depends on it. The budget's abort signal cuts the wait. Mirrors src/lib/facts/snapshot-store.ts.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type {Budget} from '../facts/types';

export const RECONCILE_RAW_BUCKET='reconcile-raw';
export type RawKind='sec-submissions'|'sec-document'|'openfigi'|'gleif'|'hkex'|'tushare-disclosure'|'cn-gold-pdf';
export const RAW_KINDS:readonly RawKind[]=['sec-submissions','sec-document','openfigi','gleif','hkex','tushare-disclosure','cn-gold-pdf'];
export type RawContentType='application/json'|'text/html'|'application/pdf'|'text/csv'|'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'|'application/zip';
export interface RawPut{kind:RawKind;bytes:Uint8Array;contentType:RawContentType;meta?:Record<string,string|number>}
export interface RawStored{sha256:string;path:string;status:'stored'|'exists'}
export interface RawStore{put(item:RawPut,budget?:Budget):Promise<RawStored>;sha256Of(path:string):string}
export const RAW_EXT:Record<RawContentType,string>={
 'application/json':'json','text/html':'html','application/pdf':'pdf','text/csv':'csv',
 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet':'xlsx','application/zip':'zip',
};
export const rawPath=(kind:RawKind,sha256:string,ext:string)=>`${kind}/${sha256}.${ext}`;
export const rawMetaPath=(path:string)=>path.replace(/\.[a-z]+$/,'.meta.json');

export class RawStoreError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly code:'raw_upload_failed'|'raw_invalid',readonly reason?:string){
  super(reason?`${code}: ${reason}`:code);
  this.name='RawStoreError';
 }
}

const PATH=new RegExp(`^(${RAW_KINDS.join('|')})/([0-9a-f]{64})\\.(${Object.values(RAW_EXT).join('|')})$`);
const CREDENTIAL=/:\/\/[^/\s]*@|[?&#](?:token|key|apikey|api_key|access_token|sig|signature|auth|secret|password)=/i;

export const sha256Hex=(bytes:Uint8Array):string=>createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');

/** The sha256 a content-addressed data path names; throws raw_invalid for anything else (sidecars included). */
function sha256Of(path:string):string{
 const m=PATH.exec(path);
 if(!m)throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid',`path:${path.slice(0,80)}`);
 return m[2];
}

function prepare(item:RawPut):{sha256:string;path:string;meta:string}{
 if(!RAW_KINDS.includes(item.kind))throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid',`kind:${String(item.kind).slice(0,40)}`);
 const ext=RAW_EXT[item.contentType];
 if(!ext)throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid',`content_type:${String(item.contentType).slice(0,80)}`);
 if(!(item.bytes instanceof Uint8Array))throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid','bytes');
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(item.meta??{})){
  if(typeof v==='number'?!Number.isFinite(v):typeof v!=='string')throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid',`meta:${k}`);
  if(typeof v==='string'&&CREDENTIAL.test(v))throw new RawStoreError('raw_invalid',`meta_credential:${k}`);
 }
 const sha256=sha256Hex(item.bytes);
 // System keys last: caller meta can never overwrite what the sidecar asserts about the bytes.
 const meta=JSON.stringify({...item.meta,kind:item.kind,sha256,bytes:item.bytes.byteLength,content_type:item.contentType});
 return {sha256,path:rawPath(item.kind,sha256,ext),meta};
}

interface UploadError{message:string;statusCode?:string|number;status?:number}
const isExists=(e:UploadError)=>String(e.statusCode??e.status??'')==='409'||/already exists|duplicate/i.test(e.message);

function withinBudget<T>(p:Promise<T>,budget?:Budget):Promise<T>{
 if(!budget)return p;
 if(budget.signal.aborted)return Promise.reject(new RawStoreError('raw_upload_failed','budget_exhausted'));
 return new Promise<T>((resolve,reject)=>{
  const onAbort=()=>reject(new RawStoreError('raw_upload_failed','budget_exhausted'));
  budget.signal.addEventListener('abort',onAbort,{once:true});
  p.then(v=>{budget.signal.removeEventListener('abort',onAbort);resolve(v);},e=>{budget.signal.removeEventListener('abort',onAbort);reject(e);});
 });
}

export function supabaseRawStore(admin:SupabaseClient):RawStore{
 const bucket=()=>admin.storage.from(RECONCILE_RAW_BUCKET);
 const upload=async(path:string,body:Uint8Array|string,contentType:string,budget?:Budget):Promise<'stored'|'exists'>=>{
  const {error}=await withinBudget(bucket().upload(path,body,{contentType,upsert:false}),budget);
  if(!error)return 'stored';
  if(isExists(error as UploadError))return 'exists';
  throw new RawStoreError('raw_upload_failed',(error as UploadError).message);
 };
 return {
  sha256Of,
  async put(item,budget){
   const {sha256,path,meta}=prepare(item);
   const status=await upload(path,item.bytes,item.contentType,budget);
   await upload(rawMetaPath(path),meta,'application/json',budget);
   return {sha256,path,status};
  },
 };
}

export function memoryRawStore():RawStore&{objects:Map<string,Uint8Array>}{
 const objects=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();
 return {
  objects,
  sha256Of,
  async put(item,budget){
   const {sha256,path,meta}=prepare(item);
   if(budget?.signal.aborted)throw new RawStoreError('raw_upload_failed','budget_exhausted');
   if(objects.has(path))return {sha256,path,status:'exists'};
   // a copy: later mutation of the caller's buffer cannot rewrite evidence
   objects.set(path,new Uint8Array(item.bytes));
   objects.set(rawMetaPath(path),new TextEncoder().encode(meta));
   return {sha256,path,status:'stored'};
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
const code=(p:unknown,allowed?:readonly string[])=>{
 try{sanitizeProvenance(p,allowed);return 'ok';}
 catch(e){return e instanceof ProvenanceError?`${e.code}@${e.path}`:'other';}
};

describe('sanitizeProvenance',()=>{
 it('keeps the whitelisted keys of spec 3 §3.1 and returns a deep copy',()=>{
  const p={
   valid_from:{source:'stocks_universe.list_date',provider:'tushare',as_of:'2026-11-05',row:{list_date:'2001-08-27',source:'tushare',source_updated_at:'2026-11-04T00:00:00Z'}},
   figi:{source:'openfigi',as_of:'2026-11-05',evidence_sha256:'a'.repeat(64),job:{idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'CNE0000018R8'},level:'composite'},
   pending_change:{first_missing_as_of:'2026-11-01',first_missing_sha256:'b'.repeat(64),replacement_tickers:['NEW'],sources:['sec_company_tickers_exchange']},
  };
  const out=sanitizeProvenance(p);
  expect(out).toEqual(p);
  (out.valid_from as {row:{list_date:string}}).row.list_date='x';
  expect(p.valid_from.row.list_date).toBe('2001-08-27');
  expect(sanitizeProvenance({})).toEqual({});
  expect(PROVENANCE_KEYS).toEqual(['isin','figi','valid_from','valid_to','pending_change']);
 });
 it('rejects unknown top-level keys, secret-looking keys, URL credentials, UUIDs, bad values, depth and size',()=>{
  expect(code({exchange:'NYSE'})).toBe('unknown_key@exchange');
  expect(code({valid_from:{source:'x',api_key:'k'}})).toBe('secret_key@$.valid_from.api_key');
  expect(code({valid_from:{source:'x',row:{user_id:'u'}}})).toBe('secret_key@$.valid_from.row.user_id');
  expect(code({isin:{locator:'https://api.example/x?token=abc'}})).toBe('url_credentials@$.isin.locator');
  expect(code({isin:{locator:'https://bob:pw@example.com/f.csv'}})).toBe('url_credentials@$.isin.locator');
  expect(code({isin:{locator:'https://www.hkex.com.hk/eng/services/trading/securities/securitieslists/ListOfSecurities.xlsx'}})).toBe('ok');
  expect(code({valid_from:{source:'curated',entity:'5f0c1d2e-3a4b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f'}})).toBe('uuid_value@$.valid_from.entity');
  expect(code({figi:{level:Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY}})).toBe('bad_value@$.figi.level');
  expect(code({figi:{at:new Date(0)}})).toBe('bad_value@$.figi.at');
  expect(code([])).toBe('not_object@$');
  expect(code(null)).toBe('not_object@$');
  expect(code({valid_from:{a:{b:{c:{d:{e:{f:{g:1}}}}}}}})).toBe('too_deep@$.valid_from.a.b.c.d.e.f');
  expect(code({figi:{x:'y'.repeat(9000)}})).toBe('too_large@$');
 });
 it('takes another whitelist for issuer provenance',()=>{

 });
});
```

```ts
const SHA='b'.repeat(64);
const EV:ClaimEvidence={source:'gleif',as_of:'2026-11-05',evidence_sha256:SHA};
const I='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
const issuerT={issuer_id:I};
const rowT={issuer_id:I,ticker:'600519.SH',valid_from:'2001-08-27'};
const d=(over:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:'hard_identifier',target:issuerT,params:{},evidence:EV,sources:[],...over}) as ClaimDetail;
const verdict=(r:ReturnType<typeof validateClaimDetail>)=>r.ok?'ok':r.error;
const client=()=>memoryTableClient({issuer_identifier_claims:['id']});

afterEach(()=>{vi.useRealTimers();});

describe('claimTargetKey',()=>{
 it('is op:issuer for issuer-level targets and op:issuer|ticker|valid_from for security rows',()=>{
  expect(claimTargetKey('set_identifier',issuerT)).toBe(`set_identifier:${I}`);
  expect(claimTargetKey('close_security',rowT)).toBe(`close_security:${I}|600519.SH|2001-08-27`);
 });
});

describe('validateClaimDetail (mirrors identifier_claim_problem in SQL)',()=>{
 it('accepts one well-formed claim per op',()=>{
  const ok:[Parameters<typeof validateClaimDetail>[0],Parameters<typeof validateClaimDetail>[1],ClaimDetail][]=[
   ['set_identifier','lei',d()],
   ['set_identifier','isin',d({target:rowT,params:{candidates:[{compositeFIGI:'BBG000B9XRY4'}]}})],
   ['correct_identifier','figi',d({target:rowT,params:{expected_current:'BBG000B9XRY4',new_value:'BBG000B9Y5X2'}})],
   ['attach_security','ticker',d({evidence_kind:'name_match',params:{share_class:'H',valid_from:'2004-06-16',valid_from_method:'listing_date',source:'hkex_list_name_match',isin:'CNE1000003G1'}})],
   ['close_security','ticker',d({evidence_kind:'filing_form',target:rowT,params:{valid_to:'2026-03-02',valid_to_method:'delisting'}})],
   ['backdate_window','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{new_valid_from:'2001-08-01',valid_from_method:'ticker_change'}})],
   ['evidence_only','ticker',d({evidence_kind:'filing_form',params:{suggested_op:'backdate_window',accession:'0001234567-26-000001',form:'8-A12B'}})],
  ];
  for(const [op,t,detail] of ok)expect({op,t,r:verdict(validateClaimDetail(op,t,detail))}).toEqual({op,t,r:'ok'});
 });
 it('names the field at fault',()=>{
  const cases:[Parameters<typeof validateClaimDetail>,string][]=[
   [['legacy','lei',d()],'legacy_claim'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',{...d(),schema:'claim/0'}],'invalid_claim:schema'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({evidence_kind:'confidence'})],'invalid_claim:evidence_kind'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({target:{issuer_id:''}})],'invalid_claim:target.issuer_id'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({params:[]})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({evidence:{...EV,evidence_sha256:'XYZ'}})],'invalid_claim:evidence'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({evidence:{...EV,as_of:'2026-02-30'}})],'invalid_claim:evidence'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({sources:[{...EV,source:''}]})],'invalid_claim:sources'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({target:rowT})],'invalid_claim:target'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({target:{issuer_id:I,extra:'x'}})],'invalid_claim:target'],
   [['set_identifier','isin',d()],'invalid_claim:target'],
   [['set_identifier','ticker',d()],'invalid_claim:op_id_type'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({params:{expected_current:'x'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['correct_identifier','lei',d({params:{expected_current:'A',new_value:'A'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['correct_identifier','lei',d({params:{expected_current:'A',new_value:'B'}}),'C'],'invalid_claim:params.new_value'],
   [['attach_security','ticker',d({target:rowT})],'invalid_claim:op_id_type'],
   [['attach_security','ticker',d({params:{share_class:'B',valid_from:'2004-06-16',valid_from_method:'listing_date',source:'x'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['attach_security','ticker',d({params:{share_class:'H',valid_from:'2004-06-16',valid_from_method:'listing_date',source:'x',isin:'CN12'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['close_security','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{valid_to:'2001-08-27',valid_to_method:'delisting'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['close_security','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{valid_to:'2026-03-02',valid_to_method:'vanished'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['close_security','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{valid_to:'2026-03-02',valid_to_method:'delisting'}}),'000001.SZ'],'invalid_claim:target.ticker'],
   [['backdate_window','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{new_valid_from:'2001-09-01',valid_from_method:'listing_date'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['backdate_window','ticker',d({target:rowT,params:{new_valid_from:'2001-08-01',valid_from_method:'first_observed'}})],'invalid_claim:params'],
   [['evidence_only','ticker',d({params:{suggested_op:'merge'}})],'invalid_claim:params.suggested_op'],
   [['evidence_only','lei',d()],'invalid_claim:op_id_type'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({provenance_written:{cik:{source:'x'}}})],'invalid_claim:provenance_written:unknown_key'],
   [['set_identifier','lei',d({provenance_written:{lei:{source:'x',user_id:'u'}}})],'invalid_claim:provenance_written:secret_key'],
   [['evidence_only','ticker',d({provenance_written:{valid_from:{source:'x'}}})],'invalid_claim:provenance_written:unknown_key'],
  ];
  for(const [args,want] of cases)expect({args:JSON.stringify(args),got:verdict(validateClaimDetail(...args))}).toEqual({args:JSON.stringify(args),got:want});
 });
 it('allows exactly the provenance keys the accepted op writes',()=>{
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('set_identifier','lei')).toEqual(['lei']);
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('correct_identifier','isin')).toEqual(['isin']);
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('attach_security','ticker')).toEqual(['isin','figi','valid_from']);
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('close_security','ticker')).toEqual(['valid_to']);
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('backdate_window','ticker')).toEqual(['valid_from']);
  expect(provenanceKeysFor('evidence_only','ticker')).toEqual([]);
  expect(verdict(validateClaimDetail('attach_security','ticker',d({params:{share_class:'A',valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_from_method:'listing_date',source:'x'},provenance_written:{valid_from:{source:'stocks_universe.list_date',as_of:'2026-11-05'}}})))).toBe('ok');
 });
});

describe('claim evidence helpers',()=>{
 it('hashes the canonical JSON of a record (key order never matters) and falls back to today (UTC) for a non-date as_of',()=>{
  vi.useFakeTimers();vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-11-05T10:00:00Z'));
  expect(canonicalJson({b:1,a:{d:[2,{f:1,e:null}],c:'x',u:undefined}})).toBe('{"a":{"c":"x","d":[2,{"e":null,"f":1}]},"b":1}');
  const a=claimEvidence({source:'sec',asOf:'2026-11-04T12:00:00Z',record:{cik:'320193',lei:'HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394'}});
  expect(a).toEqual(claimEvidence({source:'sec',asOf:'2026-11-04',record:{lei:'HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394',cik:'320193'}}));
  expect(a).toEqual({source:'sec',as_of:'2026-11-04',evidence_sha256:expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/)});
  expect(claimEvidence({source:'x',asOf:'garbage',record:{}}).as_of).toBe('2026-11-05');
  expect(claimEvidence({source:'x',record:{},locator:'row:3',note:'n'})).toMatchObject({as_of:'2026-11-05',locator:'row:3',note:'n'});
  expect([isIsoDate('2026-02-28'),isIsoDate('2026-02-30'),isIsoDate('2026-2-3'),isIsoDate(20260228)]).toEqual([true,false,false,false]);
 });
 it('builds a claim/1 detail with an empty sources list by default',()=>{
  expect(buildClaimDetail({evidence_kind:'hard_identifier',target:issuerT,evidence:EV})).toEqual({schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:'hard_identifier',target:issuerT,params:{},evidence:EV,sources:[]});
  expect(buildClaimDetail({evidence_kind:'provider_mapping',target:rowT,params:{candidates:[]},evidence:EV,provenance_written:{isin:{source:'gleif'}}})).toMatchObject({params:{candidates:[]},provenance_written:{isin:{source:'gleif'}}});
 });
});

describe('fileClaim',()=>{
 const input=(over:Partial<ClaimInput>={}):ClaimInput=>({issuer_id:I,id_type:'lei',value:'529900T8BM49AURSDO55',source:'gleif',op:'set_identifier',detail:d(),...over});
 it('writes a claim/1 row: op, target_key, detail with a sources list, no confidence',async()=>{
  const c=client();
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input())).toBe(true);
  expect(c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')).toEqual([{id:expect.any(String),issuer_id:I,id_type:'lei',value:'529900T8BM49AURSDO55',source:'gleif',confidence:null,status:'pending',
   op:'set_identifier',target_key:`set_identifier:${I}`,detail:d(),resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:expect.any(String)}]);
 });
 it('appends only new evidence to the pending claim with the same key and never changes its target or params',async()=>{
  const c=client();
  await fileClaim(c,input());
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input())).toBe(false);                                     // same evidence: nothing appended
  const later={...EV,as_of:'2026-11-06',evidence_sha256:'c'.repeat(64)};
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input({detail:d({evidence:later,params:{note:'other'}})}))).toBe(false);
  expect(c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')[0].detail).toEqual({...d(),sources:[later]});
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input({detail:d({evidence:later})}))).toBe(false);         // already among the sources
  expect((c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')[0].detail as ClaimDetail).sources).toEqual([later]);
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input({op:'correct_identifier',detail:d({params:{expected_current:'HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394',new_value:'529900T8BM49AURSDO55'}})}))).toBe(true);   // another op is another claim
  expect(c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')).toHaveLength(2);
 });
 it('treats a 23505 insert race as the winner existing and appends to it',async()=>{
  const c=client();
  await fileClaim(c,input());
  const select=c.select.bind(c);let blind=true;
  c.select=async(t,m,o)=>{if(t==='issuer_identifier_claims'&&blind){blind=false;return [];}return select(t,m,o);};
  const insert=c.insert.bind(c);
  c.insert=async(t,r)=>{if(t==='issuer_identifier_claims')throw new TableError('insert',t,'duplicate key value violates unique constraint "issuer_identifier_claims_pending_unique"','23505');return insert(t,r);};
  const later={...EV,evidence_sha256:'d'.repeat(64)};
  expect(await fileClaim(c,input({detail:d({evidence:later})}))).toBe(false);
  expect((c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')[0].detail as ClaimDetail).sources).toEqual([later]);
 });
 it('validates before touching the database',async()=>{
  const c=client();
  await expect(fileClaim(c,input({detail:d({target:{issuer_id:'22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222'}})}))).rejects.toThrow('invalid_claim:target.issuer_id');
  await expect(fileClaim(c,input({op:'correct_identifier',detail:d({params:{expected_current:'A',new_value:'B'}})}))).rejects.toThrow('invalid_claim:params.new_value');
  await expect(fileClaim(c,input({source:''}))).rejects.toThrow('invalid_claim:source');
  await expect(fileClaim(c,input({value:''}))).rejects.toThrow('invalid_claim:value');
  await expect(fileClaim(c,{...input(),op:'legacy' as never})).rejects.toThrow('legacy_claim');
  expect(c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')).toEqual([]);
 });
});
```

```ts
describe('attachSecurity',()=>{
 const EV={kind:'provider_mapping' as const,evidence:{source:'sec',as_of:'2026-11-05',evidence_sha256:'e'.repeat(64)}};
 const sec={issuer_id:'a',ticker:'AAPL',share_class:'common' as const,is_primary:true,valid_from:'2000-01-01',source:'sec',claimEvidence:EV};
 const closed=(valid_to:string)=>({valid_to,valid_to_method:'unrecorded' as const});
 const claimKeys=(c:ReturnType<typeof client>)=>c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims').map(r=>({issuer_id:r.issuer_id,op:r.op,id_type:r.id_type,value:r.value,target_key:r.target_key}));
 const raceInsert=(c:ReturnType<typeof client>,owner:string,code='23505')=>{
  const base=c.insert.bind(c);let raced=false;
  c.insert=async(t,row)=>{if(t==='issuer_securities'&&!raced){raced=true;await base(t,{...row,issuer_id:owner,valid_from:'1999-01-01'});throw dupErr(t,code);}return base(t,row);};
 };

 });

 });
 it('reports conflict without a claim when a closed window overlaps another issuer',async()=>{

  expect(c.rows('issuer_securities')).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(c.rows('issuer_identifier_claims')).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('reports duplicate when a closed interval is replayed',async()=>{
  const c=client();

  expect(c.rows('issuer_securities')).toEqual([]);
  const prov={valid_from:{source:'sec_company_tickers_exchange',as_of:'2026-11-05',row:{exchange:'Nasdaq'}}};
  await attachSecurity(c,{...sec,provenance:prov});
  expect(c.rows('issuer_securities')[0].provenance).toEqual(prov);
 });
 it('maps the inactive-issuer trigger (SQLSTATE 23514) to issuer_not_active and rethrows other check violations',async()=>{
  const c=client();
  c.insert=async(t)=>{throw new TableError('insert',t,'issuer_not_active: issuer a (status merged) cannot hold open security AAPL','23514');};
  await expect(attachSecurity(c,sec)).rejects.toThrow(/^issuer_not_active$/);
  c.insert=async(t)=>{throw new TableError('insert',t,'new row violates check constraint "issuer_securities_window"','23514');};
  await expect(attachSecurity(c,sec)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(TableError);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/types.ts
// Issuer master-data shapes (spec 2026-11-04 data foundation §3.1–3.2; spec 3 §3.1, §4.2.1; plan 3
// contract C2).
import type {ShareClass,ValidFromMethod,ValidToMethod} from '@/lib/supabase/database.types';
export type {ShareClass,ValidFromMethod,ValidToMethod} from '@/lib/supabase/database.types';
export type HardIdType='lei'|'cik'|'usci';
/** id_type values allowed by the issuer_identifier_claims check constraint. */
export type ClaimIdType=HardIdType|'isin'|'figi'|'cninfo_org_id'|'ticker';
export type ClaimOp='legacy'|'evidence_only'|'set_identifier'|'correct_identifier'|'attach_security'|'close_security'|'backdate_window';
/** Evidence class of a claim (facts vs judgments: a class, never a confidence number). */
export type EvidenceKind='hard_identifier'|'official_list'|'name_match'|'filing_form'|'provider_mapping';
export interface ClaimTarget{issuer_id:string;ticker?:string;valid_from?:string}
export interface ClaimEvidence{source:string;as_of:string;evidence_sha256:string;locator?:string;note?:string}
export interface ClaimDetail{schema:'claim/1';evidence_kind:EvidenceKind;target:ClaimTarget;params:Record<string,unknown>;evidence:ClaimEvidence;sources:ClaimEvidence[];provenance_written?:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface IssuerIdentifiers{lei?:string|null;cik?:string|null;usci?:string|null;cninfo_org_id?:string|null}
export interface IssuerInput extends IssuerIdentifiers{
 canonical_name_zh?:string|null;canonical_name_en?:string|null;country_code?:string|null;hkex_stock_code_primary?:string|null;
 provenance?:Record<string,unknown>;
}
export interface Issuer extends IssuerInput{issuer_id:string;status:'active'|'merged'|'dissolved';merged_into?:string|null}
/** What a writer carries so an ISIN contradiction can become a claim/1 claim (spec 3 §4.2.1). */
export interface SecurityClaimEvidence{kind:EvidenceKind;evidence:ClaimEvidence}
export interface IssuerSecurityInput{
 issuer_id:string;ticker:string;isin?:string|null;figi?:string|null;share_class:ShareClass;is_primary?:boolean;valid_from:string;valid_to?:string|null;
 /** default: source==='curated' ? 'curated' : 'first_observed' */
 valid_from_method?:ValidFromMethod;
 /** required when valid_to is set, absent/null otherwise */
 valid_to_method?:ValidToMethod|null;
 source:string;
 /** public: only PROVENANCE_KEYS (sanitizeProvenance) */
 provenance?:Record<string,unknown>;
 /** without it an ISIN contradiction is reported as 'conflict' but no claim is filed */
 claimEvidence?:SecurityClaimEvidence;
}
```
