```ts
// src/lib/entities/provenance.ts
// Public provenance whitelist (spec 3 §3.1; plan 3 contract C2). issuer_securities.provenance and
// issuers.provenance are anon-readable, so writers pass every object through sanitizeProvenance: only
// whitelisted top-level keys; nested values may carry source names, ids, dates, hashes and the source
// row values an evidence method copied, never a secret-looking key, URL credentials or a token-like
// query parameter, or a UUID (user ids are UUIDs; no public provenance value needs one).
export const PROVENANCE_KEYS=['isin','figi','valid_from','valid_to','pending_change'] as const;
export const ISSUER_PROVENANCE_KEYS=['lei','cik','usci','cninfo_org_id','hkex_stock_code_primary','canonical_name_zh','canonical_name_en','country_code'] as const;
export type ProvenanceErrorCode='not_object'|'unknown_key'|'secret_key'|'url_credentials'|'uuid_value'|'bad_value'|'too_deep'|'too_large';

export class ProvenanceError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly code:ProvenanceErrorCode,readonly path:string){
  super(`provenance_rejected:${code}:${path}`);
  this.name='ProvenanceError';
 }
}

const SECRET_KEY=/token|secret|passw|api[_-]?key|apikey|auth|cookie|session|credential|private|user_?id|email/i;
const UUID=/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/i;
const URL_CREDENTIALS=/:\/\/[^/\s]*@|[?&#](?:token|key|apikey|api_key|access_token|sig|signature|auth|secret|password|code)=/i;
const MAX_DEPTH=6;
const MAX_JSON=8192;
const isPlainObject=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&Object.getPrototypeOf(v)===Object.prototype;

function clean(v:unknown,path:string,depth:number):unknown{
 if(depth>MAX_DEPTH)throw new ProvenanceError('too_deep',path);
 if(v===null||typeof v==='boolean')return v;
 if(typeof v==='number'){if(!Number.isFinite(v))throw new ProvenanceError('bad_value',path);return v;}
 if(typeof v==='string'){
  if(UUID.test(v))throw new ProvenanceError('uuid_value',path);
  if(URL_CREDENTIALS.test(v))throw new ProvenanceError('url_credentials',path);
  return v;
 }
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map((x,i)=>clean(x,`${path}[${i}]`,depth+1));
 if(isPlainObject(v)){
  const out:Record<string,unknown>={};
  for(const [k,x] of Object.entries(v)){
   if(SECRET_KEY.test(k))throw new ProvenanceError('secret_key',`${path}.${k}`);
   if(x===undefined)continue;
   out[k]=clean(x,`${path}.${k}`,depth+1);
  }
  return out;
 }
 throw new ProvenanceError('bad_value',path);
}

/** A deep copy of `p` restricted to `allowed` top-level keys; throws ProvenanceError on anything unsafe. */
export function sanitizeProvenance(p:unknown,allowed:readonly string[]=PROVENANCE_KEYS):Record<string,unknown>{
 if(!isPlainObject(p))throw new ProvenanceError('not_object','$');
 for(const k of Object.keys(p))if(!allowed.includes(k))throw new ProvenanceError('unknown_key',k);
 const out=clean(p,'$',0) as Record<string,unknown>;
 if(JSON.stringify(out).length>MAX_JSON)throw new ProvenanceError('too_large','$');
 return out;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/claims.ts
// Pending issuer_identifier_claims in the claim/1 shape (spec 3 §4.2.1; plan 3 contract C2): the review
// queue for identifier and window changes that contradict stored data or need a human decision.
// validateClaimDetail mirrors the SQL check identifier_claim_problem that resolve_identifier_claim
// runs again on acceptance: keep the two in step (migration 20261107090000). A claim is keyed by
// (issuer_id, id_type, value, op, target_key) while pending (partial unique index); filing the same key
// again only appends new evidence to detail.sources and never changes target or params.
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {TableError} from '../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {ProvenanceError,sanitizeProvenance} from './provenance';
import type {ClaimDetail,ClaimEvidence,ClaimIdType,ClaimOp,ClaimTarget,EvidenceKind} from './types';

/** Unique (23505) or exclusion (23P01) violation, i.e. another row already holds the key. */
export const isUnique=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof TableError&&(e.code==='23505'||e.code==='23P01');

export interface ClaimInput{issuer_id:string;id_type:ClaimIdType;value:string;source:string;op:Exclude<ClaimOp,'legacy'>;detail:ClaimDetail}
export const CLAIM_SCHEMA='claim/1';
export const EVIDENCE_KINDS:readonly EvidenceKind[]=['hard_identifier','official_list','name_match','filing_form','provider_mapping'];
const ISSUER_COLUMNS:readonly string[]=['lei','cik','usci','cninfo_org_id'];
const SECURITY_COLUMNS:readonly string[]=['isin','figi'];
const SHARE_CLASSES:readonly string[]=['A','H','ADR','common','preferred','other','unknown'];
const FROM_METHODS:readonly string[]=['first_observed','listing_date','ticker_change','curated'];
const TO_METHODS:readonly string[]=['delisting','ticker_change','sec_file_absent','curated','merge_close','unrecorded'];
const BACKDATE_METHODS:readonly string[]=['listing_date','ticker_change','curated'];
const SUGGESTED_OPS:readonly string[]=['attach_security','close_security','backdate_window'];
const ISIN=/^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{9}[0-9]$/;
const SHA256=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

const isObj=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);
const str=(v:unknown,max=64):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>=1&&v.length<=max;
const onlyKeys=(o:Record<string,unknown>,allowed:readonly string[])=>Object.keys(o).every(k=>allowed.includes(k));

/** A real calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD (2026-02-30 is not). */
export function isIsoDate(v:unknown):v is string{
 if(typeof v!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v))return false;
 const d=new Date(`${v}T00:00:00Z`);
 return Number.isFinite(d.getTime())&&d.toISOString().slice(0,10)===v;
}
const validEvidence=(e:unknown):e is ClaimEvidence=>isObj(e)&&str(e.source)&&isIsoDate(e.as_of)&&typeof e.evidence_sha256==='string'&&SHA256.test(e.evidence_sha256 as string)
 &&(e.locator===undefined||typeof e.locator==='string')&&(e.note===undefined||typeof e.note==='string');

/** op ':' issuer_id, or op ':' issuer_id '|' ticker '|' valid_from (= SQL identifier_claim_target_key). */
export function claimTargetKey(op:ClaimOp,target:ClaimTarget):string{
 return target.ticker!==undefined?`${op}:${target.issuer_id}|${target.ticker}|${target.valid_from}`:`${op}:${target.issuer_id}`;
}

/** Provenance keys an accepted claim may write to its target row (detail.provenance_written). */
export function provenanceKeysFor(op:ClaimOp,idType:ClaimIdType):readonly string[]{
 if(op==='set_identifier'||op==='correct_identifier')return [idType];
 if(op==='attach_security')return ['isin','figi','valid_from'];
 if(op==='close_security')return ['valid_to'];
 if(op==='backdate_window')return ['valid_from'];
 return [];
}

type Verdict={ok:true}|{ok:false;error:string};
const bad=(field:string):Verdict=>({ok:false,error:`invalid_claim:${field}`});

/**
 * claim/1 check for (op, id_type, detail) per spec 3 §4.2.1; with `value`, also that the claim's value
 * column agrees (correct_identifier new_value, close/backdate target.ticker). Unknown top-level detail
 * keys are allowed (amend bookkeeping); unknown params keys are not, except for evidence_only.
 */
export function validateClaimDetail(op:ClaimOp,idType:ClaimIdType,detail:unknown,value?:string):Verdict{
 if(op==='legacy')return {ok:false,error:'legacy_claim'};
 if(!isObj(detail)||detail.schema!==CLAIM_SCHEMA)return bad('schema');
 if(!EVIDENCE_KINDS.includes(detail.evidence_kind as EvidenceKind))return bad('evidence_kind');
 const t=detail.target,pa=detail.params;
 if(!isObj(t)||!str(t.issuer_id))return bad('target.issuer_id');
 if(!isObj(pa))return bad('params');
 if(!validEvidence(detail.evidence))return bad('evidence');
 if(!Array.isArray(detail.sources)||!detail.sources.every(validEvidence))return bad('sources');
 if(detail.provenance_written!==undefined&&!isObj(detail.provenance_written))return bad('provenance_written');
 const full='ticker' in t||'valid_from' in t;
 if(full){if(!str(t.ticker,32)||!isIsoDate(t.valid_from)||Object.keys(t).length!==3)return bad('target');}
 else if(Object.keys(t).length!==1)return bad('target');
 switch(op){
  case 'set_identifier':
  case 'correct_identifier':
   if(ISSUER_COLUMNS.includes(idType)){if(full)return bad('target');}
   else if(SECURITY_COLUMNS.includes(idType)){if(!full)return bad('target');}
   else return bad('op_id_type');
   if(op==='set_identifier'){
    if(!onlyKeys(pa,['candidates','note'])||(pa.candidates!==undefined&&!Array.isArray(pa.candidates))||(pa.note!==undefined&&typeof pa.note!=='string'))return bad('params');
   }else{
    if(!onlyKeys(pa,['expected_current','new_value','candidates','note'])||!str(pa.expected_current)||!str(pa.new_value)||pa.expected_current===pa.new_value)return bad('params');
    if(value!==undefined&&pa.new_value!==value)return bad('params.new_value');
   }
   break;
  case 'attach_security':
   if(idType!=='ticker'||full)return bad('op_id_type');
   if(!onlyKeys(pa,['share_class','valid_from','valid_from_method','source','isin','note'])||!SHARE_CLASSES.includes(pa.share_class as string)
    ||!isIsoDate(pa.valid_from)||!FROM_METHODS.includes(pa.valid_from_method as string)||!str(pa.source)
    ||(pa.isin!==undefined&&pa.isin!==null&&!(typeof pa.isin==='string'&&ISIN.test(pa.isin as string))))return bad('params');
   break;
  case 'close_security':
  case 'backdate_window':
   if(idType!=='ticker'||!full)return bad('op_id_type');
   if(value!==undefined&&t.ticker!==value)return bad('target.ticker');
   if(op==='close_security'){
    if(!onlyKeys(pa,['valid_to','valid_to_method','note'])||!isIsoDate(pa.valid_to)||!TO_METHODS.includes(pa.valid_to_method as string)||(pa.valid_to as string)<=(t.valid_from as string))return bad('params');
   }else if(!onlyKeys(pa,['new_valid_from','valid_from_method','note'])||!isIsoDate(pa.new_valid_from)||!BACKDATE_METHODS.includes(pa.valid_from_method as string)||(pa.new_valid_from as string)>=(t.valid_from as string))return bad('params');
   break;
  case 'evidence_only':
   if(idType!=='ticker'||full)return bad('op_id_type');
   if('suggested_op' in pa&&!SUGGESTED_OPS.includes(String(pa.suggested_op)))return bad('params.suggested_op');
   break;
  default:
   return bad('op');
 }
 if(detail.provenance_written!==undefined){
  try{sanitizeProvenance(detail.provenance_written,provenanceKeysFor(op,idType));}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof ProvenanceError)return bad(`provenance_written:${e.code}`);throw e;}
 }
 return {ok:true};
}

/** Canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level, undefined dropped): the bytes whose sha256 names a record. */
export function canonicalJson(v:unknown):string{
 if(Array.isArray(v))return `[${v.map(canonicalJson).join(',')}]`;
 if(isObj(v))return `{${Object.keys(v).sort().filter(k=>v[k]!==undefined).map(k=>`${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonicalJson(v[k])}`).join(',')}}`;
 return JSON.stringify(v??null);
}

/** Evidence for a claim derived from an input record: sha256 over its canonical JSON; as_of is the record's date (first 10 chars) or today (UTC). */
export function claimEvidence(input:{source:string;asOf?:unknown;record:unknown;locator?:string;note?:string}):ClaimEvidence{
 const day=typeof input.asOf==='string'?input.asOf.slice(0,10):'';
 return {
  source:input.source,as_of:isIsoDate(day)?day:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),
  evidence_sha256:createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJson(input.record)).digest('hex'),
  ...(input.locator?{locator:input.locator}:{}),...(input.note?{note:input.note}:{}),
 };
}

export function buildClaimDetail(input:{evidence_kind:EvidenceKind;target:ClaimTarget;params?:Record<string,unknown>;evidence:ClaimEvidence;sources?:ClaimEvidence[];provenance_written?:Record<string,unknown>}):ClaimDetail{
 return {schema:CLAIM_SCHEMA,evidence_kind:input.evidence_kind,target:input.target,params:input.params??{},evidence:input.evidence,sources:input.sources??[],
  ...(input.provenance_written?{provenance_written:input.provenance_written}:{})};
}

const sameEvidence=(a:unknown,b:ClaimEvidence)=>isObj(a)&&a.source===b.source&&a.evidence_sha256===b.evidence_sha256;

/** Appends `evidence` to the pending claim matching `key` unless it is already its evidence or a source. */
async function appendEvidence(client:TableClient,key:Row,evidence:ClaimEvidence):Promise<false>{
 const [row]=await client.select('issuer_identifier_claims',key,{limit:1});
 if(!row)return false;
 const detail=isObj(row.detail)?row.detail:{};
 const sources=Array.isArray(detail.sources)?detail.sources:[];
 if(sameEvidence(detail.evidence,evidence)||sources.some(s=>sameEvidence(s,evidence)))return false;
 // Guarded on the row still pending. A concurrent append may be lost: sources are supplementary
 // evidence, the claim itself and its first evidence are never touched.
 await client.update('issuer_identifier_claims',{id:row.id,status:'pending'},{detail:{...detail,sources:[...sources,evidence]}});
 return false;
}

/**
 * Files a pending claim/1 claim. Validates first (throws invalid_claim:<field> / legacy_claim, no DB
 * access). The same pending (issuer_id, id_type, value, op, target_key) → appends the new evidence to
 * detail.sources and returns false; a concurrent duplicate (23505 on the partial unique index) is
 * treated the same way. Returns whether a new claim row was written.
 */
export async function fileClaim(client:TableClient,c:ClaimInput):Promise<boolean>{
 const v=validateClaimDetail(c.op,c.id_type,c.detail,c.value);
 if(!v.ok)throw new Error(v.error);
 if(c.detail.target.issuer_id!==c.issuer_id)throw new Error('invalid_claim:target.issuer_id');
 if(!str(c.source))throw new Error('invalid_claim:source');
 if(!str(c.value))throw new Error('invalid_claim:value');
 const target_key=claimTargetKey(c.op,c.detail.target);
 const key:Row={issuer_id:c.issuer_id,id_type:c.id_type,value:c.value,op:c.op,target_key,status:'pending'};
 if((await client.select('issuer_identifier_claims',key,{limit:1})).length)return appendEvidence(client,key,c.detail.evidence);
 try{
  await client.insert('issuer_identifier_claims',{
   id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:c.issuer_id,id_type:c.id_type,value:c.value,source:c.source,confidence:null,status:'pending',
   op:c.op,target_key,detail:{...c.detail,sources:c.detail.sources??[]},resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:new Date().toISOString(),
  });
  return true;
 }catch(e){
  if(isUnique(e))return appendEvidence(client,key,c.detail.evidence);
  throw e;
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/securities.ts
// Ticker ownership over time. The DB enforces one open owner per ticker and no overlapping
// half-open [valid_from, valid_to) windows; this module classifies an incoming window against the
// rows it overlaps and turns those violations into 'duplicate' / 'conflict' outcomes.
// Plan 3 (spec 3 §3.1, §4.2.1; contract C2): every inserted row carries valid_from_method /
// valid_to_method (defaults: curated source → 'curated', else 'first_observed'; a closed window must
// name its method), provenance passes the public whitelist (sanitizeProvenance) before any DB access,
// and an ISIN contradiction becomes a claim/1 claim when the caller supplies claimEvidence: a row of
// this issuer → set_identifier / correct_identifier on that row; another holder (open incoming window
// only) → attach_security for the incoming security. Closed-history conflicts are only reported.
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {buildClaimDetail,fileClaim,isUnique} from './claims';
import {isBlank,normalizeIsin,normalizeTicker} from './normalize';
import {sanitizeProvenance} from './provenance';
import type {IssuerSecurityInput,ValidFromMethod,ValidToMethod} from './types';

export type AttachResult='inserted'|'duplicate'|'conflict';
export const VALID_FROM_METHODS:readonly ValidFromMethod[]=['first_observed','listing_date','ticker_change','curated'];
export const VALID_TO_METHODS:readonly ValidToMethod[]=['delisting','ticker_change','sec_file_absent','curated','merge_close','unrecorded'];

type Window={valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null};
const str=(v:unknown)=>v==null?null:String(v);
/** Half-open overlap with null valid_to = +∞. Dates are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD', so text order is date order. */
const overlaps=(r:Row,w:Window)=>{
 const from=String(r.valid_from),to=str(r.valid_to);
 return (w.valid_to===null||from<w.valid_to)&&(to===null||w.valid_from<to);
};

/** Window-end methods for an incoming row; throws invalid_security:<field> on a missing or unknown method. */
export function securityMethods(raw:Pick<IssuerSecurityInput,'source'|'valid_from_method'|'valid_to_method'>,validTo:string|null):{valid_from_method:ValidFromMethod;valid_to_method:ValidToMethod|null}{
 const from=raw.valid_from_method??(raw.source==='curated'?'curated':'first_observed');
 if(!VALID_FROM_METHODS.includes(from))throw new Error('invalid_security:valid_from_method');
 const to=raw.valid_to_method??null;
 if(validTo===null){
  if(to!==null)throw new Error('invalid_security:valid_to_method');
  return {valid_from_method:from,valid_to_method:null};
 }
 if(to===null||!VALID_TO_METHODS.includes(to))throw new Error('invalid_security:valid_to_method');
 return {valid_from_method:from,valid_to_method:to};
}

export async function attachSecurity(client:TableClient,raw:IssuerSecurityInput):Promise<AttachResult>{
 const sec={...raw,ticker:normalizeTicker(raw.ticker),isin:normalizeIsin(raw.isin),valid_to:isBlank(raw.valid_to)?null:String(raw.valid_to)};
 const methods=securityMethods(raw,sec.valid_to);
 const provenance=sanitizeProvenance(raw.provenance??{});
 /** ISIN claim against a row of this issuer: set when the row has none, correct when it differs. */
 const claimOnRow=async(row:Row)=>{
  if(!sec.isin||!raw.claimEvidence)return;
  const current=str(row.isin);
  const op=current===null?'set_identifier':'correct_identifier';
  await fileClaim(client,{issuer_id:sec.issuer_id,id_type:'isin',value:sec.isin,source:sec.source,op,
   detail:buildClaimDetail({evidence_kind:raw.claimEvidence.kind,target:{issuer_id:sec.issuer_id,ticker:sec.ticker,valid_from:String(row.valid_from)},
    params:current===null?{}:{expected_current:current,new_value:sec.isin},evidence:raw.claimEvidence.evidence})});
 };
 /** Another holder blocks the window: an open incoming window with an ISIN becomes attach_security. */
 const claimAttach=async()=>{
  if(!sec.isin||!raw.claimEvidence||sec.valid_to!==null)return;
  await fileClaim(client,{issuer_id:sec.issuer_id,id_type:'ticker',value:sec.ticker,source:sec.source,op:'attach_security',
   detail:buildClaimDetail({evidence_kind:raw.claimEvidence.kind,target:{issuer_id:sec.issuer_id},
    params:{share_class:sec.share_class,valid_from:sec.valid_from,valid_from_method:methods.valid_from_method,source:sec.source,isin:sec.isin},evidence:raw.claimEvidence.evidence})});
 };
 /** null when nothing on this ticker overlaps the incoming window (safe to insert). */
 const classify=async():Promise<AttachResult|null>=>{
  // A ticker has a handful of ownership rows at most; overlap is computed here, not in SQL.
  const rows=await client.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:sec.ticker},{orderBy:'valid_from'});
  const same=rows.find(r=>r.issuer_id===sec.issuer_id&&String(r.valid_from)===sec.valid_from);
  if(same){
   // Same primary key: a replay is a duplicate only if the window end and (when given) ISIN agree.
   // An absent incoming ISIN carries no information and never contradicts a stored one.
   const isinDiffers=sec.isin!==null&&same.isin!==sec.isin;
   if(str(same.valid_to)===sec.valid_to&&!isinDiffers)return 'duplicate';
   if(isinDiffers)await claimOnRow(same);
   return 'conflict';
  }
  const hit=rows.filter(r=>overlaps(r,sec));
  if(!hit.length)return null;
  // Same issuer under a different valid_from: a duplicate unless the incoming ISIN contradicts an
  // overlapping row's ISIN (an absent incoming ISIN never contradicts).
  if(hit.every(r=>r.issuer_id===sec.issuer_id)){
   const differing=sec.isin===null?undefined:hit.find(r=>r.isin!==sec.isin);
   if(!differing)return 'duplicate';
   await claimOnRow(differing);
   return 'conflict';
  }
  await claimAttach();
  return 'conflict';
 };
 const before=await classify();
 if(before)return before;
 try{
  await client.insert('issuer_securities',{
   issuer_id:sec.issuer_id,ticker:sec.ticker,isin:sec.isin,figi:sec.figi??null,share_class:sec.share_class,
   is_primary:sec.is_primary??false,valid_from:sec.valid_from,valid_to:sec.valid_to,
   valid_from_method:methods.valid_from_method,valid_to_method:methods.valid_to_method,source:sec.source,provenance,
  });
  return 'inserted';
 }catch(e){
  const code=(e as {code?:unknown})?.code;
  if(code==='23514'&&e instanceof Error&&e.message.includes('issuer_not_active:'))throw new Error('issuer_not_active');
  if(!isUnique(e))throw e;
  // The ISIN index (isin, valid_from) and the ISIN no-overlap exclusion span tickers: another
  // ticker already carries this ISIN over an overlapping window. A ticker-only re-read cannot see it.
  if(e instanceof Error&&(e.message.includes('issuer_securities_isin_idx')||(code==='23P01'&&e.message.includes('issuer_securities_isin_no_overlap')))){
   await claimAttach();
   return 'conflict';
  }
  // A concurrent writer took the window (PK, open-owner index or no-overlap exclusion): re-read once.
  const after=await classify();
  if(after)return after;
  // A unique violation that no current row explains is an exact replay that raced us.
  if(code==='23505')return 'duplicate';
  throw e;
 }
}
```

```ts
const entryOf=(prov:Record<string,unknown>|undefined,k:string)=>{const e=prov?.[k];return e&&typeof e==='object'?e as Record<string,unknown>:undefined;};
const sourceOf=(prov:Record<string,unknown>|undefined,k:string)=>{
 const s=entryOf(prov,k)?.source;
 return typeof s==='string'&&s?s.slice(0,64):'unknown';
};
/**
 * Files a claim/1 claim for identifier `k` against `row`: set_identifier when the row has none,
 * correct_identifier (expected_current = the stored value) when it differs. The evidence is the
 * incoming identifier record itself (sha256 of its canonical JSON), so replaying the same record
 * never appends a source (spec 3 §4.2.1; Part A contract note 3).
 */
const claimFor=(client:TableClient,row:Row,k:string,input:IssuerInput)=>{
 const issuer_id=String(row.issuer_id),value=String(input[k as keyof IssuerInput]);
 const current=row[k]==null?null:String(row[k]);
 const op=current===null?'set_identifier':'correct_identifier';
 const record=Object.fromEntries(ENRICH_FIELDS.filter(f=>input[f]!=null).map(f=>[f,input[f]]));
 const evidence=claimEvidence({source:sourceOf(input.provenance,k),asOf:entryOf(input.provenance,k)?.as_of,record});
 return fileClaim(client,{issuer_id,id_type:k as ClaimIdType,value,source:evidence.source,op,
  detail:buildClaimDetail({evidence_kind:k==='cninfo_org_id'?'provider_mapping':'hard_identifier',target:{issuer_id},
   params:current===null?{}:{expected_current:current,new_value:value},evidence})});
};
/** Claims, against `row`, every incoming hard id whose value differs from what `row` stores. */
async function claimDiffering(client:TableClient,row:Row,input:IssuerInput){
 for(const k of HARD_IDS)if(input[k]&&row[k]!==input[k])await claimFor(client,row,k,input);
}
```

### 契约问题（integrator 决定；本部分按下列假设写）

1. **`securityType` 过滤可能排除 A 股与 H 股**（规格 §4.1.2 `{'Common Stock','ADR','GDR'}`）。Bloomberg 证券类型里 A 股常见为 `China-A`、H 股常见为 `H-Shares`（未核实）。本部分把集合放进单一常量 `ALLOWED_SECURITY_TYPES`，并在 Task 3b 核对步骤给出决策规则：实测 600519/0700 的 `securityType` 若不在集合内，只把**实测观察到的确切字符串**加入集合、`EXCH_MAP_VERSION` 升为 `'exch-map/2'`、在核对记录里登记为规格 §15 偏差；未核对前 `EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED=false`，`fill-identifiers --apply` 与 `link-ah --apply` 拒绝执行。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #22。**
2. **多组 FIGI 的声明**：规格写"一条 claim，`detail.candidates` 全部列出"，但 `value` 列只能放一个值（唯一键含 `value`）。本部分为**每个候选组各建一条** `set_identifier`（`value`=该组 FIGI，`params:{}`，`evidence.note` 列出全部候选），审核人接受其一、拒绝其余。Part A 的 `validateClaimDetail` 允许 `set_identifier.params.candidates/note`；integrator 若要改为"一条 claim + `params.candidates`"，只改 `plan.ts::multiFigi` 一处。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #17。**
3. **`RawKind` 无巨潮类别**：Task 4b 在 `raw-store.ts` 的 `RawKind` 联合里加 `'cninfo'`（`fill-cninfo-org-id` 的 topSearch 原始响应入桶，满足"每个数字可回放"）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #13。**
4. **`claims_summary` 不在落地 `INFO_CODES`**：Task 4a 加入并同步两个断言 `INFO_CODES` 全集的测试（`batches.test.ts`、`facts/rules.test.ts`）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #13。**
5. **§4.1.2 与 §4.2.2 规则 1 重叠**：阶段 B 若对某 LEI 返回港股 ticker、该发行人持 A 股行且该 ticker 无持有人，`plan.ts` 不建 `attach_security` 声明，而是放进 `ahCandidates` 由 `link-ah` 按规则 1 自动挂接（否则同一事实既自动又待审）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #23。**
6. **`evidence_only` 声明的 `value` 列**：`id_type='ticker'` 的证据项没有可断言的标识符值。本部分规定：8-A/25 证据的 `value` = 申报 `accessionNumber`（每份申报一条，不被同键合并吞掉 params）；换码观测证据的 `value` = 消失的 OLD ticker。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #24。**
7. **`entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif` 对账行**：`record.ts::recordReconciliation` 属 Task 13（更晚）。Task 4a 在 `apply.ts` 内直接经 `TableClient` 插入 `dq_reconciliations`（`kind='text'`、`outcome='compared'`、`cycle_id` 等四列为空、`action` 等价 `record`）；Task 13 可把它改为调用 `recordReconciliation`，行形状不变。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #25。**
8. **`sanitizeProvenance` 与落地 provenance 键**：Part A（Task 2）已把 `load-sec` 的 `{exchange}` 改写到 `{valid_from:{source, as_of, row:{exchange}}}`、`link-research` 的 `{source, as_of}` 改写到 `valid_from` 键下，且白名单拒绝含 UUID 的字符串值。本部分对 `provenance` 的写入一律"库中旧对象原样保留 + `sanitizeProvenance(本次新增的单个键)` 合并"，新增值不含 UUID；回填（5a）用有证据的 `valid_from` 替换该键下旧的 `curated`/观测记录（方法同时升级）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #15。**
9. **发行人级 provenance**（`issuers.provenance.cninfo_org_id`）不经 `sanitizeProvenance`（其白名单是证券级键 `isin/figi/valid_from/valid_to/pending_change`）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #16。**
10. **E2"研究队列"的取数**：规格未给 SQL。本部分定义为 `research_entity_keys where in_scope = true and issuer_id is not null` 的发行人（计划一 `link-research` 的来源表）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #26。**
11. **claims 路由错误映射**：§7.1 写"其他 → 500"，§8 写"claims：各冲突 → 409"。本部分把 `issuer_not_active` 也映射为 409（目标发行人非活跃是冲突，不是服务器错误）；`invalid_claim` 按 §7.1 为 500（路由已先用 `validateClaimDetail` 校验，到函数仍失败是编程错误）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #9。**
12. **`issuer_securities` 全量分页**：该表无单列唯一键；全量（含已关闭行）读取用 `windows.ts::keysetAll`（按 `ticker` 键集分页并按主键去重，复制落地 `facts/scope.ts` 私有助手的写法）；只读未关闭行时按 `ticker` 用 `selectAll`（未关闭行 `ticker` 唯一）。 **→ 已裁决：接口对齐记录 #27。**

**假设**：`fileClaim` 对新建声明返回 `true`、对同键 pending 追加 `sources` 返回 `false`（契约原文）；`memoryRawStore().put` 返回 `{sha256, path, status}` 且 `objects` 以 `path` 为键；`resolve_identifier_claim` 接受 `attach_security` 时按 `detail.params` 插入证券行（`source` 取 `params.source`）。

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `gleif.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/gleif.ts
// Stage A (spec §4.1.1): GLEIF ISIN↔LEI mapping (`LEI,ISIN` CSV, public domain). The ~300 MB file
// is pre-filtered line by line (filterGleifLines) and the kept lines go through the landed
// selectIsinsForLeis, which validates the header (invalid_schema). The subset is rendered
// deterministically (sorted, deduplicated, check-digit valid) so its sha256 is stable evidence for
// reconcile-raw. Bond ISINs are kept here: stage B (OpenFIGI) judges the security type.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {selectIsinsForLeis} from '../../research/entity-keys/parsers';
import {isValidIsin} from '../../research/entity-keys/identifiers';

export const GLEIF_HEADER='LEI,ISIN';
export const GLEIF_URL='https://mapping.gleif.org/api/v2/isin-lei/latest/download';
export interface GleifSubset{csv:string;sha256:string;byLei:Map<string,string[]>;missing:string[];invalidIsins:string[]}

const stripBom=(s:string)=>s.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff?s.slice(1):s;

/** Streams the file, yielding the header (BOM/CR stripped) and the lines whose LEI is wanted. */
export async function* filterGleifLines(lines:AsyncIterable<string>,leis:ReadonlySet<string>):AsyncGenerator<string>{
 let first=true;
 for await(const raw of lines){
  const line=raw.replace(/\r$/,'');
  if(first){first=false;yield stripBom(line);continue;}
  const comma=line.indexOf(',');
  if(comma>0&&leis.has(line.slice(0,comma)))yield line;
 }
}

/** Header + candidate lines → validated subset. Throws invalid_schema (landed parser) on a wrong or missing header. */
export function subsetForLeis(lines:Iterable<string>,leis:ReadonlySet<string>):GleifSubset{
 const {found}=selectIsinsForLeis(lines,new Set(leis));
 const byLei=new Map<string,string[]>();
 const invalidIsins:string[]=[];
 for(const lei of Object.keys(found).sort()){
  const isins=[...new Set(found[lei].map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()))].sort().filter(i=>{
   if(isValidIsin(i))return true;
   invalidIsins.push(`${lei},${i}`);return false;
  });
  if(isins.length)byLei.set(lei,isins);
 }
 const csv=[GLEIF_HEADER,...[...byLei].flatMap(([lei,isins])=>isins.map(i=>`${lei},${i}`))].join('\n')+'\n';
 return {csv,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(csv,'utf8').digest('hex'),byLei,missing:[...leis].filter(l=>!byLei.has(l)).sort(),invalidIsins:invalidIsins.sort()};
}

/** Replays a stored subset (every LEI in it). */
export function parseGleifCsv(csv:string):Map<string,string[]>{
 const lines=stripBom(csv).split('\n').map(l=>l.replace(/\r$/,'')).filter((l,i)=>i===0||l!=='');
 const leis=new Set(lines.slice(1).map(l=>{const c=l.indexOf(',');return c<0?l:l.slice(0,c);}));
 return subsetForLeis(lines,leis).byLei;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/hkex-list.ts
// Stage D (spec §4.1.4): HKEX securities lists → (stock code, name, category, ISIN). Columns are
// located by header text, never by position (HKEX changed the layout; circular CT/118/25 added ISIN
// to ListOfSecurities.xlsx). A file without an ISIN column still yields names and categories, which
// the A+H name match uses (§4.2.2). ISIN precedence follows HKEX_LIST_FILES priority.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import {isValidIsin} from '../../research/entity-keys/identifiers';

export const XLSX_MIME='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' as const;
export type HkexFileId='list_of_securities'|'isin_hkex'|'isin_other_agencies';
export interface HkexListFile{id:HkexFileId;file:string;url:string|null;priority:number}
/** Expected file names inside `--hkex <dir>`. url null: located on the HKEX "Securities Lists" page by the Task 3a verification step (verification.md). */
export const HKEX_LIST_FILES:readonly HkexListFile[]=[
 {id:'list_of_securities',file:'ListOfSecurities.xlsx',url:'https://www.hkex.com.hk/eng/services/trading/securities/securitieslists/ListOfSecurities.xlsx',priority:1},
 {id:'isin_hkex',file:'isin-assigned-by-hkex.xlsx',url:null,priority:2},
 {id:'isin_other_agencies',file:'isin-other-agencies.xlsx',url:null,priority:3},
];
export interface HkexListRow{stockCode:string;name:string|null;category:string|null;isin:string|null;row:number}
export interface HkexListParse{
 file:HkexFileId;sha256:string;headerRow:number;
 columns:{stockCode:number;name:number|null;category:number|null;isin:number|null};
 rows:HkexListRow[];rejected:{row:number;reason:'invalid_stock_code'|'invalid_isin'}[];
}
export interface HkexIsin{isin:string;file:HkexFileId;sha256:string;row:number}

const norm=(v:unknown)=>v==null?'':String(v).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
const text=(v:unknown)=>v==null||String(v).trim()===''?null:String(v).trim();

export function parseHkexList(bytes:Uint8Array,file:HkexFileId):HkexListParse{
 let grid:unknown[][];
 try{
  const wb=XLSX.read(bytes,{type:'array'});
  const ws=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];
  if(!ws)throw new Error('no sheet');
  grid=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<unknown[]>(ws,{header:1,raw:false,defval:null,blankrows:true});
 }catch{throw new Error('invalid_schema');}
 const headerIdx=grid.slice(0,30).findIndex(r=>Array.isArray(r)&&r.some(c=>norm(c)==='stock code'));
 if(headerIdx<0)throw new Error('invalid_schema');
 const header=(grid[headerIdx] as unknown[]).map(norm);
 const find=(pred:(h:string)=>boolean)=>{const i=header.findIndex(pred);return i<0?null:i;};
 const columns={
  stockCode:header.indexOf('stock code'),
  name:find(h=>h==='name of securities'||h==='name of security'||h==='name'),
  category:find(h=>h==='category'),
  isin:find(h=>h.startsWith('isin')),
 };
 const rows:HkexListRow[]=[];
 const rejected:HkexListParse['rejected']=[];
 for(let i=headerIdx+1;i<grid.length;i++){
  const r=grid[i];
  if(!Array.isArray(r)||r.every(c=>text(c)===null))continue;
  const code=text(r[columns.stockCode])??'';
  if(!/^\d{1,5}$/.test(code)){rejected.push({row:i+1,reason:'invalid_stock_code'});continue;}
  const cell=(c:number|null)=>c===null?null:text(r[c]);
  let isin=cell(columns.isin)?.toUpperCase()??null;
  if(isin!==null&&!isValidIsin(isin)){rejected.push({row:i+1,reason:'invalid_isin'});isin=null;}
  rows.push({stockCode:code.padStart(5,'0'),name:cell(columns.name),category:cell(columns.category),isin,row:i+1});
 }
 return {file,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),headerRow:headerIdx+1,columns,rows,rejected};
}

/** Stock code → ISIN by file priority (first file wins); a different ISIN in a later file is listed in conflicts. */
export function mergeHkexIsins(parses:readonly HkexListParse[]):{byCode:Map<string,HkexIsin>;conflicts:{stockCode:string;isins:{file:HkexFileId;isin:string}[]}[];hasIsinColumn:boolean}{
 const prio=(f:HkexFileId)=>HKEX_LIST_FILES.find(x=>x.id===f)!.priority;
 const ordered=[...parses].sort((a,b)=>prio(a.file)-prio(b.file));
 const byCode=new Map<string,HkexIsin>();
 const seen=new Map<string,{file:HkexFileId;isin:string}[]>();
 for(const p of ordered)for(const r of p.rows){
  if(!r.isin)continue;
  const list=seen.get(r.stockCode)??[];
  if(!list.some(x=>x.isin===r.isin))list.push({file:p.file,isin:r.isin});
  seen.set(r.stockCode,list);
  if(!byCode.has(r.stockCode))byCode.set(r.stockCode,{isin:r.isin,file:p.file,sha256:p.sha256,row:r.row});
 }
 const conflicts=[...seen].filter(([,l])=>l.length>1).map(([stockCode,isins])=>({stockCode,isins})).sort((a,b)=>a.stockCode<b.stockCode?-1:1);
 return {byCode,conflicts,hasIsinColumn:parses.some(p=>p.columns.isin!==null)};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `openfigi.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/openfigi.ts
// Stage B/C (spec §4.1.2–§4.1.3): OpenFIGI v3 mapping adapter. mapJobs throttles to 80% of the
// documented limits (no key: 25 requests/min and 10 jobs/request; key: 250/min and 100 jobs),
// backs off BACKOFF_MS once on 429/5xx/network failure and then gives up the rest of the run
// (exhausted → the caller records quota_exhausted). Each request's job array and the exact
// response bytes go to reconcile-raw; the API key travels only in a header and is never stored.
// groupFigiResults is pure: equity filter, EXCH_MAP, grouping by compositeFIGI (composite level)
// or figi (venue level), sorted so the order of API results never changes the outcome. No venue
// preference is invented: several groups for one ticker means "do not write, file claims".
import type {Budget} from '../../facts/types';
import type {RawStore} from '../../dq/raw-store';
import {normalizeSecurityTicker} from '../../securities/ticker';

export const OPENFIGI_URL='https://api.openfigi.com/v3/mapping';
export const OPENFIGI_VERSION='v3';
export const EXCH_MAP_VERSION='exch-map/1';
/** True only after the Task 3b live check (verification.md). fill-identifiers/link-ah --apply refuse while false. */
export const EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED:boolean=false;
/** openfigi.com/about/exchange-codes. CG→.SH, CS→.SZ, CH (China composite) by code prefix (6/9→.SH, 0/3→.SZ). */
export const EXCH_MAP:Readonly<Record<string,'US'|'SH'|'SZ'|'CH'|'HK'>>={US:'US',UN:'US',UW:'US',UA:'US',UR:'US',UP:'US',UQ:'US',CG:'SH',CS:'SZ',CH:'CH',HK:'HK'};
/** Spec §4.1.2 set; extend only with values observed in the live check (contract issue 1). */
export const ALLOWED_SECURITY_TYPES:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set(['Common Stock','ADR','GDR']);
export const BACKOFF_MS=60_000;
const FIGI=/^BBG[A-Z0-9]{9}$/;

export type FigiMarket='US'|'CN'|'HK';
export interface FigiJob{idType:'ID_ISIN'|'TICKER';idValue:string;exchCode?:string}
export interface FigiRecord{figi:string;compositeFIGI?:string|null;ticker?:string|null;exchCode?:string|null;securityType?:string|null;securityType2?:string|null;marketSector?:string|null;name?:string|null;shareClassFIGI?:string|null}
export interface FigiEvidence{request_sha256:string;response_sha256:string;index:number}
export type FigiJobResult=
 |{job:FigiJob;status:'ok';records:FigiRecord[];evidence:FigiEvidence}
 |{job:FigiJob;status:'not_found'|'error';message:string;evidence:FigiEvidence};
export interface MapResult{results:(FigiJobResult|null)[];exhausted:boolean;requests:number}
export interface MappedBy{byKey:Map<string,FigiJobResult>;exhausted:boolean;unprocessed:string[];unsupported:string[];requests:number}
export interface OpenFigiDeps{fetch:typeof fetch;raw:RawStore;apiKey?:string|null;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;now?:()=>number;budget?:Budget}
export class OpenFigiError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly code:'invalid_schema'|'openfigi_http',detail?:string){super(detail?`${code}: ${detail}`:code);this.name='OpenFigiError';}
}

export function openFigiLimits(apiKey?:string|null):{jobsPerRequest:number;minIntervalMs:number}{
 const keyed=!!apiKey;
 const perMinute=Math.floor((keyed?250:25)*0.8);
 return {jobsPerRequest:keyed?100:10,minIntervalMs:Math.ceil(60_000/perMinute)};
}

function parseItem(job:FigiJob,item:unknown,evidence:FigiEvidence):FigiJobResult{
 if(!item||typeof item!=='object'||Array.isArray(item))throw new OpenFigiError('invalid_schema','job result');
 const o=item as {data?:unknown;error?:unknown;warning?:unknown};
 if(Array.isArray(o.data)){
  const records=o.data.map(r=>{
   if(!r||typeof r!=='object'||typeof (r as FigiRecord).figi!=='string')throw new OpenFigiError('invalid_schema','record');
   return r as FigiRecord;
  });
  return records.length?{job,status:'ok',records,evidence}:{job,status:'not_found',message:'empty data',evidence};
 }
 if(typeof o.warning==='string')return {job,status:'not_found',message:o.warning,evidence};
 if(typeof o.error==='string')return {job,status:'error',message:o.error,evidence};
 throw new OpenFigiError('invalid_schema','job result');
}

export async function mapJobs(jobs:readonly FigiJob[],deps:OpenFigiDeps):Promise<MapResult>{
 const {jobsPerRequest,minIntervalMs}=openFigiLimits(deps.apiKey);
 const sleep=deps.sleep??((ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)));
 const now=deps.now??Date.now;
 const results:(FigiJobResult|null)[]=jobs.map(()=>null);
 const headers:Record<string,string>={'Content-Type':'application/json'};
 if(deps.apiKey)headers['X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY']=deps.apiKey;
 let last:number|null=null,requests=0;
 const send=async(body:string):Promise<Response|null>=>{
  if(last!==null){const wait=last+minIntervalMs-now();if(wait>0)await sleep(wait);}
  last=now();requests++;
  try{return await deps.fetch(OPENFIGI_URL,{method:'POST',headers,body,signal:deps.budget?.signal});}
  catch(e){if(deps.budget?.signal.aborted)throw e;return null;}
 };
 const retryable=(r:Response|null)=>r===null||r.status===429||r.status>=500;
 for(let start=0;start<jobs.length;start+=jobsPerRequest){
  const chunk=jobs.slice(start,start+jobsPerRequest);
  const body=JSON.stringify(chunk);
  let res=await send(body);
  if(retryable(res)){await sleep(BACKOFF_MS);res=await send(body);}
  if(res===null||retryable(res))return {results,exhausted:true,requests};
  if(!res.ok)throw new OpenFigiError('openfigi_http',String(res.status));
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const req=await deps.raw.put({kind:'openfigi',bytes:new TextEncoder().encode(body),contentType:'application/json',meta:{role:'request',jobs:chunk.length}},deps.budget);
  const resp=await deps.raw.put({kind:'openfigi',bytes,contentType:'application/json',meta:{role:'response',request_sha256:req.sha256}},deps.budget);
  let parsed:unknown;
  try{parsed=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));}catch{throw new OpenFigiError('invalid_schema','response is not JSON');}
  if(!Array.isArray(parsed)||parsed.length!==chunk.length)throw new OpenFigiError('invalid_schema','response length');
  parsed.forEach((item,i)=>{results[start+i]=parseItem(chunk[i],item,{request_sha256:req.sha256,response_sha256:resp.sha256,index:i});});
 }
 return {results,exhausted:false,requests};
}

function keyed(keys:readonly string[],jobs:FigiJob[],out:MapResult,unsupported:string[]):MappedBy{
 const byKey=new Map<string,FigiJobResult>();const unprocessed:string[]=[];
 keys.forEach((k,i)=>{const r=out.results[i];if(r)byKey.set(k,r);else unprocessed.push(k);});
 return {byKey,exhausted:out.exhausted,unprocessed,unsupported,requests:out.requests};
}

export async function mapIsins(isins:readonly string[],deps:OpenFigiDeps):Promise<MappedBy>{
 const keys=[...new Set(isins)];
 const jobs=keys.map(idValue=>({idType:'ID_ISIN' as const,idValue}));
 return keyed(keys,jobs,await mapJobs(jobs,deps),[]);
}

/** Reverse lookup for TICKER jobs (spec §4.1.3); null = no OpenFIGI exchange code for this ticker. */
export function exchCodeFor(ticker:string):{exchCode:string;idValue:string}|null{
 const cn=/^(\d{6})\.(SH|SZ)$/.exec(ticker);
 if(cn)return {exchCode:cn[2]==='SH'?'CG':'CS',idValue:cn[1]};
 const hk=/^(\d{5})\.HK$/.exec(ticker);
 if(hk)return {exchCode:'HK',idValue:hk[1].replace(/^0+(?=\d)/,'')};
 if(/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.]{0,7}$/.test(ticker)&&!/\.(SH|SZ|BJ|HK)$/.test(ticker))return {exchCode:'US',idValue:ticker.replace(/\./g,'/')};
 return null;
}

export async function mapTickers(tickers:readonly string[],deps:OpenFigiDeps):Promise<MappedBy>{
 const keys:string[]=[],jobs:FigiJob[]=[],unsupported:string[]=[];
 for(const t of [...new Set(tickers)]){
  const x=exchCodeFor(t);
  if(!x){unsupported.push(t);continue;}
  keys.push(t);jobs.push({idType:'TICKER',idValue:x.idValue,exchCode:x.exchCode});
 }
 return keyed(keys,jobs,await mapJobs(jobs,deps),unsupported);
}

export function securityTickerFor(exchCode:string|null|undefined,ticker:string|null|undefined):{ok:true;market:FigiMarket;ticker:string}|{ok:false;reason:string}{
 const kind=exchCode?EXCH_MAP[exchCode]:undefined;
 if(!kind)return {ok:false,reason:`exch_unknown:${exchCode??'null'}`};
 const raw=(ticker??'').trim().toUpperCase();
 if(kind==='US'){const t=normalizeSecurityTicker(raw,'US');return t?{ok:true,market:'US',ticker:t}:{ok:false,reason:'ticker_invalid'};}
 if(kind==='HK'){const t=normalizeSecurityTicker(raw,'HK');return t?{ok:true,market:'HK',ticker:t}:{ok:false,reason:'ticker_invalid'};}
 if(!/^\d{6}$/.test(raw))return {ok:false,reason:'ticker_invalid'};
 const suffix=kind==='SH'?'SH':kind==='SZ'?'SZ':/^[69]/.test(raw)?'SH':/^[03]/.test(raw)?'SZ':null;
 if(!suffix)return {ok:false,reason:`exch_unknown:CH:${raw[0]}`};
 return {ok:true,market:'CN',ticker:`${raw}.${suffix}`};
}

export interface FigiGroup{figi:string;level:'composite'|'venue';exchCodes:string[];securityType:string}
export interface FigiCandidate{market:FigiMarket;ticker:string;groups:FigiGroup[]}
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;

export function groupFigiResults(records:readonly FigiRecord[]):{candidates:FigiCandidate[];skipped:string[]}{
 const sorted=[...records].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.compositeFIGI??a.figi,b.compositeFIGI??b.figi)||cmp(a.exchCode??'',b.exchCode??'')||cmp(a.figi,b.figi));
 const byTicker=new Map<string,{market:FigiMarket;ticker:string;groups:Map<string,FigiGroup>}>();
 const skipped:string[]=[];
 for(const r of sorted){
  if(r.marketSector!=='Equity'){skipped.push(`market_sector:${r.marketSector??'null'}`);continue;}
  if(!r.securityType||!ALLOWED_SECURITY_TYPES.has(r.securityType)){skipped.push(`security_type:${r.securityType??'null'}`);continue;}
  const composite=typeof r.compositeFIGI==='string'&&r.compositeFIGI!=='';
  const figi=composite?r.compositeFIGI!:r.figi;
  if(!FIGI.test(figi)){skipped.push('invalid_figi');continue;}
  const t=securityTickerFor(r.exchCode,r.ticker);
  if(!t.ok){skipped.push(t.reason);continue;}
  const key=`${t.market}|${t.ticker}`;
  const entry=byTicker.get(key)??{market:t.market,ticker:t.ticker,groups:new Map<string,FigiGroup>()};
  byTicker.set(key,entry);
  const gk=`${composite?'c':'v'}:${figi}`;
  const g=entry.groups.get(gk)??{figi,level:composite?'composite':'venue',exchCodes:[],securityType:r.securityType};
  if(r.exchCode&&!g.exchCodes.includes(r.exchCode))g.exchCodes.push(r.exchCode);
  entry.groups.set(gk,g);
 }
 const candidates=[...byTicker.values()]
  .sort((a,b)=>cmp(`${a.market}|${a.ticker}`,`${b.market}|${b.ticker}`))
  .map(e=>({market:e.market,ticker:e.ticker,groups:[...e.groups.values()].map(g=>({...g,exchCodes:[...g.exchCodes].sort()})).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.figi,b.figi))}));
 return {candidates,skipped:skipped.sort()};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Live check for spec §4.1.2 / §14-2 (Task 3b Step 8): maps AAPL, Kweichow Moutai and Tencent by
 * ISIN and by TICKER WITHOUT an API key, prints exchCode/securityType/compositeFIGI per record and
 * writes the exact response bytes for verification.md.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/probe-openfigi.ts <out-dir>
 * No database access. Never pass OPENFIGI_API_KEY here (the check is the keyless path).
 */
import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {groupFigiResults,mapJobs,type FigiJob} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/openfigi';

const ISIN_JOBS:FigiJob[]=[{idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'US0378331005'},{idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'CNE0000018R8'},{idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'KYG875721634'}];
const TICKER_JOBS:FigiJob[]=[{idType:'TICKER',idValue:'AAPL',exchCode:'US'},{idType:'TICKER',idValue:'600519',exchCode:'CG'},{idType:'TICKER',idValue:'700',exchCode:'HK'}];

async function main(){
 const out=process.argv[2];
 if(!out){console.error('usage: probe-openfigi.ts <out-dir>');process.exit(2);}
 mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
 for(const [label,jobs] of [['isin',ISIN_JOBS],['ticker',TICKER_JOBS]] as const){
  const raw=memoryRawStore();
  const res=await mapJobs(jobs,{fetch,raw,apiKey:null});
  if(res.exhausted){console.error(`${label}: rate limited / unavailable`);process.exitCode=1;continue;}
  for(const [path,bytes] of raw.objects)writeFileSync(join(out,`openfigi-${label}-${path.split('/').pop()}`),bytes);
  res.results.forEach((r,i)=>{
   console.log(`== ${label} ${jobs[i].idValue} → ${r?.status}`);
   if(r?.status==='ok'){
    for(const x of r.records)console.log(`  exchCode=${x.exchCode} ticker=${x.ticker} securityType=${x.securityType} securityType2=${x.securityType2} marketSector=${x.marketSector} compositeFIGI=${x.compositeFIGI} figi=${x.figi}`);
    console.log('  grouped:',JSON.stringify(groupFigiResults(r.records)));
   }
   if(r)console.log(`  response_sha256=${r.evidence.response_sha256}`);
  });
 }
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

决策规则（逐条执行，结论写在表下）：
1. 三家都"恰 1 组且 ticker 正确"→ 把 `openfigi.ts` 里 `EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED` 改为 `true`。
2. 某家 `securityType` 不在 `ALLOWED_SECURITY_TYPES`（例如 600519 为 `China-A`）→ 只把实测的确切字符串加入集合，`EXCH_MAP_VERSION` 改为 `'exch-map/2'`，同步改 Step 1 测试里两处对集合与版本的断言；在 `verification.md` 写"规格 §15 偏差：允许类型集合扩为 …（实测）"；再按规则 1 置 `EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED=true`。
3. 某家 exchCode 不在 `EXCH_MAP` → 按 openfigi.com/about/exchange-codes 确认该码含义后加入映射（只加实测出现且含义确认的码），版本同规则 2，测试同步。
4. 某家多于 1 组（同 ticker 多个 composite）→ 不改代码（规格：不发明场所偏好），`EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED=true`，表下写明"该证券将进入 claim"。
5. 实测成功时把 ISIN 响应（`raw/openfigi-isin-<sha>.json`，那份 response 文件）复制为 `src/lib/entities/fixtures/openfigi/recorded-probe-isin.json`，跑 `npm test -- src/lib/entities/identifiers/openfigi.test.ts`，`recorded probe` 用例必须 PASS（规则 4 情形下把该用例期望里对应项改为实测组数）。

**降级路径**：网络不可达或返回 429 → 表格写"未核对（<日期> <错误>）"，`EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED` 保持 `false`；`fill-identifiers --apply` 与 `link-ah --apply` 因此拒绝执行（Task 4b、7a），dry-run 仍可跑。不得用记忆值填表、不得手工改 `EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED`。

```ts
const rec=(o:Partial<FigiRecord>):FigiRecord=>({figi:'BBG000B9XRY4',compositeFIGI:'BBG000B9XRY4',ticker:'AAPL',exchCode:'US',securityType:'Common Stock',marketSector:'Equity',...o});

const AAPL_JOB:FigiJob={idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'US0378331005'};

 asOf:ASOF,stages:new Set(['A','B']),issuers:[{issuer_id:I1,lei:LEI1,usci:null}],openRows:[row({})],
 universe:new Set(['AAPL','AAPLW','00700.HK']),
 gleif:{sha256:GSHA,byLei:new Map([[LEI1,['US0378331005']]])},

 tickerResults:new Map(),hkex:null,...o,
});

const FIGI_PROV={source:'openfigi',as_of:ASOF,evidence_sha256:RSHA,job:{idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'US0378331005'},level:'composite'};

describe('planIdentifierWrites · stage B',()=>{
 it('writes an empty ISIN and FIGI as guarded sets carrying one sanitized provenance key each',()=>{
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base());
  expect(p.writes.map(w=>[w.kind,w.column,w.value,w.patch])).toEqual([['set','isin','US0378331005',{isin:ISIN_PROV}],['set','figi','BBG000B9XRY4',{figi:FIGI_PROV}]]);

  expect(p.claims).toEqual([]);expect(p.duplicates).toBe(0);expect(p.figiMissing).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('same value: provenance-only write when the key is missing, duplicate when present',()=>{
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({openRows:[row({isin:'US0378331005',figi:'BBG000B9XRY4',provenance:{figi:{source:'openfigi'}}})]}));
  expect(p.writes.map(w=>[w.kind,w.column])).toEqual([['provenance','isin']]);
  expect(p.duplicates).toBe(1);
 });
 it('a different stored value becomes correct_identifier and is never overwritten',()=>{
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({openRows:[row({figi:'BBG000OLD001'})]}));
  expect(p.writes.map(w=>w.column)).toEqual(['isin']);
  expect(p.claims).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(p.claims[0]).toMatchObject({issuer_id:I1,id_type:'figi',value:'BBG000B9XRY4',source:'openfigi',op:'correct_identifier',detail:{
   schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:'provider_mapping',target:{issuer_id:I1,ticker:'AAPL',valid_from:'2026-01-02'},
   params:{expected_current:'BBG000OLD001',new_value:'BBG000B9XRY4'},provenance_written:{figi:FIGI_PROV},
  }});
  expect(p.claims[0].detail.sources).toEqual([p.claims[0].detail.evidence]);
 });
 it('several FIGI groups for one ticker: one set_identifier claim per group, ISIN still written',()=>{
  const two=okR(AAPL_JOB,[rec({figi:'BBG000VENUE1',compositeFIGI:null}),rec({figi:'BBG000VENUE2',compositeFIGI:null})]);
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({isinResults:new Map([['US0378331005',two]])}));
  expect(p.writes.map(w=>w.column)).toEqual(['isin']);
  const candidates=[{figi:'BBG000VENUE1',level:'venue'},{figi:'BBG000VENUE2',level:'venue'}];
  expect(p.claims.map(c=>[c.op,c.id_type,c.value,c.detail.params])).toEqual([['set_identifier','figi','BBG000VENUE1',{candidates}],['set_identifier','figi','BBG000VENUE2',{candidates}]]);
  expect(p.claims[0].detail.evidence.note).toBe('one of 2 candidate FIGIs: BBG000VENUE1(venue), BBG000VENUE2(venue)');
  expect(p.skipped).toContain('figi_multiple_groups');
 });
 it('attach claims, ownership quarantines, universe skips and A+H candidates for tickers the issuer does not hold',()=>{
  const res=okR(AAPL_JOB,[rec({ticker:'AAPLW',figi:'BBG000ZZZZ01',compositeFIGI:'BBG000ZZZZ01'}),rec({ticker:'ZZNOPE',figi:'BBG000ZZZZ02',compositeFIGI:'BBG000ZZZZ02'}),rec({ticker:'700',exchCode:'HK',figi:'BBG000TENCT1',compositeFIGI:'BBG000TENCT1'})]);

  expect(p.claims.map(c=>[c.op,c.id_type,c.value])).toEqual([['attach_security','ticker','AAPLW']]);
  expect(p.claims[0].detail.params).toEqual({share_class:'unknown',valid_from:ASOF,valid_from_method:'first_observed',source:'gleif_openfigi',isin:'US0378331005'});
  expect(p.claims[0].detail.target).toEqual({issuer_id:I1});
  expect(p.skipped).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['ticker_not_in_universe','ah_link_candidate']));
  expect(p.ahCandidates).toEqual([{issuer_id:I1,ticker:'00700.HK',isin:'US0378331005',evidence:{source:'gleif_openfigi',as_of:ASOF,evidence_sha256:GSHA,locator:`gleif:${LEI1},US0378331005;openfigi:${RSHA}#0`}}]);
  const owned=planIdentifierWrites(base({openRows:[row({ticker:'600000.SH'}),row({issuer_id:I2,ticker:'AAPLW'})],isinResults:new Map([['US0378331005',res]])}));
  expect(owned.claims.map(c=>c.value)).toEqual(['AAPLW']);
  expect(owned.quarantines).toEqual([{naturalKey:`AAPLW:${ASOF}`,reasonCode:'ownership_conflict',detail:{reason:'ticker_owned_by_other_issuer',stage:'B',owner_issuer_id:I2},payload:{issuer_id:I1,ticker:'AAPLW',isin:'US0378331005'}}]);
 });
 it('two ISINs pointing at the same row are ambiguous: claims only',()=>{
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({
   gleif:{sha256:GSHA,byLei:new Map([[LEI1,['US0378331005','US5949181045']]])},
   isinResults:new Map([['US0378331005',okR(AAPL_JOB,[rec({})])],['US5949181045',okR({idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'US5949181045'},[rec({})],1)]]),
  }));
  expect(p.writes.map(w=>w.column)).toEqual(['figi']);
  expect(p.claims.map(c=>[c.op,c.value])).toEqual([['set_identifier','US0378331005'],['set_identifier','US5949181045']]);
  expect(p.skipped).toContain('ambiguous_isin');
 });
 it('records why nothing was queried or found',()=>{
  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({isinResults:new Map([['US0378331005',{job:AAPL_JOB,status:'not_found',message:'No identifier found.',evidence:ev(0)}]])}));
  expect(p.skipped).toEqual(['openfigi_not_found']);
  expect(planIdentifierWrites(base({isinResults:new Map()})).skipped).toEqual(['figi_not_queried']);
  expect(planIdentifierWrites(base({stages:new Set(['D'])})).writes).toEqual([]);

});

describe('planIdentifierWrites · stages C and D',()=>{
 it('lists rows still without a FIGI for stage C, then writes the single TICKER group',()=>{
  const input=base({openRows:[row({}),row({ticker:'00700.HK',valid_from:'2026-02-01'})],stages:new Set(['A','B','C'])});
  expect(planIdentifierWrites(input).figiMissing).toEqual(['00700.HK']);
  const job:FigiJob={idType:'TICKER',idValue:'700',exchCode:'HK'};
  const p=planIdentifierWrites({...input,tickerResults:new Map([['00700.HK',okR(job,[rec({ticker:'700',exchCode:'HK',figi:'BBG000TENCT1',compositeFIGI:'BBG000TENCT1'})],2)]])});
  expect(p.figiMissing).toEqual([]);
  const w=p.writes.find(x=>x.ticker==='00700.HK')!;
  expect(w).toMatchObject({column:'figi',value:'BBG000TENCT1',patch:{figi:{source:'openfigi',as_of:ASOF,evidence_sha256:RSHA,job:{idType:'TICKER',idValue:'700',exchCode:'HK'},level:'composite'}}});
  const nf=planIdentifierWrites({...input,tickerResults:new Map([['00700.HK',{job,status:'not_found',message:'x',evidence:ev(0)}]])});
  expect(nf.skipped).toContain('figi_not_found');expect(nf.figiMissing).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('HKEX ISIN is the primary source for .HK rows; a disagreeing stage-B ISIN becomes a text reconciliation and a claim',()=>{
  const HK=row({ticker:'00700.HK'});
  const res=okR(AAPL_JOB,[rec({ticker:'700',exchCode:'HK',figi:'BBG000TENCT1',compositeFIGI:'BBG000TENCT1'})]);

  const p=planIdentifierWrites(base({stages:new Set(['A','B','D']),openRows:[HK],isinResults:new Map([['US0378331005',res]]),hkex}));

  expect(isin).toMatchObject({value:'KYG875721634',source:'hkex_list_of_securities',evidenceKind:'official_list',patch:{isin:{source:'hkex_list_of_securities',as_of:ASOF,evidence_sha256:'d'.repeat(64),locator:'list_of_securities:row:5'}}});
  expect(p.recons).toEqual([{naturalKey:'00700.HK:2026-01-02',passed:false,leftText:'US0378331005',rightText:'KYG875721634',leftSource:'gleif_openfigi',rightSource:'hkex_list_of_securities',
   detail:{left:{evidence_sha256:GSHA,locator:`gleif:${LEI1},US0378331005;openfigi:${RSHA}#0`},right:{document:'list_of_securities',sha256:'d'.repeat(64),locator:'row:5'}}}]);
  expect(p.claims.map(c=>[c.op,c.value,c.detail.params])).toEqual([['correct_identifier','US0378331005',{expected_current:'KYG875721634',new_value:'US0378331005'}]]);
  const agree=planIdentifierWrites(base({stages:new Set(['A','B','D']),openRows:[HK],gleif:{sha256:GSHA,byLei:new Map([[LEI1,['KYG875721634']]])},
   isinResults:new Map([['KYG875721634',okR({idType:'ID_ISIN',idValue:'KYG875721634'},[rec({ticker:'700',exchCode:'HK',figi:'BBG000TENCT1',compositeFIGI:'BBG000TENCT1'})])]]),hkex}));
  expect(agree.recons.map(r=>r.passed)).toEqual([true]);expect(agree.claims).toEqual([]);
  expect(planIdentifierWrites(base({stages:new Set(['D']),openRows:[HK],hkex:new Map()})).skipped).toEqual(['hkex_no_isin']);
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `plan.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/plan.ts
// Pure planning of ISIN/FIGI writes (spec §4.1.2–§4.1.4). Inputs: the run's evidence (GLEIF subset,
// OpenFIGI job results by ISIN and by ticker, merged HKEX lists) and the current open security rows.
// Output: guarded column writes (one sanitized provenance key each), claim/1 claims, ownership
// quarantines and HKEX-vs-GLEIF text reconciliations. A stored value is never overwritten: a
// different value becomes correct_identifier. Several candidate values for one row/column are
// ambiguous and only produce claims. HK tickers found for an issuer that holds A shares are left
// to link-ah (spec §4.2.2 rule 1; contract issue 5).
import type {ClaimInput} from '../claims';
import {sanitizeProvenance} from '../provenance';
import type {ClaimDetail,ClaimEvidence,ClaimIdType,ClaimOp,EvidenceKind} from '../types';
import type {HkexIsin} from './hkex-list';
import {groupFigiResults,type FigiGroup,type FigiJob,type FigiJobResult} from './openfigi';

export const ISIN_RECON_PAIR='entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif' as const;
export type Stage='A'|'B'|'C'|'D';
export interface SecRow{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string;isin:string|null;figi:string|null;provenance:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface IssuerRow{issuer_id:string;lei:string|null;usci:string|null}
export interface PlanInput{
 asOf:string;stages:ReadonlySet<Stage>;
 /** the run's active issuers */
 issuers:readonly IssuerRow[];
 /** ALL open (valid_to null) security rows: ownership lookups use every issuer's rows */
 openRows:readonly SecRow[];
 universe:ReadonlySet<string>;
 gleif:{sha256:string;byLei:ReadonlyMap<string,readonly string[]>}|null;
 isinResults:ReadonlyMap<string,FigiJobResult>;
 tickerResults:ReadonlyMap<string,FigiJobResult>;
 /** 5-digit stock code → ISIN (mergeHkexIsins); null or empty = no HKEX ISIN source this run */
 hkex:ReadonlyMap<string,HkexIsin>|null;
}
export type IdColumn='isin'|'figi';
export interface SecurityWrite{
 kind:'set'|'provenance';issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string;column:IdColumn;value:string;
 /** exactly one sanitized provenance key ({isin:…} or {figi:…}); apply merges it into the stored object */
 patch:Record<string,unknown>;source:string;evidenceKind:EvidenceKind;evidence:ClaimEvidence;
}
export interface PlannedQuarantine{naturalKey:string;reasonCode:'ownership_conflict';detail:Record<string,unknown>;payload:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface PlannedRecon{naturalKey:string;passed:boolean;leftText:string;rightText:string;leftSource:string;rightSource:string;detail:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface AhCandidate{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;isin:string;evidence:ClaimEvidence}
export interface IdentifierPlan{writes:SecurityWrite[];claims:ClaimInput[];quarantines:PlannedQuarantine[];recons:PlannedRecon[];duplicates:number;skipped:string[];figiMissing:string[];ahCandidates:AhCandidate[]}

interface Proposal{value:string;source:string;kind:EvidenceKind;evidence:ClaimEvidence;prov:Record<string,unknown>}
type Op=Exclude<ClaimOp,'legacy'>;
const keyOf=(r:{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string})=>`${r.issuer_id}|${r.ticker}|${r.valid_from}`;
const targetOf=(r:SecRow)=>({issuer_id:r.issuer_id,ticker:r.ticker,valid_from:r.valid_from});
const jobOf=(j:FigiJob)=>j.exchCode?{idType:j.idType,idValue:j.idValue,exchCode:j.exchCode}:{idType:j.idType,idValue:j.idValue};

export function planIdentifierWrites(input:PlanInput):IdentifierPlan{
 const {asOf,stages}=input;
 const out:IdentifierPlan={writes:[],claims:[],quarantines:[],recons:[],duplicates:0,skipped:[],figiMissing:[],ahCandidates:[]};
 const runIds=new Set(input.issuers.map(i=>i.issuer_id));
 const runRows=input.openRows.filter(r=>runIds.has(r.issuer_id));
 const openOwner=new Map(input.openRows.map(r=>[r.ticker,r.issuer_id]));
 const holdsA=new Set(input.openRows.filter(r=>/\.(SH|SZ)$/.test(r.ticker)).map(r=>r.issuer_id));
 const proposals=new Map<string,{row:SecRow;col:IdColumn;list:Proposal[]}>();
 const figiClaimed=new Set<string>();
 const propose=(row:SecRow,col:IdColumn,p:Proposal)=>{
  const k=`${keyOf(row)}|${col}`;
  const e=proposals.get(k)??{row,col,list:[]};
  if(!e.list.some(x=>x.value===p.value))e.list.push(p);
  proposals.set(k,e);
 };
 const claim=(c:{issuer_id:string;id_type:ClaimIdType;value:string;source:string;op:Op;kind:EvidenceKind;target:ClaimDetail['target'];params:Record<string,unknown>;evidence:ClaimEvidence;written?:Record<string,unknown>})=>{
  out.claims.push({issuer_id:c.issuer_id,id_type:c.id_type,value:c.value,source:c.source,op:c.op,detail:{
   schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:c.kind,target:c.target,params:c.params,evidence:c.evidence,sources:[c.evidence],...(c.written?{provenance_written:c.written}:{}),
  }});
 };
 const figiProposal=(r:Extract<FigiJobResult,{status:'ok'}>,g:FigiGroup):Proposal=>({
  value:g.figi,source:'openfigi',kind:'provider_mapping',
  evidence:{source:'openfigi',as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:r.evidence.response_sha256,locator:`openfigi:${r.evidence.response_sha256}#${r.evidence.index}`},
  prov:{source:'openfigi',as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:r.evidence.response_sha256,job:jobOf(r.job),level:g.level},
 });
 const multiFigi=(row:SecRow,r:Extract<FigiJobResult,{status:'ok'}>,groups:FigiGroup[])=>{
  figiClaimed.add(keyOf(row));
  out.skipped.push('figi_multiple_groups');
  if(groups.some(g=>g.figi===row.figi)){out.duplicates++;return;}
  const note=`one of ${groups.length} candidate FIGIs: ${groups.map(g=>`${g.figi}(${g.level})`).join(', ')}`;
  // spec §4.1.2 "detail.candidates 全部列出": every per-group claim carries the full sorted list in params.candidates
  // (Part A validateClaimDetail/identifier_claim_problem allow params.candidates for set_identifier/correct_identifier).
  const candidates=groups.map(g=>({figi:g.figi,level:g.level}));
  for(const g of groups){
   const p=figiProposal(r,g);
   const op:Op=row.figi===null?'set_identifier':'correct_identifier';
   claim({issuer_id:row.issuer_id,id_type:'figi',value:g.figi,source:'openfigi',op,kind:'provider_mapping',target:targetOf(row),
    params:op==='set_identifier'?{candidates}:{expected_current:row.figi,new_value:g.figi,candidates},evidence:{...p.evidence,note},written:sanitizeProvenance({figi:p.prov})});
  }
 };

 // Stage B: ISIN (from GLEIF, stage A) → OpenFIGI → (issuer via LEI, normalized ticker).
 if(stages.has('B')&&input.gleif){
  for(const iss of input.issuers){
   if(!iss.lei)continue;
   for(const isin of input.gleif.byLei.get(iss.lei)??[]){
    const r=input.isinResults.get(isin);
    if(!r){out.skipped.push('figi_not_queried');continue;}
    if(r.status!=='ok'){out.skipped.push(`openfigi_${r.status}`);continue;}
    const g=groupFigiResults(r.records);
    out.skipped.push(...g.skipped);
    const locator=`gleif:${iss.lei},${isin};openfigi:${r.evidence.response_sha256}#${r.evidence.index}`;
    const evidence:ClaimEvidence={source:'gleif_openfigi',as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:input.gleif.sha256,locator};
    const isinProposal:Proposal={value:isin,source:'gleif_openfigi',kind:'provider_mapping',evidence,prov:{source:'gleif_openfigi',as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:input.gleif.sha256,locator}};
    for(const c of g.candidates){
     const own=runRows.find(x=>x.issuer_id===iss.issuer_id&&x.ticker===c.ticker);
     if(own){
      propose(own,'isin',isinProposal);
      if(c.groups.length===1)propose(own,'figi',figiProposal(r,c.groups[0]));
      else multiFigi(own,r,c.groups);
      continue;
     }
     if(!input.universe.has(c.ticker)){out.skipped.push('ticker_not_in_universe');continue;}
     const owner=openOwner.get(c.ticker);
     if(owner===undefined&&c.market==='HK'&&holdsA.has(iss.issuer_id)){
      out.ahCandidates.push({issuer_id:iss.issuer_id,ticker:c.ticker,isin,evidence});out.skipped.push('ah_link_candidate');continue;
     }
     claim({issuer_id:iss.issuer_id,id_type:'ticker',value:c.ticker,source:'gleif_openfigi',op:'attach_security',kind:'provider_mapping',target:{issuer_id:iss.issuer_id},
      params:{share_class:'unknown',valid_from:asOf,valid_from_method:'first_observed',source:'gleif_openfigi',isin},evidence});
     if(owner!==undefined)out.quarantines.push({naturalKey:`${c.ticker}:${asOf}`,reasonCode:'ownership_conflict',
      detail:{reason:'ticker_owned_by_other_issuer',stage:'B',owner_issuer_id:owner},payload:{issuer_id:iss.issuer_id,ticker:c.ticker,isin}});
    }
   }
  }
 }

 // Stage D: HKEX is the primary ISIN source for .HK rows; stage-B values are compared, not written.
 if(stages.has('D')){
  if(!input.hkex||input.hkex.size===0)out.skipped.push('hkex_no_isin');
  else for(const row of runRows){
   const m=/^(\d{5})\.HK$/.exec(row.ticker);
   if(!m)continue;
   const hk=input.hkex.get(m[1]);
   if(!hk){out.skipped.push('hkex_code_not_listed');continue;}
   const source=`hkex_${hk.file}`,locator=`${hk.file}:row:${hk.row}`;
   const evidence:ClaimEvidence={source,as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:hk.sha256,locator};
   const k=`${keyOf(row)}|isin`;
   for(const b of proposals.get(k)?.list??[]){
    out.recons.push({naturalKey:`${row.ticker}:${row.valid_from}`,passed:b.value===hk.isin,leftText:b.value,rightText:hk.isin,leftSource:b.source,rightSource:source,
     detail:{left:{evidence_sha256:b.evidence.evidence_sha256,locator:b.evidence.locator},right:{document:hk.file,sha256:hk.sha256,locator:`row:${hk.row}`}}});
    if(b.value!==hk.isin)claim({issuer_id:row.issuer_id,id_type:'isin',value:b.value,source:b.source,op:'correct_identifier',kind:b.kind,target:targetOf(row),
     params:{expected_current:hk.isin,new_value:b.value},evidence:b.evidence,written:sanitizeProvenance({isin:b.prov})});
   }
   proposals.set(k,{row,col:'isin',list:[{value:hk.isin,source,kind:'official_list',evidence,prov:{source,as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:hk.sha256,locator}}]});
  }
 }

 // Stage C: TICKER → FIGI for rows that still have none.
 const hasFigi=(row:SecRow)=>row.figi!==null||proposals.has(`${keyOf(row)}|figi`)||figiClaimed.has(keyOf(row));
 if(stages.has('C')){
  for(const row of runRows){
   if(hasFigi(row))continue;
   const r=input.tickerResults.get(row.ticker);
   if(!r)continue;
   if(r.status!=='ok'){out.skipped.push(r.status==='not_found'?'figi_not_found':'openfigi_error');continue;}
   const g=groupFigiResults(r.records);
   out.skipped.push(...g.skipped);
   const c=g.candidates.find(x=>x.ticker===row.ticker);
   if(!c){out.skipped.push('figi_not_found');continue;}
   if(c.groups.length===1)propose(row,'figi',figiProposal(r,c.groups[0]));
   else multiFigi(row,r,c.groups);
  }
 }
 out.figiMissing=[...new Set(runRows.filter(r=>!hasFigi(r)&&!input.tickerResults.has(r.ticker)).map(r=>r.ticker))].sort();

 // Resolve proposals against the stored values.
 for(const {row,col,list} of proposals.values()){
  const current=row[col];
  if(list.length>1){
   out.skipped.push(`ambiguous_${col}`);
   for(const p of list){
    if(current===p.value)continue;
    const op:Op=current===null?'set_identifier':'correct_identifier';
    claim({issuer_id:row.issuer_id,id_type:col,value:p.value,source:p.source,op,kind:p.kind,target:targetOf(row),
     params:op==='set_identifier'?{}:{expected_current:current,new_value:p.value},evidence:p.evidence,written:sanitizeProvenance({[col]:p.prov})});
   }
   continue;
  }
  const p=list[0];
  const patch=sanitizeProvenance({[col]:p.prov});
  const write=(kind:SecurityWrite['kind'])=>out.writes.push({kind,...targetOf(row),column:col,value:p.value,patch,source:p.source,evidenceKind:p.kind,evidence:p.evidence});
  if(current===null){write('set');continue;}
  if(current===p.value){if(col in row.provenance)out.duplicates++;else write('provenance');continue;}
  claim({issuer_id:row.issuer_id,id_type:col,value:p.value,source:p.source,op:'correct_identifier',kind:p.kind,target:targetOf(row),
   params:{expected_current:current,new_value:p.value},evidence:p.evidence,written:patch});
 }
 out.skipped.sort();
 return out;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 `apply.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/apply.ts
// Writes an IdentifierPlan (spec §4.1.2 "写入"): guarded column sets (only an empty column of an open
// row), provenance-only completions, claim/1 claims, ownership quarantines and the
// entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif text reconciliations (written directly until record.ts exists;
// contract issue 7). Each write reads the row's current provenance and merges its one key, so a
// failed sibling write never leaves provenance describing a value that is not stored. fetched =
// rows with a table outcome; claims-only outcomes are reported in claims_summary (informational),
// a correct_identifier also as identifier_mismatch (degrades the batch to partial).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {TableError,type TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,type BatchCounts,type BatchError} from '../../dq/batches';
import {DATASETS} from '../../dq/datasets';
import {fileClaim,type ClaimInput} from '../claims';
import {errorMessage,parkConflict,withSkippedSummary} from '../load-sec';
import {ISIN_RECON_PAIR,type IdentifierPlan,type SecurityWrite} from './plan';

export interface IdentifierApplyResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];skippedSummary:Record<string,number>;claimsSummary:Record<string,number>}

const violates=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof TableError&&(e.code==='23505'||e.code==='23P01');
const provOf=(v:unknown)=>(v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?v:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
const claimFor=(w:SecurityWrite,op:'set_identifier'|'correct_identifier',current:string|null):ClaimInput=>({
 issuer_id:w.issuer_id,id_type:w.column,value:w.value,source:w.source,op,detail:{
  schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:w.evidenceKind,target:{issuer_id:w.issuer_id,ticker:w.ticker,valid_from:w.valid_from},
  params:op==='set_identifier'?{}:{expected_current:current,new_value:w.value},evidence:w.evidence,sources:[w.evidence],provenance_written:w.patch,
 },
});

export async function applyIdentifierPlan(tables:TableClient,plan:IdentifierPlan,opts:{batchId:string;dataset:string}):Promise<IdentifierApplyResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();
 const errors:BatchError[]=[];
 const claimsSummary:Record<string,number>={};
 counts.duplicates=plan.duplicates;
 const fileOne=async(c:ClaimInput)=>{
  try{
   const created=await fileClaim(tables,c);
   const k=created?c.op:`${c.op}_appended`;
   claimsSummary[k]=(claimsSummary[k]??0)+1;
   if(c.op==='correct_identifier')errors.push({code:'identifier_mismatch',key:`${c.detail.target.ticker??c.issuer_id}:${c.id_type}`,message:`${String(c.detail.params.expected_current)} -> ${c.value}`});
  }catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'claim_error',key:`${c.issuer_id}:${c.id_type}:${c.value}`,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 };

 for(const w of plan.writes){
  const key={issuer_id:w.issuer_id,ticker:w.ticker,valid_from:w.valid_from};
  const where=`${w.ticker}:${w.valid_from}:${w.column}`;
  try{
   const [cur]=await tables.select('issuer_securities',key,{limit:1});
   if(!cur||cur.valid_to!==null){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'row_changed',key:where,message:'row missing or closed'});continue;}
   const stored=cur[w.column]==null?null:String(cur[w.column]);
   const provenance={...provOf(cur.provenance),...w.patch};
   if(stored!==null&&stored!==w.value){await fileOne(claimFor(w,'correct_identifier',stored));continue;}
   if(stored===w.value&&w.column in provOf(cur.provenance)){counts.duplicates++;continue;}
   const n=stored===null
    ?await tables.update('issuer_securities',{...key,valid_to:null,[w.column]:null},{[w.column]:w.value,provenance})
    :await tables.update('issuer_securities',{...key,valid_to:null,[w.column]:w.value},{provenance});
   if(n!==1){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'row_changed',key:where,message:'guarded update matched no row'});continue;}
   if(stored===null)counts.inserted++;else counts.duplicates++;
  }catch(e){
   if(w.column==='isin'&&violates(e)){
    await fileOne(claimFor(w,'set_identifier',null));
    await parkConflict(tables,{dataset:opts.dataset,table:'issuer_securities',naturalKey:`isin:${w.value}`,reasonCode:'ownership_conflict',
     detail:{reason:'isin_held_by_other_row',ticker:w.ticker,valid_from:w.valid_from},payload:{issuer_id:w.issuer_id,ticker:w.ticker,valid_from:w.valid_from,isin:w.value},batchId:opts.batchId},
     counts,errors,{code:'ownership_conflict',key:`isin:${w.value}`});
    continue;
   }
   counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'identifier_write_error',key:where,message:errorMessage(e)});
  }
 }
 for(const q of plan.quarantines){
  await parkConflict(tables,{dataset:opts.dataset,table:'issuer_securities',naturalKey:q.naturalKey,reasonCode:q.reasonCode,detail:q.detail,payload:q.payload,batchId:opts.batchId},
   counts,errors,{code:q.reasonCode,key:q.naturalKey});
 }
 for(const c of plan.claims)await fileOne(c);
 for(const r of plan.recons){
  try{
   await tables.insert('dq_reconciliations',{
    id:randomUUID(),dataset:DATASETS.reconcile(ISIN_RECON_PAIR),pair:ISIN_RECON_PAIR,kind:'text',outcome:'compared',
    left_source:r.leftSource,right_source:r.rightSource,natural_key:r.naturalKey,left_value:null,right_value:null,abs_diff:null,rel_diff:null,tolerance:0,passed:r.passed,
    detail:{left_text:r.leftText,right_text:r.rightText,...r.detail,tolerance_rule:'text_equal'},batch_id:opts.batchId,
    cycle_id:null,issuer_id:null,market:null,attempt:null,created_at:new Date().toISOString(),
   });
  }catch(e){errors.push({code:'reconciliation_error',key:r.naturalKey,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 }
 counts.fetched=counts.inserted+counts.duplicates+counts.versioned+counts.quarantined+counts.failed;
 const skippedSummary:Record<string,number>={};
 for(const s of plan.skipped)skippedSummary[s]=(skippedSummary[s]??0)+1;
 const lead:BatchError[]=Object.keys(claimsSummary).length?[{code:'claims_summary',message:JSON.stringify(claimsSummary)}]:[];
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary([...lead,...errors],skippedSummary),skippedSummary,claimsSummary};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/coverage.test.ts
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {coverageE1,meetsThreshold,ratio} from './coverage';

describe('ratio',()=>{
 it('formats a truncated two-decimal percentage with integer arithmetic and null for an empty denominator',()=>{
  expect(ratio(2,3)).toEqual({num:2,den:3,pct:'66.66'});
  expect(ratio(19,20)).toEqual({num:19,den:20,pct:'95.00'});
  expect(ratio(0,0)).toEqual({num:0,den:0,pct:null});
  expect(meetsThreshold(ratio(19,20),95)).toBe(true);
  expect(meetsThreshold(ratio(18,19),95)).toBe(false);
  expect(meetsThreshold(ratio(0,0),95)).toBe(false);
 });
});

describe('coverageE1',()=>{
 it('counts open rows of US in-scope issuers (priority > 0); the ISIN denominator keeps issuers with a LEI',()=>{
```

```ts
 return c;
}

  expect(res.counts).toMatchObject({failed:1});

  const res=await fillCninfoOrgIds({tables:c,raw,asOf:'2026-11-05',sleep:async()=>{},lookup:lookups({'600519':{hit:{orgId:'gssh0600519',name:'x'},bytes:bytes('[]')},'000001':{hit:null,bytes:bytes('[]')}})},await cninfoTargets(c),{batchId:null});

 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/entities/coverage.ts
// Success-criteria measurements (spec §1.1): E1 = FIGI/ISIN coverage of the open security rows of
// US in-scope issuers (fact_sync_scope market 'US', priority > 0); E2 (Task 5a) = listing-date
// windows on research-queue A/H rows. Pure functions over rows the coverage script reads; integer
// arithmetic only, percentages truncated to two decimals and never used for thresholds.
import type {Row} from '../db/table-client';

export interface Ratio{num:number;den:number;pct:string|null}
export function ratio(num:number,den:number):Ratio{
 if(den===0)return {num,den,pct:null};
 const bp=Math.floor(num*10000/den);
 return {num,den,pct:`${Math.floor(bp/100)}.${String(bp%100).padStart(2,'0')}`};
}
/** num/den >= pct% by cross-multiplication; an empty denominator never passes. */
export const meetsThreshold=(r:Ratio,pct:number)=>r.den>0&&r.num*100>=r.den*pct;

export interface E1Result{figi:Ratio;isin:Ratio;passes:{figi:boolean;isin:boolean}}
export function coverageE1(input:{scope:readonly Row[];securities:readonly Row[];issuers:readonly Row[]}):E1Result{
 const inScope=new Set(input.scope.filter(s=>s.market==='US'&&typeof s.priority==='number'&&s.priority>0).map(s=>String(s.issuer_id)));
 const withLei=new Set(input.issuers.filter(i=>typeof i.lei==='string'&&i.lei!=='').map(i=>String(i.issuer_id)));
 const rows=input.securities.filter(s=>s.valid_to==null&&inScope.has(String(s.issuer_id)));
 const isinRows=rows.filter(s=>withLei.has(String(s.issuer_id)));
 const figi=ratio(rows.filter(s=>s.figi!=null).length,rows.length);
 const isin=ratio(isinRows.filter(s=>s.isin!=null).length,isinRows.length);
 return {figi,isin,passes:{figi:meetsThreshold(figi,95),isin:meetsThreshold(isin,90)}};
}
```
