```ts
// src/lib/entities/cninfo-org-id.ts
// Spec §4.1.6: fill issuers.cninfo_org_id for active issuers that have a USCI, no orgId and an open
// .SH/.SZ row, from 巨潮 topSearch (exact code match, landed resolveOrgId). The guarded update only
// fills an empty column of an active issuer; a unique-index clash (another issuer holds the orgId)
// becomes a set_identifier claim; a different value appearing concurrently becomes
// correct_identifier. The exact topSearch response bytes go to reconcile-raw (kind 'cninfo') so
// the provenance/claim hash is replayable. batchId null = dry run (no bucket, no DB writes).
import {selectAll,type TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,type BatchError} from '../dq/batches';
import type {RawStore} from '../dq/raw-store';
import {fileClaim,isUnique,type ClaimInput} from './claims';
import {errorMessage,withSkippedSummary,type ApplyResult} from './load-sec';
import type {ClaimEvidence} from './types';

export interface CninfoLookup{hit:{orgId:string;name:string}|null;bytes:Uint8Array}
export interface CninfoTarget{issuer_id:string;code:string;ticker:string;provenance:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface CninfoDeps{tables:TableClient;raw:RawStore;lookup:(code:string)=>Promise<CninfoLookup>;asOf:string;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;intervalMs?:number}
export interface CninfoPlanned{issuer_id:string;code:string;orgId:string|null;outcome:'written'|'duplicate'|'claimed'|'not_found'|'failed'|'planned'}

const obj=(v:unknown)=>(v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?v:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
const A_SHARE=/^\d{6}\.(SH|SZ)$/;

export async function cninfoTargets(tables:TableClient):Promise<CninfoTarget[]>{
 const issuers=(await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{status:'active',cninfo_org_id:null},'issuer_id')).filter(r=>typeof r.usci==='string'&&r.usci!=='');
 const out:CninfoTarget[]=[];
 for(const i of issuers){
  const rows=await tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:i.issuer_id,valid_to:null},{orderBy:'ticker'});
  const a=[...rows].sort((x,y)=>Number(y.is_primary===true)-Number(x.is_primary===true)).find(r=>A_SHARE.test(String(r.ticker)));
  if(a)out.push({issuer_id:String(i.issuer_id),code:String(a.ticker).slice(0,6),ticker:String(a.ticker),provenance:obj(i.provenance)});
 }
 return out;
}

export async function fillCninfoOrgIds(deps:CninfoDeps,targets:readonly CninfoTarget[],opts:{batchId:string|null}):Promise<ApplyResult&{claims:Record<string,number>;planned:CninfoPlanned[]}>{
 const {tables}=deps;
 const sleep=deps.sleep??((ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)));
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const planned:CninfoPlanned[]=[];
 const skippedSummary:Record<string,number>={};const claims:Record<string,number>={};
 for(const [n,t] of targets.entries()){
  if(n>0)await sleep(deps.intervalMs??600);
  let look:CninfoLookup;
  try{look=await deps.lookup(t.code);}
  catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'cninfo_error',key:t.code,message:errorMessage(e)});planned.push({issuer_id:t.issuer_id,code:t.code,orgId:null,outcome:'failed'});continue;}
  if(!look.hit){skippedSummary.org_id_not_found=(skippedSummary.org_id_not_found??0)+1;planned.push({issuer_id:t.issuer_id,code:t.code,orgId:null,outcome:'not_found'});continue;}
  const orgId=look.hit.orgId;
  const plan=(outcome:CninfoPlanned['outcome'])=>planned.push({issuer_id:t.issuer_id,code:t.code,orgId,outcome});
  if(opts.batchId===null){plan('planned');continue;}
  try{
   const stored=await deps.raw.put({kind:'cninfo',bytes:look.bytes,contentType:'application/json',meta:{code:t.code}});
   const evidence:ClaimEvidence={source:'cninfo_topsearch',as_of:deps.asOf,evidence_sha256:stored.sha256,locator:`topSearch:keyWord=${t.code}`};
   const claim=async(op:'set_identifier'|'correct_identifier',current:string|null)=>{
    const c:ClaimInput={issuer_id:t.issuer_id,id_type:'cninfo_org_id',value:orgId,source:'cninfo_topsearch',op,detail:{
     schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:'provider_mapping',target:{issuer_id:t.issuer_id},params:op==='set_identifier'?{}:{expected_current:current,new_value:orgId},evidence,sources:[evidence],
    }};
    const created=await fileClaim(tables,c);
    const k=created?op:`${op}_appended`;claims[k]=(claims[k]??0)+1;plan('claimed');
   };
   try{
    const n=await tables.update('issuers',{issuer_id:t.issuer_id,status:'active',cninfo_org_id:null},{
     cninfo_org_id:orgId,provenance:{...t.provenance,cninfo_org_id:{source:'cninfo_topsearch',as_of:deps.asOf,evidence_sha256:stored.sha256}},updated_at:new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    if(n===1){counts.inserted++;plan('written');continue;}
    const [now]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:t.issuer_id},{limit:1});
    if(now?.cninfo_org_id===orgId){counts.duplicates++;plan('duplicate');continue;}
    if(now?.status==='active'&&typeof now.cninfo_org_id==='string'){await claim('correct_identifier',now.cninfo_org_id);continue;}
    counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'issuer_changed',key:t.issuer_id,message:'issuer no longer active'});plan('failed');
   }catch(e){
    if(isUnique(e)){await claim('set_identifier',null);continue;}
    throw e;
   }
  }catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'cninfo_write_error',key:t.issuer_id,message:errorMessage(e)});plan('failed');}
 }
 counts.fetched=counts.inserted+counts.duplicates+counts.failed;
 const lead:BatchError[]=Object.keys(claims).length?[{code:'claims_summary',message:JSON.stringify(claims)}]:[];
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary([...lead,...errors],skippedSummary),skippedSummary,rejectedSummary:{},claims,planned};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Fill issuers.cninfo_org_id from 巨潮 topSearch (spec §4.1.6): active issuers with a USCI, no orgId
 * and an open .SH/.SZ row; exact code match; one request every 600 ms.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/fill-cninfo-org-id.ts [--apply]
 * Dry run (default): looks up and prints, writes nothing (no batch, no bucket). --apply records an
 * ingest batch (dataset entities.cninfo), stores every topSearch response in reconcile-raw, writes
 * guarded updates and files set_identifier claims on unique-index clashes.
 * first-cohort.json is no longer a write target.
 * Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
 */
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch,type BatchError,type BatchStatus} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import {DATASETS,DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY} from '../../src/lib/dq/datasets';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../src/lib/dq/freshness';
import {memoryRawStore,supabaseRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {cninfoTargets,fillCninfoOrgIds,type CninfoLookup} from '../../src/lib/entities/cninfo-org-id';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {resolveOrgId} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/cninfo';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const DATASET=DATASETS.entities.cninfo;
const cadenceOf=(dataset:string)=>{const e=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);if(!e)throw new Error(`unregistered_dataset:${dataset}`);return e.cadence;};

/** resolveOrgId through a fetch that keeps the exact response bytes (evidence for reconcile-raw). */
async function lookup(code:string):Promise<CninfoLookup>{
 let bytes=new Uint8Array();
 const tap=(async(url:string|URL|Request,init?:RequestInit)=>{
  const res=await fetch(url,init);
  bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  return new Response(bytes,{status:res.status,statusText:res.statusText,headers:res.headers});
 }) as typeof fetch;
 const hit=await resolveOrgId(code,{fetch:tap});
 return {hit:hit?{orgId:hit.orgId,name:hit.name}:null,bytes};
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);
 if(argv.some(a=>a!=='--apply')){console.error('usage: fill-cninfo-org-id.ts [--apply]');process.exit(2);}
 const apply=argv.includes('--apply');
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
 const asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const targets=await cninfoTargets(tables);
 if(!apply){
  const res=await fillCninfoOrgIds({tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),lookup,asOf},targets,{batchId:null});
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'dry-run (no batch, nothing written; pass --apply)',targets:targets.length,planned:res.planned,skipped:res.skippedSummary,errors:res.errors},null,1));
  return;
 }
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'fill-cninfo-org-id',dataset:DATASET,toolVersions:{source:'cninfo_topsearch',as_of:asOf}});
 let counts=emptyCounts(),errors:BatchError[]=[],status:BatchStatus='failed';
 try{({counts,errors}=await fillCninfoOrgIds({tables,raw:supabaseRawStore(admin),lookup,asOf},targets,{batchId}));}
 catch(e){errors=[...errors,{code:'exception',message:errorMessage(e)}];}
 finally{
  try{status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors});}
  catch(e){console.error(`finishBatch failed: ${errorMessage(e)}`);status='failed';}
 }
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts);
 await recordAttempt(tables,DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:cadenceOf(DATASET)});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({batchId,status,counts,errors:errors.slice(0,20)},null,1));
 process.exitCode=outcome.exitCode;
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
/**
 * Success-criteria measurements (spec §1.1). Read-only.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/coverage.ts [--segment e1|all] [--out <file.md>]
 * E1: FIGI/ISIN coverage of open security rows of US in-scope issuers (targets 95% / 90%).
 * --out writes a markdown table (e.g. docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/e1-<date>.md).
 */
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {coverageE1,type E1Result} from '../../src/lib/entities/coverage';
import {errorMessage} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

function args(argv:string[]){
 let segment='all',out:string|null=null;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  if(argv[i]==='--segment')segment=argv[++i]??'';
  else if(argv[i]==='--out')out=argv[++i]??null;
  else{console.error('usage: coverage.ts [--segment e1|all] [--out <file.md>]');process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!['e1','all'].includes(segment)||(argv.includes('--out')&&!out)){console.error('usage: coverage.ts [--segment e1|all] [--out <file.md>]');process.exit(2);}
 return {segment,out};
}
const e1Markdown=(r:E1Result,at:string)=>[
 `## E1 · 标识符覆盖（${at}）`,'','| 指标 | 分子 | 分母 | 百分比 | 目标 | 达标 |','|---|---|---|---|---|---|',
 `| FIGI（美股范围发行人未关闭行） | ${r.figi.num} | ${r.figi.den} | ${r.figi.pct??'—'} | 95% | ${r.passes.figi?'是':'否'} |`,
 `| ISIN（其中发行人有 LEI 的行） | ${r.isin.num} | ${r.isin.den} | ${r.isin.pct??'—'} | 90% | ${r.passes.isin?'是':'否'} |`,'',
].join('\n');

async function main(){
 const {out}=args(process.argv.slice(2));
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(getAdminSupabase());
 const at=new Date().toISOString();
 const e1=coverageE1({
  scope:await selectAll(tables,'fact_sync_scope',{market:'US'},'issuer_id'),
  securities:await selectAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{valid_to:null},'ticker'),
  issuers:await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{},'issuer_id'),
 });
 console.log(JSON.stringify({at,e1},null,1));
 if(out)writeFileSync(out,e1Markdown(e1,at));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

- [ ] **Step 10: 写 `scripts/entity-keys/fill-identifiers.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Fill ISIN/FIGI on open issuer_securities rows (spec §4.1): A GLEIF subset → B OpenFIGI by ISIN →
 * D HKEX lists → C OpenFIGI by ticker for rows still without a FIGI.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/fill-identifiers.ts --gleif <lei-isin.csv> --hkex <dir> [--stage A|B|C|D|all] [--issuer <uuid>]... [--apply]
 * --stage B implies A (B queries the ISINs A selects); default all. --gleif is needed for A/B,
 * --hkex for D (files named as in HKEX_LIST_FILES; missing files are skipped).
 * Dry run (default): no ingest batch, no DB or bucket writes (raw evidence is hashed in memory);
 * OpenFIGI IS called and E1 before/after the planned writes is printed.
 * --apply refuses while EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED is false (Task 3b live check, verification.md).
 * Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; optional OPENFIGI_API_KEY (raises limits).
 * tsx does not load .env.local: node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/entity-keys/fill-identifiers.ts …
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {createReadStream,existsSync,readFileSync,statSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {createInterface} from 'node:readline';
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient,type Row,type TableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch,type BatchError,type BatchStatus} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import {DATASETS,DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY} from '../../src/lib/dq/datasets';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../src/lib/dq/freshness';
import {memoryRawStore,supabaseRawStore,type RawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {coverageE1} from '../../src/lib/entities/coverage';
import {applyIdentifierPlan} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/apply';
import {filterGleifLines,subsetForLeis,type GleifSubset} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/gleif';
import {HKEX_LIST_FILES,XLSX_MIME,mergeHkexIsins,parseHkexList,type HkexFileId,type HkexIsin,type HkexListParse} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/hkex-list';
import {EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED,EXCH_MAP_VERSION,OPENFIGI_VERSION,mapIsins,mapTickers,type FigiJobResult} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/openfigi';
import {planIdentifierWrites,type IdentifierPlan,type IssuerRow,type PlanInput,type SecRow,type Stage} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/plan';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const DATASET=DATASETS.entities.identifiers;
const USAGE='usage: fill-identifiers.ts --gleif <lei-isin.csv> --hkex <dir> [--stage A|B|C|D|all] [--issuer <uuid>]... [--apply]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const STAGES:Record<string,Stage[]>={A:['A'],B:['A','B'],C:['C'],D:['D'],all:['A','B','C','D']};
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v!==''?v:null;
const obj=(v:unknown)=>(v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?v:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
const cadenceOf=(dataset:string)=>{const e=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);if(!e)throw new Error(`unregistered_dataset:${dataset}`);return e.cadence;};

interface Args{gleif:string|null;hkex:string|null;stages:Set<Stage>;issuers:string[];apply:boolean}
function bad():never{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={gleif:null,hkex:null,stages:new Set(STAGES.all),issuers:[],apply:false};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const k=argv[i];
  if(k==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else if(k==='--gleif')a.gleif=argv[++i]??bad();
  else if(k==='--hkex')a.hkex=argv[++i]??bad();
  else if(k==='--stage'){const s=STAGES[argv[++i]??''];if(!s)bad();a.stages=new Set(s);}
  else if(k==='--issuer'){const id=argv[++i]??bad();if(!UUID.test(id))bad();a.issuers.push(id.toLowerCase());}
  else bad();
 }
 if(a.stages.has('A')&&(!a.gleif||!existsSync(a.gleif)))bad();
 if(a.stages.has('D')&&(!a.hkex||!existsSync(a.hkex)))bad();
 return a;
}

async function fileDigest(path:string):Promise<{sha256:string;bytes:number}>{
 const h=createHash('sha256');let bytes=0;
 for await(const chunk of createReadStream(path)){const b=chunk as Buffer;h.update(b);bytes+=b.length;}
 return {sha256:h.digest('hex'),bytes};
}

interface Inputs{
 issuers:IssuerRow[];openRows:SecRow[];universe:Set<string>;scope:Row[];issuerRows:Row[];
 gleif:{subset:GleifSubset;sha256:string;bytes:number;downloaded:string}|null;
 hkex:{parses:HkexListParse[];bytes:Map<HkexFileId,Uint8Array>}|null;
}

/** Everything that needs no network and no bucket: DB reads, the GLEIF subset, the HKEX parses. */
async function readInputs(tables:TableClient,args:Args):Promise<Inputs>{
 const issuerRows=await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{},'issuer_id');
 const issuers=issuerRows.filter(r=>r.status==='active'&&(args.issuers.length===0||args.issuers.includes(String(r.issuer_id))))
  .map(r=>({issuer_id:String(r.issuer_id),lei:str(r.lei),usci:str(r.usci)}));
 const openRows=(await selectAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{valid_to:null},'ticker'))
  .map(r=>({issuer_id:String(r.issuer_id),ticker:String(r.ticker),valid_from:String(r.valid_from),isin:str(r.isin),figi:str(r.figi),provenance:obj(r.provenance)}));
 const universe=new Set((await selectAll(tables,'stocks_universe',{},'ticker')).map(r=>String(r.ticker)));
 const scope=await selectAll(tables,'fact_sync_scope',{market:'US'},'issuer_id');
 let gleif:Inputs['gleif']=null;
 if(args.stages.has('A')){
  const leis=new Set(issuers.map(i=>i.lei).filter((l):l is string=>l!==null));
  const lines:string[]=[];
  for await(const l of filterGleifLines(createInterface({input:createReadStream(args.gleif!),crlfDelay:Infinity}),leis))lines.push(l);
  const digest=await fileDigest(args.gleif!);
  gleif={subset:subsetForLeis(lines,leis),...digest,downloaded:statSync(args.gleif!).mtime.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
 }
 let hkex:Inputs['hkex']=null;
 if(args.stages.has('D')){
  const parses:HkexListParse[]=[];const bytes=new Map<HkexFileId,Uint8Array>();
  for(const f of HKEX_LIST_FILES){
   const p=join(args.hkex!,f.file);
   if(!existsSync(p))continue;
   const b=new Uint8Array(readFileSync(p));
   parses.push(parseHkexList(b,f.id));bytes.set(f.id,b);
  }
  hkex={parses,bytes};
 }
 return {issuers,openRows,universe,scope,issuerRows,gleif,hkex};
}

/** Stores the evidence, calls OpenFIGI (B, then C for rows still without a FIGI) and plans. */
async function evidenceAndPlan(inp:Inputs,raw:RawStore,args:Args,asOf:string):Promise<{plan:IdentifierPlan;exhausted:boolean;requests:number}>{
 if(inp.gleif)await raw.put({kind:'gleif',bytes:new TextEncoder().encode(inp.gleif.subset.csv),contentType:'text/csv',
  meta:{source_sha256:inp.gleif.sha256,source_bytes:inp.gleif.bytes,downloaded:inp.gleif.downloaded,leis:inp.gleif.subset.byLei.size}});
 let hkexMap:ReadonlyMap<string,HkexIsin>|null=null;
 if(inp.hkex){
  for(const p of inp.hkex.parses)await raw.put({kind:'hkex',bytes:inp.hkex.bytes.get(p.file)!,contentType:XLSX_MIME,meta:{file:p.file}});
  const merged=mergeHkexIsins(inp.hkex.parses);
  hkexMap=merged.hasIsinColumn?merged.byCode:null;
 }
 const deps={fetch,raw,apiKey:process.env.OPENFIGI_API_KEY||null};
 let isinResults:ReadonlyMap<string,FigiJobResult>=new Map();
 let exhausted=false,requests=0;
 if(args.stages.has('B')&&inp.gleif){
  const m=await mapIsins([...new Set([...inp.gleif.subset.byLei.values()].flat())].sort(),deps);
  isinResults=m.byKey;exhausted=m.exhausted;requests+=m.requests;
 }
 const base:PlanInput={asOf,stages:args.stages,issuers:inp.issuers,openRows:inp.openRows,universe:inp.universe,
  gleif:inp.gleif?{sha256:inp.gleif.subset.sha256,byLei:inp.gleif.subset.byLei}:null,isinResults,tickerResults:new Map(),hkex:hkexMap};
 let plan=planIdentifierWrites(base);
 if(args.stages.has('C')&&!exhausted&&plan.figiMissing.length){
  const m=await mapTickers(plan.figiMissing,deps);
  exhausted=m.exhausted;requests+=m.requests;
  plan=planIdentifierWrites({...base,tickerResults:m.byKey});
 }
 return {plan,exhausted,requests};
}

function summary(plan:IdentifierPlan){
 const by=(xs:string[])=>xs.reduce<Record<string,number>>((m,x)=>{m[x]=(m[x]??0)+1;return m;},{});
 return {
  writes:by(plan.writes.map(w=>`${w.kind}:${w.column}`)),claims:by(plan.claims.map(c=>`${c.op}:${c.id_type}`)),quarantines:plan.quarantines.length,
  recons:{passed:plan.recons.filter(r=>r.passed).length,failed:plan.recons.filter(r=>!r.passed).length},
  ahCandidates:plan.ahCandidates.length,duplicates:plan.duplicates,figiMissing:plan.figiMissing.length,skipped:by(plan.skipped),
 };
}
function projectedRows(inp:Inputs,plan:IdentifierPlan):Row[]{
 const k=(r:{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string})=>`${r.issuer_id}|${r.ticker}|${r.valid_from}`;
 const sets=new Map(plan.writes.filter(w=>w.kind==='set').map(w=>[`${k(w)}|${w.column}`,w.value]));
 return inp.openRows.map(r=>({...r,valid_to:null,isin:r.isin??sets.get(`${k(r)}|isin`)??null,figi:r.figi??sets.get(`${k(r)}|figi`)??null}));
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 if(args.apply&&!EXCH_MAP_VERIFIED){
  console.error('exch_map_unverified: run the Task 3b OpenFIGI live check first (docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/verification.md)');
  process.exit(2);
 }
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
 const asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 let inp:Inputs;
 try{inp=await readInputs(tables,args);}
 catch(e){
  // A malformed GLEIF/HKEX file still leaves a failed receipt in --apply mode (spec §8 invalid_schema).
  const code=errorMessage(e)==='invalid_schema'?'invalid_schema':'exception';
  if(args.apply){
   const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'fill-identifiers',dataset:DATASET,toolVersions:{openfigi:OPENFIGI_VERSION,exch_map:EXCH_MAP_VERSION}});
   await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[{code,message:errorMessage(e)}]});
   await recordAttempt(tables,DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:cadenceOf(DATASET)});
  }
  console.error(`${code}: ${errorMessage(e)}`);process.exit(1);
 }
 if(!args.apply){
  const {plan,exhausted,requests}=await evidenceAndPlan(inp,memoryRawStore(),args,asOf);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
   mode:'dry-run (no batch, nothing written; pass --apply)',stages:[...args.stages].sort().join(''),issuers:inp.issuers.length,openfigiRequests:requests,quotaExhausted:exhausted,
   plan:summary(plan),
   e1:{current:coverageE1({scope:inp.scope,securities:inp.openRows.map(r=>({...r,valid_to:null})),issuers:inp.issuerRows}),projected:coverageE1({scope:inp.scope,securities:projectedRows(inp,plan),issuers:inp.issuerRows})},
  },null,1));
  return;
 }
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'fill-identifiers',dataset:DATASET,toolVersions:{
  gleif_file_sha256:inp.gleif?.sha256??'none',gleif_subset_sha256:inp.gleif?.subset.sha256??'none',
  hkex_file_sha256s:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries((inp.hkex?.parses??[]).map(p=>[p.file,p.sha256]))),
  openfigi:OPENFIGI_VERSION,exch_map:EXCH_MAP_VERSION,stages:[...args.stages].sort().join(''),as_of:asOf,
 }});
 let counts=emptyCounts(),errors:BatchError[]=[],status:BatchStatus='failed';
 try{
  const {plan,exhausted}=await evidenceAndPlan(inp,supabaseRawStore(admin),args,asOf);
  ({counts,errors}=await applyIdentifierPlan(tables,plan,{batchId,dataset:DATASET}));
  if(exhausted)errors=[...errors,{code:'quota_exhausted',message:'OpenFIGI limit reached: remaining jobs of this run skipped'}];
 }catch(e){errors=[...errors,{code:'exception',message:errorMessage(e)}];}
 finally{
  try{status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors});}
  catch(e){console.error(`finishBatch failed: ${errorMessage(e)}`);status='failed';}
 }
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts);
 await recordAttempt(tables,DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:cadenceOf(DATASET)});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({batchId,status,counts,errors:errors.slice(0,20)},null,1));
 process.exitCode=outcome.exitCode;
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `windows.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/windows.ts
// Evidenced holding windows (spec §4.3.1–§4.3.2). planWindowBackfill is pure: per ticker it lifts
// the EARLIEST holding row's valid_from to stocks_universe.list_date (method listing_date) and
// closes the LATEST open row at delist_date (method delisting), copying the exact source-row
// values into provenance (never a reference to the mutable universe table). A listing date after
// the first observation, or a delisting on/before valid_from, is a window_evidence_conflict
// (quarantined, row unchanged). US tickers carry no list_date and are left as first_observed.
// applyWindowBackfill uses guarded updates; exclusion/unique violations become ownership_conflict.
import {MAX_PAGE,type RangeOptions,type Row,type TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,type BatchError} from '../dq/batches';
import {isUnique} from './claims';
import {errorMessage,parkConflict,withSkippedSummary,type ApplyResult} from './load-sec';
import {sanitizeProvenance} from './provenance';

export const WINDOWS_RULES_VERSION='windows/1';
export const SEC_ROW_KEY=['issuer_id','ticker','valid_from'] as const;
export interface UniverseDates{ticker:string;list_date:string|null;delist_date:string|null;source:string|null;source_updated_at:string|null}
export interface WindowRow{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null;valid_from_method:string;valid_to_method:string|null;provenance:Record<string,unknown>}
export type WindowChange=
 |{kind:'from';row:WindowRow;newValidFrom:string;provenance:Record<string,unknown>}
 |{kind:'to';row:WindowRow;validFrom:string;newValidTo:string;provenance:Record<string,unknown>};
export interface WindowConflict{row:WindowRow;reason:'list_date_after_first_observed'|'delist_on_or_before_valid_from';detail:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface WindowPlan{changes:WindowChange[];conflicts:WindowConflict[];unchanged:number;skipped:string[]}

/**
 * Pages a table by a NON-unique order column with gte cursors, de-duplicating on keyCols (same
 * approach as the private helper in facts/scope.ts). A single order value with more than MAX_PAGE
 * rows cannot be paged and throws keyset_tie_group_overflow.
 */
export async function keysetAll(tables:TableClient,table:string,match:Row,range:RangeOptions,orderBy:string,keyCols:readonly string[]):Promise<Row[]>{
 const seen=new Set<string>(),out:Row[]=[];
 let cursor:string|null=null;
 for(;;){
  const gte={...range.gte,...(cursor===null?{}:{[orderBy]:cursor})};
  const page=await tables.select(table,match,{...range,gte,orderBy,limit:MAX_PAGE});
  for(const r of page){const k=keyCols.map(c=>String(r[c])).join('\u0000');if(!seen.has(k)){seen.add(k);out.push(r);}}
  if(page.length<MAX_PAGE)return out;
  const last=String(page[page.length-1][orderBy]);
  if(last===cursor)throw new Error('keyset_tie_group_overflow');
  cursor=last;
 }
}

const byFrom=(a:WindowRow,b:WindowRow)=>a.valid_from<b.valid_from?-1:a.valid_from>b.valid_from?1:0;

export function planWindowBackfill(rows:readonly WindowRow[],universe:ReadonlyMap<string,UniverseDates>,asOf:string):WindowPlan{
 const byTicker=new Map<string,WindowRow[]>();
 for(const r of rows){const l=byTicker.get(r.ticker)??[];l.push(r);byTicker.set(r.ticker,l);}
 const plan:WindowPlan={changes:[],conflicts:[],unchanged:0,skipped:[]};
 for(const ticker of [...byTicker.keys()].sort()){
  const list=[...byTicker.get(ticker)!].sort(byFrom);
  const u=universe.get(ticker);
  if(!u){plan.skipped.push('not_in_universe');continue;}
  const first=list[0],last=list[list.length-1];
  let firstFrom=first.valid_from,firstProv=first.provenance;
  if(u.list_date===null)plan.skipped.push('no_list_date');
  else if(first.valid_from_method==='listing_date')plan.unchanged++;
  else if(first.valid_from_method!=='first_observed'&&first.valid_from_method!=='curated')plan.skipped.push(`method_${first.valid_from_method}`);
  else if(u.list_date>first.valid_from)plan.conflicts.push({row:first,reason:'list_date_after_first_observed',detail:{list_date:u.list_date,valid_from:first.valid_from,source:u.source}});
  else{
   firstProv={...first.provenance,...sanitizeProvenance({valid_from:{source:'stocks_universe.list_date',provider:u.source,as_of:asOf,row:{list_date:u.list_date,source:u.source,source_updated_at:u.source_updated_at}}})};
   firstFrom=u.list_date;
   plan.changes.push({kind:'from',row:first,newValidFrom:firstFrom,provenance:firstProv});
  }
  if(u.delist_date!==null&&last.valid_to===null){
   const vf=last===first?firstFrom:last.valid_from;
   const base=last===first?firstProv:last.provenance;
   if(u.delist_date<=vf)plan.conflicts.push({row:last,reason:'delist_on_or_before_valid_from',detail:{delist_date:u.delist_date,valid_from:vf,source:u.source}});
   else plan.changes.push({kind:'to',row:last,validFrom:vf,newValidTo:u.delist_date,provenance:{...base,...sanitizeProvenance({valid_to:{source:'stocks_universe.delist_date',provider:u.source,as_of:asOf,row:{delist_date:u.delist_date,source:u.source,source_updated_at:u.source_updated_at}}})}});
  }
 }
 plan.skipped.sort();
 return plan;
}

export async function applyWindowBackfill(tables:TableClient,plan:WindowPlan,opts:{batchId:string;dataset:string}):Promise<ApplyResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];
 counts.duplicates=plan.unchanged;
 const keyOf=(r:WindowRow)=>`${r.ticker}:${r.valid_from}`;
 const park=(r:WindowRow,reason:'ownership_conflict'|'window_evidence_conflict',detail:Record<string,unknown>)=>parkConflict(tables,{
  dataset:opts.dataset,table:'issuer_securities',naturalKey:keyOf(r),reasonCode:reason,detail,
  payload:{issuer_id:r.issuer_id,ticker:r.ticker,valid_from:r.valid_from,valid_to:r.valid_to,valid_from_method:r.valid_from_method},batchId:opts.batchId,
 },counts,errors,{code:reason,key:keyOf(r)});
 const blocked=new Set<string>();
 for(const c of plan.changes){
  const id=`${c.row.issuer_id}|${keyOf(c.row)}`;
  if(c.kind==='to'&&blocked.has(id)){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'blocked_by_from_change',key:keyOf(c.row)});continue;}
  try{
   const n=c.kind==='from'
    ?await tables.update('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:c.row.issuer_id,ticker:c.row.ticker,valid_from:c.row.valid_from,valid_from_method:c.row.valid_from_method},{valid_from:c.newValidFrom,valid_from_method:'listing_date',provenance:c.provenance})
    :await tables.update('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:c.row.issuer_id,ticker:c.row.ticker,valid_from:c.validFrom,valid_to:null},{valid_to:c.newValidTo,valid_to_method:'delisting',provenance:c.provenance});
   if(n===1){counts.versioned++;continue;}
   if(c.kind==='from')blocked.add(id);
   counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'row_changed',key:keyOf(c.row),message:c.kind});
  }catch(e){
   if(c.kind==='from')blocked.add(id);
   if(isUnique(e)){await park(c.row,'ownership_conflict',{reason:'window_overlaps_other_row',change:c.kind,new_value:c.kind==='from'?c.newValidFrom:c.newValidTo});continue;}
   counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'window_write_error',key:keyOf(c.row),message:errorMessage(e)});
  }
 }
 for(const x of plan.conflicts)await park(x.row,'window_evidence_conflict',{reason:x.reason,...x.detail});
 counts.fetched=counts.inserted+counts.duplicates+counts.versioned+counts.quarantined+counts.failed;
 const skippedSummary:Record<string,number>={};
 for(const s of plan.skipped)skippedSummary[s]=(skippedSummary[s]??0)+1;
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary(errors,skippedSummary),skippedSummary,rejectedSummary:{}};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: `coverage.ts` 加 `coverageE2`（追加到文件末尾）**

```ts
export interface E2Result{backfillable:Ratio;not_backfillable:number;open_quarantine:number;passes:boolean}
/**
 * E2 (spec §1.1): research-queue A/H rows. Backfillable = the earliest row of its ticker in this
 * database, stocks_universe.list_date non-null, and no open window_evidence_conflict /
 * ownership_conflict item keyed `${ticker}:${valid_from}`. Target: 100% listing_date.
 */
export function coverageE2(input:{rows:readonly Row[];listDates:ReadonlyMap<string,string|null>;queueIssuers:ReadonlySet<string>;openQuarantineKeys:ReadonlySet<string>}):E2Result{
 const earliest=new Map<string,string>();
 for(const r of input.rows){const t=String(r.ticker),vf=String(r.valid_from);const e=earliest.get(t);if(e===undefined||vf<e)earliest.set(t,vf);}
 const key=(r:Row)=>`${r.ticker}:${r.valid_from}`;
 const ah=input.rows.filter(r=>/\.(SH|SZ|HK)$/.test(String(r.ticker))&&input.queueIssuers.has(String(r.issuer_id)));
 const back=ah.filter(r=>earliest.get(String(r.ticker))===String(r.valid_from)&&!!input.listDates.get(String(r.ticker))&&!input.openQuarantineKeys.has(key(r)));
 const backfillable=ratio(back.filter(r=>r.valid_from_method==='listing_date').length,back.length);
 return {backfillable,not_backfillable:ah.length-back.length,open_quarantine:ah.filter(r=>input.openQuarantineKeys.has(key(r))).length,passes:backfillable.den>0&&backfillable.num===backfillable.den};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Evidenced holding windows (spec §4.3.2): earliest row per ticker → stocks_universe.list_date,
 * latest open row → delist_date; conflicts are quarantined. A-share and HK universe rows only
 * (US carries no list_date).
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/backfill-windows.ts [--apply]
 * Dry run (default): prints the plan, writes nothing. --apply records an ingest batch (dataset
 * entities.windows) and a freshness attempt.
 * Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
 */
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient,type TableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch,type BatchError,type BatchStatus} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import {DATASETS,DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY} from '../../src/lib/dq/datasets';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../src/lib/dq/freshness';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {SEC_ROW_KEY,WINDOWS_RULES_VERSION,applyWindowBackfill,keysetAll,planWindowBackfill,type UniverseDates,type WindowRow} from '../../src/lib/entities/windows';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const DATASET=DATASETS.entities.windows;
const cadenceOf=(dataset:string)=>{const e=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);if(!e)throw new Error(`unregistered_dataset:${dataset}`);return e.cadence;};
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v!==''?v:null;

async function load(tables:TableClient){
 const rows:WindowRow[]=(await keysetAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{},{},'ticker',SEC_ROW_KEY)).map(r=>({
  issuer_id:String(r.issuer_id),ticker:String(r.ticker),valid_from:String(r.valid_from),valid_to:str(r.valid_to),
  valid_from_method:String(r.valid_from_method),valid_to_method:str(r.valid_to_method),
  provenance:(r.provenance&&typeof r.provenance==='object'?r.provenance:{}) as Record<string,unknown>,
 }));
 const universe=new Map<string,UniverseDates>();
 for(const market of ['A','HK'])for(const r of await selectAll(tables,'stocks_universe',{market},'ticker'))
  universe.set(String(r.ticker),{ticker:String(r.ticker),list_date:str(r.list_date),delist_date:str(r.delist_date),source:str(r.source),source_updated_at:str(r.source_updated_at)});
 return {rows:rows.filter(r=>universe.has(r.ticker)),universe};
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);
 if(argv.some(a=>a!=='--apply')){console.error('usage: backfill-windows.ts [--apply]');process.exit(2);}
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(getAdminSupabase());
 const asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 if(!argv.includes('--apply')){
  const {rows,universe}=await load(tables);
  const plan=planWindowBackfill(rows,universe,asOf);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'dry-run (nothing written; pass --apply)',rows:rows.length,
   changes:{from:plan.changes.filter(c=>c.kind==='from').length,to:plan.changes.filter(c=>c.kind==='to').length},
   conflicts:plan.conflicts.length,unchanged:plan.unchanged,firstConflicts:plan.conflicts.slice(0,10).map(c=>({ticker:c.row.ticker,valid_from:c.row.valid_from,reason:c.reason}))},null,1));
  return;
 }
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'backfill-windows',dataset:DATASET,toolVersions:{rules:WINDOWS_RULES_VERSION,as_of:asOf}});
 let counts=emptyCounts(),errors:BatchError[]=[],status:BatchStatus='failed';
 try{
  const {rows,universe}=await load(tables);
  ({counts,errors}=await applyWindowBackfill(tables,planWindowBackfill(rows,universe,asOf),{batchId,dataset:DATASET}));
 }catch(e){errors=[...errors,{code:'exception',message:errorMessage(e)}];}
 finally{
  try{status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors});}
  catch(e){console.error(`finishBatch failed: ${errorMessage(e)}`);status='failed';}
 }
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts);
 await recordAttempt(tables,DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:cadenceOf(DATASET)});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({batchId,status,counts,errors:errors.slice(0,20)},null,1));
 process.exitCode=outcome.exitCode;
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

注：`loaderOutcome` 的 `ok` 要求 `inserted+duplicates>0`（部分成功时）；回填只产生 `versioned`/`duplicates`，全部是 `versioned` 且无失败时状态是 `success`，`ok=true`，不受影响。

```ts
/**
 * Success-criteria measurements (spec §1.1). Read-only.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/coverage.ts [--segment e1|windows|all] [--out <file.md>]
 * E1: FIGI/ISIN coverage of open security rows of US in-scope issuers (targets 95% / 90%).
 * windows (E2): research-queue A/H rows — backfillable rows at listing_date (target 100%), with the
 * non-backfillable and open-quarantine counts reported separately. The research queue is
 * research_entity_keys with in_scope = true and a linked issuer_id (Part B contract issue 10).
 * --out writes a markdown table (e.g. docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/coverage-<date>.md).
 */
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient,type TableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {DATASETS} from '../../src/lib/dq/datasets';
import {coverageE1,coverageE2,type E1Result,type E2Result} from '../../src/lib/entities/coverage';
import {errorMessage} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {SEC_ROW_KEY,keysetAll} from '../../src/lib/entities/windows';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: coverage.ts [--segment e1|windows|all] [--out <file.md>]';
function args(argv:string[]){
 let segment='all',out:string|null=null;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  if(argv[i]==='--segment')segment=argv[++i]??'';
  else if(argv[i]==='--out')out=argv[++i]??'';
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!['e1','windows','all'].includes(segment)||out===''){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 return {segment,out};
}

async function e1(tables:TableClient){
 return coverageE1({
  scope:await selectAll(tables,'fact_sync_scope',{market:'US'},'issuer_id'),
  securities:await selectAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{valid_to:null},'ticker'),
  issuers:await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{},'issuer_id'),
 });
}
async function windows(tables:TableClient){
 const rows=await keysetAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{},{},'ticker',SEC_ROW_KEY);
 const listDates=new Map<string,string|null>();
 for(const market of ['A','HK'])for(const r of await selectAll(tables,'stocks_universe',{market},'ticker'))listDates.set(String(r.ticker),typeof r.list_date==='string'?r.list_date:null);
 const queue=new Set((await keysetAll(tables,'research_entity_keys',{in_scope:true},{},'entity_id',['user_id','entity_id'])).map(r=>r.issuer_id).filter((v):v is string=>typeof v==='string'));
 const open=await selectAll(tables,'dq_quarantine',{status:'open',dataset:DATASETS.entities.windows},'id');
 const keys=new Set(open.filter(q=>q.reason_code==='window_evidence_conflict'||q.reason_code==='ownership_conflict').map(q=>String(q.natural_key)));
 return coverageE2({rows,listDates,queueIssuers:queue,openQuarantineKeys:keys});
}
const md=(at:string,a:E1Result|null,b:E2Result|null)=>[
 `# 覆盖度量（${at}）`,'',
 ...(a?['## E1 · 标识符覆盖','','| 指标 | 分子 | 分母 | 百分比 | 目标 | 达标 |','|---|---|---|---|---|---|',
  `| FIGI（美股范围发行人未关闭行） | ${a.figi.num} | ${a.figi.den} | ${a.figi.pct??'—'} | 95% | ${a.passes.figi?'是':'否'} |`,
  `| ISIN（其中发行人有 LEI 的行） | ${a.isin.num} | ${a.isin.den} | ${a.isin.pct??'—'} | 90% | ${a.passes.isin?'是':'否'} |`,'']:[]),
 ...(b?['## E2 · 持有区间（研究队列 A/H 行）','','| 指标 | 值 |','|---|---|',
  `| 可回填行中 listing_date | ${b.backfillable.num} / ${b.backfillable.den}（${b.backfillable.pct??'—'}%，目标 100%，${b.passes?'达标':'未达标'}） |`,
  `| 不可回填行 | ${b.not_backfillable} |`,`| open 隔离项（window_evidence_conflict / ownership_conflict） | ${b.open_quarantine} |`,'']:[]),
].join('\n');

async function main(){
 const {segment,out}=args(process.argv.slice(2));
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(getAdminSupabase());
 const at=new Date().toISOString();
 const a=segment==='windows'?null:await e1(tables);
 const b=segment==='e1'?null:await windows(tables);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({at,e1:a,windows:b},null,1));
 if(out)writeFileSync(out,md(at,a,b));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 替换 `src/lib/entities/resolve.ts`**

```ts
// Read-side issuer resolution: exactly one of ticker / ISIN / CIK / LEI → canonical issuer with
// its securities. Zero identifiers → 'empty_query'; more than one → 'ambiguous_query' (callers
// must not rely on an implicit precedence between conflicting identifiers).
// Effective dates: validity windows are DATE-level and evaluated against a UTC calendar date
// (`asOf`, default = current UTC date; `today` is the deprecated synonym, spec 3 §4.3.5);
// exchange-local trading dates are out of scope. A security row is current at `asOf` iff
// valid_from <= asOf and (valid_to is null or valid_to > asOf). Each security carries its window
// methods (observation bounds vs evidenced dates, spec 3 §4.3.1) so callers can judge the ends.
// `date` columns arrive from PostgREST as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings, so ISO strings compare
// lexicographically; the in-memory client used in tests must be fed the same string form.
// Merges: one merged_into hop is followed (result carries redirected_from); a merged target
// returns null rather than walking a chain, so cycles and stale chains surface as not-found.
// Provenance (source) and identifier claims are deliberately not part of the response.
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {inferCoreMarket,normalizeSecurityTicker} from '../securities/ticker';
import {isValidIsin,isValidLei,normalizeCik} from '../research/entity-keys/identifiers';
import type {ValidFromMethod,ValidToMethod} from './types';

export interface ResolveQuery{ticker?:string;isin?:string;cik?:string;lei?:string}
export interface ResolvedSecurity{ticker:string;isin:string|null;figi:string|null;share_class:string|null;is_primary:boolean;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null;valid_from_method:ValidFromMethod|null;valid_to_method:ValidToMethod|null}
export interface ResolvedIssuer{
 issuer_id:string;status:string;redirected_from?:string;
 names:{zh:string|null;en:string|null};
 identifiers:{cik:string|null;lei:string|null;usci:string|null};
 securities:ResolvedSecurity[];
}
export interface ResolveOptions{
 includeExpired?:boolean;
 /** Evaluation date 'YYYY-MM-DD' (UTC calendar date); default = current UTC date. */
 asOf?:string;
 /** @deprecated use asOf (same meaning). Both given and different → invalid_as_of. */
 today?:string;
}
/** Cache-Control for a resolve evaluated at a past date (spec 3 §4.3.5). */
export const HISTORICAL_CACHE_CONTROL='public, max-age=600, s-maxage=3600';

const FROM_METHODS:readonly string[]=['first_observed','listing_date','ticker_change','curated'];
const TO_METHODS:readonly string[]=['delisting','ticker_change','sec_file_absent','curated','merge_close','unrecorded'];
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'?v:null;
const isCurrent=(r:Row,today:string)=>{const from=str(r.valid_from),to=str(r.valid_to);return from!==null&&from<=today&&(to===null||to>today);};
/** The one validity predicate (valid_from <= today && (valid_to is null || valid_to > today)); reused by the facts scope (plan 2 Task 14). */
export const isCurrentSecurity=isCurrent;
const toSecurity=(r:Row):ResolvedSecurity=>({
 ticker:String(r.ticker),isin:str(r.isin),figi:str(r.figi),share_class:str(r.share_class),is_primary:r.is_primary===true,valid_from:String(r.valid_from),valid_to:str(r.valid_to),
 valid_from_method:typeof r.valid_from_method==='string'&&FROM_METHODS.includes(r.valid_from_method)?r.valid_from_method as ValidFromMethod:null,
 valid_to_method:typeof r.valid_to_method==='string'&&TO_METHODS.includes(r.valid_to_method)?r.valid_to_method as ValidToMethod:null,
});

/** A real calendar date in the exact form 'YYYY-MM-DD' (2026-02-30 and ' 2026-11-05' are rejected). */
export function isCalendarDate(s:string):boolean{
 if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s))return false;
 const ms=Date.parse(`${s}T00:00:00Z`);
 return !Number.isNaN(ms)&&new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10)===s;
}

/** asOf wins; today is its deprecated synonym (invalid_today kept for callers that still pass it). */
function resolveAsOf(opts:ResolveOptions):string{
 if(opts.asOf!==undefined&&opts.today!==undefined&&opts.asOf!==opts.today)throw new Error('invalid_as_of');
 if(opts.asOf!==undefined){if(!isCalendarDate(opts.asOf))throw new Error('invalid_as_of');return opts.asOf;}
 if(opts.today!==undefined){if(!isCalendarDate(opts.today))throw new Error('invalid_today');return opts.today;}
 return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
}

/**
 * Ticker candidates in lookup order. The exact (trimmed, upper-cased, '/'→'.') form comes first:
 * the shared normalizer strips Wind suffixes (.A/.N/.O/...), which would turn BRK.A into BRK.
 * The normalized form is only a fallback when the exact form has NO rows at all: a ticker the
 * schema knows (even if only expired or future rows exist) is authoritative, so XYZ.A with only
 * expired rows resolves to null rather than to whoever holds XYZ today.
 */
function tickerCandidates(raw:string):string[]{
 const exact=raw.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
 const market=inferCoreMarket(raw);
 const normalized=(market&&normalizeSecurityTicker(raw,market))||exact;
 return normalized===exact?[exact]:[exact,normalized];
}

type Lookup={column:'lei'|'cik'|'isin';value:string}|{column:'ticker';values:string[]};

/** Requires exactly one non-blank identifier and validates it. */
function parseQuery(q:ResolveQuery):Lookup{
 const t=(v?:string)=>v?.trim()||undefined;
 const given=(['ticker','isin','cik','lei'] as const).filter(k=>t(q[k])!==undefined);
 if(given.length===0)throw new Error('empty_query');
 if(given.length>1)throw new Error('ambiguous_query');
 const key=given[0],raw=t(q[key])!;
 switch(key){
  case 'lei':{const v=raw.toUpperCase();if(!isValidLei(v))throw new Error('invalid_identifier:lei');return {column:'lei',value:v};}
  case 'isin':{const v=raw.toUpperCase();if(!isValidIsin(v))throw new Error('invalid_identifier:isin');return {column:'isin',value:v};}
  case 'cik':{try{return {column:'cik',value:normalizeCik(raw)};}catch{throw new Error('invalid_identifier:cik');}}
  case 'ticker':return {column:'ticker',values:tickerCandidates(raw)};
 }
}

/** The single issuer owning a current row among `rows`; null if none; 'ambiguous_owner' if several. */
function currentOwner(rows:Row[],today:string):string|null{
 const owners=new Set(rows.filter(r=>isCurrent(r,today)).map(r=>str(r.issuer_id)).filter((v):v is string=>v!==null));
 // Prevented by the schema for both lookups (issuer_securities_no_overlap per ticker,
 // issuer_securities_isin_no_overlap per ISIN); kept as defense against non-conforming data.
 if(owners.size>1)throw new Error('ambiguous_owner');
 return owners.values().next().value??null;
}

export async function resolveIssuer(client:TableClient,q:ResolveQuery,opts:ResolveOptions={}):Promise<ResolvedIssuer|null>{
 const lookup=parseQuery(q);
 const today=resolveAsOf(opts);
 let issuerId:string|null=null;
 if(lookup.column==='lei'||lookup.column==='cik'){
  issuerId=str((await client.select('issuers',{[lookup.column]:lookup.value},{limit:1}))[0]?.issuer_id);
 }else if(lookup.column==='ticker'){
  // Fall back to the next candidate only when this one has no rows at all (see tickerCandidates).
  for(const v of lookup.values){
   const rows=await client.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:v});
   if(rows.length===0)continue;
   issuerId=currentOwner(rows,today);
   break;
  }
 }else{
  issuerId=currentOwner(await client.select('issuer_securities',{isin:lookup.value}),today);
 }
 if(!issuerId)return null;
 let issuer=(await client.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuerId},{limit:1}))[0];
 if(!issuer)return null;
 let redirectedFrom:string|undefined;
 if(issuer.status==='merged'){
  const target=str(issuer.merged_into);
  if(!target)return null;
  redirectedFrom=issuerId;
  issuer=(await client.select('issuers',{issuer_id:target},{limit:1}))[0];
  if(!issuer||issuer.status==='merged')return null;
 }
 const id=String(issuer.issuer_id);
 // Single page: PostgREST caps responses at 1000 rows, far above any one issuer's listings.
 const secs=await client.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:id},{orderBy:'valid_from'});
 return {
  issuer_id:id,status:String(issuer.status),...(redirectedFrom?{redirected_from:redirectedFrom}:{}),
  names:{zh:str(issuer.canonical_name_zh),en:str(issuer.canonical_name_en)},
  identifiers:{cik:str(issuer.cik),lei:str(issuer.lei),usci:str(issuer.usci)},
  securities:(opts.includeExpired?secs:secs.filter(r=>isCurrent(r,today))).map(toSecurity),
 };
}

/**
 * Cache-Control for a successful resolve. Validity windows flip at UTC date boundaries, so a
 * shared cache may hold a response at most until the next UTC midnight (clamped to [60, 3600]s);
 * stale-while-revalidate is kept short, so a pre-midnight answer can still be served after the
 * flip: worst case ≈ 11 minutes past midnight (the 60s floor plus the 600s revalidate window).
 */
export function successCacheControl(now:Date):string{
 const nextMidnight=Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(),now.getUTCMonth(),now.getUTCDate()+1);
 const secs=Math.min(3600,Math.max(60,Math.floor((nextMidnight-now.getTime())/1000)));
 return `public, s-maxage=${secs}, stale-while-revalidate=600`;
}
```

```ts
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {HISTORICAL_CACHE_CONTROL,isCalendarDate,resolveIssuer,successCacheControl,type ResolveQuery} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';

// TODO: add application-level throttling for this public endpoint (cf. security_resolve_rate_limits).
export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const SAFE=/^[A-Za-z0-9.\/\-]{1,24}$/;
const KEYS=['ticker','isin','cik','lei'] as const;
// invalid_today / invalid_as_of are deliberately absent: the route always passes a validated
// asOf, so either error would be a server bug and correctly surfaces as a 500.
const CLIENT_ERRORS=new Set(['empty_query','ambiguous_query']);
const utcDate=(d:Date)=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

export async function GET(req:Request){
 // One clock for the whole request: the default asOf and the cache lifetime share it.
 const now=new Date();
 const url=new URL(req.url);
 // searchParams values are already percent-decoded; do not decode again.
 for(const k of [...KEYS,'includeExpired','asOf'])if(url.searchParams.getAll(k).length>1)return err('duplicate_parameter',`${k} given more than once`,400);
 const q:ResolveQuery={};
 for(const k of KEYS){
  const v=url.searchParams.get(k);
  if(!v)continue;
  if(!SAFE.test(v))return err(`invalid_identifier:${k}`,'invalid identifier',400);
  q[k]=v;
 }
 const given=Object.keys(q).length;
 if(given===0)return err('empty_query','ticker, isin, cik or lei required',400);
 if(given>1)return err('ambiguous_query','exactly one of ticker, isin, cik or lei',400);
 const includeExpired=url.searchParams.get('includeExpired');
 if(includeExpired!==null&&includeExpired!=='1')return err('invalid_parameter','includeExpired must be 1 or absent',400);
 const today=utcDate(now);
 const asOfParam=url.searchParams.get('asOf');
 if(asOfParam!==null&&(!isCalendarDate(asOfParam)||asOfParam>today))return err('invalid_parameter:asOf','asOf must be a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date not after today (UTC)',400);
 const asOf=asOfParam??today;
 try{
  // Public reference data: the anon client respects RLS (issuer tables grant anon SELECT).
  const result=await resolveIssuer(supabaseTableClient(getAnonSupabase()),q,{includeExpired:includeExpired==='1',asOf});
  if(!result)return err('not_found','no issuer',404);
  // A past asOf answers for fixed windows (cache a fixed time). For today: if the UTC date flipped
  // while resolving, the answer is for yesterday's windows and must not be shared under today's key.
  const cacheControl=asOf<today?HISTORICAL_CACHE_CONTROL:utcDate(new Date())!==today?'no-store':successCacheControl(now);
  return NextResponse.json(result,{headers:{'Cache-Control':cacheControl}});
 }catch(e){
  const m=e instanceof Error?e.message:'';
  if(m.startsWith('invalid_identifier:')||CLIENT_ERRORS.has(m))return err(m,'invalid query',400);
  // TableError, ambiguous_owner and anything unexpected: log server-side, never leak to the client.
  console.error('[entities/resolve]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return err('internal','resolve failed',500);
 }
}
```

  expect(claims[0].detail).toEqual({schema:'claim/1',evidence_kind:'filing_form',target:{issuer_id:ISSUER},
   params:{suggested_op:'close_security',accession:'0000999001-25-000031',form:'25-NSE',filing_date:'2025-09-12',note:'Rule 12d2-2(d) 下退市于申报后 10 日生效，须核对原文所指类别'},
   evidence:{source:'sec_submissions',as_of:'2026-11-05',evidence_sha256:sha(MAIN),locator:'recent#accessionNumber=0000999001-25-000031',note:'Rule 12d2-2(d) 下退市于申报后 10 日生效，须核对原文所指类别'},
   sources:[claims[0].detail.evidence]});
  expect(claims[1].detail.params).toMatchObject({suggested_op:'backdate_window',form:'8-A12B'});
  expect(claims[1].detail.evidence.evidence_sha256).toBe(sha(PAGE));
 });

```ts
// src/lib/entities/identifiers/sec-submissions.ts
// SEC submissions (spec §4.3.3; reused by acceptance times §4.5 and the filing calendar §6.1).
// One fetch per CIK serves several consumers. submissionsClient paces requests (declared
// User-Agent; at least SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS apart within one client), stores the exact bytes of the
// main document and of each fetched filings.files[] page in reconcile-raw, and returns the parsed,
// merged snapshot. Parsers are pure and strict about the columnar `filings.recent` shape (every
// column has one entry per accession). 8-A12B/8-A12G/25/25-NSE become evidence_only claims that
// never prefill a security or an effective date (the reviewer reads the filing, spec §4.2.1).
import type {Budget} from '../../facts/types';
import type {RawStore} from '../../dq/raw-store';
import {normalizeCik} from '../../research/entity-keys/identifiers';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import type {ClaimInput} from '../claims';
import type {ClaimEvidence} from '../types';

export const SEC_SUBMISSIONS_BASE='https://data.sec.gov/submissions/';
export const SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS=120;
export const SUBMISSIONS_PARSER_VERSION='sec-submissions/1';
const PAGE_NAME=/^CIK\d{10}-submissions-\d{3}\.json$/;
export const submissionsUrl=(cik:string)=>`${SEC_SUBMISSIONS_BASE}CIK${normalizeCik(cik).padStart(10,'0')}.json`;

export interface SubmissionFiling{accessionNumber:string;filingDate:string;reportDate:string|null;acceptanceDateTime:string|null;form:string;primaryDocument:string|null;isInlineXBRL:boolean|null;page:string}
export interface SubmissionsPageRef{name:string;filingCount:number|null;filingFrom:string|null;filingTo:string|null}
export interface FormerName{name:string;from:string|null;to:string|null}
export interface ParsedSubmissions{cik:string;name:string|null;category:string|null;fiscalYearEnd:string|null;tickers:string[];exchanges:string[];formerNames:FormerName[];filings:SubmissionFiling[];files:SubmissionsPageRef[]}
export interface StoredDoc{name:string;sha256:string;path:string}
export interface SubmissionsSnapshot{cik:string;fetchedAt:string;main:StoredDoc;pages:StoredDoc[];parsed:ParsedSubmissions;complete:boolean}
export class SecSubmissionsError extends Error{
 constructor(readonly code:'sec_unavailable'|'invalid_schema',detail?:string){super(detail?`${code}: ${detail}`:code);this.name='SecSubmissionsError';}
}
export type FilerAcceleration='large_accelerated'|'accelerated'|'non_accelerated'|'unknown';

/** Acceleration named in submissions `category` (reference only; deadlines use the 10-K cover, spec §6.1). Only "Smaller reporting company" → unknown. */
export function submissionsCategory(raw:string|null|undefined):FilerAcceleration{
 const s=(raw??'').toLowerCase();
 if(s.includes('non-accelerated'))return 'non_accelerated';
 if(s.includes('large accelerated'))return 'large_accelerated';
 if(s.includes('accelerated filer'))return 'accelerated';
 return 'unknown';
}

const text=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim()!==''?v:null;
const invalid=(detail:string)=>new SecSubmissionsError('invalid_schema',detail);

function columnar(o:unknown,page:string):SubmissionFiling[]{
 if(!o||typeof o!=='object'||Array.isArray(o))throw invalid(`${page}: not an object`);
 const c=o as Record<string,unknown>;
 const acc=c.accessionNumber;
 if(!Array.isArray(acc))throw invalid(`${page}: accessionNumber`);
 const col=(k:string,required:boolean):unknown[]|null=>{
  const v=c[k];
  if(v===undefined&&!required)return null;
  if(!Array.isArray(v)||v.length!==acc.length)throw invalid(`${page}: ${k}`);
  return v;
 };
 const fd=col('filingDate',true)!,form=col('form',true)!;
 const rd=col('reportDate',false),ad=col('acceptanceDateTime',false),pd=col('primaryDocument',false),ix=col('isInlineXBRL',false);
 return acc.map((a,i)=>{
  if(typeof a!=='string'||typeof fd[i]!=='string'||typeof form[i]!=='string')throw invalid(`${page}: row ${i}`);
  const x=ix?.[i];
  return {accessionNumber:a,filingDate:fd[i] as string,reportDate:text(rd?.[i]),acceptanceDateTime:text(ad?.[i]),form:form[i] as string,
   primaryDocument:text(pd?.[i]),isInlineXBRL:x===1||x===true?true:x===0||x===false?false:null,page};
 });
}
const parseJson=(json:string,what:string)=>{try{return JSON.parse(json) as unknown;}catch{throw invalid(`${what}: not JSON`);}};

export function parseSubmissionsPage(json:string,name:string):SubmissionFiling[]{return columnar(parseJson(json,name),name);}

export function parseSubmissions(json:string):ParsedSubmissions{
 const doc=parseJson(json,'main');
 if(!doc||typeof doc!=='object'||Array.isArray(doc))throw invalid('main: not an object');
 const d=doc as Record<string,unknown>;
 let cik:string;
 try{cik=normalizeCik(d.cik);}catch{throw invalid('cik');}
 const filings=d.filings as {recent?:unknown;files?:unknown}|undefined;
 if(!filings||typeof filings!=='object')throw invalid('filings');
 const strings=(v:unknown)=>Array.isArray(v)?v.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'&&x.trim()!==''):[];
 const fye=text(d.fiscalYearEnd);
 return {
  cik,name:text(d.name),category:text(d.category),
  fiscalYearEnd:fye&&/^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$/.test(fye)?fye:null,
  tickers:strings(d.tickers).map(t=>t.trim().toUpperCase()),exchanges:strings(d.exchanges),
  formerNames:(Array.isArray(d.formerNames)?d.formerNames:[]).flatMap(f=>{
   const o=(f&&typeof f==='object'?f:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;const n=text(o.name);
   return n?[{name:n,from:text(o.from),to:text(o.to)}]:[];
  }),
  filings:columnar(filings.recent,'recent'),
  files:(Array.isArray(filings.files)?filings.files:[]).map(f=>{
   const o=(f&&typeof f==='object'?f:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;const n=text(o.name);
   if(!n||!PAGE_NAME.test(n))throw invalid('files[].name');
   return {name:n,filingCount:typeof o.filingCount==='number'?o.filingCount:null,filingFrom:text(o.filingFrom),filingTo:text(o.filingTo)};
  }),
 };
}

export interface FetchSubmissionsDeps{fetch:typeof fetch;raw:RawStore;userAgent?:string;sleep?:(ms:number)=>Promise<void>;now?:()=>number;clock?:()=>Date;budget?:Budget}

export function submissionsClient(deps:FetchSubmissionsDeps){
 const ua=deps.userAgent??process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
 const sleep=deps.sleep??((ms:number)=>new Promise<void>(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)));
 const now=deps.now??Date.now;
 const clock=deps.clock??(()=>new Date());
 let last:number|null=null;
 const get=async(url:string,cik:string,name:string):Promise<{bytes:Uint8Array;doc:StoredDoc}>=>{
  if(last!==null){const wait=last+SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS-now();if(wait>0)await sleep(wait);}
  last=now();
  let res:Response;
  try{res=await deps.fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':ua,Accept:'application/json'},signal:deps.budget?.signal??AbortSignal.timeout(30_000)});}
  catch(e){throw new SecSubmissionsError('sec_unavailable',`${name}: ${e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}`);}
  if(!res.ok)throw new SecSubmissionsError('sec_unavailable',`${name}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const stored=await deps.raw.put({kind:'sec-submissions',bytes,contentType:'application/json',meta:{cik,name}},deps.budget);
  return {bytes,doc:{name,sha256:stored.sha256,path:stored.path}};
 };
 return {
  /** coverFrom: also fetch every files[] page whose filingTo >= coverFrom ('YYYY-MM-DD'); null/undefined: main document only. */
  async fetch(cik:string,opts:{coverFrom?:string|null}={}):Promise<SubmissionsSnapshot>{
   const c=normalizeCik(cik);
   const fetchedAt=clock().toISOString();
   const main=await get(submissionsUrl(c),c,'main');
   const parsed=parseSubmissions(new TextDecoder().decode(main.bytes));
   if(parsed.cik!==c)throw invalid(`cik ${parsed.cik} != ${c}`);
   const from=opts.coverFrom??null;
   const wanted=from===null?[]:parsed.files.filter(f=>f.filingTo===null||f.filingTo>=from);
   const pages:StoredDoc[]=[];
   const filings=[...parsed.filings];
   const seen=new Set(filings.map(f=>f.accessionNumber));
   for(const f of wanted){
    const p=await get(`${SEC_SUBMISSIONS_BASE}${f.name}`,c,f.name);
    pages.push(p.doc);
    for(const x of parseSubmissionsPage(new TextDecoder().decode(p.bytes),f.name))if(!seen.has(x.accessionNumber)){seen.add(x.accessionNumber);filings.push(x);}
   }
   return {cik:c,fetchedAt,main:main.doc,pages,parsed:{...parsed,filings},complete:wanted.length===parsed.files.length};
  },
 };
}

export const fetchSubmissions=(cik:string,deps:FetchSubmissionsDeps,opts:{coverFrom?:string|null}={})=>submissionsClient(deps).fetch(cik,opts);
export const filingsByAccession=(parsed:ParsedSubmissions)=>new Map(parsed.filings.map(f=>[f.accessionNumber,f] as const));

export const EVIDENCE_FORMS:Readonly<Record<string,{suggested_op:'backdate_window'|'close_security';note:string}>>={
 '8-A12B':{suggested_op:'backdate_window',note:'12(b) 交易所注册；所指证券类别与生效日须核对原文'},
 '8-A12G':{suggested_op:'backdate_window',note:'12(g) 注册，非交易所上市'},
 '25':{suggested_op:'close_security',note:'Rule 12d2-2(d) 下退市于申报后 10 日生效，须核对原文所指类别'},
 '25-NSE':{suggested_op:'close_security',note:'Rule 12d2-2(d) 下退市于申报后 10 日生效，须核对原文所指类别'},
};

/** One evidence_only claim per 8-A/25 filing; value = accession number (Part B contract issue 6). */
export function submissionsEvidenceClaims(issuerId:string,snap:SubmissionsSnapshot,asOf:string):ClaimInput[]{
 const shaOf=(page:string)=>page==='recent'?snap.main.sha256:snap.pages.find(p=>p.name===page)?.sha256??null;
 return snap.parsed.filings.flatMap(f=>{
  const rule=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(EVIDENCE_FORMS,f.form)?EVIDENCE_FORMS[f.form]:null;
  const sha=rule?shaOf(f.page):null;
  if(!rule||!sha)return [];
  const evidence:ClaimEvidence={source:'sec_submissions',as_of:asOf,evidence_sha256:sha,locator:`${f.page}#accessionNumber=${f.accessionNumber}`,note:rule.note};
  return [{issuer_id:issuerId,id_type:'ticker' as const,value:f.accessionNumber,source:'sec_submissions',op:'evidence_only' as const,detail:{
   schema:'claim/1' as const,evidence_kind:'filing_form' as const,target:{issuer_id:issuerId},
   params:{suggested_op:rule.suggested_op,accession:f.accessionNumber,form:f.form,filing_date:f.filingDate,note:rule.note},evidence,sources:[evidence],
  }}];
 });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 实现 `submissions-evidence.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/entities/submissions-evidence.ts
// Writes the identity evidence of one SEC submissions snapshot (spec §4.3.3): formerNames as
// security_aliases on the issuer's primary row, 8-A/25 filings as evidence_only claims, and
// tickers[] that SEC lists but this database does not hold as first_observed rows (only tickers in
// stocks_universe; a ticker held by another issuer is quarantined as ownership_conflict). Tickers
// this database holds but SEC no longer lists are handled by load-sec ticker-change detection.
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,type BatchError} from '../dq/batches';
import {normalizeSecurityTicker} from '../securities/ticker';
import {fileClaim,isUnique} from './claims';
import {submissionsEvidenceClaims,type SubmissionsSnapshot} from './identifiers/sec-submissions';
import {errorMessage,parkConflict,withSkippedSummary,type ApplyResult} from './load-sec';
import {attachSecurity} from './securities';

export interface SubmissionsApplyInput{issuerId:string;primaryTicker:string|null;snapshot:SubmissionsSnapshot;asOf:string;batchId:string;dataset:string;universe:ReadonlySet<string>}

export async function applySubmissionsEvidence(tables:TableClient,input:SubmissionsApplyInput):Promise<ApplyResult&{claims:Record<string,number>}>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];
 const skippedSummary:Record<string,number>={};const claims:Record<string,number>={};
 const skip=(k:string)=>{skippedSummary[k]=(skippedSummary[k]??0)+1;};
 const names=input.snapshot.parsed.formerNames;
 if(input.primaryTicker){
  for(const f of names){
   try{
    await tables.insert('security_aliases',{alias:f.name,ticker:input.primaryTicker,alias_type:'name',source:'sec_submissions',created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
    counts.inserted++;
   }catch(e){if(isUnique(e))counts.duplicates++;else{counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'alias_error',key:f.name,message:errorMessage(e)});}}
  }
 }else if(names.length)skip('no_primary_ticker');
 for(const c of submissionsEvidenceClaims(input.issuerId,input.snapshot,input.asOf)){
  try{const created=await fileClaim(tables,c);const k=created?'evidence_only':'evidence_only_appended';claims[k]=(claims[k]??0)+1;}
  catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'claim_error',key:c.value,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 }
 const held=new Set((await tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:input.issuerId,valid_to:null})).map(r=>String(r.ticker)));
 for(const raw of input.snapshot.parsed.tickers){
  const ticker=input.universe.has(raw)?raw:normalizeSecurityTicker(raw,'US');
  if(!ticker||!input.universe.has(ticker)){skip('ticker_not_in_universe');continue;}
  if(held.has(ticker)){counts.duplicates++;continue;}
  try{
   const res=await attachSecurity(tables,{issuer_id:input.issuerId,ticker,share_class:'unknown',is_primary:false,valid_from:input.asOf,valid_from_method:'first_observed',source:'sec_submissions',provenance:{}});
   if(res==='inserted')counts.inserted++;
   else if(res==='duplicate')counts.duplicates++;
   else await parkConflict(tables,{dataset:input.dataset,table:'issuer_securities',naturalKey:`${ticker}:${input.asOf}`,reasonCode:'ownership_conflict',
    detail:{reason:'ticker_owned_by_other_issuer',source:'sec_submissions'},payload:{issuer_id:input.issuerId,ticker,valid_from:input.asOf},batchId:input.batchId},
    counts,errors,{code:'ownership_conflict',key:ticker});
  }catch(e){counts.failed++;errors.push({code:errorMessage(e)==='issuer_not_active'?'issuer_not_active':'security_error',key:ticker,message:errorMessage(e)});}
 }
 counts.fetched=counts.inserted+counts.duplicates+counts.quarantined+counts.failed;
 const lead:BatchError[]=Object.keys(claims).length?[{code:'claims_summary',message:JSON.stringify(claims)}]:[];
 return {counts,errors:withSkippedSummary([...lead,...errors],skippedSummary),skippedSummary,rejectedSummary:{},claims};
}
```

```ts
/**
 * SEC submissions identity evidence (spec §4.3.3) for US in-scope issuers with a CIK: fetches
 * submissions (all filings.files[] pages), stores the raw bytes, and writes formerNames aliases,
 * 8-A/25 evidence_only claims and SEC-listed tickers (first_observed).
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/sec-submissions.ts [--issuer <uuid>]... [--apply]
 * Dry run (default): fetches and prints what would be written (raw bytes hashed in memory only).
 * --apply records an ingest batch (dataset entities.sec-submissions) and a freshness attempt.
 * Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; EDGAR_USER_AGENT (else DEFAULT_USER_AGENT).
 */
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch,type BatchCounts,type BatchError,type BatchStatus} from '../../src/lib/dq/batches';
import {DATASETS,DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY} from '../../src/lib/dq/datasets';
import {recordAttempt} from '../../src/lib/dq/freshness';
import {memoryRawStore,supabaseRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {SUBMISSIONS_PARSER_VERSION,SecSubmissionsError,submissionsClient,submissionsEvidenceClaims} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/sec-submissions';
import {errorMessage,loaderOutcome} from '../../src/lib/entities/load-sec';
import {applySubmissionsEvidence} from '../../src/lib/entities/submissions-evidence';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const DATASET=DATASETS.entities.submissions;
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const ALL_PAGES='1993-01-01';
const cadenceOf=(dataset:string)=>{const e=DQ_DATASET_INVENTORY.find(x=>x.dataset===dataset);if(!e)throw new Error(`unregistered_dataset:${dataset}`);return e.cadence;};
const add=(a:BatchCounts,b:BatchCounts)=>{for(const k of Object.keys(a) as (keyof BatchCounts)[])a[k]+=b[k];};

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);
 const ids:string[]=[];let apply=false;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  if(argv[i]==='--apply')apply=true;
  else if(argv[i]==='--issuer'&&UUID.test(argv[i+1]??''))ids.push(argv[++i].toLowerCase());
  else{console.error('usage: sec-submissions.ts [--issuer <uuid>]... [--apply]');process.exit(2);}
 }
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);
 const asOf=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const inScope=new Set((await selectAll(tables,'fact_sync_scope',{market:'US'},'issuer_id')).filter(s=>typeof s.priority==='number'&&s.priority>0).map(s=>String(s.issuer_id)));
 const issuers=(await selectAll(tables,'issuers',{status:'active'},'issuer_id'))
  .filter(i=>typeof i.cik==='string'&&inScope.has(String(i.issuer_id))&&(ids.length===0||ids.includes(String(i.issuer_id))));
 const universe=new Set((await selectAll(tables,'stocks_universe',{market:'US'},'ticker')).map(r=>String(r.ticker)));
 const raw=apply?supabaseRawStore(admin):memoryRawStore();
 const client=submissionsClient({fetch,raw});
 const batchId=apply?(await startBatch(tables,{producer:'sec-submissions',dataset:DATASET,toolVersions:{parser:SUBMISSIONS_PARSER_VERSION,as_of:asOf}})).batchId:null;
 const counts=emptyCounts();let errors:BatchError[]=[];let status:BatchStatus='failed';
 const preview:Record<string,unknown>[]=[];
 try{
  for(const i of issuers){
   const issuerId=String(i.issuer_id),cik=String(i.cik);
   try{
    const snapshot=await client.fetch(cik,{coverFrom:ALL_PAGES});
    const open=await tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:issuerId,valid_to:null},{orderBy:'ticker'});
    const primary=[...open].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.is_primary===true)-Number(a.is_primary===true))[0];
    const primaryTicker=primary?String(primary.ticker):null;
    if(!batchId){
     preview.push({cik,formerNames:snapshot.parsed.formerNames.length,evidenceClaims:submissionsEvidenceClaims(issuerId,snapshot,asOf).length,
      secOnlyTickers:snapshot.parsed.tickers.filter(t=>!open.some(r=>r.ticker===t)),pages:snapshot.pages.length,complete:snapshot.complete});
     continue;
    }
    const res=await applySubmissionsEvidence(tables,{issuerId,primaryTicker,snapshot,asOf,batchId,dataset:DATASET,universe});
    add(counts,res.counts);errors=[...errors,...res.errors];
   }catch(e){
    counts.failed++;
    errors.push({code:e instanceof SecSubmissionsError?e.code:'exception',key:cik,message:errorMessage(e)});
   }
  }
 }finally{
  if(batchId){
   try{status=await finishBatch(tables,batchId,{counts,errors});}
   catch(e){console.error(`finishBatch failed: ${errorMessage(e)}`);status='failed';}
  }
 }
 if(!batchId){console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'dry-run (nothing written; pass --apply)',issuers:issuers.length,preview,errors},null,1));return;}
 const outcome=loaderOutcome(status,counts);
 await recordAttempt(tables,DATASET,{ok:outcome.ok,cadence:cadenceOf(DATASET)});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({batchId,status,counts,errors:errors.slice(0,20)},null,1));
 process.exitCode=outcome.exitCode;
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(errorMessage(e));process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
/**
 * Verification helper for spec §14-9 (Task 6a Step 9): fetches one CIK's submissions including
 * every filings.files[] page and prints the page structure the parser saw. No database access.
 *   npx tsx scripts/entity-keys/probe-submissions.ts <cik> [<out-dir>]
 * With <out-dir>, writes the exact main and page bytes there (for a trimmed fixture).
 */
import {mkdirSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {fetchSubmissions} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/sec-submissions';

async function main(){
 const [cik,out]=process.argv.slice(2);
 if(!cik){console.error('usage: probe-submissions.ts <cik> [<out-dir>]');process.exit(2);}
 const raw=memoryRawStore();
 const s=await fetchSubmissions(cik,{fetch,raw},{coverFrom:'1993-01-01'});
 const byPage:Record<string,{n:number;earliest:string;latest:string}>={};
 for(const f of s.parsed.filings){const p=byPage[f.page]??={n:0,earliest:f.filingDate,latest:f.filingDate};p.n++;if(f.filingDate<p.earliest)p.earliest=f.filingDate;if(f.filingDate>p.latest)p.latest=f.filingDate;}
 console.log(JSON.stringify({cik:s.cik,files:s.parsed.files,complete:s.complete,main:s.main,pages:s.pages,byPage,category:s.parsed.category,fiscalYearEnd:s.parsed.fiscalYearEnd,tickers:s.parsed.tickers},null,1));
 if(out){mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});for(const [path,bytes] of raw.objects)writeFileSync(join(out,path.split('/').pop()!),bytes);}
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```
