```ts
// src/lib/facts/types.ts
// Shared contract of the facts layer (plan 2 §共享契约, spec §4.8; plan 3 C4, spec §3.2). Every task
// uses these names verbatim. FactsDb has three implementations: supabaseFactsDb (db.ts, rpc),
// memoryFactsDb (memory-facts-db.ts, unit tests), pgFactsDb (pg-facts-db.ts, integration tests).
// The reconciliation types are imported as types only (no runtime cycle with src/lib/dq).
import type {ApplyReconcileOutcome,CyclePairId,Fence,MemberCounts,ReconcileResultInput} from '../dq/reconcile/types';
export type Market='US'|'CN';
export type Statement='IS'|'BS'|'CF'|'DEI';
export type Duration='3M'|'6M'|'9M'|'12M'|'INSTANT';
export type MetricDuration=Duration|'TTM';
export type FactStatus='staged'|'ok'|'quarantined';
export type RunStatus='staged'|'published'|'abandoned';
export type FormType='10-K'|'10-Q'|'20-F'|'40-F'|'10-K/A'|'10-Q/A'|'20-F/A'|'annual'|'semiannual'|'q1'|'q3'|'restatement'|'other';
export type Origin='sec'|'sse'|'szse'|'bse';
export type Source='edgar'|'tushare';
export type UnitKind='money'|'shares'|'per_share';

export interface ConceptDef{
 id:string;statement:Statement;nature:'duration'|'instant';unitKind:UnitKind;
 usGaap:string[];ifrs:string[];
 tushare:{api:'income'|'balancesheet'|'cashflow';field:string}|{api:'income'|'balancesheet'|'cashflow';sum:string[]}|null;
 notes?:string;
}

/** 一个解析出的候选事实（value 为规范十进制字符串，§6.2） */
export interface FactCandidate{
 concept:string;sourceConcept:string;statement:Statement;
 periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;duration:Duration;
 value:string;unit:string;consolidation:'consolidated';
 filingRef:string;                 // = FilingCandidate.sourceRef
 rawHash:string;
}
export interface FilingCandidate{
 sourceRef:string;market:Market;source:Source;origin:Origin;formType:FormType;
 fiscalYear:number|null;fiscalPeriod:'FY'|'Q1'|'Q2'|'Q3'|'H1'|'9M'|null;
 periodEnd:string|null;availableDate:string;url:string|null;
}
export interface ParseResult{candidates:FactCandidate[];filings:FilingCandidate[];skipped:{reason:string;n:number}[];ambiguous:{key:string;candidates:FactCandidate[]}[];oddDuration:FactCandidate[];missingAvailableDate:Record<string,unknown>[]}

export interface RawSnapshot{bytes:Uint8Array;sha256:string;meta:{source:Source;api?:string;url?:string;params?:Record<string,unknown>;fields?:string;fetched_at:string;http_status:number;has_more?:boolean;page?:number}}
export interface Budget{remainingMs():number;signal:AbortSignal}

export interface FactRow{
 fact_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:Market;filing_id:string;run_id:string;concept:string;source_concept:string;statement:Statement;
 period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:Duration;value:string;value_text:string;unit:string;consolidation:string;
 available_date:string;mapping_gen:number;mapping_version:string;status:FactStatus;raw_hash:string;created_at:string;
 disclosure_seq?:number;is_current?:boolean;is_revision?:boolean;   // 只有 readFacts 返回时带
}
export interface FilingRow{
 filing_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:Market;source:Source;origin:Origin;form_type:FormType;fiscal_year:number|null;fiscal_period:string|null;
 period_end:string|null;available_date:string;source_ref:string;url:string|null;document_ref:string|null;document_url:string|null;
 link_attempts:number;mapping_gen:number;run_id:string;created_at:string;
 /** SEC acceptance time (ISO) written once by set_filing_acceptance (plan 3 §4.5) */
 accepted_at:string|null;acceptance_source:'sec_submissions'|null;
}
export interface ScopeRow{issuer_id:string;market:Market;reasons:string[];priority:number;fetch_key:string;next_due_at:string;lease_until:string|null;lease_batch_id:string|null;state_rev:number;last_attempt_at:string|null;last_success_at:string|null;last_batch_id:string|null;last_status:'success'|'failed'|null}
/** One member of a lineage and its fact-state version (plan 3 §4.4). */
export interface LineageRev{issuer_id:string;state_rev:number}
export interface MetricRow{issuer_id:string;market:Market;metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;duration:MetricDuration;value:string;unit:string;input_unit:string;basis:string;formula_version:string;inputs:{fact_id:string;concept:string;filing_id:string;available_date:string;ytd_rule?:'same_filing'|'never_revised';quarter?:[string,string]}[];based_on_rev:number;
 /** the complete lineage state the row was derived from (issuer_id ascending); compared as a whole (T8) */
 based_on_lineage:LineageRev[];as_of:string}
export interface ConflictItem{id:string;natural_key:string;fact_ids:string[];available_date:string;key:Record<string,string|null>}
export interface LineageConflict{key:Record<string,string|null>;available_date:string;fact_ids:string[]}

export interface ReadFactsOptions{concepts:string[];asOf:string;from?:string;to?:string;history?:boolean;limit?:number;includeNonOk?:boolean}
export interface ReadFactsResult{stateRev:number;rows:FactRow[];truncated:boolean}
export interface ReadFactsLineageResult{stateRevs:LineageRev[];lineage:string[];rows:FactRow[];conflicts:LineageConflict[];truncated:boolean}
export type FilingFactRow=FactRow&{run_status:RunStatus};
export type CalendarFiling=FilingRow&{run_status:RunStatus;accepted_at:string|null};

export type FactsDbErrorCode='lease_lost'|'run_pending'|'run_published'|'mapping_gen_regression'|'stale_computation'|'stale_plan'|'run_abandoned'|'read_truncated'|'duplicate_key'|'invalid_chosen'|'item_not_open'|'unknown'
 |'fence_failed'|'member_incomplete'|'stale_evaluation'|'batch_mismatch'|'invalid_choice'|'invalid_candidate'|'generation_moved'
 |'duplicate'|'conflict_exists'|'replay_required'|'filing_not_found'|'not_passing'|'lineage_changed'|'scope_missing'|'unresolved'
 |'acceptance_conflict'|'source_not_active'|'has_referrers'|'topology_write_forbidden'|'invalid_result';
export class FactsDbError extends Error{constructor(public code:FactsDbErrorCode,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='FactsDbError';}}

export interface FactsDb{
 claimLease(issuer:string,market:Market,batch:string,ttlSeconds:number):Promise<boolean>;
 beginRun(issuer:string,market:Market,batch:string,mappingGen:number):Promise<string>;
 /** source_ref → filing_id，含已存在者 */
 stageFilings(run:string,rows:FilingInsert[]):Promise<Map<string,string>>;
 stageFacts(run:string,rows:FactInsert[]):Promise<number>;
 quarantineFacts(run:string,factIds:string[],itemId:string):Promise<number>;
 /** expectedRev: the state_rev the plan was read at; a different current value fails as stale_plan (a promotion landed after planning). */
 publishRun(run:string,manifest:string[],expectedRev?:number):Promise<number>;
 abandonRun(run:string):Promise<void>;
 releaseLease(issuer:string,market:Market,batch:string,outcome:'success'|'failed',nextDue:string):Promise<void>;
 resolveFactsQuarantine(itemId:string,chosen:string[],resolvedBy:string):Promise<{promoted:number;skipped:number;chosenFactIds:string[]}>;
 /** plan-2 wrapper of replaceMetricsLineage with the one-member vector [{issuer, basedOnRev}] */
 replaceMetrics(issuer:string,market:Market,basedOnRev:number,rows:MetricRow[]):Promise<number>;
 readFacts(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:ReadFactsOptions):Promise<ReadFactsResult>;
 /** Rows for the given ids: deduped, ordered by fact_id; unknown ids are omitted. */
 factsByIds(ids:string[]):Promise<FactRow[]>;
 openConflicts(issuer:string,market:Market):Promise<ConflictItem[]>;
 filingsOfIssuer(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:{from?:string;to?:string;limit?:number;unlinkedOnly?:boolean}):Promise<FilingRow[]>;
 updateFilingLink(filingId:string,patch:{document_ref?:string|null;document_url?:string|null;link_attempts:number}):Promise<void>;
 /** snapshotAt: when the sources behind `rows` were read. A retirement (priority 0 over a stored priority > 0) applies only to a row whose scope was neither changed nor confirmed active after it (scope_confirmed_at <= snapshotAt); activations and upserts always apply. */
 reconcileScope(market:Market,rows:{issuer_id:string;reasons:string[];priority:number;fetch_key:string}[],snapshotAt?:string):Promise<number>;
 scopeDue(market:Market,now:string,limit:number):Promise<ScopeRow[]>;
 /** 指定发行人的 scope 行（不看 priority / next_due_at；缺行者不返回），供脚本 `--issuer` 与回放测试直指发行人（审计 round-1 #13） */
 scopeRows(market:Market,issuerIds:string[]):Promise<ScopeRow[]>;
 /** Every scope row of the market, priority 0 included, ordered by issuer_id (complete set, paged to exhaustion) */
 scopeAll(market:Market):Promise<ScopeRow[]>;
 metricsOfIssuer(issuer:string,market:Market,formulaVersion:string):Promise<MetricRow[]>;
 // ---- plan 3 (C4)
 /** materialisation target T(i) = i.merged_into ?? i (unknown issuer → itself) */
 targetOf(issuer:string):Promise<string>;
 /** [target, ...issuers whose merged_into = target, ascending] */
 lineageOf(target:string):Promise<string[]>;
 /** one snapshot; issuer_id ascending, deduped; no scope row ⇒ 0 */
 stateRevs(issuers:string[],market:Market):Promise<LineageRev[]>;
 readFactsLineage(issuers:string[],market:Market,opts:ReadFactsOptions):Promise<ReadFactsLineageResult>;
 /** every generation and status of one filing (includeNonOk=false: ok only), with the run status; no binding */
 readFilingFacts(filingId:string,includeNonOk:boolean):Promise<FilingFactRow[]>;
 replaceMetricsLineage(issuer:string,market:Market,basedOn:LineageRev[],rows:MetricRow[]):Promise<number>;
 findFilingBySourceRef(source:Source,sourceRef:string):Promise<FilingRow|null>;
 /** every filing with period_end >= fromPeriodEnd (complete set, never cut by a row count, T9), ordered by period_end, available_date, filing_id */
 filingsForCalendar(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:{fromPeriodEnd:string}):Promise<CalendarFiling[]>;
 setFilingAcceptance(filingId:string,acceptedAt:string,source:'sec_submissions'):Promise<boolean>;
 adoptCandidate(itemId:string,index:number,batchId:string,expectedRev:number,resolvedBy:string):Promise<{factId:string;runId:string;issuerId:string;market:Market}>;
 restoreReconciled(itemId:string,batchId:string,inputsHashNow:string,resolvedBy:string):Promise<{promoted:number;skipped:{fact_id:string;reason:string}[]}>;
 resolveLineageConflict(itemId:string,keepFactId:string,batchId:string,resolvedBy:string):Promise<{quarantined:number}>;
 claimReconcileMember(pair:CyclePairId,cycleId:string,issuer:string,market:Market,batchId:string):Promise<Fence|null>;
 applyReconcileResult(fence:Fence,result:ReconcileResultInput):Promise<ApplyReconcileOutcome>;
 completeReconcileMember(fence:Fence):Promise<MemberCounts>;
 failReconcileMember(fence:Fence,error:string):Promise<void>;
 setMerge(source:string,target:string,resolvedBy:string):Promise<{repointed:number}>;
 setDissolved(issuer:string,resolvedBy:string):Promise<void>;
}
/** stageFilings 的输入行（写入端生成 filing_id） */
export interface FilingInsert extends FilingCandidate{filing_id:string;issuer_id:string}
/** stageFacts 的输入行（写入端生成 fact_id；status 由函数置 staged） */
export interface FactInsert{fact_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:Market;filing_id:string;concept:string;source_concept:string;statement:Statement;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:Duration;value:string;unit:string;consolidation:'consolidated';available_date:string;mapping_gen:number;mapping_version:string;raw_hash:string}
```

(b) `MESSAGE_CODES` 与 `toFactsDbError` 替换为（23505 先于首词判断，见契约问题 4）：

```ts
const MESSAGE_CODES:readonly FactsDbErrorCode[]=['run_pending','run_published','mapping_gen_regression','stale_computation','stale_plan','run_abandoned','invalid_chosen','item_not_open',
 'fence_failed','member_incomplete','stale_evaluation','batch_mismatch','invalid_choice','invalid_candidate','generation_moved','duplicate','conflict_exists','replay_required',
 'filing_not_found','not_passing','lineage_changed','scope_missing','unresolved','acceptance_conflict','source_not_active','has_referrers','topology_write_forbidden','invalid_result'];

export interface PgErrorLike{message?:string;code?:string|null;details?:string|null;hint?:string|null}
/** PostgreSQL / PostgREST error → FactsDbError (shared by the Supabase and pg adapters). 23505 is checked before the head word: "duplicate key value …" must stay duplicate_key, not the plan-3 code duplicate. */
export function toFactsDbError(e:PgErrorLike):FactsDbError{
 const message=e.message??'';
 const head=message.split(/[\s:]/,1)[0];
 if(e.code==='55P03'||head==='lease_lost')return new FactsDbError('lease_lost',message||'lease_lost');
 if(e.code==='23505')return new FactsDbError('duplicate_key',message);
 if((MESSAGE_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(head))return new FactsDbError(head as FactsDbErrorCode,message);
 return new FactsDbError('unknown',message||'unknown');
}
```

(c) `filingFromTable` 与 `metricFromTable` 替换为（并在 `metricFromTable` 前加谱系归一函数）：

```ts
/** A filings table row (PostgREST or pg) → FilingRow; created_at and accepted_at are ISO. */
export function filingFromTable(r:Record<string,unknown>):FilingRow{return {...(r as unknown as FilingRow),accepted_at:isoOrNull(r.accepted_at),acceptance_source:(r.acceptance_source??null) as FilingRow['acceptance_source'],created_at:isoTs(r.created_at)};}
/** filingsForCalendar row: a filings row plus run_status. */
export function calendarFilingFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):CalendarFiling{return {...filingFromTable(r),run_status:r.run_status as RunStatus};}
/** LineageRev[] in the canonical order (issuer_id ascending; lowercase uuids compare like PostgreSQL's uuid order); state_rev as a number. */
export function lineageRevsFrom(x:unknown):LineageRev[]{
 if(!Array.isArray(x))return [];
 return x.map(e=>({issuer_id:String((e as {issuer_id:unknown}).issuer_id),state_rev:Number((e as {state_rev:unknown}).state_rev)}))
  .sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:0);
}
export const lineageKey=(v:LineageRev[]):string=>lineageRevsFrom(v).map(r=>`${r.issuer_id}=${r.state_rev}`).join(',');
/** The complete vector compared (T8): same members, same revs. */
export const lineageRevsEqual=(a:LineageRev[],b:LineageRev[]):boolean=>lineageKey(a)===lineageKey(b);
export function metricFromTable(r:Record<string,unknown>):MetricRow{
 return {issuer_id:String(r.issuer_id),market:r.market as Market,metric:String(r.metric),period_start:String(r.period_start),period_end:String(r.period_end),duration:r.duration as MetricRow['duration'],
  value:String(r.value_text),unit:String(r.unit),input_unit:String(r.input_unit),basis:String(r.basis),formula_version:String(r.formula_version),inputs:(Array.isArray(r.inputs)?r.inputs:[]) as MetricRow['inputs'],based_on_rev:Number(r.based_on_rev),
  based_on_lineage:lineageRevsFrom(r.based_on_lineage),as_of:String(r.as_of)};
}
```

（`isoOrNull` 已在第 53 行定义，`filingFromTable` 在它之后。）

```ts
export function readLineageArgs(issuers:string[],market:Market,o:ReadFactsOptions){return {p_issuers:issuers,p_market:market,p_concepts:o.concepts,p_as_of:o.asOf,p_from:o.from??null,p_to:o.to??null,p_history:o.history===true,p_limit:o.limit??null,p_include_non_ok:o.includeNonOk===true};}
export interface ReadFactsLineageEnvelope{state_revs:unknown;lineage:unknown;rows:Record<string,unknown>[];conflicts:unknown;truncated:boolean;row_count:number}
export function lineageResultFromEnvelope(env:ReadFactsLineageEnvelope):ReadFactsLineageResult{
 const conflicts=(Array.isArray(env.conflicts)?env.conflicts:[]) as {key?:unknown;available_date?:unknown;fact_ids?:unknown}[];
 return {stateRevs:lineageRevsFrom(env.state_revs),lineage:Array.isArray(env.lineage)?env.lineage.map(String):[],rows:(env.rows??[]).map(rowFromEnvelope),
  conflicts:conflicts.map((c):LineageConflict=>({key:(c.key&&typeof c.key==='object'?c.key:{}) as Record<string,string|null>,available_date:String(c.available_date),fact_ids:Array.isArray(c.fact_ids)?c.fact_ids.map(String):[]})),
  truncated:env.truncated===true};
}
/** read_filing_facts row → FilingFactRow (value from value_text, ISO created_at). */
export function filingFactFromJson(r:Record<string,unknown>):FilingFactRow{return {...factRowFromTable(r),run_status:r.run_status as RunStatus};}
export const fenceArgs=(f:Fence)=>({pair:f.pair,cycle_id:f.cycle_id,issuer_id:f.issuer_id,market:f.market,batch_id:f.batch_id,attempt:f.attempt});
export function fenceFromJson(x:unknown):Fence|null{
 if(x===null||x===undefined)return null;
 const f=x as Record<string,unknown>;
 return {pair:String(f.pair) as CyclePairId,cycle_id:String(f.cycle_id),issuer_id:String(f.issuer_id),market:f.market as Market,batch_id:String(f.batch_id),attempt:Number(f.attempt)};
}
export function applyOutcomeFromJson(x:unknown):ApplyReconcileOutcome{
 const o=(x??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;const m=o.materialize as {issuer_id?:unknown;market?:unknown}|null|undefined;
 return {reused:o.reused===true,reconciliationId:String(o.reconciliation_id),itemId:o.item_id===null||o.item_id===undefined?null:String(o.item_id),quarantined:Number(o.quarantined)===1?1:0,
  materialize:m&&typeof m==='object'?{issuerId:String(m.issuer_id),market:m.market as Market}:null};
}
export const countsFromJson=(x:unknown):MemberCounts=>{const o=(x??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;return {compared_passed:Number(o.compared_passed),compared_failed:Number(o.compared_failed),not_compared:Number(o.not_compared)};};
export const adoptFromJson=(x:unknown)=>{const o=(x??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;return {factId:String(o.fact_id),runId:String(o.run_id),issuerId:String(o.issuer_id),market:o.market as Market};};
export const restoreFromJson=(x:unknown)=>{const o=(x??{}) as {promoted?:unknown;skipped?:unknown};return {promoted:Number(o.promoted),skipped:(Array.isArray(o.skipped)?o.skipped:[]).map(s=>({fact_id:String((s as {fact_id:unknown}).fact_id),reason:String((s as {reason:unknown}).reason)}))};};
```

```ts
  if(typeof r.left_source!=='string'||typeof r.right_source!=='string'||!r.detail||typeof r.detail!=='object'||Array.isArray(r.detail))return false;
  if(typeof r.tolerance!=='string'||!NUMERIC.test(r.tolerance)||[r.left_value,r.right_value,r.abs_diff,r.rel_diff].some(v=>v!==null&&v!==undefined&&!NUMERIC.test(v)))return false;
  if(r.left_fact_id!==undefined&&!UUID.test(r.left_fact_id))return false;
  if(r.action==='quarantine_left'&&r.left_fact_id===undefined)return false;
  if((r.action==='review_item'||r.action==='lineage_item')&&(!r.item||typeof r.item.natural_key!=='string'||r.item.natural_key.length<1||r.item.natural_key.length>512||!r.item.payload||typeof r.item.payload!=='object'))return false;
  return true;
 };
 const cursorKey=(f:{pair:string;cycle_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:Market})=>({pair:f.pair,cycle_id:f.cycle_id,issuer_id:f.issuer_id,market:f.market});
 const fenceLock=async(f:Fence)=>{
  const [c]=await tables.select('dq_reconcile_cursor',cursorKey(f),{limit:1});
  if(!c||c.state!=='claimed'||c.claimed_by!==f.batch_id||Number(c.attempts)!==f.attempt||typeof c.claim_until!=='string'||c.claim_until<=now())throw new FactsDbError('fence_failed');
  return c;
 };
 const registerPending=async(target:string)=>{
  const cycles=(await tables.select('dq_reconcile_cycles',{pair:'facts.lineage_same_day'}))
   .sort((a,b)=>Number(b.status==='running')-Number(a.status==='running')||cmp(String(b.started_at),String(a.started_at)));
  const c=cycles[0];if(!c)return;
  const d=detailOf(c);const list=Array.isArray(d.pending_members)?[...(d.pending_members as {issuer_id:string;market:string}[])]:[];
  for(const m of MARKETS)if(!list.some(x=>x.issuer_id===target&&x.market===m))list.push({issuer_id:target,market:m});
  await tables.update('dq_reconcile_cycles',{pair:String(c.pair),cycle_id:String(c.cycle_id)},{detail:{...d,pending_members:list}});

 // promote_quarantined eligibility (§4.5 + plan 3 T6): quarantined, run published, filing on the
 // row's generation, not referenced by any OPEN item, its (K, date) not disputed by an OPEN
 // same_day_conflict, chosen by every RESOLVED same_day_conflict and lineage_conflict that lists it
 // (lineage: payload members and the rows it quarantined), and no reconcile_mismatch referencing it
 // unless that one is resolved_accept with latest_result.passed = true.
 const promote=async(issuer:string,market:Market,ids:string[])=>{
  const all=await items({});
  const open=all.filter(i=>i.status==='open');
  const resolvedConflicts=all.filter(i=>i.reason_code==='same_day_conflict'&&i.status!=='open');
  const lineageVerdicts=all.filter(i=>i.reason_code==='lineage_conflict'&&i.status!=='open');
  const mismatches=all.filter(i=>i.reason_code==='reconcile_mismatch');
  const passing=(i:Row)=>i.status==='resolved_accept'&&(detailOf(i).latest_result as {passed?:unknown}|undefined)?.passed===true;
  let n=0;
  for(const id of new Set(ids)){
   const f=facts.get(id);
   if(!f||f.issuer_id!==issuer||f.market!==market||f.status!=='quarantined')continue;
   if(runs.get(f.run_id)?.status!=='published')continue;
   if(!visible(f))continue;
   if(open.some(i=>idsOf(i).includes(id)))continue;
   if(open.some(i=>i.reason_code==='same_day_conflict'&&disputes(i,f)))continue;
   if(resolvedConflicts.some(i=>idsOf(i).includes(id)&&!chosenOf(i).includes(id)))continue;
   if(lineageVerdicts.some(i=>(idsOf(i).includes(id)||listOf(detailOf(i).quarantined_fact_ids).includes(id))&&!chosenOf(i).includes(id)))continue;
   if(mismatches.some(i=>idsOf(i).includes(id)&&!passing(i)))continue;
   f.status='ok';n++;
  }
  return n;
 };
 // read_facts_lineage: the read_facts rules over a member set; with more than one member, ok rows of
 // one (K, available_date) from different issuers with different values leave the sequences and go to conflicts.
 const readLineage=(members:string[],market:Market,o:ReadFactsOptions):ReadFactsLineageResult=>{
  const set=[...new Set(members)].sort(cmp);const inSet=new Set(set);
  const stateRevs:LineageRev[]=set.map(i=>({issuer_id:i,state_rev:scopeOf(i,market)?.state_rev??0}));
  const base=[...facts.values()].filter(f=>inSet.has(f.issuer_id)&&f.market===market&&o.concepts.includes(f.concept)&&f.available_date<=o.asOf
   &&(o.from===undefined||f.period_end>=o.from)&&(o.to===undefined||f.period_end<=o.to)&&(f.status==='ok'||o.includeNonOk===true)&&visible(f));
  const conflicts:LineageConflict[]=[];const excluded=new Set<string>();
  if(set.length>1){
   const byDay=new Map<string,FactRow[]>();
   for(const f of base)if(f.status==='ok'){const k=`${keyOf(f)}|${f.available_date}`;const g=byDay.get(k);if(g)g.push(f);else byDay.set(k,[f]);}
   for(const g of byDay.values()){
    if(new Set(g.map(f=>f.issuer_id)).size<2||g.every(f=>numericEquals(f.value,g[0].value)))continue;
    for(const f of g)excluded.add(f.fact_id);
    const f0=g[0];
    conflicts.push({key:{concept:f0.concept,period_start:f0.period_start,period_end:f0.period_end,consolidation:f0.consolidation,unit:f0.unit},available_date:f0.available_date,fact_ids:g.map(f=>f.fact_id).sort(cmp)});
   }
   const s=(v:string|null|undefined)=>v??'';
   conflicts.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.available_date,b.available_date)||cmp(s(a.key.concept),s(b.key.concept))||cmp(s(a.key.period_end),s(b.key.period_end))||cmp(s(a.key.period_start),s(b.key.period_start))||cmp(s(a.key.consolidation),s(b.key.consolidation))||cmp(s(a.key.unit),s(b.key.unit)));
  }
  const eligible=base.filter(f=>!excluded.has(f.fact_id));
  const groups=new Map<string,FactRow[]>();
  for(const f of eligible)if(f.status==='ok'){const k=keyOf(f);if(!groups.has(k))groups.set(k,[]);groups.get(k)!.push(f);}
  const out:FactRow[]=[];
  for(const g of groups.values()){g.sort(byDisclosure);g.forEach((f,i)=>out.push({...clone(f),disclosure_seq:i+1,is_current:i===g.length-1,is_revision:i>0&&!numericEquals(f.value,g[i-1].value)}));}
  for(const f of eligible)if(f.status!=='ok')out.push({...clone(f),disclosure_seq:undefined,is_current:false,is_revision:false});
  const heads=new Map<string,FactRow>();for(const f of out)if(!heads.has(keyOf(f)))heads.set(keyOf(f),f);
  const rank=new Map([...heads.entries()].sort((a,b)=>keyOrder(a[1],b[1])).map(([k],i)=>[k,i+1] as const));
  const picked=out.filter(f=>(o.history===true||f.is_current===true)&&(o.limit===undefined||rank.get(keyOf(f))!<=o.limit));
  picked.sort((a,b)=>rank.get(keyOf(a))!-rank.get(keyOf(b))!||byDisclosure(a,b));
  if(picked.length>READ_FACTS_CAP)return {stateRevs,lineage:set,rows:[],conflicts,truncated:true};
  return {stateRevs,lineage:set,rows:picked,conflicts,truncated:false};
 };
 // replace_financial_metrics_lineage: member set = current lineage, every rev equal, else stale_computation.
 const replaceLineage=(issuer:string,market:Market,basedOn:LineageRev[],input:MetricRow[])=>{
  const norm=lineageRevsFrom(basedOn);
  if(norm.length===0||new Set(norm.map(x=>x.issuer_id)).size!==norm.length||!norm.some(x=>x.issuer_id===issuer)||norm.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x.state_rev)||x.state_rev<0))throw unknown('invalid_based_on');
  if(norm.some(x=>!scopeOf(x.issuer_id,market)))throw new FactsDbError('scope_missing');
  if([...lineageMembers(issuer)].sort(cmp).join(',')!==norm.map(x=>x.issuer_id).join(','))throw new FactsDbError('stale_computation');
  if(norm.some(x=>scopeOf(x.issuer_id,market)!.state_rev!==x.state_rev))throw new FactsDbError('stale_computation');
  const pk=(m:MetricRow)=>[m.metric,m.period_start,m.period_end,m.input_unit,m.basis,m.formula_version].join('|');
  if(new Set(input.map(pk)).size!==input.length)throw new FactsDbError('duplicate_key','financial_metrics_pkey');
  const rev=scopeOf(issuer,market)!.state_rev;
  metrics=metrics.filter(m=>!(m.issuer_id===issuer&&m.market===market)).concat(input.map(m=>({...clone(m),issuer_id:issuer,market,based_on_rev:rev,based_on_lineage:norm.map(x=>({...x}))})));
  return input.length;
 };
```

(e) `stageFilings` 里构造 `FilingRow` 的对象字面量，在 `created_at:now()` 之后加 `,accepted_at:null,acceptance_source:null`。

(f) 原 `replaceMetrics` 与 `readFacts` 方法整体替换为：

```ts
  async replaceMetrics(issuer,market,basedOnRev,input){
   // plan-2 contract: no scope row ⇒ rev 0 (a non-zero rev is stale); rev 0 without a row is scope_missing (as in SQL)
   if(!scopeOf(issuer,market)){if(basedOnRev!==0)throw new FactsDbError('stale_computation');throw new FactsDbError('scope_missing');}
   if(!Number.isInteger(basedOnRev)||basedOnRev<0)throw new FactsDbError('stale_computation');
   return replaceLineage(issuer,market,[{issuer_id:issuer,state_rev:basedOnRev}],input);
  },
  async readFacts(issuer,market,o){const r=readLineage([issuer],market,o);return {stateRev:r.stateRevs[0].state_rev,rows:r.rows,truncated:r.truncated};},
```

```ts
  async resolveLineageConflict(itemId,keep,batchId,resolvedBy){
   if(!resolvedBy)throw unknown('invalid_resolver');
   const [it]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:itemId},{limit:1});
   if(!it||it.status!=='open')throw new FactsDbError('item_not_open');
   if(it.table_name!=='financial_facts'||it.reason_code!=='lineage_conflict'||(it.dataset!==DATASETS.facts('US')&&it.dataset!==DATASETS.facts('CN')))throw new FactsDbError('invalid_choice');
   const b=await batchRow(batchId);if(!b||b.status!=='running')throw new FactsDbError('batch_mismatch');
   const parts=String(it.natural_key).split(':');
   if(parts.length!==7)throw new FactsDbError('invalid_choice');
   const [t,concept,ps,pe,cons,unit,date]=parts;
   if(!UUID.test(t)||(ps!==''&&!isDate(ps))||!isDate(pe)||!isDate(date))throw new FactsDbError('invalid_choice');
   const market:Market=it.dataset===DATASETS.facts('US')?'US':'CN';
   const lin=lineageMembers(t);
   if(lin.some(i=>!scopeOf(i,market)))throw new FactsDbError('scope_missing');
   const ids=idsOf(it);
   if(!ids.includes(keep))throw new FactsDbError('invalid_choice');
   if(ids.some(id=>{const f=facts.get(id);return !!f&&!lin.includes(f.issuer_id);}))throw new FactsDbError('lineage_changed');
   const k:KeyPart={concept,period_start:ps===''?null:ps,period_end:pe,consolidation:cons,unit};
   const hit=[...facts.values()].filter(f=>lin.includes(f.issuer_id)&&f.market===market&&f.status==='ok'&&visible(f)&&keyOf(f)===keyOf(k)&&f.available_date===date);
   if(!hit.some(f=>f.fact_id===keep))throw new FactsDbError('unresolved');                     // the kept row must be the one visible ok row left; nothing written
   const others=hit.filter(f=>f.fact_id!==keep);
   for(const f of others)f.status='quarantined';
   const t0=now();
   await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:itemId,status:'open'},{status:'resolved_accept',resolved_by:resolvedBy,resolved_at:t0,
    detail:{...detailOf(it),chosen_fact_ids:[keep],quarantined_fact_ids:others.map(f=>f.fact_id).sort(cmp),issuer_id:t,market,batch_id:batchId,hook:{stage:'materialize',state:'pending',at:t0}}});
   for(const i of lin)bump(i,market);
   return {quarantined:others.length};
  },
  async claimReconcileMember(pair,cycleId,issuer,market,batchId){
   const key={pair,cycle_id:cycleId,issuer_id:issuer,market};
   const [c]=await tables.select('dq_reconcile_cursor',key,{limit:1});
   const [y]=await tables.select('dq_reconcile_cycles',{pair,cycle_id:cycleId},{limit:1});

   const latest={passed:r.passed,reconciliation_id:rid,at:t0,inputs_hash:r.inputs_hash??null};
   const f=r.left_fact_id===undefined?undefined:facts.get(r.left_fact_id);

   let itemId:string|null=null;let quarantined:0|1=0;let mat:ApplyReconcileOutcome['materialize']=null;
   if(r.action==='quarantine_left'&&r.outcome==='compared'&&r.passed===false&&f&&f.status==='ok'&&runs.get(f.run_id)?.status==='published'){
    const nk=`${fence.pair}:${r.natural_key}:${f.fact_id}`;
    if(nk.length>512)throw new FactsDbError('invalid_result');
    const [hit]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{dataset,table_name:'financial_facts',natural_key:nk,reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',status:'open'},{limit:1});
    const hook={stage:'materialize',state:'pending',at:t0};
    if(hit){itemId=String(hit.id);await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:itemId},{detail:{...detailOf(hit),reconciliation_id:rid,latest_result:latest,hook}});}
    else{
     itemId=randomUUID();
     await tables.insert('dq_quarantine',{id:itemId,dataset,table_name:'financial_facts',natural_key:nk,reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',
      detail:{pair:fence.pair,reconciliation_id:rid,inputs_hash:r.inputs_hash??null,latest_result:latest,issuer_id:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market,hook},
      payload:{key:{issuer_id:f.issuer_id,market:f.market,concept:f.concept,period_start:f.period_start,period_end:f.period_end,consolidation:f.consolidation,unit:f.unit,available_date:f.available_date},
       fact_ids:[f.fact_id],left_value:r.left_value,right_value:r.right_value,right_locator:(r.detail.right as {locator?:unknown}|undefined)?.locator??null},
      batch_id:fence.batch_id,status:'open',resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:t0});
    }
    f.status='quarantined';quarantined=1;bump(fence.issuer_id,fence.market);mat={issuerId:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market};
   }else if(f&&f.status==='quarantined'){
    const hits=(await items({status:'open',reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch'})).filter(i=>detailOf(i).pair===fence.pair&&idsOf(i).includes(f.fact_id)).sort((a,b)=>cmp(String(a.id),String(b.id)));
    for(const i of hits)await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:String(i.id)},{detail:{...detailOf(i),latest_result:latest}});
    itemId=hits[0]?String(hits[0].id):null;
   }
   if((r.action==='review_item'||r.action==='lineage_item')&&r.item){
    const reason=r.action==='review_item'?'reconcile_review':'lineage_conflict';
    const [hit]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{dataset,table_name:'financial_facts',natural_key:r.item.natural_key,reason_code:reason,status:'open'},{limit:1});
    if(hit)itemId=String(hit.id);
    else{
     itemId=randomUUID();
     await tables.insert('dq_quarantine',{id:itemId,dataset,table_name:'financial_facts',natural_key:r.item.natural_key,reason_code:reason,
      detail:{...(r.item.detail??{}),pair:fence.pair,reconciliation_id:rid,issuer_id:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market},payload:r.item.payload,
      batch_id:fence.batch_id,status:'open',resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:t0});
    }
   }
   await tables.insert('dq_reconciliations',{id:rid,dataset:`reconcile.${fence.pair}`,left_source:r.left_source,right_source:r.right_source,natural_key:r.natural_key,left_value:r.left_value,right_value:r.right_value,
    abs_diff:r.abs_diff,rel_diff:r.rel_diff,tolerance:r.tolerance,passed:r.passed,batch_id:fence.batch_id,pair:fence.pair,kind:r.kind,outcome:r.outcome,detail:{...r.detail,item_id:itemId,inputs_hash:r.inputs_hash??null},
    cycle_id:fence.cycle_id,issuer_id:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market,attempt:Number(c.attempts),created_at:t0});
   return {reused:false,reconciliationId:rid,itemId,quarantined,materialize:mat};
  },
  async completeReconcileMember(fence){
   const c=await fenceLock(fence);
   const rows=await tables.select('dq_reconciliations',{pair:fence.pair,cycle_id:fence.cycle_id,issuer_id:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market});
   const counts={compared_passed:rows.filter(x=>x.outcome==='compared'&&x.passed===true).length,compared_failed:rows.filter(x=>x.outcome==='compared'&&x.passed!==true).length,not_compared:rows.filter(x=>x.outcome!=='compared').length};
   if(counts.compared_passed+counts.compared_failed+counts.not_compared!==Number(c.expected))throw new FactsDbError('member_incomplete');
   await tables.update('dq_reconcile_cursor',cursorKey(fence),{state:'done',done_at:now(),claim_until:null,...counts});
   return counts;
  },
  async failReconcileMember(fence,error){
   await fenceLock(fence);
   await tables.update('dq_reconcile_cursor',cursorKey(fence),{state:'failed',claim_until:null,last_error:String(error??'unknown').slice(0,2000)});
  },
  async setMerge(source,target,resolvedBy){
   if(!source||!target||source===target)throw unknown('invalid_merge');
   if(!resolvedBy)throw unknown('invalid_resolver');
   if(topoOf(source).status!=='active')throw new FactsDbError('source_not_active');
   if(topoOf(target).status!=='active')throw unknown('merge_target_not_active');
   const set=[...new Set([source,target,...referrers(source),...referrers(target)])];
   for(const i of set)for(const m of MARKETS)ensureScope(i,m);
   const refs=referrers(source);
   for(const r of refs)topo.set(r,{...topoOf(r),merged_into:target});
   topo.set(source,{status:'merged',merged_into:target});
   for(const i of set)for(const m of MARKETS)bump(i,m);
   await registerPending(target);
   return {repointed:refs.length};
  },
  async setDissolved(issuer,resolvedBy){
   if(!resolvedBy)throw unknown('invalid_resolver');
   if(referrers(issuer).length>0)throw new FactsDbError('has_referrers');
   if(topoOf(issuer).status!=='active')throw new FactsDbError('source_not_active');
   for(const m of MARKETS)ensureScope(issuer,m);
   topo.set(issuer,{status:'dissolved',merged_into:null});
   for(const m of MARKETS)bump(issuer,m);
  },
```

```ts
  it('plan 3 reconcile cursor + restore: claim / fence / apply (quarantine, reuse) / complete; a quarantined left gets latest_result; restoreReconciled needs the current passing hash',async()=>{
   const {iss,r}=await published();const by=await h.user();const pair=newPair();
   const c1=await cycle(pair,[{issuer_id:iss,expected:2}]);const w=await h.batch();
   const fence=(await db.claimReconcileMember(pair,c1,iss,'US',w))!;
   expect(fence).toEqual({pair,cycle_id:c1,issuer_id:iss,market:'US',batch_id:w,attempt:1});
   expect(await db.claimReconcileMember(pair,c1,iss,'US',await h.batch())).toBeNull();
   const q1=await db.applyReconcileResult(fence,res('k1',{action:'quarantine_left',left_fact_id:r}));
   expect(q1).toMatchObject({reused:false,quarantined:1,materialize:{issuerId:iss,market:'US'}});
   expect(await statusOf(r)).toBe('quarantined');
   expect(await db.applyReconcileResult(fence,res('k1',{action:'quarantine_left',left_fact_id:r}))).toEqual({...q1,reused:true,quarantined:0,materialize:null});
   expect(await code(db.completeReconcileMember(fence))).toBe('member_incomplete:member_incomplete');
   await db.applyReconcileResult(fence,res('k2',{outcome:'right_missing',left_value:null,right_value:null,abs_diff:null,rel_diff:null}));
   expect(await db.completeReconcileMember(fence)).toEqual({compared_passed:0,compared_failed:1,not_compared:1});
   expect(await code(db.applyReconcileResult(fence,res('k3')))).toBe('fence_failed:fence_failed');
   const [item]=await h.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:q1.itemId!});
   expect(item).toMatchObject({status:'open',reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',dataset:'facts.us',natural_key:`${pair}:k1:${r}`});
   expect(item.detail).toMatchObject({pair,issuer_id:iss,market:'US',latest_result:{passed:false,inputs_hash:'h1'},hook:{stage:'materialize',state:'pending'}});
   expect(await code(db.restoreReconciled(q1.itemId!,w,'h1',by))).toBe('not_passing:not_passing');
   await closeCycle(pair,c1);
   const c2=await cycle(pair,[{issuer_id:iss,expected:1}]);
   const f2=(await db.claimReconcileMember(pair,c2,iss,'US',w))!;
   await db.applyReconcileResult(f2,res('k1',{left_fact_id:r,passed:true,right_value:'100',abs_diff:'0',rel_diff:'0',inputs_hash:'h2'}));
   expect(((await h.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:q1.itemId!}))[0].detail as {latest_result:unknown}).latest_result).toMatchObject({passed:true,inputs_hash:'h2'});
   expect(await code(db.restoreReconciled(q1.itemId!,w,'h1',by))).toBe('not_passing:not_passing');
   expect(await db.restoreReconciled(q1.itemId!,w,'h2',by)).toEqual({promoted:1,skipped:[]});
   expect(await statusOf(r)).toBe('ok');
   await h.expireReconcileClaim(pair,c2,iss,'US');
   expect(await code(db.completeReconcileMember(f2))).toBe('fence_failed:fence_failed');
   const f3=(await db.claimReconcileMember(pair,c2,iss,'US',w))!;expect(f3.attempt).toBe(2);
   await db.failReconcileMember(f3,'boom');
   expect((await db.claimReconcileMember(pair,c2,iss,'US',w))!.attempt).toBe(3);
  });

  it('plan 3 resolveLineageConflict: after setMerge the disagreement is a conflict; keeping one row quarantines the others of the lineage and clears it',async()=>{

   const ab=await h.batch();

   expect(await statusOf(x)).toBe('quarantined');
   const after=await db.readFactsLineage(lin,'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2030-01-01'});
   expect(after.conflicts).toEqual([]);expect(after.rows.map(y=>y.fact_id)).toEqual([r]);
   expect(((await h.tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:item}))[0].detail as Record<string,unknown>)).toMatchObject({chosen_fact_ids:[r],quarantined_fact_ids:[x],issuer_id:t,market:'US'});
  });
```

```ts
describe('materialize (lineage contract, spec §4.4 / T9)',()=>{
 const env=(stateRevs:LineageRev[],rows:FactRow[],truncated=false):ReadFactsLineageResult=>({stateRevs,lineage:stateRevs.map(x=>x.issuer_id),rows,conflicts:[],truncated});
 function fakeDb(envs:ReadFactsLineageResult[],o:{staleFirst?:boolean;staleAlways?:boolean;target?:string;lineage?:string[]}={}){
  let reads=0,replaces=0;const calls:{issuer:string;basedOn:LineageRev[];rows:MetricRow[]}[]=[];const readArgs:string[][]=[];
  const db:MaterializeDb={
   async targetOf(i){return o.target??i;},
   async lineageOf(t){return o.lineage??[t];},
   async readFactsLineage(issuers){readArgs.push(issuers);return envs[Math.min(reads++,envs.length-1)];},
   async replaceMetricsLineage(issuer,_m,basedOn,rows){replaces++;if(o.staleAlways||(o.staleFirst&&replaces===1))throw new FactsDbError('stale_computation');calls.push({issuer,basedOn,rows});return rows.length;},
  };
  return {db,calls,reads:()=>reads,readArgs};
 }
 it('reads the lineage envelope, derives, replaces under the rev vector, and retries once on stale_computation',async()=>{
  const rows=[dur('revenue','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','10'),dur('gross_profit','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','4')];
  const {db,calls,reads}=fakeDb([env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:7}],rows),env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:8}],rows)],{staleFirst:true});
  expect(await materialize(db,'I','US',{today:'2025-01-01'})).toEqual({rows:2,stateRev:8,retried:true,target:'I',basedOn:[{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:8}]});
  expect(reads()).toBe(2);
  expect(calls[0]).toMatchObject({issuer:'I',basedOn:[{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:8}]});
  expect(calls[0].rows.map(x=>x.metric)).toEqual(['gross_margin','q_single_revenue']);   // gross_margin + q_single_revenue (round-1 #17c)
  expect(calls[0].rows[0]).toMatchObject({metric:'gross_margin',value:'0.4',based_on_rev:8,based_on_lineage:[{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:8}],as_of:'2025-01-01'});
 });
 it('a merged source materialises its target T over the whole lineage: rows of both issuers form one series for T',async()=>{
  const lin=[{issuer_id:'S',state_rev:2},{issuer_id:'T',state_rev:5}];
  const rows=[dur('revenue','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','10',{issuer_id:'S'}),dur('gross_profit','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','4',{issuer_id:'T'})];
  const {db,calls,readArgs}=fakeDb([env(lin,rows)],{target:'T',lineage:['T','S']});
  expect(await materialize(db,'S','US',{today:'2025-01-01'})).toMatchObject({target:'T',stateRev:5,basedOn:lin,retried:false});
  expect(readArgs[0]).toEqual(['T','S']);
  expect(calls[0].issuer).toBe('T');
  const gm=calls[0].rows.find(x=>x.metric==='gross_margin')!;
  expect(gm).toMatchObject({issuer_id:'T',value:'0.4',based_on_rev:5,based_on_lineage:lin});
  expect(gm.inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id).sort()).toEqual(rows.map(x=>x.fact_id).sort());
 });
 it('gives up after the second stale_computation',async()=>{
  const {db}=fakeDb([env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:1}],[])],{staleAlways:true});
  await expect(materialize(db,'I','US')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'stale_computation'});
 });
 it('empty facts still replace with []; rows outside the lineage or market are refused',async()=>{
  const {db,calls}=fakeDb([env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:5}],[])]);
  expect(await materialize(db,'I','US',{today:'2025-01-01'})).toEqual({rows:0,stateRev:5,retried:false,target:'I',basedOn:[{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:5}]});
  expect(calls).toEqual([{issuer:'I',basedOn:[{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:5}],rows:[]}]);
  const other=fakeDb([env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:5}],[dur('revenue','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','1',{issuer_id:'OTHER'})])]);
  await expect(materialize(other.db,'I','US')).rejects.toThrow('derive_scope_mismatch');
  expect(other.calls).toEqual([]);
  expect(()=>deriveLineageMetrics([dur('revenue','2024-01-01','2024-03-31','1',{market:'CN'})],'I',['I'],{market:'US',asOf:'2025-01-01',basedOn:[]})).toThrow('derive_scope_mismatch');
 });
 it('refuses a truncated envelope with read_truncated and writes nothing',async()=>{
  const {db,calls}=fakeDb([env([{issuer_id:'I',state_rev:3}],[],true)]);
  await expect(materialize(db,'I','US')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'read_truncated'});
  expect(calls).toEqual([]);
 });
});
```

```ts
// materialize() follows the plan-3 lineage contract (spec §4.4, T9): target T = targetOf(issuer); the
// current lineage of T; read_facts_lineage (truncated → read_truncated); every row must belong to the
// lineage and market; derive for T; replace_financial_metrics_lineage under the envelope's rev
// vector, one retry on stale_computation (a rev or the lineage moved).
```

把 `MaterializeDb`、`MaterializeResult`、`materialize` 整段替换为：

```ts
export type MaterializeDb=Pick<FactsDb,'targetOf'|'lineageOf'|'readFactsLineage'|'replaceMetricsLineage'>;
export interface MaterializeResult{rows:number;stateRev:number;retried:boolean;target:string;basedOn:LineageRev[]}
/**
 * Rows of a lineage derived for its target T: every row must belong to the lineage and the market
 * (replaces plan 2's "rows of this issuer only"); issuer ids are relabelled to T so the
 * single-issuer derivation applies — the recorded issuer stays traceable through inputs[].fact_id.
 * based_on_rev = T's rev in basedOn; based_on_lineage = basedOn.
 */
export function deriveLineageMetrics(rows:FactRow[],target:string,lineage:readonly string[],opts:{market:Market;asOf:string;basedOn:LineageRev[]}):MetricRow[]{
 const members=new Set(lineage);
 if(!members.has(target)||rows.some(r=>!members.has(r.issuer_id)||r.market!==opts.market))throw new Error(`derive_scope_mismatch:${target}/${opts.market}`);
 const basedOnRev=opts.basedOn.find(x=>x.issuer_id===target)?.state_rev??0;
 return deriveMetrics(rows.map(r=>r.issuer_id===target?r:{...r,issuer_id:target}),{market:opts.market,asOf:opts.asOf,basedOnRev,basedOn:opts.basedOn});
}
/** as_of = today; materialises T(issuer) over its current lineage (see the header). */
export async function materialize(db:MaterializeDb,issuer:string,market:Market,opts:{today?:string}={}):Promise<MaterializeResult>{
 const asOf=opts.today??new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const target=await db.targetOf(issuer);
 for(let attempt=0;;attempt++){
  const lineage=await db.lineageOf(target);
  const env=await db.readFactsLineage(lineage,market,{concepts:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS[market]],asOf,history:true});
  if(env.truncated)throw new FactsDbError('read_truncated',`read_facts_lineage truncated for ${target}/${market}`);
  const rows=deriveLineageMetrics(env.rows,target,lineage,{market,asOf,basedOn:env.stateRevs});
  const stateRev=env.stateRevs.find(x=>x.issuer_id===target)?.state_rev??0;
  try{const n=await db.replaceMetricsLineage(target,market,env.stateRevs,rows);return {rows:n,stateRev,retried:attempt>0,target,basedOn:env.stateRevs};}
  catch(e){if(attempt===0&&e instanceof FactsDbError&&e.code==='stale_computation')continue;throw e;}
 }
}
```

（`scripts/facts/materialize.ts` 打印 `...r`，新字段随之输出，无需改；`sync.ts`、`facts-resolver.ts` 传入完整 `FactsDb`，类型自动满足。）

(d) `PublicIssuer` 与 `resolvePublicIssuer` 替换为：

```ts
export interface PublicIssuer{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;tickerAsOf:string;validFromMethod:string|null}
/**
 * Ticker → issuer by ownership AT tickerAsOf (default today; one merge hop is followed by
 * resolveIssuer, so issuerId is the lineage target). resolveIssuer matches the exact upper-cased
 * ticker first and falls back to the normalised one (so BRK.A is never BRK, and 600519 / SH600519 /
 * 600519.SS find 600519.SH). Market, echoed ticker and validFromMethod come from the security row
 * that matches one of those two forms (exact first; for a merged issuer, the source row read
 * directly, current at tickerAsOf); none matching, or a market the facts layer does not serve (HK),
 * is null (→ 404 unknown_ticker). Throws Error('ambiguous_owner') through.
 */
export async function resolvePublicIssuer(tables:TableClient,rawTicker:string,today:string,tickerAsOf:string=today):Promise<PublicIssuer|null>{
 const given=rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
 const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:given},{asOf:tickerAsOf});
 if(!r)return null;
 const core=inferCoreMarket(given);
 const normalised=core?normalizeSecurityTicker(given,core):null;
 const sec=r.securities.find(x=>x.ticker.toUpperCase()===given)??(normalised?r.securities.find(x=>x.ticker.toUpperCase()===normalised):undefined);
 let ticker=sec?.ticker;let validFromMethod:string|null=sec?.valid_from_method??null;
 if(ticker===undefined){
  // Merged issuer: resolveIssuer returned the TARGET's securities. Read the source row directly
  // (exact ticker first; the first form with any rows is authoritative, like the resolver).
  for(const t of normalised&&normalised!==given?[given,normalised]:[given]){
   const rows=await tables.select('issuer_securities',{ticker:t});
   if(rows.length===0)continue;
   const cur=rows.find(x=>isCurrentSecurity(x,tickerAsOf));
   if(cur){ticker=t;validFromMethod=typeof cur.valid_from_method==='string'?cur.valid_from_method:null;}
   break;
  }
 }
 if(ticker===undefined)return null;
 const market=publicMarketOf(ticker);
 return market?{issuerId:r.issuer_id,ticker,market,tickerAsOf,validFromMethod}:null;
}
```

```ts
export const publicFiling=(f:FilingRow)=>({filingId:f.filing_id,formType:f.form_type,periodEnd:f.period_end,availableDate:f.available_date,sourceRef:f.source_ref,url:f.url,documentRef:f.document_ref,documentUrl:f.document_url,citation:citationOf(f),acceptedAt:f.accepted_at??null,recordedIssuerId:f.issuer_id});
export const publicFact=(r:FactRow)=>({factId:r.fact_id,concept:r.concept,sourceConcept:r.source_concept,statement:r.statement,periodStart:r.period_start,periodEnd:r.period_end,duration:r.duration,value:r.value_text,unit:r.unit,availableDate:r.available_date,filingId:r.filing_id,disclosureSeq:r.disclosure_seq??null,isCurrent:r.is_current??null,isRevision:r.is_revision??null,mappingGen:r.mapping_gen,rawHash:r.raw_hash,recordedIssuerId:r.issuer_id});
export const publicConflict=(c:LineageConflict)=>({key:c.key,availableDate:c.available_date,factIds:c.fact_ids});
export const publicResolution=(i:PublicIssuer)=>({tickerAsOf:i.tickerAsOf,issuerId:i.issuerId,validFromMethod:i.validFromMethod});
/** Published filings of every lineage member (spec §4.4), newest available_date first, then filing_id (the order filingsOfIssuer gives one issuer). */
export async function lineageFilings(db:FactsDb,lineage:readonly string[],market:Market,opts:{from?:string;to?:string}={}):Promise<FilingRow[]>{
 const all=(await Promise.all(lineage.map(i=>db.filingsOfIssuer(i,market,opts)))).flat().filter(isPublished);
 return all.sort((a,b)=>a.available_date<b.available_date?1:a.available_date>b.available_date?-1:a.filing_id<b.filing_id?-1:a.filing_id>b.filing_id?1:0);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现三个路由**

`src/app/api/facts/[ticker]/route.ts` 整文件替换为：

```ts
// src/app/api/facts/[ticker]/route.ts
// Public disclosure-log read (spec §9; plan 3 §4.4): concepts mode (read_facts_lineage envelope over
// the issuer's lineage, asOf replay, history, durations, limit = natural keys) or factIds evidence
// mode (≤ 100 ids, any mapping generation, RLS limits to status ok, rows of lineage members only).
// tickerAsOf picks the ticker's owner at that date. The body names the lineage target (issuerId),
// its lineage, the cross-issuer conflicts withheld from current values, and every row's
// recordedIssuerId; filings returned are exactly those referenced by the returned facts.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {CONCEPT_IDS as CONCEPT_ID_LIST,MAPPING_GEN,MAX_READ_CONCEPTS} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {QueryError,TICKER_RE,UUID_RE,asOfParam,dateParam,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,flagParam,intParam,lineageFilings,listParam,paramErrorResponse,publicClients,publicConflict,publicFact,publicFiling,publicResolution,readParams,resolvePublicIssuer,successHeaders,tickerAsOfParam,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {Duration,FactRow,LineageConflict} from '@/lib/facts/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['concepts','factIds','from','to','asOf','durations','history','limit','tickerAsOf'] as const;
const CONCEPT_IDS=new Set(CONCEPT_ID_LIST);
const DURATIONS=new Set<string>(['3M','6M','9M','12M','INSTANT']);
const MAX_FACT_IDS=100,DEFAULT_LIMIT=200,MAX_LIMIT=1000;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const {ticker:raw}=await params;const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
 if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400);
 let q:{concepts?:string[];factIds?:string[];from?:string;to?:string;asOf:string;durations?:Set<string>;history:boolean;limit:number;tickerAsOf:string};
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  const concepts=listParam(p,'concepts',CONCEPT_IDS,MAX_READ_CONCEPTS);
  const factIds=listParam(p,'factIds',null,MAX_FACT_IDS);
  if(factIds&&factIds.some(id=>!UUID_RE.test(id)))throw new QueryError('factIds');
  if((concepts===undefined)===(factIds===undefined))throw new QueryError(concepts?'factIds':'concepts');   // exactly one mode
  const durations=listParam(p,'durations',DURATIONS,DURATIONS.size);
  q={concepts,factIds,from:dateParam(p,'from'),to:dateParam(p,'to'),asOf:asOfParam(p,today),durations:durations?new Set(durations):undefined,history:flagParam(p,'history'),limit:intParam(p,'limit',DEFAULT_LIMIT,MAX_LIMIT),tickerAsOf:tickerAsOfParam(p,today)};
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {tables,db}=publicClients();
  const issuer=await resolvePublicIssuer(tables,ticker,today,q.tickerAsOf);
  if(!issuer)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
  const lineage=await db.lineageOf(issuer.issuerId);
  const members=new Set(lineage);
  let rows:FactRow[],truncated=false,conflicts:LineageConflict[]=[];
  const filingsAll=await lineageFilings(db,lineage,issuer.market);   // published only, before any use
  const publishedIds=new Set(filingsAll.map(f=>f.filing_id));
  if(q.factIds){
   rows=(await db.factsByIds(q.factIds)).filter(r=>members.has(r.issuer_id)&&r.market===issuer.market&&publishedIds.has(r.filing_id));
  }else{
   // durations are applied BEFORE the natural-key limit: read without the limit (the 10,000-row cap still
   // applies → truncated), filter, then keep the first `limit` natural keys (rows arrive grouped by key in rank order).
   const env=await db.readFactsLineage(lineage,issuer.market,{concepts:q.concepts!,asOf:q.asOf,from:q.from,to:q.to,history:q.history,limit:q.durations?undefined:q.limit});
   truncated=env.truncated;rows=env.rows;conflicts=env.conflicts;
   if(q.durations){
    const kept=new Set<string>();
    rows=rows.filter(r=>{
     if(!q.durations!.has(r.duration as Duration))return false;
     const k=[r.concept,r.period_start??'',r.period_end,r.consolidation,r.unit].join('|');
     if(!kept.has(k)){if(kept.size>=q.limit)return false;kept.add(k);}
     return true;
    });
   }
  }
  const wanted=new Set(rows.map(r=>r.filing_id));
  const filings=filingsAll.filter(f=>wanted.has(f.filing_id));
  const body={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf:q.factIds?null:q.asOf,mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,truncated,lineage,resolution:publicResolution(issuer),
   conflicts:conflicts.map(publicConflict),facts:rows.map(publicFact),filings:filings.map(publicFiling)};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:successHeaders(now,q.factIds?undefined:q.asOf,rows.length===0||truncated)});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'facts','facts read failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/facts/[ticker]/metrics/route.ts
// Public derived metrics (spec §9; plan 3 §4.4, T8). Without asOf: the materialized
// financial_metrics rows of the lineage target T for the current FORMULA_VERSION, served only when
// the lineage members and their state_revs read before and after the metrics read are identical
// and every row's based_on_lineage equals that vector; any mismatch or an unstable read →
// metrics:[], stale:true, STALE_CACHE_CONTROL (never recomputed inline: the visibility paths
// re-materialise). With asOf: a live deriveLineageMetrics over the read_facts_lineage envelope
// (asOf replay), basedOnRev = T's rev, basedOnLineage = the envelope vector. Metric names are
// validated per market; tickerAsOf picks the ticker's owner at that date.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {lineageRevsEqual} from '@/lib/facts/db';
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,FORMULA_VERSION,deriveLineageMetrics,metricNames} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL,STALE_CACHE_CONTROL,QueryError,TICKER_RE,dateParam,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,intParam,listParam,paramErrorResponse,publicClients,publicResolution,readParams,resolvePublicIssuer,successHeaders,tickerAsOfParam,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {FactsDbError} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['metrics','from','to','asOf','limit','tickerAsOf'] as const;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT=200,MAX_LIMIT=1000;
const publicMetric=(m:MetricRow)=>({metric:m.metric,periodStart:m.period_start,periodEnd:m.period_end,duration:m.duration,value:m.value,unit:m.unit,inputUnit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,inputs:m.inputs,basedOnRev:m.based_on_rev,basedOnLineage:m.based_on_lineage});

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const {ticker:raw}=await params;const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
 if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400);
 let p:Map<string,string>,from:string|undefined,to:string|undefined,asOf:string|undefined,limit:number,tickerAsOf:string;
 try{
  p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  from=dateParam(p,'from');to=dateParam(p,'to');asOf=dateParam(p,'asOf');limit=intParam(p,'limit',DEFAULT_LIMIT,MAX_LIMIT);tickerAsOf=tickerAsOfParam(p,today);
  if(asOf!==undefined&&asOf>today)throw new QueryError('asOf');
 }catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {tables,db}=publicClients();
  const issuer=await resolvePublicIssuer(tables,ticker,today,tickerAsOf);
  if(!issuer)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
  let metrics:string[]|undefined;
  try{metrics=listParam(p,'metrics',new Set(metricNames(issuer.market)),metricNames(issuer.market).length);}
  catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
  const target=issuer.issuerId;
  const lineage=await db.lineageOf(target);
  let rows:MetricRow[],truncated=false,stale=false;
  if(asOf===undefined){
   const before=await db.stateRevs(lineage,issuer.market);
   try{rows=await db.metricsOfIssuer(target,issuer.market,FORMULA_VERSION);}
   catch(e){if(e instanceof FactsDbError&&e.message==='metrics_unstable'){rows=[];stale=true;}else throw e;}
   if(!stale&&rows.length>0){
    const lineageAfter=await db.lineageOf(target);
    const after=await db.stateRevs(lineageAfter,issuer.market);
    if(lineageAfter.join(',')!==lineage.join(',')||!lineageRevsEqual(before,after)||rows.some(m=>!lineageRevsEqual(m.based_on_lineage,before))){rows=[];stale=true;}
   }
  }else{
   const env=await db.readFactsLineage(lineage,issuer.market,{concepts:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS[issuer.market]],asOf,history:true});
   truncated=env.truncated;
   rows=truncated?[]:deriveLineageMetrics(env.rows,target,lineage,{market:issuer.market,asOf,basedOn:env.stateRevs});
  }
  const wanted=metrics?new Set(metrics):null;
  rows=rows.filter(m=>(!wanted||wanted.has(m.metric))&&(from===undefined||m.period_end>=from)&&(to===undefined||m.period_end<=to)).slice(0,limit);
  const body={issuerId:target,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf:asOf??null,mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION,truncated,stale,lineage,resolution:publicResolution(issuer),metrics:rows.map(publicMetric)};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:stale?{'Cache-Control':STALE_CACHE_CONTROL}:asOf===undefined&&rows.length>0?{'Cache-Control':FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL}:successHeaders(now,asOf,rows.length===0||truncated)});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'facts/metrics','metrics read failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/filings/[ticker]/route.ts
// Public filings list (spec §9; plan 3 §4.4, §4.5): the published filings of every member of the
// issuer's lineage by available_date window, newest first, with the citation state
// (edgar | linked | pending), acceptedAt and recordedIssuerId. tickerAsOf picks the owner at that date.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {TICKER_RE,dateParam,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,intParam,lineageFilings,paramErrorResponse,publicClients,publicFiling,publicResolution,readParams,resolvePublicIssuer,successHeaders,tickerAsOfParam,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['from','to','limit','tickerAsOf'] as const;
const DEFAULT_LIMIT=200,MAX_LIMIT=1000;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=utcDate(now);
 const {ticker:raw}=await params;const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
 if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400);
 let from:string|undefined,to:string|undefined,limit:number,tickerAsOf:string;
 try{const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);from=dateParam(p,'from');to=dateParam(p,'to');limit=intParam(p,'limit',DEFAULT_LIMIT,MAX_LIMIT);tickerAsOf=tickerAsOfParam(p,today);}
 catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 try{
  const {tables,db}=publicClients();
  const issuer=await resolvePublicIssuer(tables,ticker,today,tickerAsOf);
  if(!issuer)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
  const lineage=await db.lineageOf(issuer.issuerId);
  // published only, filtered BEFORE the limit (so staged filings never consume page slots)
  const filings=(await lineageFilings(db,lineage,issuer.market,{from,to})).slice(0,limit);
  return NextResponse.json({issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,lineage,resolution:publicResolution(issuer),filings:filings.map(publicFiling)},{headers:successHeaders(now,undefined,filings.length===0)});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'filings','filings read failed');}
}
```

```ts
  const r=await resolveFactsItem(db,tables,it_,{status:'resolved_accept',keepFactId:KEEP,resolvedBy:ADMIN,now:NOW});

 });
 it('reconcile_review: accept and reject are the plan-1 status flip only (no promotion, no hook, no materialize)',async()=>{
```
