- [ ] **Step 3: 实现**

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/ixbrl.ts
// Inline XBRL subset parser (spec §5.2), IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION='ixbrl/1'.
// A bounded streaming XML tokenizer (elements, attributes, the five XML entities plus &nbsp; and numeric
// character references; comments, processing instructions and a DOCTYPE WITHOUT internal subset are
// skipped; an internal DTD subset is refused; CDATA is literal text; script/style content is raw text;
// depth <= 1000, attributes <= 256 per element) feeds a parser that resolves every element name and every
// QName value through the in-scope xmlns declarations, so prefixes never matter.
// Supported subset (each has a test); everything else lands in `unsupported` and is never merged:
//  - xbrli:context: entity/identifier; period startDate+endDate | instant, dates YYYY-MM-DD. ANY child
//    element inside segment or scenario marks the context dimensional and its facts are skipped (out of
//    scope by design, not reported). Facts carry (entity, period), so equal contexts with different ids
//    give the same key (ixFactKey) — the normalised dedupe.
//  - xbrli:unit: one measure, or divide with exactly one numerator and one denominator measure; iso4217
//    and xbrli measures become USD / shares / pure, then facts/units.ts normalizeUnit ('USD/shares' →
//    'USD/share'); anything else → unsupported(unit).
//  - ix:nonFraction: name, contextRef, unitRef, scale, sign, decimals, format, xsi:nil. Text grammar by
//    format (transformation registries 2015-02-26, 2020-02-12, 2022-02-16 only):
//      (no format), num-dot-decimal, numdotdecimal   ^\s*-?[0-9][0-9,]*(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$   commas dropped
//      num-comma-decimal, numcommadecimal            ^\s*-?[0-9][0-9.]*(,[0-9]+)?\s*$    dots dropped, comma = point
//      fixed-zero, zerodash                          → 0
//      numwordsen                                    'no' | 'none' (trimmed, case-insensitive) → 0
//    any other format or no match → unsupported(format); xsi:nil = true|1 → unsupported(nil).
//    value = canonical decimal × 10^scale, negated when sign='-'. A nested ix:nonFraction gives the outer
//    fact the innermost text; text inside ix:exclude is not fact text.
//  - ix:nonNumeric: only dei:EntityFilerCategory, dei:DocumentFiscalYearFocus, dei:DocumentPeriodEndDate
//    (whitespace-collapsed raw text; a second, different text → unsupported(nonnumeric_conflict)).
//  - ix:fraction, ix:tuple and facts with tupleRef → unsupported. No ix element at all → not_inline_xbrl.
// Malformed XML throws IxbrlParseError(code); the pair turns that into unsupported results.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {normalizeUnit} from '../../facts/units';

export const IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION='ixbrl/1';
export const MAX_IXBRL_BYTES=50*1024*1024;
export const NS={ix:'http://www.xbrl.org/2013/inlineXBRL',xbrli:'http://www.xbrl.org/2003/instance',xbrldi:'http://xbrl.org/2006/xbrldi',xsi:'http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance',iso4217:'http://www.xbrl.org/2003/iso4217',xml:'http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace'} as const;
export const TRANSFORM_NS:readonly string[]=['http://www.xbrl.org/inlineXBRL/transformation/2015-02-26','http://www.xbrl.org/inlineXBRL/transformation/2020-02-12','http://www.xbrl.org/inlineXBRL/transformation/2022-02-16'];
export const DEI_NON_NUMERIC:readonly string[]=['dei:EntityFilerCategory','dei:DocumentFiscalYearFocus','dei:DocumentPeriodEndDate'];

export interface IxFact{name:string;periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;unit:string;value:string;decimals:string|null;scale:number;entity:string;contextRef:string;unitRef:string}
export interface IxUnsupported{reason:string;name?:string;contextRef?:string;periodStart?:string|null;periodEnd?:string}
export interface IxbrlDocument{facts:IxFact[];nonNumeric:Record<string,string>;unsupported:IxUnsupported[]}
export class IxbrlParseError extends Error{constructor(public readonly code:string){super(code);this.name='IxbrlParseError';}}

// ---------------- tokenizer ----------------
export type XmlToken=
 |{t:'open';name:string;attrs:[string,string][];self:boolean;start:number;end:number}
 |{t:'close';name:string;start:number;end:number}
 |{t:'text';text:string;start:number;end:number};
const MAX_DEPTH=1000,MAX_ATTRS=256;
const NAME_RE=/[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*(?::[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)?/y;
const NAMED:Record<string,string>={lt:'<',gt:'>',amp:'&',quot:'"',apos:"'",nbsp:' '};
const fail=(code:string):never=>{throw new IxbrlParseError(code);};
const isWs=(c:number)=>c===32||c===9||c===10||c===13;
function nameAt(doc:string,at:number):string|null{NAME_RE.lastIndex=at;const m=NAME_RE.exec(doc);return m?m[0]:null;}

export function decodeEntities(s:string):string{
 if(!s.includes('&'))return s;
 return s.replace(/&(#[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,6}|#[0-9]{1,7}|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,31});/g,(m,b:string)=>{
  if(b[0]!=='#')return NAMED[b]??m;
  const cp=b[1]==='x'||b[1]==='X'?Number.parseInt(b.slice(2),16):Number.parseInt(b.slice(1),10);
  return cp>0&&cp<=0x10ffff&&(cp<0xd800||cp>0xdfff)?String.fromCodePoint(cp):m;
 });
}

/** Streaming tokens with source offsets [start, end). Throws IxbrlParseError on malformed markup. */
export function* tokenizeXml(doc:string):Generator<XmlToken>{
 const n=doc.length;let i=doc.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff?1:0;let depth=0;let rawEnd:string|null=null;let lower:string|null=null;
 while(i<n){
  if(rawEnd!==null){
   lower??=doc.toLowerCase();
   const e=lower.indexOf(rawEnd,i);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_raw_text');
   if(e>i)yield {t:'text',text:doc.slice(i,e),start:i,end:e};
   rawEnd=null;i=e;continue;
  }
  const lt=doc.indexOf('<',i);
  if(lt<0){yield {t:'text',text:decodeEntities(doc.slice(i)),start:i,end:n};break;}
  if(lt>i)yield {t:'text',text:decodeEntities(doc.slice(i,lt)),start:i,end:lt};
  if(doc.startsWith('<!--',lt)){const e=doc.indexOf('-->',lt+4);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_comment');i=e+3;continue;}
  if(doc.startsWith('<![CDATA[',lt)){const e=doc.indexOf(']]>',lt+9);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_cdata');yield {t:'text',text:doc.slice(lt+9,e),start:lt,end:e+3};i=e+3;continue;}
  if(doc.startsWith('<?',lt)){const e=doc.indexOf('?>',lt+2);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_pi');i=e+2;continue;}
  if(doc.startsWith('<!',lt)){const e=doc.indexOf('>',lt+2);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_declaration');if(doc.slice(lt,e).includes('['))fail('dtd_unsupported');i=e+1;continue;}
  if(doc.charCodeAt(lt+1)===47){
   const name=nameAt(doc,lt+2)??fail('bad_close_tag');
   let j=lt+2+name.length;while(j<n&&isWs(doc.charCodeAt(j)))j++;
   if(doc[j]!=='>')fail('bad_close_tag');
   depth--;if(depth<0)fail('unbalanced_close');
   yield {t:'close',name,start:lt,end:j+1};i=j+1;continue;
  }
  const name=nameAt(doc,lt+1)??fail('bad_open_tag');
  let j=lt+1+name.length;const attrs:[string,string][]=[];let self=false;
  for(;;){
   while(j<n&&isWs(doc.charCodeAt(j)))j++;
   if(j>=n)fail('unterminated_tag');
   if(doc.startsWith('/>',j)){self=true;j+=2;break;}
   if(doc[j]==='>'){j++;break;}
   const an=nameAt(doc,j)??fail('bad_attribute');j+=an.length;
   while(j<n&&isWs(doc.charCodeAt(j)))j++;
   if(doc[j]!=='=')fail('bad_attribute');
   j++;while(j<n&&isWs(doc.charCodeAt(j)))j++;
   const q=doc[j];if(q!=='"'&&q!=="'")fail('bad_attribute');
   const e=doc.indexOf(q,j+1);if(e<0)fail('unterminated_attribute');
   attrs.push([an,decodeEntities(doc.slice(j+1,e))]);j=e+1;
   if(attrs.length>MAX_ATTRS)fail('too_many_attributes');
  }
  yield {t:'open',name,attrs,self,start:lt,end:j};
  if(!self){
   depth++;if(depth>MAX_DEPTH)fail('too_deep');
   const local=name.slice(name.indexOf(':')+1).toLowerCase();
   if(local==='script'||local==='style')rawEnd=`</${name.toLowerCase()}`;
  }
  i=j;
 }
 if(rawEnd!==null)fail('unterminated_raw_text');
}

// ---------------- names ----------------
export type NsMap=ReadonlyMap<string,string>;   // prefix ('' = default namespace) → URI
/** Element names and QName values use the default namespace when unprefixed (useDefault); plain attribute names never do. */
export function resolveQName(q:string,ns:NsMap,useDefault:boolean):{uri:string|null;local:string}{
 const k=q.indexOf(':');
 if(k<0)return {uri:useDefault?(ns.get('')??null):null,local:q};
 const p=q.slice(0,k);
 return {uri:p==='xml'?NS.xml:(ns.get(p)??null),local:q.slice(k+1)};
}
/** Canonical concept name: us-gaap / dei / ifrs-full / srt by namespace URI pattern (any taxonomy year), else Clark notation {uri}local. */
export function canonicalConcept(uri:string|null,local:string):string{
 if(uri!==null){
  if(/^http:\/\/fasb\.org\/us-gaap\/\d{4}(-\d{2}-\d{2})?$/.test(uri))return `us-gaap:${local}`;
  if(/^http:\/\/xbrl\.sec\.gov\/dei\/\d{4}(-\d{2}-\d{2})?$/.test(uri))return `dei:${local}`;
  if(/^https?:\/\/xbrl\.ifrs\.org\/taxonomy\/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\/ifrs-full$/.test(uri))return `ifrs-full:${local}`;
  if(/^http:\/\/fasb\.org\/srt\/\d{4}(-\d{2}-\d{2})?$/.test(uri))return `srt:${local}`;
 }
 return `{${uri??''}}${local}`;
}
const attrOf=(attrs:readonly [string,string][],name:string)=>attrs.find(([k])=>k===name)?.[1];
function nsAttr(attrs:readonly [string,string][],ns:NsMap,uri:string,local:string):string|undefined{
 for(const [k,v] of attrs){
  const i=k.indexOf(':');if(i<0)continue;
  const p=k.slice(0,i);if(p==='xmlns')continue;
  if(ns.get(p)===uri&&k.slice(i+1)===local)return v;
 }
 return undefined;
}

// ---------------- values ----------------
const RE_DOT=/^\s*-?[0-9][0-9,]*(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$/;
const RE_COMMA=/^\s*-?[0-9][0-9.]*(,[0-9]+)?\s*$/;
/** Digits (no exponent) for a format's text, or null when the text does not match the format's grammar. */
export function parseFactText(format:string,text:string):string|null{
 switch(format){
  case 'none':case 'num-dot-decimal':case 'numdotdecimal':return RE_DOT.test(text)?text.replace(/[\s,]/g,''):null;
  case 'num-comma-decimal':case 'numcommadecimal':return RE_COMMA.test(text)?text.replace(/[\s.]/g,'').replace(',','.'):null;
  case 'fixed-zero':case 'zerodash':return '0';
  case 'numwordsen':{const t=text.trim().toLowerCase();return t==='no'||t==='none'?'0':null;}
  default:return null;
 }
}
function formatOf(q:string|undefined,ns:NsMap):string|null{
 if(q===undefined)return 'none';
 const r=resolveQName(q.trim(),ns,true);
 return r.uri!==null&&TRANSFORM_NS.includes(r.uri)?r.local:null;
}
/** Right-side key of a fact: (concept, canonical context = entity + period, unit). */
export const ixFactKey=(f:Pick<IxFact,'name'|'entity'|'periodStart'|'periodEnd'|'unit'>)=>[f.name,f.entity,f.periodStart??'',f.periodEnd,f.unit].join('|');
/** Facts grouped by ixFactKey with their DISTINCT values (canonical decimal equality), in document order. */
export function indexIxFacts(facts:readonly IxFact[]):Map<string,{values:string[];facts:IxFact[]}>{
 const out=new Map<string,{values:string[];facts:IxFact[]}>();
 for(const f of facts){
  const k=ixFactKey(f);const g=out.get(k)??{values:[],facts:[]};
  if(!g.values.includes(f.value))g.values.push(f.value);
  g.facts.push(f);out.set(k,g);
 }
 return out;
}

// ---------------- parser ----------------
interface Frame{name:string;ns:NsMap;uri:string|null;local:string}
interface RawCtx{id:string;scheme:string;ident:string;start:string;end:string;instant:string;forever:boolean;dimensional:boolean}
interface RawUnit{id:string;measures:string[];num:string[];den:string[]}
interface FactFrame{kind:'nf'|'nn';attrs:[string,string][];ns:NsMap;text:string;inner:string|null}
interface RawFact{kind:'nf'|'nn';attrs:[string,string][];ns:NsMap;text:string}
const DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function periodOf(c:RawCtx):{start:string|null;end:string}|null{
 if(c.forever)return null;
 const s=c.start.trim(),e=c.end.trim(),i=c.instant.trim();
 if(i!==''&&s===''&&e==='')return DATE.test(i)?{start:null,end:i}:null;
 if(i===''&&DATE.test(s)&&DATE.test(e)&&s<=e)return {start:s,end:e};
 return null;
}
function unitString(u:RawUnit):string|null{
 if(u.num.length>0||u.den.length>0)return u.num.length===1&&u.den.length===1&&u.measures.length===0?`${u.num[0]}/${u.den[0]}`:null;
 return u.measures.length===1?u.measures[0]:null;
}

export function parseInlineXbrl(doc:string):IxbrlDocument{
 const out:IxbrlDocument={facts:[],nonNumeric:{},unsupported:[]};
 const root:NsMap=new Map([['xml',NS.xml]]);
 const stack:Frame[]=[];
 const contexts=new Map<string,RawCtx>();const units=new Map<string,RawUnit>();const rawFacts:RawFact[]=[];
 const open:FactFrame[]=[];
 let sawIx=false,exclude=0;
 let ctx:RawCtx|null=null;let ctxField:'ident'|'start'|'end'|'instant'|null=null;let segDepth=-1;
 let unit:RawUnit|null=null;let unitPart:'num'|'den'|null=null;let measure:{ns:NsMap;text:string}|null=null;

 const onOpen=(f:Frame,attrs:[string,string][])=>{
  if(ctx!==null&&segDepth>=0){ctx.dimensional=true;return;}   // any element inside segment / scenario
  if(f.uri===NS.ix){
   sawIx=true;
   if(f.local==='nonFraction'||f.local==='nonNumeric'){
    if(attrOf(attrs,'tupleRef')!==undefined)out.unsupported.push({reason:'tuple_member',name:attrOf(attrs,'name')});
    open.push({kind:f.local==='nonFraction'?'nf':'nn',attrs,ns:f.ns,text:'',inner:null});
   }else if(f.local==='exclude')exclude++;
   else if(f.local==='fraction'||f.local==='tuple')out.unsupported.push({reason:`ix_${f.local}`,name:attrOf(attrs,'name')});
   return;
  }
  if(f.uri!==NS.xbrli)return;
  if(f.local==='context'){ctx={id:attrOf(attrs,'id')??'',scheme:'',ident:'',start:'',end:'',instant:'',forever:false,dimensional:false};return;}
  if(ctx!==null){
   if(f.local==='segment'||f.local==='scenario'){segDepth=stack.length;return;}
   if(f.local==='identifier'){ctx.scheme=attrOf(attrs,'scheme')??'';ctxField='ident';return;}
   if(f.local==='startDate'){ctxField='start';return;}
   if(f.local==='endDate'){ctxField='end';return;}
   if(f.local==='instant'){ctxField='instant';return;}
   if(f.local==='forever'){ctx.forever=true;return;}
   return;
  }
  if(f.local==='unit'){unit={id:attrOf(attrs,'id')??'',measures:[],num:[],den:[]};return;}
  if(unit!==null){
   if(f.local==='unitNumerator')unitPart='num';
   else if(f.local==='unitDenominator')unitPart='den';
   else if(f.local==='measure')measure={ns:f.ns,text:''};
  }
 };
 const onClose=(f:Frame)=>{
  if(f.uri===NS.ix){
   if(f.local==='exclude'){exclude=Math.max(0,exclude-1);return;}
   if(f.local==='nonFraction'||f.local==='nonNumeric'){
    const fr=open.pop();if(!fr)return;
    const text=fr.inner??fr.text;
    const parent=open[open.length-1];
    if(parent){if(parent.kind==='nf')parent.inner=text;else parent.text+=text;}
    rawFacts.push({kind:fr.kind,attrs:fr.attrs,ns:fr.ns,text});
   }
   return;
  }
  if(f.uri!==NS.xbrli)return;
  if(ctx!==null){
   if(f.local==='context'){contexts.set(ctx.id,ctx);ctx=null;ctxField=null;segDepth=-1;return;}
   if((f.local==='segment'||f.local==='scenario')&&segDepth===stack.length){segDepth=-1;return;}
   if(f.local==='identifier'||f.local==='startDate'||f.local==='endDate'||f.local==='instant')ctxField=null;
   return;
  }
  if(unit!==null){
   if(f.local==='unit'){units.set(unit.id,unit);unit=null;unitPart=null;return;}
   if(f.local==='measure'&&measure!==null){
    const r=resolveQName(measure.text.trim(),measure.ns,true);
    const m=r.uri===NS.iso4217||r.uri===NS.xbrli?r.local:`{${r.uri??''}}${r.local}`;
    (unitPart==='num'?unit.num:unitPart==='den'?unit.den:unit.measures).push(m);measure=null;return;
   }
   if(f.local==='unitNumerator'||f.local==='unitDenominator')unitPart=null;
  }
 };

 for(const tok of tokenizeXml(doc)){
  if(tok.t==='text'){
   if(ctx!==null&&ctxField!==null&&segDepth<0)ctx[ctxField]+=tok.text;
   if(measure!==null)measure.text+=tok.text;
   if(open.length>0&&exclude===0)open[open.length-1].text+=tok.text;
   continue;
  }
  if(tok.t==='open'){
   const parent=stack.length>0?stack[stack.length-1].ns:root;
   let ns:NsMap=parent;
   const decl=tok.attrs.filter(([k])=>k==='xmlns'||k.startsWith('xmlns:'));
   if(decl.length>0){const m=new Map(parent);for(const [k,v] of decl)m.set(k==='xmlns'?'':k.slice(6),v);ns=m;}
   const {uri,local}=resolveQName(tok.name,ns,true);
   const frame:Frame={name:tok.name,ns,uri,local};
   if(tok.self){onOpen(frame,tok.attrs);onClose(frame);}
   else{onOpen(frame,tok.attrs);stack.push(frame);}
   continue;
  }
  const frame=stack.pop();
  if(!frame||frame.name!==tok.name)throw new IxbrlParseError('mismatched_close');
  onClose(frame);
 }
 if(stack.length>0)throw new IxbrlParseError('unclosed_elements');
 if(!sawIx)return {facts:[],nonNumeric:{},unsupported:[{reason:'not_inline_xbrl'}]};

 for(const f of rawFacts){
  const nameQ=attrOf(f.attrs,'name');
  if(!nameQ){out.unsupported.push({reason:'name'});continue;}
  const q=resolveQName(nameQ.trim(),f.ns,true);const name=canonicalConcept(q.uri,q.local);
  if(f.kind==='nn'){
   if(!DEI_NON_NUMERIC.includes(name))continue;
   const text=f.text.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
   const prev=out.nonNumeric[name];
   if(prev===undefined)out.nonNumeric[name]=text;
   else if(prev!==text)out.unsupported.push({reason:'nonnumeric_conflict',name});
   continue;
  }
  if(attrOf(f.attrs,'tupleRef')!==undefined)continue;   // reported when opened
  const contextRef=attrOf(f.attrs,'contextRef')??'';
  const c=contexts.get(contextRef);
  if(!c){out.unsupported.push({reason:'context',name,contextRef});continue;}
  if(c.dimensional)continue;
  const period=periodOf(c);
  if(!period){out.unsupported.push({reason:'period',name,contextRef});continue;}
  const where={name,contextRef,periodStart:period.start,periodEnd:period.end};
  const nil=nsAttr(f.attrs,f.ns,NS.xsi,'nil');
  if(nil==='true'||nil==='1'){out.unsupported.push({reason:'nil',...where});continue;}
  const unitRef=attrOf(f.attrs,'unitRef')??'';
  const u=units.get(unitRef);const raw=u?unitString(u):null;const unitNorm=raw===null?null:normalizeUnit(raw);
  if(unitNorm===null){out.unsupported.push({reason:'unit',...where});continue;}
  const scaleRaw=(attrOf(f.attrs,'scale')??'0').trim();
  if(!/^-?\d{1,2}$/.test(scaleRaw)){out.unsupported.push({reason:'scale',...where});continue;}
  const sign=attrOf(f.attrs,'sign');
  if(sign!==undefined&&sign!=='-'){out.unsupported.push({reason:'sign',...where});continue;}
  const fmt=formatOf(attrOf(f.attrs,'format'),f.ns);
  const digits=fmt===null?null:parseFactText(fmt,f.text);
  if(digits===null){out.unsupported.push({reason:'format',...where});continue;}
  const scale=Number(scaleRaw);
  let value=canonicalDecimal(`${digits}e${scale}`);
  if(sign==='-'&&value!=='0')value=value.startsWith('-')?value.slice(1):`-${value}`;
  out.facts.push({name,periodStart:period.start,periodEnd:period.end,unit:unitNorm,value,decimals:attrOf(f.attrs,'decimals')??null,scale,entity:`${c.scheme}#${c.ident.trim()}`,contextRef,unitRef});
 }
 return out;
```

裁剪规则（`IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION='ixbrl-trim/1'`）：保留根元素开标签原文（全部 `xmlns` 声明）、第一个 `ix:header`/`ix:resources` 的限定名、每个**最外层** `ix:nonFraction`/`ix:nonNumeric` 中解析后概念名通过 `keep` 的那些（缺省 `factConceptKeep` = 全部 `FACT_CONCEPTS` 标签 ∪ 三个 dei 非数值名）、它们引用的 `xbrli:context`/`xbrli:unit` 原文切片；缺省丢弃维度上下文的事实。输出顺序 = 源顺序，每个事实一个 `<p>`。同一份源字节永远得到同一份裁剪字节；录制脚本把源文件 sha256 写进 `.meta.json`，以后重录比较 `source_sha256` 即知 SEC 是否改过文档。

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/ixbrl-trim.ts
// Deterministic trimming of a real inline XBRL primary document into a small committed fixture
// (IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION='ixbrl-trim/1'; plan 3 Task 13c). Kept, as verbatim source slices: the root
// element's open tag (every xmlns declaration), each OUTERMOST ix:nonFraction / ix:nonNumeric whose
// resolved concept name passes `keep` (default factConceptKeep: every FACT_CONCEPTS tag plus the three dei
// nonNumeric names), and the xbrli:context / xbrli:unit elements those facts reference. Facts in
// dimensional contexts are dropped unless dropDimensional:false. Output order is source order, one fact
// per <p>, so identical source bytes always give identical trimmed bytes. Uses the same tokenizer and
// namespace resolution as ixbrl.ts, so prefixes do not matter.
import {FACT_CONCEPTS} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {tagsOf} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {DEI_NON_NUMERIC,IxbrlParseError,NS,canonicalConcept,resolveQName,tokenizeXml} from './ixbrl';
import type {NsMap} from './ixbrl';

export const IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION='ixbrl-trim/1';
const KEEP=new Set<string>([...FACT_CONCEPTS.flatMap(c=>tagsOf(c)),...DEI_NON_NUMERIC]);
export const factConceptKeep=(name:string):boolean=>KEEP.has(name);
export interface TrimOptions{keep:(name:string)=>boolean;dropDimensional?:boolean}
export interface TrimResult{html:string;facts:number;contexts:number;units:number}

interface El{name:string;ns:NsMap;uri:string|null;local:string}
interface Span{start:number;end:number}
interface FactSpan extends Span{name:string;contextRef:string;unitRef:string|null}
const attrOf=(a:readonly [string,string][],k:string)=>a.find(([n])=>n===k)?.[1];
const isFact=(el:{uri:string|null;local:string})=>el.uri===NS.ix&&(el.local==='nonFraction'||el.local==='nonNumeric');

export function trimInlineXbrl(doc:string,opts:TrimOptions):TrimResult{
 const dropDimensional=opts.dropDimensional??true;
 const root:NsMap=new Map([['xml',NS.xml]]);const stack:El[]=[];
 let rootOpen:string|null=null,rootName='',headerName:string|null=null,resourcesName:string|null=null;
 const contexts=new Map<string,Span&{dimensional:boolean}>();const units=new Map<string,Span>();const facts:FactSpan[]=[];
 let ctx:{id:string;start:number;dimensional:boolean;segDepth:number}|null=null;
 let unit:{id:string;start:number}|null=null;
 let fact:{depth:number;start:number;name:string;contextRef:string;unitRef:string|null}|null=null;
 const close=(el:El,end:number)=>{
  if(ctx!==null&&el.uri===NS.xbrli&&el.local==='context'){contexts.set(ctx.id,{start:ctx.start,end,dimensional:ctx.dimensional});ctx=null;return;}
  if(ctx!==null&&el.uri===NS.xbrli&&(el.local==='segment'||el.local==='scenario')&&ctx.segDepth===stack.length){ctx.segDepth=-1;return;}
  if(unit!==null&&el.uri===NS.xbrli&&el.local==='unit'){units.set(unit.id,{start:unit.start,end});unit=null;return;}
  if(fact!==null&&stack.length===fact.depth&&isFact(el)){facts.push({...fact,end});fact=null;}
 };
 for(const tok of tokenizeXml(doc)){
  if(tok.t==='text')continue;
  if(tok.t==='close'){
   const el=stack.pop();
   if(!el||el.name!==tok.name)throw new IxbrlParseError('mismatched_close');
   close(el,tok.end);continue;
  }
  const parent=stack.length>0?stack[stack.length-1].ns:root;let ns:NsMap=parent;
  const decl=tok.attrs.filter(([k])=>k==='xmlns'||k.startsWith('xmlns:'));
  if(decl.length>0){const m=new Map(parent);for(const [k,v] of decl)m.set(k==='xmlns'?'':k.slice(6),v);ns=m;}
  const {uri,local}=resolveQName(tok.name,ns,true);
  const el:El={name:tok.name,ns,uri,local};
  if(rootOpen===null){rootOpen=doc.slice(tok.start,tok.end);rootName=tok.name;}
  if(ctx!==null&&ctx.segDepth>=0)ctx.dimensional=true;
  else if(uri===NS.ix&&local==='header'&&headerName===null)headerName=tok.name;
  else if(uri===NS.ix&&local==='resources'&&resourcesName===null)resourcesName=tok.name;
  else if(uri===NS.xbrli&&local==='context')ctx={id:attrOf(tok.attrs,'id')??'',start:tok.start,dimensional:false,segDepth:-1};
  else if(ctx!==null&&uri===NS.xbrli&&(local==='segment'||local==='scenario'))ctx.segDepth=stack.length;
  else if(uri===NS.xbrli&&local==='unit')unit={id:attrOf(tok.attrs,'id')??'',start:tok.start};
  else if(fact===null&&isFact(el)){
   const q=resolveQName((attrOf(tok.attrs,'name')??'').trim(),ns,true);
   fact={depth:stack.length,start:tok.start,name:canonicalConcept(q.uri,q.local),contextRef:attrOf(tok.attrs,'contextRef')??'',unitRef:local==='nonFraction'?(attrOf(tok.attrs,'unitRef')??''):null};
  }
  if(tok.self)close(el,tok.end);else stack.push(el);
 }
 if(stack.length>0)throw new IxbrlParseError('unclosed_elements');
 if(rootOpen===null||headerName===null||resourcesName===null)throw new IxbrlParseError('not_inline_xbrl');
 const kept=facts.filter(f=>{const c=contexts.get(f.contextRef);return opts.keep(f.name)&&c!==undefined&&!(dropDimensional&&c.dimensional);});
 const bySource=(a:Span,b:Span)=>a.start-b.start;
 const keptContexts=[...new Set(kept.map(f=>f.contextRef))].map(id=>contexts.get(id)!).sort(bySource);
 const keptUnits=[...new Set(kept.map(f=>f.unitRef).filter((u):u is string=>u!==null&&units.has(u)))].map(id=>units.get(id)!).sort(bySource);
 const slice=(s:Span)=>doc.slice(s.start,s.end);
 const html=['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>',`<!-- ${IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION}: ${kept.length} facts -->`,rootOpen,'<head><title>trimmed</title></head>','<body>',
  `<div style="display:none"><${headerName}><${resourcesName}>`,...keptContexts.map(slice),...keptUnits.map(slice),`</${resourcesName}></${headerName}></div>`,
  ...kept.map(f=>`<p>${slice(f)}</p>`),'</body>',`</${rootName}>`,''].join('\n');
 return {html,facts:kept.length,contexts:keptContexts.length,units:keptUnits.length};
}
```

```ts
// scripts/dq/record-ixbrl-fixture.ts
/**
 * Records a reproducible trimmed inline XBRL fixture from a real SEC primary document (plan 3 Task 13c).
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/dq/record-ixbrl-fixture.ts --cik 320193 --accn 0000320193-23-000106 --out src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/aapl-20230930.trimmed.htm
 *
 * 1. GET https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json and find the accession in filings.recent
 *    (primaryDocument, isInlineXBRL, form, filingDate, reportDate) plus the top-level category and
 *    fiscalYearEnd. An accession only reachable through filings.files[] pages is refused (exit 1).
 * 2. GET https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<accession without dashes>/<primaryDocument>.
 * 3. trimInlineXbrl(document, {keep: factConceptKeep, dropDimensional: true}); write <out> and
 *    <out>.meta.json {source_url, source_sha256, source_bytes, fetched_at, trim_version, parser_version,
 *    trimmed_sha256, facts, contexts, units, submissions:{url, sha256, accession, form, filingDate,
 *    reportDate, primaryDocument, isInlineXBRL, category, fiscalYearEnd}}.
 * User-Agent = EDGAR_USER_AGENT or DEFAULT_USER_AGENT; one request at a time, 250 ms apart. Nothing is
 * written unless both downloads and the trim succeed. Exit 1 on failure, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION,MAX_IXBRL_BYTES} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/ixbrl';
import {IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION,factConceptKeep,trimInlineXbrl} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/ixbrl-trim';

const USAGE='usage: record-ixbrl-fixture.ts --cik <digits> --accn <##########-##-######> --out <path.htm>';
const sha=(b:Uint8Array|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const pause=(ms:number)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));

async function get(url:string):Promise<Uint8Array>{
 const res=await fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT,Accept:'*/*'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60_000)});
 if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`http_${res.status} ${url}`);
 const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
 if(bytes.byteLength>MAX_IXBRL_BYTES)throw new Error(`too_large ${url}`);
 return bytes;
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let cik='',accn='',out='';
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i+=2){const k=argv[i],v=argv[i+1]??'';if(k==='--cik')cik=v;else if(k==='--accn')accn=v;else if(k==='--out')out=v;else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}}
 if(!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(cik)||!/^\d{10}-\d{2}-\d{6}$/.test(accn)||!out.endsWith('.htm')){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 const subUrl=`https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK${cik.padStart(10,'0')}.json`;
 const subBytes=await get(subUrl);
 const sub=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(subBytes)) as {category?:string;fiscalYearEnd?:string;filings?:{recent?:Record<string,unknown[]>}};
 const recent=sub.filings?.recent??{};
 const idx=(recent.accessionNumber??[]).indexOf(accn);
 if(idx<0)throw new Error(`accession ${accn} not in filings.recent (filings.files pages are not supported by this recorder)`);
 const at=(k:string)=>(recent[k]??[])[idx];
 const primaryDocument=String(at('primaryDocument')??'');
 if(!primaryDocument)throw new Error('no primaryDocument');
 await pause(250);
 const sourceUrl=`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/${cik}/${accn.replace(/-/g,'')}/${primaryDocument}`;
 const source=await get(sourceUrl);
 const trimmed=trimInlineXbrl(new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(source),{keep:factConceptKeep,dropDimensional:true});
 const meta={source_url:sourceUrl,source_sha256:sha(source),source_bytes:source.byteLength,fetched_at:new Date().toISOString(),trim_version:IXBRL_TRIM_VERSION,parser_version:IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION,
  trimmed_sha256:sha(trimmed.html),facts:trimmed.facts,contexts:trimmed.contexts,units:trimmed.units,
  submissions:{url:subUrl,sha256:sha(subBytes),accession:accn,form:at('form')??null,filingDate:at('filingDate')??null,reportDate:at('reportDate')??null,primaryDocument,isInlineXBRL:at('isInlineXBRL')===1||at('isInlineXBRL')===true,category:sub.category??null,fiscalYearEnd:sub.fiscalYearEnd??null}};
 writeFileSync(out,trimmed.html);
 writeFileSync(`${out}.meta.json`,`${JSON.stringify(meta,null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({out,source_sha256:meta.source_sha256,trimmed_sha256:meta.trimmed_sha256,facts:trimmed.facts}));
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e));process.exit(1);});
```

**Files:**

- Test: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/pairs.test.ts`

要点：
- `RECONCILE_PAIRS` 只登记周期对；三个周期外对（`sec.filing_date_vs_submissions`、`sec.filer_category`、`entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif`）经 `record.ts` 记录，不在此表。
- 绑定（T1、S2）：常规绑定只用 `activeRows`（`mapping_gen = filings.mapping_gen > 0`、运行 `published`、`ok|quarantined`）；**显式复查**——该结果自然键有 open `reconcile_mismatch` 项时，绑定到项的 `payload.fact_ids[0]`，不论代、不论状态，绝不换行。
- 动作规则 `actionFor`（契约问题 2）：经 open 项绑定 → `quarantine_left`；未绑定且 `compared && !passed && 左侧 ok` → 对的 `onFail`（`quarantine_left` 或 A 股舍入印刷的 `review_item`）；其余 `record`。
- `us.companyfacts_vs_gold`：只比较非 `<pending>` 条目（`recorded_by==='<pending>' || value==='<pending>'`，与落地黄金门同一判定）；每个 `<pending>` 条目恰一行 `incomplete_gold`，绝不比较占位值（T15）。落地的 `plan2.json` 现有两条 US 条目都是 pending（AAPL 的 `recorded_by` 仍为 `<pending>`），因此当前该对只产出 2 行 `incomplete_gold`，周期 `complete_with_gaps`、新鲜度 `ok:false`——这是如实状态，不是缺陷。
- `facts.lineage_same_day`：成员 = 每个有引用方的目标 T（`issuers.status='merged'` 的 `merged_into` 去重）× 两市场中 `readFactsLineage` 有 `conflicts` 的市场；预期键 = 建周期时的冲突（冻结）。评估时冲突仍在 → `compared`、`passed=false`、`lineage_item`（建 `lineage_conflict` 项，`natural_key=<T>:<K>:<available_date>`，`payload={fact_ids, values:[{issuer_id, filing, fact_id, value}], key, available_date, target}`）；冲突已消失 → 原 `fact_ids` 中仍 `ok` 的行值一致 → `compared passed=true record`（`reason='conflict_cleared'`），无 `ok` 行 → `left_missing`。

```ts
  expect(RECONCILE_PAIRS['us.companyfacts_vs_gold']?.inputs).toEqual({repoFile:US_GOLD_PATH,parserVersion:US_GOLD_PARSER,goldSchema:'plan2-gold/1'});
 });
 it('actionFor: bound → quarantine_left; failed ok row → onFail; everything else record',()=>{
  expect(actionFor({bound:true,leftStatus:'quarantined',compared:true,passed:true,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('quarantine_left');
  expect(actionFor({bound:true,leftStatus:'quarantined',compared:false,passed:false,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('quarantine_left');
  expect(actionFor({bound:false,leftStatus:'ok',compared:true,passed:false,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('quarantine_left');
  expect(actionFor({bound:false,leftStatus:'ok',compared:true,passed:false,onFail:'review_item'})).toBe('review_item');
  expect(actionFor({bound:false,leftStatus:'quarantined',compared:true,passed:false,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('record');
  expect(actionFor({bound:false,leftStatus:'ok',compared:true,passed:true,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('record');
  expect(actionFor({bound:false,leftStatus:null,compared:false,passed:false,onFail:'quarantine_left'})).toBe('record');
 });
 it('activeRows keeps the active generation of published runs, ok or quarantined (T1)',()=>{
  const filing={mapping_gen:2} as FilingRow;
  const r=(o:Partial<FilingFactRow>)=>({fact_id:randomUUID(),mapping_gen:2,run_status:'published',status:'ok',...o}) as FilingFactRow;
  const rows=[r({}),r({status:'quarantined'}),r({mapping_gen:1}),r({run_status:'staged'}),r({status:'staged'})];
  expect(activeRows(rows,filing)).toEqual(rows.slice(0,2));
  expect(activeRows(rows,{mapping_gen:0} as FilingRow)).toEqual([]);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-support.ts
// Pieces shared by the cycle pairs (spec §5.1–§5.6). RegisteredPair = C3 ReconcilePair plus its input
// recipe (repo file, parser version, gold schema) used for batch tool_versions and inputs_hash.
// PairRunContext = PairContext plus the batch id and dry-run flag the runner passes (record.ts side rows
// need the batch; dry runs must not write). ReconcileConfigError refuses a run (invalid gold/sample file,
// unresolvable issuer) — the runner finishes the batch failed with the code. activeRows is the T1/S2
// binding filter over read_filing_facts rows. openMismatches is the explicit re-check binding: an OPEN
// reconcile_mismatch item of this pair (natural_key '<pair>:<result natural_key>:<fact_id>') pins its key
// to payload.fact_ids[0] whatever the generation or status. Result builders keep the dq_reconciliations
// kind/side rules; actionFor is the one action rule every fact-backed pair uses (contract note 2).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {selectAll} from '../../db/table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {keyComponents} from '../../facts/keys';
import type {FactRow,FactStatus,FilingFactRow,FilingRow,Market} from '../../facts/types';
import {DATASETS} from '../datasets';
import {absDecimal,relDiff,subDecimal} from './decimal';
import type {CyclePairId,PairContext,ReconcileAction,ReconcileKind,ReconcileOutcome,ReconcilePair,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

export interface PairInputs{repoFile:string|null;parserVersion:string;goldSchema:string|null}
export interface RegisteredPair extends ReconcilePair{inputs:PairInputs}
export interface PairRunContext extends PairContext{batchId:string|null;dryRun:boolean}
/** The run context behind a PairContext; a context without the flags counts as a dry run (no side writes). */
export const runContextOf=(ctx:PairContext):PairRunContext=>{const c=ctx as Partial<PairRunContext>;return {...ctx,batchId:c.batchId??null,dryRun:c.dryRun??true};};

export type ReconcileConfigCode='invalid_gold_file'|'invalid_sample_file'|'issuer_unresolved'|'lineage_read_truncated';
export class ReconcileConfigError extends Error{constructor(public readonly code:ReconcileConfigCode,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='ReconcileConfigError';}}

export const sha256Hex=(b:Uint8Array|string):string=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
export const todayOf=(ctx:PairContext):string=>ctx.now().toISOString().slice(0,10);
/** Repo JSON with the sha256 of its exact bytes; unreadable or malformed → ReconcileConfigError(code). */
export async function readRepoJson(ctx:PairContext,path:string,code:'invalid_gold_file'|'invalid_sample_file'):Promise<{json:unknown;sha256:string}>{
 let bytes:Uint8Array;
 try{bytes=await ctx.readRepoFile(path);}catch(e){throw new ReconcileConfigError(code,`read ${path}: ${e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}`);}
 try{return {json:JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(bytes)),sha256:sha256Hex(bytes)};}
 catch{throw new ReconcileConfigError(code,`json ${path}`);}
}

/** T1 binding filter: rows of the filing's ACTIVE generation (> 0) from published runs, ok or quarantined. */
export function activeRows(rows:readonly FilingFactRow[],filing:FilingRow):FilingFactRow[]{
 if(!(filing.mapping_gen>0))return [];
 return rows.filter(r=>r.mapping_gen===filing.mapping_gen&&r.run_status==='published'&&(r.status==='ok'||r.status==='quarantined'));
}
export const factKeyOf=(r:{concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;unit:string})=>`${r.concept}|${r.period_start??''}|${r.period_end}|${r.unit}`;
export const fractionDigits=(v:string):number=>{const i=v.indexOf('.');return i<0?0:v.length-i-1;};
export const mismatchItemKey=(pair:CyclePairId,naturalKey:string,factId:string)=>`${pair}:${naturalKey}:${factId}`;

export interface OpenMismatch{itemId:string;factIds:string[]}
export async function openMismatches(tables:TableClient,pair:CyclePairId,market:Market):Promise<Map<string,OpenMismatch>>{
 const rows=await selectAll(tables,'dq_quarantine',{dataset:DATASETS.facts(market),reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',status:'open'},'id');
 const out=new Map<string,OpenMismatch>();const prefix=`${pair}:`;
 for(const r of rows){
  if(((r.detail??{}) as {pair?:unknown}).pair!==pair)continue;
  const raw=((r.payload??{}) as {fact_ids?:unknown}).fact_ids;
  const factIds=Array.isArray(raw)?raw.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'):[];
  const nk=String(r.natural_key);
  if(factIds.length===0||!nk.startsWith(prefix)||!nk.endsWith(`:${factIds[0]}`))continue;
  out.set(nk.slice(prefix.length,nk.length-factIds[0].length-1),{itemId:String(r.id),factIds});
 }
 return out;
}

export interface Sides{left_source:string;right_source:string}
export interface ResultExtras{left_fact_id?:string;inputs_hash?:string;action?:ReconcileAction;item?:ReconcileResultInput['item']}
const extras=(x:ResultExtras)=>({...(x.left_fact_id!==undefined?{left_fact_id:x.left_fact_id}:{}),...(x.inputs_hash!==undefined?{inputs_hash:x.inputs_hash}:{}),...(x.item!==undefined?{item:x.item}:{})});
/** A non-compared result: every value column null, passed false, detail.reason defaults to the outcome. */
export function notCompared(natural_key:string,kind:ReconcileKind,outcome:Exclude<ReconcileOutcome,'compared'>,sides:Sides,detail:Record<string,unknown>,x:ResultExtras={}):ReconcileResultInput{
 return {natural_key,kind,outcome,passed:false,left_value:null,right_value:null,abs_diff:null,rel_diff:null,tolerance:'0',...sides,detail:{reason:outcome,...detail},action:x.action??'record',...extras(x)};
}
/** A compared numeric result with exact abs_diff and rel_diff. */
export function comparedNumeric(natural_key:string,left:string,right:string,o:{passed:boolean;tolerance:string;sides:Sides;detail:Record<string,unknown>}&ResultExtras):ReconcileResultInput{
 return {natural_key,kind:'numeric',outcome:'compared',passed:o.passed,left_value:left,right_value:right,abs_diff:absDecimal(subDecimal(left,right)),rel_diff:relDiff(left,right),tolerance:o.tolerance,...o.sides,detail:o.detail,action:o.action??'record',...extras(o)};
}
/** Contract note 2: bound through an open item → back to it; failed compare of an ok row → onFail; else record. */
export function actionFor(o:{bound:boolean;leftStatus:FactStatus|null;compared:boolean;passed:boolean;onFail:'quarantine_left'|'review_item'}):ReconcileAction{
 if(o.bound)return 'quarantine_left';
 if(o.compared&&!o.passed&&o.leftStatus==='ok')return o.onFail;
 return 'record';
}
/** The work item of a fact-backed mismatch (spec §5.6 payload); apply_reconcile_result adds reconciliation_id, latest_result and hook. */
export function mismatchItem(pair:CyclePairId,naturalKey:string,left:FactRow,rightValue:string|null,rightLocator:Record<string,unknown>,inputsHash:string):NonNullable<ReconcileResultInput['item']>{
 return {natural_key:mismatchItemKey(pair,naturalKey,left.fact_id),
  payload:{key:keyComponents(left.issuer_id,left.market,left),fact_ids:[left.fact_id],left_value:left.value,right_value:rightValue,right_locator:rightLocator},
  detail:{pair,inputs_hash:inputsHash,issuer_id:left.issuer_id,market:left.market}};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-us-gold.ts
// us.companyfacts_vs_gold (spec §5.1, T15). Left = the published US facts, right = the US entries of plan
// 2's gold file src/lib/facts/fixtures/gold/plan2.json. An entry whose recorded_by or value is '<pending>'
// (the landed gate's isPending rule) is NEVER compared: each gets exactly one incomplete_gold result, so
// the cycle shows gaps and the gold is never reported complete while ready:false. natural_key =
// <ticker>:<concept>:<period_end>:<duration>:<unit>; duration defaults like the plan-2 gate (instant
// concept → INSTANT, else 12M). Binding: an open reconcile_mismatch item of the key pins its fact;
// otherwise the CURRENT ok row as of the entry's as_of (the row the gold asserts). Tolerance 0 (exact
// decimal). inputs_hash: left raw_hash, right = gold file sha256 (also the gold_or_sample part), parser
// 'gold-us/1'. The member issuer is the ticker's resolved issuer (resolveIssuer follows a merge).
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../entities/resolve';
import {conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import type {FactRow} from '../../facts/types';
import {DATASETS} from '../datasets';
import {compareDecimal} from './decimal';
import {computeInputsHash} from './inputs-hash';
import {ReconcileConfigError,actionFor,comparedNumeric,fractionDigits,mismatchItem,notCompared,openMismatches,readRepoJson,todayOf} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import type {MemberPlan,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

export const US_GOLD_PATH='src/lib/facts/fixtures/gold/plan2.json';
export const US_GOLD_PARSER='gold-us/1';
const PAIR='us.companyfacts_vs_gold' as const;
const SIDES={left_source:DATASETS.facts('US'),right_source:'gold.plan2'};
const DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'?v:null;

export interface UsGoldEntry{index:number;ticker:string;concept:string;period_end:string;unit:string;duration:string;value:string|null;as_of:string|null;pending:boolean;source:Record<string,unknown>}
export const usGoldKey=(e:Pick<UsGoldEntry,'ticker'|'concept'|'period_end'|'duration'|'unit'>)=>`${e.ticker}:${e.concept}:${e.period_end}:${e.duration}:${e.unit}`;

/** The US entries of the gold file in file order; throws invalid_gold_file on shape errors or duplicate keys. */
export function usGoldEntries(json:unknown):{ready:boolean;entries:UsGoldEntry[]}{
 const bad=(m:string):never=>{throw new ReconcileConfigError('invalid_gold_file',m);};
 if(!json||typeof json!=='object'||!Array.isArray((json as {entries?:unknown}).entries))bad('entries');
 const j=json as {ready?:unknown;entries:unknown[]};
 const out:UsGoldEntry[]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();
 j.entries.forEach((raw,index)=>{
  const e=(raw??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;const iss=(e.issuer??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
  if(iss.market!=='US')return;
  const ticker=str(iss.ticker),concept=str(e.concept),periodEnd=str(e.period_end),unit=str(e.unit),value=str(e.value),recordedBy=str(e.recorded_by);
  if(ticker===null||concept===null||periodEnd===null||!DATE.test(periodEnd)||unit===null||value===null||recordedBy===null)return bad(`entry ${index}: shape`);
  const def=conceptById(concept);if(!def)return bad(`entry ${index}: unknown concept ${concept}`);
  const pending=recordedBy==='<pending>'||value==='<pending>';
  let canonical:string|null=null;
  if(!pending){try{canonical=canonicalDecimal(value);}catch{return bad(`entry ${index}: value`);}}
  const asOf=e.as_of===null||e.as_of===undefined?null:str(e.as_of);
  if(asOf!==null&&!DATE.test(asOf))return bad(`entry ${index}: as_of`);
  if(e.as_of!==null&&e.as_of!==undefined&&asOf===null)return bad(`entry ${index}: as_of`);
  const entry:UsGoldEntry={index,ticker,concept,period_end:periodEnd,unit,duration:str(e.duration)??(def.nature==='instant'?'INSTANT':'12M'),value:canonical,as_of:asOf,pending,source:(e.source??{}) as Record<string,unknown>};
  const k=usGoldKey(entry);if(seen.has(k))return bad(`duplicate ${k}`);
  seen.add(k);out.push(entry);
 });
 return {ready:j.ready===true,entries:out};
}

export function usCompanyfactsVsGoldPair():RegisteredPair{
 return {
  id:PAIR,kind:'numeric',left:DATASETS.facts('US'),right:'gold.plan2',
  inputs:{repoFile:US_GOLD_PATH,parserVersion:US_GOLD_PARSER,goldSchema:'plan2-gold/1'},
  async members(ctx){
   const {json}=await readRepoJson(ctx,US_GOLD_PATH,'invalid_gold_file');
   const byTicker=new Map<string,UsGoldEntry[]>();
   for(const e of usGoldEntries(json).entries)byTicker.set(e.ticker,[...(byTicker.get(e.ticker)??[]),e]);
   const out:MemberPlan[]=[];
   for(const [ticker,list] of [...byTicker.entries()].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0)){
    const r=await resolveIssuer(ctx.tables,{ticker},{today:todayOf(ctx)});
    if(!r)throw new ReconcileConfigError('issuer_unresolved',ticker);
    out.push({issuerId:r.issuer_id,market:'US',expectedKeys:list.map(e=>({naturalKey:usGoldKey(e),locator:{index:e.index,ticker:e.ticker,concept:e.concept,period_end:e.period_end,unit:e.unit,duration:e.duration,as_of:e.as_of,pending:e.pending}}))});
   }
   return out;
  },
  async evaluate(ctx,member){
   const {json,sha256:goldSha}=await readRepoJson(ctx,US_GOLD_PATH,'invalid_gold_file');
   const current=new Map(usGoldEntries(json).entries.map(e=>[usGoldKey(e),e]));
   const open=await openMismatches(ctx.tables,PAIR,'US');
   const out:ReconcileResultInput[]=[];
   for(const k of member.expectedKeys){
    const e=current.get(k.naturalKey);
    if(!e){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','incomplete_gold',SIDES,{reason:'entry_removed'}));continue;}
    if(e.pending||e.value===null){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','incomplete_gold',SIDES,{reason:'pending',gold_index:e.index}));continue;}
    const bound=open.get(k.naturalKey);
    let rows:FactRow[];
    if(bound)rows=(await ctx.db.factsByIds([bound.factIds[0]])).slice(0,1);
    else rows=(await ctx.db.readFacts(member.issuerId,'US',{concepts:[e.concept],asOf:e.as_of??todayOf(ctx),from:e.period_end,to:e.period_end})).rows
     .filter(r=>r.period_end===e.period_end&&r.unit===e.unit&&r.duration===e.duration&&r.is_current===true);
    if(rows.length>1){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_ambiguous',SIDES,{gold_index:e.index,fact_ids:rows.map(r=>r.fact_id)}));continue;}
    const left=rows[0];
    if(!left){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_missing',SIDES,{gold_index:e.index,as_of:e.as_of}));continue;}
    const passed=compareDecimal(left.value,e.value)===0;
    const inputs_hash=computeInputsHash({left_raw_hash:left.raw_hash,right_sha256:goldSha,gold_or_sample_sha256:goldSha,parser_version:US_GOLD_PARSER});
    const action=actionFor({bound:bound!==undefined,leftStatus:left.status,compared:true,passed,onFail:'quarantine_left'});
    const locator={document:US_GOLD_PATH,index:e.index,source:e.source};
    out.push(comparedNumeric(k.naturalKey,left.value,e.value,{passed,tolerance:'0',sides:SIDES,inputs_hash,left_fact_id:left.fact_id,action,
     detail:{left:{fact_id:left.fact_id,raw_hash:left.raw_hash,precision:{decimals:fractionDigits(left.value_text)}},right:{document:US_GOLD_PATH,sha256:goldSha,locator,precision:{exact:true}},unit:e.unit,tolerance_rule:'exact/1',inputs_hash,as_of:e.as_of},
     ...(action==='record'?{}:{item:mismatchItem(PAIR,k.naturalKey,left,e.value,locator,inputs_hash)})}));
   }
   return out;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-lineage.ts
// facts.lineage_same_day (spec §4.4, §5.1). Members: every target T that has referrers
// (issuers.status='merged' rows' merged_into, deduplicated) × each market where readFactsLineage over
// lineageOf(T) reports conflicts; expected keys = those conflicts at cycle creation, keyed
// <T>:<K>:<available_date> (K = facts/keys factKey). opts.targets restricts the enumeration (tests and
// targeted script runs); the registry instance has none. Evaluation re-reads the lineage: a conflict
// still present → compared, passed=false, action lineage_item (one lineage_conflict item per key, payload
// {fact_ids, values, key, available_date, target}; never auto-chosen); a conflict that is gone → the
// frozen fact_ids still ok are compared (equal values → passed, reason conflict_cleared), none ok →
// left_missing. A truncated lineage read is an execution failure (member retried), never a result.
import {selectAll} from '../../db/table-client';
import {CONCEPT_IDS} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {factKey} from '../../facts/keys';
import type {FactRow,LineageConflict,Market} from '../../facts/types';
import {compareDecimal} from './decimal';
import {ReconcileConfigError,comparedNumeric,notCompared,todayOf} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import type {ExpectedKey,MemberPlan,PairContext,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

const MARKETS:readonly Market[]=['US','CN'];
const s=(v:unknown)=>v===null||v===undefined?null:String(v);
export const lineageNaturalKey=(target:string,c:Pick<LineageConflict,'key'|'available_date'>):string=>
 `${target}:${factKey({concept:String(c.key.concept),period_start:s(c.key.period_start),period_end:String(c.key.period_end),consolidation:String(c.key.consolidation),unit:String(c.key.unit)})}:${c.available_date}`;
const byIssuerThenId=(a:FactRow,b:FactRow)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:a.fact_id<b.fact_id?-1:a.fact_id>b.fact_id?1:0;

async function conflictsOf(ctx:PairContext,target:string,market:Market):Promise<LineageConflict[]>{
 const env=await ctx.db.readFactsLineage(await ctx.db.lineageOf(target),market,{concepts:[...CONCEPT_IDS],asOf:todayOf(ctx)});
 if(env.truncated)throw new ReconcileConfigError('lineage_read_truncated',`${target}/${market}`);
 return env.conflicts;
}

export function lineageSameDayPair(opts:{targets?:readonly string[]}={}):RegisteredPair{
 return {
  id:'facts.lineage_same_day',kind:'numeric',left:'facts.lineage',right:'facts.lineage',
  inputs:{repoFile:null,parserVersion:'lineage/1',goldSchema:null},
  async members(ctx){
   const merged=await selectAll(ctx.tables,'issuers',{status:'merged'},'issuer_id');
   const targets=[...new Set(merged.map(r=>r.merged_into).filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'))]
    .filter(t=>opts.targets===undefined||opts.targets.includes(t)).sort();
   const out:MemberPlan[]=[];
   for(const target of targets)for(const market of MARKETS){
    const conflicts=await conflictsOf(ctx,target,market);
    if(conflicts.length===0)continue;
    const keys=new Map<string,ExpectedKey>();
    for(const c of conflicts){const nk=lineageNaturalKey(target,c);if(!keys.has(nk))keys.set(nk,{naturalKey:nk,locator:{key:c.key,available_date:c.available_date,fact_ids:c.fact_ids}});}
    out.push({issuerId:target,market,expectedKeys:[...keys.values()]});
   }
   return out;
  },
  async evaluate(ctx,member){
   let live:Map<string,LineageConflict>;
   try{live=new Map((await conflictsOf(ctx,member.issuerId,member.market)).map(c=>[lineageNaturalKey(member.issuerId,c),c]));}
   catch(e){if(e instanceof ReconcileConfigError)throw new Error(`lineage_read_truncated:${member.issuerId}`);throw e;}
   const out:ReconcileResultInput[]=[];
   for(const k of member.expectedKeys){
    const c=live.get(k.naturalKey);
    const ids=c?c.fact_ids:(Array.isArray(k.locator.fact_ids)?k.locator.fact_ids.map(String):[]);
    const rows=(await ctx.db.factsByIds(ids)).sort(byIssuerThenId);
    const sides=(l:FactRow,r:FactRow)=>({left_source:`facts.lineage:${l.issuer_id}`,right_source:`facts.lineage:${r.issuer_id}`});
    const values=rows.map(r=>({issuer_id:r.issuer_id,filing:r.filing_id,fact_id:r.fact_id,value:r.value,status:r.status}));
    if(c){
     const left=rows[0];const right=left?(rows.find(r=>compareDecimal(r.value,left.value)!==0)??rows[1]):undefined;
     if(!left||!right){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_missing',{left_source:'facts.lineage',right_source:'facts.lineage'},{target:member.issuerId,reason:'conflict_rows_missing',fact_ids:ids}));continue;}
     out.push(comparedNumeric(k.naturalKey,left.value,right.value,{passed:false,tolerance:'0',sides:sides(left,right),action:'lineage_item',
      detail:{target:member.issuerId,available_date:c.available_date,key:c.key,values,tolerance_rule:'exact/1'},
      item:{natural_key:k.naturalKey,payload:{fact_ids:c.fact_ids,values:values.map(({issuer_id,filing,fact_id,value})=>({issuer_id,filing,fact_id,value})),key:c.key,available_date:c.available_date,target:member.issuerId},detail:{target:member.issuerId,market:member.market}}}));
     continue;
    }
    const ok=rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok');
    if(ok.length===0){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_missing',{left_source:'facts.lineage',right_source:'facts.lineage'},{target:member.issuerId,reason:'no_ok_value',values}));continue;}
    const first=ok[0],other=ok.find(r=>compareDecimal(r.value,first.value)!==0);
    out.push(comparedNumeric(k.naturalKey,first.value,(other??ok[ok.length-1]).value,{passed:other===undefined,tolerance:'0',sides:sides(first,other??ok[ok.length-1]),action:'record',
     detail:{target:member.issuerId,reason:other===undefined?'conflict_cleared':'conflict_not_reported',values,tolerance_rule:'exact/1'}}));
   }
   return out;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pairs.ts
// Registry of the cycle pairs run by run.ts (spec §5.1; contract C3). Task 14 registers
// facts.lineage_same_day and us.companyfacts_vs_gold; Task 15 adds us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl; Task 16 adds
// cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold. The three non-cycle pairs (sec.filing_date_vs_submissions,
// sec.filer_category, entities.isin_hkex_vs_gleif) are recorded inline through record.ts and are
// deliberately absent. inputsHashNow recomputes a reconcile_mismatch item's inputs_hash from CURRENT
// inputs for restore_reconciled (spec §5.6): left raw_hash from the item's fact, right sha256 from the
// result row named by latest_result (the right document the last run actually read), the CURRENT gold or
// sample file bytes, the CURRENT parser version. Any change since the last passing run → a different hash.
import type {Row} from '../../db/table-client';
import {computeInputsHash} from './inputs-hash';
import {lineageSameDayPair} from './pair-lineage';
import {sha256Hex} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import {usCompanyfactsVsGoldPair} from './pair-us-gold';
import type {CyclePairId,PairContext} from './types';

export const RECONCILE_PAIRS:Partial<Record<CyclePairId,RegisteredPair>>={
 'facts.lineage_same_day':lineageSameDayPair(),
 'us.companyfacts_vs_gold':usCompanyfactsVsGoldPair(),
};

export async function inputsHashNow(ctx:PairContext,item:Row):Promise<string>{
 const detail=(item.detail??{}) as {pair?:unknown;latest_result?:{reconciliation_id?:unknown}};
 const pair=typeof detail.pair==='string'?RECONCILE_PAIRS[detail.pair as CyclePairId]:undefined;
 if(!pair)throw new Error('pair_not_registered');
 const factIds=((item.payload??{}) as {fact_ids?:unknown}).fact_ids;
 const factId=Array.isArray(factIds)&&typeof factIds[0]==='string'?factIds[0]:null;
 const [fact]=factId===null?[]:await ctx.db.factsByIds([factId]);
 if(!fact)throw new Error('left_fact_missing');
 const recId=detail.latest_result?.reconciliation_id;
 if(typeof recId!=='string')throw new Error('no_latest_result');
 const [rec]=await ctx.tables.select('dq_reconciliations',{id:recId},{limit:1});
 const right=((rec?.detail??{}) as {right?:{sha256?:unknown}}).right?.sha256;
 if(typeof right!=='string')throw new Error('no_latest_result');
 const file=pair.inputs.repoFile===null?'':sha256Hex(await ctx.readRepoFile(pair.inputs.repoFile));
 return computeInputsHash({left_raw_hash:fact.raw_hash,right_sha256:right,gold_or_sample_sha256:file,parser_version:pair.inputs.parserVersion});
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/testing.ts
// TEST-ONLY helpers for the reconcile unit tests (nothing in src/app imports this file). reconcileTables
// declares the primary keys the in-memory TableClient enforces for the tables the runner and memoryFactsDb
// share; seedPublished drives the real FactsDb API (scope → lease → run → filing → facts → publish →
// release) so seeded rows are exactly what a sync would have published (generation 1, status ok).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../../db/memory-table-client';
import type {Duration,FactInsert,FormType,Market,Source,Statement} from '../../facts/types';
import type {MemoryFactsDb} from '../../facts/memory-facts-db';

export const reconcileTables=()=>memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],dq_reconciliations:['id'],dq_reconcile_cycles:['pair','cycle_id'],dq_reconcile_cursor:['pair','cycle_id','issuer_id','market'],ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_freshness:['dataset'],issuers:['issuer_id']});

export interface SeedFact{concept:string;value:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;unit?:string;source_concept?:string;statement?:Statement;duration?:Duration}
export async function seedPublished(db:MemoryFactsDb,o:{issuer:string;market:Market;sourceRef:string;availableDate:string;facts:SeedFact[];formType?:FormType;source?:Source;mappingGen?:number}):Promise<{filingId:string;runId:string;factIds:string[]}>{
 const batch=randomUUID();
 if((await db.scopeRows(o.market,[o.issuer])).length===0)await db.reconcileScope(o.market,[{issuer_id:o.issuer,reasons:['test'],priority:1,fetch_key:o.market==='US'?'0000000001':'600000.SH'}]);
 if(!(await db.claimLease(o.issuer,o.market,batch,600)))throw new Error('seed_lease_not_acquired');
 const run=await db.beginRun(o.issuer,o.market,batch,o.mappingGen??1);
 const map=await db.stageFilings(run,[{filing_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:o.issuer,sourceRef:o.sourceRef,market:o.market,source:o.source??(o.market==='US'?'edgar':'tushare'),origin:o.market==='US'?'sec':'sse',formType:o.formType??(o.market==='US'?'10-K':'annual'),fiscalYear:null,fiscalPeriod:null,periodEnd:null,availableDate:o.availableDate,url:null}]);
 const filingId=map.get(o.sourceRef)!;
 const rows:FactInsert[]=o.facts.map(f=>({fact_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:o.issuer,market:o.market,filing_id:filingId,concept:f.concept,source_concept:f.source_concept??`us-gaap:${f.concept}`,statement:f.statement??(f.period_start===null?'BS':'IS'),period_start:f.period_start,period_end:f.period_end,duration:f.duration??(f.period_start===null?'INSTANT':'12M'),value:f.value,unit:f.unit??(o.market==='US'?'USD':'CNY'),consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:o.availableDate,mapping_gen:o.mappingGen??1,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',raw_hash:`raw:${o.sourceRef}:${f.concept}:${f.period_end}`}));
 await db.stageFacts(run,rows);
 await db.publishRun(run,[filingId]);
 await db.releaseLease(o.issuer,o.market,batch,'success',new Date(Date.now()+86_400_000).toISOString());
 return {filingId,runId:run,factIds:rows.map(r=>r.fact_id)};
}
```

### Task 14b: 对账运行器 `runReconcile`（§5.5、§5.6、§3.1 周期/游标、§8）

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/run.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/run.test.ts`

运行器一次调用 = 一个 pair 的一个批次：
0. **挂起钩子扫描**：本 pair 的 open `reconcile_mismatch` 项中 `detail.hook.state ∈ {pending, failed}` 者先物化（`T(i)=issuers.merged_into ?? i`，`detail.issuer_id/market` 取发行人），钩子置 `done`/`failed`（U2：`apply_reconcile_result` 提交后、物化前崩溃的补做）。
1. **周期**：有 `running` 周期就用；否则 `pair.members(ctx)` ∪ 旧周期行 `detail.pending_members`（契约问题 3）冻结为新周期（`cycle_id=<pair>-<started_at 日期>-<uuid 前 8 位>`，`members=[{issuer_id, market, expected_keys}]`，`expected_total=Σ`）；插入撞部分唯一索引（23505）→ 读回赢家。每次运行都为冻结成员补建缺失的游标行（建周期者中途崩溃可自愈）。
2. **认领**：按 `(issuer_id, market)` 顺序，游标可认领（`pending` | `claimed` 且租约过期 | `failed` 且 `attempts<3`）且剩余预算 ≥ 60 s 才调用 `claimReconcileMember`；返回 null → `skipped_summary(<issuer>:<market>:claimed)`。
3. **逐键提交**：每个预期键一次 `applyReconcileResult(fence, result)`；`reused` 计 `duplicates`；`fence_failed` → 本工作者立即停止（已提交键有效）；可见性变化在成员末尾按目标去重物化一次，并把各项钩子置 `done`/`failed`；`completeReconcileMember` 推导计数；其余异常 → `failReconcileMember(fence, code)`。`evaluate` 结果数或自然键顺序与预期键不一致 → `evaluate_contract` 异常。
4. **结算**：全部游标 `done` 或 `failed` 且 `attempts≥3` 时，逐个 `done` 游标断言三计数非空、非负且和 = `expected`（`drc_done_accounted`，**不 coalesce**，不满足 → 不结算、记 `cursor_unaccounted`）；`status = not_compared=0 且无失败成员 ? complete : complete_with_gaps`；带 `status='running'` 守卫更新周期行，**只有本工作者结算成功时**记新鲜度 `recordAttempt(DATASETS.reconcile(pair), {ok: status==='complete', cadence:'weekly', detail:{cycle_id, 四计数}})`。
5. **批次计数**（§5.5）：`fetched`=本次提交的键数；`inserted`=passed；`duplicates`=复用；`quarantined`=不一致且进了项（`action≠'record'`）；`failed`=全部非 `compared` + 不一致但只记录 + 成员执行失败；`errors`：`outcome_summary`（按 outcome 计数的 JSON）、`fence_failed`、`materialize_error`、`member_failed`、`cursor_unaccounted`、`deadline_hit`（信息）、`skipped_summary`（信息）。配置错误（黄金/样本文件无效、发行人不可解析）→ 批次 `failed`、错误码即 `ReconcileConfigError.code`，不建周期。
6. **dry run**：不建批次/周期，只 `members` + `evaluate`（`ctx.dryRun=true`），返回结果。

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/run.test.ts
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {TableError} from '../../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '../../facts/memory-facts-db';
import {FactsDbError} from '../../facts/types';
import type {FactsDb} from '../../facts/types';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../raw-store';
import {ReconcileConfigError} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import {CURSOR_TABLE,CYCLE_TABLE,MIN_MEMBER_MS,runReconcile} from './run';
import type {ReconcileDeps} from './run';
import {reconcileTables,seedPublished} from './testing';
import type {CyclePairId,MemberPlan,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

const PAIR:CyclePairId='us.companyfacts_vs_gold';
const T0='2026-11-05T02:00:00.000Z';
const rec=(nk:string,over:Partial<ReconcileResultInput>={}):ReconcileResultInput=>({natural_key:nk,kind:'numeric',outcome:'compared',passed:true,left_value:'1',right_value:'1',abs_diff:'0',rel_diff:'0',tolerance:'0',left_source:'l',right_source:'r',detail:{},action:'record',...over});
const miss=(nk:string)=>rec(nk,{outcome:'right_missing',passed:false,right_value:null,left_value:null,abs_diff:null,rel_diff:null});
const keys=(...nks:string[])=>nks.map(naturalKey=>({naturalKey,locator:{}}));
function stubPair(members:MemberPlan[],evaluate:(m:MemberPlan)=>Promise<ReconcileResultInput[]>|ReconcileResultInput[]):RegisteredPair{
 return {id:PAIR,kind:'numeric',left:'l',right:'r',inputs:{repoFile:null,parserVersion:'stub/1',goldSchema:null},members:async()=>members,evaluate:async(_ctx,m)=>evaluate(m)};
}
function harness(pair:RegisteredPair,over:Partial<ReconcileDeps>={}){
 const tables=reconcileTables();const db=memoryFactsDb(tables);let clock=T0;db.setNow(clock);
 const materialize=vi.fn<(db:FactsDb,issuer:string,market:string)=>Promise<unknown>>(async()=>({rows:0,stateRev:0,retried:false}));
 const deps:ReconcileDeps={db,tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),fetch:(async()=>{throw new Error('no network');}) as unknown as typeof fetch,
  readRepoFile:async()=>{throw new Error('no repo files');},now:()=>new Date(clock),deadline:null,codeVersion:'test',pairs:{[PAIR]:pair},materialize,...over};
 const advance=(ms:number)=>{clock=new Date(Date.parse(clock)+ms).toISOString();db.setNow(clock);};
 return {tables,db,deps,materialize,advance};
}
const A='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a',B='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b';

const cursors=(t:TableClient)=>t.select(CURSOR_TABLE,{pair:PAIR},{orderBy:'issuer_id'});

 it('fence_failed stops the worker; after the lease expires the next worker reuses the committed key',async()=>{

  const r1=await runReconcile({...h.deps,db:flaky},{pair:PAIR,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  expect(r1.members).toEqual([{issuerId:A,market:'US',outcome:'fence_lost'}]);

 });

  const h=harness(stubPair([{issuerId:A,market:'US',expectedKeys:keys('k1')}],()=>{throw new Error('sec_unavailable:http_503');}));
```
