```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/run.ts
// Reconciliation cycle runner (spec §5.5; §3.1 cycles/cursor; §3.2 apply_reconcile_result and the cursor
// functions; §5.6; §8). One call = one batch for one pair:
//  0. pending hooks: open reconcile_mismatch items of this pair whose detail.hook is pending/failed are
//     materialized first, at T(i) = issuers.merged_into ?? i (crash between apply and materialize, U2);
//  1. cycle: the pair's running cycle, else a new one frozen from pair.members(ctx) ∪ pending_members of
//     earlier cycle rows; a concurrent creator makes our insert fail with 23505 on the partial unique index
//     (pair) where status='running' → the winner is read back. Cursor rows are ensured for every frozen
//     member on every run, so a creator that died half-way is healed;
//  2. members in (issuer_id, market) order whose cursor is claimable; a member starts only with >= 60 s of
//     budget; every claim goes through claim_reconcile_member (fence);
//  3. one apply_reconcile_result per expected key (result row + item + visibility, atomic); a reused key is
//     a duplicate; fence_failed stops this worker at once (committed keys stay valid, the next claimer
//     reuses them); visibility changes are materialized once per target at the end of the member and the
//     item hooks set done/failed; complete_reconcile_member derives the counts; any other exception →
//     fail_reconcile_member (the third failure is terminal);
//  4. settlement when every cursor is done or terminally failed: each done cursor must satisfy
//     drc_done_accounted (never coalesced); complete iff not_compared = 0 and no failed member; freshness
//     reconcile.<pair> (weekly) is recorded ONLY by the worker whose guarded update settled the cycle.
// Batch counts (§5.5): fetched = keys applied; inserted = passed; duplicates = reused; quarantined =
// mismatches that went to (or back to) an item; failed = non-compared results + mismatches recorded without
// an item + member failures. A ReconcileConfigError (bad gold/sample file, unresolvable issuer) fails the
// batch with its code and creates no cycle. Dry run: members + evaluate only, no writes by the runner.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {TableError,selectAll} from '../../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {materialize as materializeFacts} from '../../facts/derive';
import {makeBudget} from '../../facts/sync';
import {FactsDbError} from '../../facts/types';
import type {FactsDb,Market} from '../../facts/types';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../batches';
import {DATASETS} from '../datasets';
import {recordAttempt} from '../freshness';
import type {RawStore} from '../raw-store';
import {ReconcileConfigError,sha256Hex} from './pair-support';
import type {PairRunContext,RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import {RECONCILE_PAIRS} from './pairs';
import {MAX_CURSOR_ATTEMPTS} from './types';
import type {ApplyReconcileOutcome,CyclePairId,CycleStatus,ExpectedKey,Fence,MemberCounts,MemberPlan,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

export const MIN_MEMBER_MS=60_000;
export const CYCLE_TABLE='dq_reconcile_cycles',CURSOR_TABLE='dq_reconcile_cursor';
const MARKETS:readonly Market[]=['US','CN'];

export interface ReconcileDeps{
 db:FactsDb;tables:TableClient;raw:RawStore;fetch:typeof fetch;readRepoFile:(path:string)=>Promise<Uint8Array>;
 now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string;
 pairs?:Partial<Record<CyclePairId,RegisteredPair>>;
 materialize?:(db:FactsDb,issuer:string,market:Market)=>Promise<unknown>;
}
export interface ReconcileOptions{pair:CyclePairId;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;issuerIds?:string[];dryRun?:boolean}
export type MemberOutcome='done'|'failed'|'claimed_elsewhere'|'fence_lost'|'not_started';
export interface MemberReport{issuerId:string;market:Market;outcome:MemberOutcome;counts?:MemberCounts;code?:string}
export interface CycleReport{cycleId:string;status:CycleStatus;created:boolean;settled:boolean;expectedTotal:number}
export interface ReconcileReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];cycle:CycleReport|null;members:MemberReport[];hooks:{retried:number;failed:number};dryRun?:{issuerId:string;market:Market;results:ReconcileResultInput[]}[]}
export class ReconcileError extends Error{constructor(public readonly code:string,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='ReconcileError';}}

interface FrozenMember{issuer_id:string;market:Market;expected_keys:ExpectedKey[]}
interface Hook{stage:'materialize'|'done';state:'done'|'failed';at:string;message?:string}
const mkey=(issuer:string,market:string)=>`${issuer}:${market}`;
const isFence=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof FactsDbError&&e.code==='fence_failed';
const codeOf=(e:unknown):string=>e instanceof FactsDbError||e instanceof ReconcileError||e instanceof ReconcileConfigError?e.code:`exception:${(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,200)}`;

function frozenOf(row:Row):FrozenMember[]{
 if(!Array.isArray(row.members))throw new ReconcileError('cycle_members_invalid');
 return row.members.map(m=>{
  const x=m as Partial<FrozenMember>;
  if(typeof x.issuer_id!=='string'||(x.market!=='US'&&x.market!=='CN')||!Array.isArray(x.expected_keys))throw new ReconcileError('cycle_members_invalid');
  return {issuer_id:x.issuer_id,market:x.market,expected_keys:x.expected_keys};
 });
}
const pendingOf=(row:Row):{issuer_id:string;market:Market}[]=>{
 const d=(row.detail??{}) as {pending_members?:unknown;pending_consumed_by?:unknown};
 if(d.pending_consumed_by!==undefined||!Array.isArray(d.pending_members))return [];
 return d.pending_members.filter((p):p is {issuer_id:string;market:Market}=>!!p&&typeof (p as Row).issuer_id==='string'&&((p as Row).market==='US'||(p as Row).market==='CN'));
};
function freeze(plans:MemberPlan[],pending:{issuer_id:string;market:Market}[]):FrozenMember[]{
 const byKey=new Map<string,FrozenMember>();
 for(const p of plans){
  const k=mkey(p.issuerId,p.market);if(byKey.has(k))throw new ReconcileError('duplicate_member',k);
  if(new Set(p.expectedKeys.map(e=>e.naturalKey)).size!==p.expectedKeys.length)throw new ReconcileError('duplicate_expected_key',k);
  byKey.set(k,{issuer_id:p.issuerId,market:p.market,expected_keys:p.expectedKeys});
 }
 for(const p of pending){const k=mkey(p.issuer_id,p.market);if(!byKey.has(k))byKey.set(k,{issuer_id:p.issuer_id,market:p.market,expected_keys:[]});}
 return [...byKey.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:a.issuer_id>b.issuer_id?1:a.market<b.market?-1:a.market>b.market?1:0);
}

async function openCycle(deps:ReconcileDeps,pair:RegisteredPair,ctx:PairRunContext):Promise<{row:Row;created:boolean}>{
 const running=async()=>(await deps.tables.select(CYCLE_TABLE,{pair:pair.id,status:'running'},{limit:1}))[0];
 const existing=await running();
 if(existing)return {row:existing,created:false};
 const plans=await pair.members(ctx);
 const earlier=(await selectAll(deps.tables,CYCLE_TABLE,{pair:pair.id},'cycle_id')).filter(r=>pendingOf(r).length>0);
 const members=freeze(plans,earlier.flatMap(pendingOf));
 const startedAt=deps.now();
 const cycleId=`${pair.id}-${startedAt.toISOString().slice(0,10)}-${randomUUID().slice(0,8)}`;
 const row:Row={pair:pair.id,cycle_id:cycleId,started_at:startedAt.toISOString(),finished_at:null,members,status:'running',
  expected_total:members.reduce((n,m)=>n+m.expected_keys.length,0),compared_passed:0,compared_failed:0,not_compared:0,exec_failed_members:0,
  detail:{pending_merged_from:earlier.map(r=>String(r.cycle_id))}};
 try{await deps.tables.insert(CYCLE_TABLE,row);}
 catch(e){
  if(e instanceof TableError&&e.code==='23505'){const winner=await running();if(winner)return {row:winner,created:false};}
  throw e;
 }
 for(const r of earlier)await deps.tables.update(CYCLE_TABLE,{pair:pair.id,cycle_id:String(r.cycle_id)},{detail:{...((r.detail??{}) as Row),pending_consumed_by:cycleId}});
 return {row,created:true};
}

async function readCursors(tables:TableClient,pair:CyclePairId,cycleId:string):Promise<Row[]>{
 const out:Row[]=[];
 for(const market of MARKETS)out.push(...await selectAll(tables,CURSOR_TABLE,{pair,cycle_id:cycleId,market},'issuer_id'));
 return out.sort((a,b)=>String(a.issuer_id)<String(b.issuer_id)?-1:String(a.issuer_id)>String(b.issuer_id)?1:String(a.market)<String(b.market)?-1:1);
}
async function ensureCursors(tables:TableClient,pair:CyclePairId,cycleId:string,members:FrozenMember[]):Promise<void>{
 const have=new Set((await readCursors(tables,pair,cycleId)).map(c=>mkey(String(c.issuer_id),String(c.market))));
 for(const m of members){
  if(have.has(mkey(m.issuer_id,m.market)))continue;
  try{
   await tables.insert(CURSOR_TABLE,{pair,cycle_id:cycleId,issuer_id:m.issuer_id,market:m.market,expected:m.expected_keys.length,state:'pending',claimed_by:null,claim_until:null,attempts:0,last_error:null,done_at:null,compared_passed:null,compared_failed:null,not_compared:null});
  }catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TableError&&e.code==='23505'))throw e;}
 }
}
function claimable(c:Row,now:Date):boolean{
 const until=c.claim_until===null||c.claim_until===undefined?null:Date.parse(String(c.claim_until));
 if(c.state==='pending')return true;
 if(c.state==='claimed')return until!==null&&until<now.getTime();
 if(c.state==='failed')return Number(c.attempts)<MAX_CURSOR_ATTEMPTS;
 return false;
}

async function targetOf(tables:TableClient,issuer:string):Promise<string>{
 const [r]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer},{limit:1});
 return typeof r?.merged_into==='string'?r.merged_into:issuer;
}
async function setHook(tables:TableClient,id:string,hook:Hook):Promise<void>{
 try{
  const [r]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id},{limit:1});if(!r)return;
  await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id},{detail:{...((r.detail??{}) as Row),hook}});
 }catch(e){console.error('[reconcile] hook write',e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e));}
}
/** Materializes each distinct target once and writes every listed item's hook; never throws. Returns the number of failed targets' items. */
async function runHooks(deps:ReconcileDeps,list:{itemId:string|null;issuerId:string;market:Market}[],errors:BatchError[]):Promise<number>{
 const mat=deps.materialize??((db:FactsDb,issuer:string,market:Market)=>materializeFacts(db,issuer,market));
 const groups=new Map<string,{target:string;market:Market;items:string[]}>();
 for(const x of list){
  const target=await targetOf(deps.tables,x.issuerId);const k=mkey(target,x.market);
  const g=groups.get(k)??{target,market:x.market,items:[]};if(x.itemId)g.items.push(x.itemId);groups.set(k,g);
 }
 let failed=0;
 for(const g of groups.values()){
  let hook:Hook;
  try{await mat(deps.db,g.target,g.market);hook={stage:'done',state:'done',at:deps.now().toISOString()};}
  catch(e){
   const code=e instanceof FactsDbError?e.code:'materialize_failed';
   hook={stage:'materialize',state:'failed',at:deps.now().toISOString(),message:code};
   errors.push({code:'materialize_error',key:mkey(g.target,g.market),message:code});failed+=g.items.length;
  }
  for(const id of g.items)await setHook(deps.tables,id,hook);
 }
 return failed;
}
async function retryPendingHooks(deps:ReconcileDeps,pair:CyclePairId,errors:BatchError[]):Promise<{retried:number;failed:number}>{
 const rows=(await selectAll(deps.tables,'dq_quarantine',{reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',status:'open'},'id')).filter(r=>{
  const d=(r.detail??{}) as {pair?:unknown;hook?:{state?:unknown};issuer_id?:unknown;market?:unknown};
  return d.pair===pair&&(d.hook?.state==='pending'||d.hook?.state==='failed')&&typeof d.issuer_id==='string'&&(d.market==='US'||d.market==='CN');
 });
 if(rows.length===0)return {retried:0,failed:0};
 const failed=await runHooks(deps,rows.map(r=>{const d=r.detail as {issuer_id:string;market:Market};return {itemId:String(r.id),issuerId:d.issuer_id,market:d.market};}),errors);
 return {retried:rows.length,failed};
}

function assertOnePerKey(plan:MemberPlan,results:ReconcileResultInput[]):void{
 if(results.length!==plan.expectedKeys.length||results.some((r,i)=>r.natural_key!==plan.expectedKeys[i].naturalKey))throw new ReconcileError('evaluate_contract');
}
function tally(r:ReconcileResultInput,out:ApplyReconcileOutcome,c:BatchCounts,outcomes:Map<string,number>):void{
 c.fetched++;
 if(out.reused){c.duplicates++;return;}
 if(r.outcome!=='compared'){c.failed++;outcomes.set(r.outcome,(outcomes.get(r.outcome)??0)+1);return;}
 if(r.passed){c.inserted++;return;}
 if(r.action==='record')c.failed++;else c.quarantined++;
}

async function processMember(deps:ReconcileDeps,pair:RegisteredPair,ctx:PairRunContext,fence:Fence,plan:MemberPlan,counts:BatchCounts,errors:BatchError[],outcomes:Map<string,number>):Promise<MemberReport>{
 const key=mkey(fence.issuer_id,fence.market);
 const report=(outcome:MemberOutcome,extra:{counts?:MemberCounts;code?:string}={}):MemberReport=>({issuerId:fence.issuer_id,market:fence.market,outcome,...extra});
 const hooks:{itemId:string|null;issuerId:string;market:Market}[]=[];
 const flush=async()=>{if(hooks.length>0){await runHooks(deps,hooks.splice(0),errors);}};
 try{
  const results=await pair.evaluate(ctx,plan);
  assertOnePerKey(plan,results);
  for(const result of results){
   let out:ApplyReconcileOutcome;
   try{out=await deps.db.applyReconcileResult(fence,result);}
   catch(e){if(isFence(e)){errors.push({code:'fence_failed',key});await flush();return report('fence_lost');}throw e;}
   tally(result,out,counts,outcomes);
   if(out.materialize)hooks.push({itemId:out.itemId,issuerId:out.materialize.issuerId,market:out.materialize.market});
  }
  await flush();
  try{return report('done',{counts:await deps.db.completeReconcileMember(fence)});}
  catch(e){if(isFence(e)){errors.push({code:'fence_failed',key});return report('fence_lost');}throw e;}
 }catch(e){
  await flush();
  const code=codeOf(e);
  counts.failed++;errors.push({code:'member_failed',key,message:code});
  try{await deps.db.failReconcileMember(fence,code);}
  catch(f){if(isFence(f)){errors.push({code:'fence_failed',key});return report('fence_lost',{code});}throw f;}
  return report('failed',{code});
 }
}

async function settle(deps:ReconcileDeps,pair:CyclePairId,cycleId:string):Promise<{settled:boolean;status:CycleStatus}>{
 const rows=await readCursors(deps.tables,pair,cycleId);
 if(!rows.every(c=>c.state==='done'||(c.state==='failed'&&Number(c.attempts)>=MAX_CURSOR_ATTEMPTS)))return {settled:false,status:'running'};
 let passed=0,failedCmp=0,notCompared=0,failedMembers=0;
 for(const c of rows){
  if(c.state==='failed'){failedMembers++;continue;}
  const v=[c.compared_passed,c.compared_failed,c.not_compared].map(x=>x===null||x===undefined?null:Number(x));
  if(v.some(x=>x===null||!Number.isSafeInteger(x)||x<0)||(v[0]!+v[1]!+v[2]!)!==Number(c.expected))throw new ReconcileError('cursor_unaccounted',mkey(String(c.issuer_id),String(c.market)));
  passed+=v[0]!;failedCmp+=v[1]!;notCompared+=v[2]!;
 }
 const status:CycleStatus=notCompared===0&&failedMembers===0?'complete':'complete_with_gaps';
 const now=deps.now();
 const n=await deps.tables.update(CYCLE_TABLE,{pair,cycle_id:cycleId,status:'running'},{status,finished_at:now.toISOString(),compared_passed:passed,compared_failed:failedCmp,not_compared:notCompared,exec_failed_members:failedMembers});
 if(n!==1)return {settled:false,status};
 await recordAttempt(deps.tables,DATASETS.reconcile(pair),{ok:status==='complete',cadence:'weekly',now,detail:{cycle_id:cycleId,compared_passed:passed,compared_failed:failedCmp,not_compared:notCompared,exec_failed_members:failedMembers}});
 return {settled:true,status};
}

export async function runReconcile(deps:ReconcileDeps,opts:ReconcileOptions):Promise<ReconcileReceipt>{
 const pair=(deps.pairs??RECONCILE_PAIRS)[opts.pair];
 if(!pair)throw new ReconcileError('pair_not_registered',opts.pair);
 const budget=makeBudget(deps.deadline,deps.now);
 const base={db:deps.db,tables:deps.tables,raw:deps.raw,now:deps.now,budget,fetch:deps.fetch,readRepoFile:deps.readRepoFile};
 const want=opts.issuerIds?new Set(opts.issuerIds):null;
 if(opts.dryRun){
  const ctx:PairRunContext={...base,batchId:null,dryRun:true};
  const out:{issuerId:string;market:Market;results:ReconcileResultInput[]}[]=[];
  for(const plan of await pair.members(ctx)){
   if(want&&!want.has(plan.issuerId))continue;
   const results=await pair.evaluate(ctx,plan);assertOnePerKey(plan,results);
   out.push({issuerId:plan.issuerId,market:plan.market,results});
  }
  return {batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts:emptyCounts(),errors:[],cycle:null,members:[],hooks:{retried:0,failed:0},dryRun:out};
 }
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const outcomes=new Map<string,number>();const members:MemberReport[]=[];
 const hooks=await retryPendingHooks(deps,pair.id,errors);
 const sample=pair.inputs.repoFile===null?'':await deps.readRepoFile(pair.inputs.repoFile).then(sha256Hex,()=>'');
 const tool=(cycleId:string)=>({pair:pair.id,cycle_id:cycleId,parser:pair.inputs.parserVersion,gold_schema:pair.inputs.goldSchema??'',sample_sha256:sample,code_version:deps.codeVersion});
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'reconcile',dataset:DATASETS.reconcile(pair.id),toolVersions:tool(''),codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy});
 const finish=async(cycle:CycleReport|null)=>{
  if(outcomes.size>0)errors.push({code:'outcome_summary',message:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries([...outcomes.entries()].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:1)))});
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors},deps.now());
  return {batchId,status,counts,errors,cycle,members,hooks} satisfies ReconcileReceipt;
 };
 const ctx:PairRunContext={...base,batchId,dryRun:false};
 let opened:{row:Row;created:boolean};
 try{opened=await openCycle(deps,pair,ctx);}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof ReconcileConfigError){errors.push({code:e.code,message:e.message});return finish(null);}throw e;}
 const cycleId=String(opened.row.cycle_id);const frozen=frozenOf(opened.row);
 await deps.tables.update('ingest_batches',{batch_id:batchId,status:'running'},{tool_versions:tool(cycleId)});
 await ensureCursors(deps.tables,pair.id,cycleId,frozen);
 const plans=new Map<string,MemberPlan>(frozen.map(m=>[mkey(m.issuer_id,m.market),{issuerId:m.issuer_id,market:m.market,expectedKeys:m.expected_keys}]));
 for(const c of await readCursors(deps.tables,pair.id,cycleId)){
  const issuerId=String(c.issuer_id),market=c.market as Market,key=mkey(issuerId,market);
  if(want&&!want.has(issuerId))continue;
  if(!claimable(c,deps.now()))continue;
  const plan=plans.get(key);
  if(!plan){errors.push({code:'member_failed',key,message:'cursor_without_member'});continue;}
  if(budget.remainingMs()<MIN_MEMBER_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',key});members.push({issuerId,market,outcome:'not_started'});continue;}
  const fence=await deps.db.claimReconcileMember(pair.id,cycleId,issuerId,market,batchId);
  if(!fence){errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key:`${key}:claimed`});members.push({issuerId,market,outcome:'claimed_elsewhere'});continue;}
  const r=await processMember(deps,pair,ctx,fence,plan,counts,errors,outcomes);
  members.push(r);
  if(r.outcome==='fence_lost')break;
 }
 let settled:{settled:boolean;status:CycleStatus}={settled:false,status:'running'};
 try{settled=await settle(deps,pair.id,cycleId);}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof ReconcileError&&e.code==='cursor_unaccounted')errors.push({code:'cursor_unaccounted',key:e.message});else throw e;}
 return finish({cycleId,status:settled.status,created:opened.created,settled:settled.settled,expectedTotal:Number(opened.row.expected_total)});
}
```

```ts
import {afterEach,beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';

const mocks=vi.hoisted(()=>({run:vi.fn(),deps:vi.fn(),codeVersion:vi.fn()}));
vi.mock('@/lib/dq/reconcile/run',async importOriginal=>({...(await importOriginal<typeof import('@/lib/dq/reconcile/run')>()),runReconcile:mocks.run}));
vi.mock('@/lib/dq/reconcile/deps',()=>({productionReconcileDeps:mocks.deps}));

const receipt={batchId:'b',status:'success',counts:{fetched:2,inserted:2,duplicates:0,versioned:0,quarantined:0,failed:0},errors:[{code:'skipped_summary',key:'x:US:claimed',message:'secret detail'}],cycle:{cycleId:'c',status:'complete',created:true,settled:true,expectedTotal:2},members:[{issuerId:'i',market:'US',outcome:'done',counts:{compared_passed:2,compared_failed:0,not_compared:0}}],hooks:{retried:0,failed:0}};

describe('reconcile cron',()=>{
 beforeEach(()=>{
  vi.clearAllMocks();process.env.CRON_SECRET='cron-secret';delete process.env.FACTS_CN_ENABLED;
  mocks.codeVersion.mockReturnValue('abc123');mocks.deps.mockReturnValue({tag:'deps'});mocks.run.mockResolvedValue(receipt);
 });
 afterEach(()=>{
  if(original===undefined)delete process.env.CRON_SECRET;else process.env.CRON_SECRET=original;
  if(originalCn===undefined)delete process.env.FACTS_CN_ENABLED;else process.env.FACTS_CN_ENABLED=originalCn;
 });
 it('fails closed without CRON_SECRET and rejects a wrong bearer before touching deps',async()=>{
  delete process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  expect((await GET(req('pair=facts.lineage_same_day',AUTH))).status).toBe(503);
  process.env.CRON_SECRET='cron-secret';
  expect((await GET(req('pair=facts.lineage_same_day',{authorization:'Bearer nope'}))).status).toBe(401);
  expect((await GET(req('pair=facts.lineage_same_day'))).status).toBe(401);
  expect(mocks.deps).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(mocks.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('requires exactly one registered cycle pair',async()=>{
  for(const qs of ['','pair=','pair=bogus','pair=sec.filer_category','pair=facts.lineage_same_day&pair=us.companyfacts_vs_gold']){
   const res=await GET(req(qs,AUTH));
   expect(res.status,qs).toBe(400);expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:pair');
  }
  expect(mocks.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('refuses CN pairs unless FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1 (degraded path: no CN cron)',async()=>{
  const res=await GET(req('pair=cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold',AUTH));
  expect([400,403]).toContain(res.status);   // 400 until Task 16a registers the CN pair, 403 afterwards
  expect(mocks.run).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('refuses to run without a code version',async()=>{
  mocks.codeVersion.mockReturnValue(null);
  const res=await POST(req('pair=facts.lineage_same_day',AUTH));
  expect(res.status).toBe(503);expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('code_version_unavailable');
  expect(mocks.codeVersion).toHaveBeenCalledWith({allowGit:false});
 });
 it('runs the pair with a 240 s deadline and cron trigger; the body carries codes and counts only',async()=>{
  const before=Date.now();
  const res=await GET(req('pair=facts.lineage_same_day',AUTH));
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
  const body=await res.json();
  expect(body).toMatchObject({ok:true,pair:'facts.lineage_same_day',receipt:{batchId:'b',status:'success',cycle:{cycleId:'c',status:'complete'}}});
  expect(body.receipt.errors).toEqual([{code:'skipped_summary',key:'x:US:claimed'}]);
  expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('secret detail');
  expect(mocks.run).toHaveBeenCalledWith({tag:'deps'},{pair:'facts.lineage_same_day',triggeredBy:'cron'});
  const d=mocks.deps.mock.calls[0][0];

  expect(d.deadline.getTime()-before).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(240_000-50);expect(d.deadline.getTime()-before).toBeLessThan(241_000);
 });
 it('ok=false when the batch is not success; errors map to codes only',async()=>{
  mocks.run.mockResolvedValueOnce({...receipt,status:'partial'});
  expect((await (await GET(req('pair=us.companyfacts_vs_gold',AUTH))).json()).ok).toBe(false);
  mocks.run.mockRejectedValueOnce(new ReconcileError('pair_not_registered','details'));
  const res=await GET(req('pair=us.companyfacts_vs_gold',AUTH));
  expect(res.status).toBe(500);expect(await res.json()).toEqual({error:{code:'pair_not_registered',message:'Reconcile failed'}});
  mocks.run.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('boom'));
  expect((await (await GET(req('pair=us.companyfacts_vs_gold',AUTH))).json()).error.code).toBe('reconcile_failed');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/deps.ts
// Production wiring of ReconcileDeps (plan 3 Task 14c) shared by /api/cron/reconcile and
// scripts/dq/reconcile.ts: Supabase FactsDb / TableClient / RawStore (bucket reconcile-raw), the global
// fetch (the pairs pace SEC themselves), and readRepoFileFromDisk, which reads ONLY JSON files under the two
// gold fixture directories (the sample and gold manifests; next.config.mjs traces them into the cron
// function). Anything else — absolute paths, '..', other directories or extensions — is refused.
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {join,normalize} from 'node:path';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {supabaseFactsDb} from '../../facts/db';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../supabase/admin';
import {supabaseRawStore} from '../raw-store';
import type {Row} from '../../db/table-client';
import {makeBudget} from '../../facts/sync';
import type {InputsHashNow} from '../facts-resolver';
import {inputsHashNow} from './pairs';
import type {ReconcileDeps} from './run';
import type {PairContext} from './types';

export const REPO_FILE_PREFIXES:readonly string[]=['src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/','src/lib/facts/fixtures/gold/'];
export async function readRepoFileFromDisk(path:string):Promise<Uint8Array>{
 const n=normalize(path).replace(/\\/g,'/');
 if(path.startsWith('/')||n!==path||n.includes('..')||!n.endsWith('.json')||!REPO_FILE_PREFIXES.some(p=>n.startsWith(p)))throw new Error('repo_file_not_allowed');
 return new Uint8Array(await readFile(join(process.cwd(),n)));
}

/** Data gaps of pairs.ts::inputsHashNow that mean "cannot restore now" (→ null → 409 not_passing / restorable=false), not a bug. */
const RESTORE_GAP_CODES:readonly string[]=['pair_not_registered','left_fact_missing','no_latest_result'];
/**
 * The CURRENT inputs hash of a reconcile_mismatch item (spec §5.6), injected into the quarantine route
 * (resolveFactsItem.inputsHashNow, Task 11) and the admin dashboard's server-computed `restorable` (Task 19a).
 */
export function restoreInputsHashNow(admin?:SupabaseClient):InputsHashNow{
 const sb=admin??getAdminSupabase();
 const now=()=>new Date();
 const ctx:PairContext={db:supabaseFactsDb(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),raw:supabaseRawStore(sb),now,budget:makeBudget(null,now),
  fetch:globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis),readRepoFile:readRepoFileFromDisk};
 return async(item:Row)=>{
  try{return await inputsHashNow(ctx,item);}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof Error&&RESTORE_GAP_CODES.includes(e.message))return null;throw e;}
 };
}

export interface ProductionReconcileOptions{deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string;admin?:SupabaseClient}
export function productionReconcileDeps(opts:ProductionReconcileOptions):ReconcileDeps{
 const sb=opts.admin??getAdminSupabase();
 return {db:supabaseFactsDb(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),raw:supabaseRawStore(sb),fetch:globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis),
  readRepoFile:readRepoFileFromDisk,now:()=>new Date(),deadline:opts.deadline,codeVersion:opts.codeVersion};
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/reconcile/route.ts
// Reconciliation trigger (spec §5.5): GET|POST /api/cron/reconcile?pair=<cycle pair id>. Same rules as
// /api/cron/facts-sync: CRON_SECRET bearer (constant-time), maxDuration 300 with a 240 s deadline handed to
// the runner (which starts a member only with >= 60 s left), a missing code_version refuses the run. The pair
// must be given once and be a REGISTERED cycle pair; cn.* pairs are refused unless FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1 (no
// Tushare token, no verified gold yet; vercel.json schedules US iXBRL 02:00 and lineage 04:00 UTC only).
// A duplicate cron delivery is harmless: cursor claims are fenced, a second worker finds nothing claimable.
// The HTTP receipt carries codes, keys and counts only — never error messages or dry-run results.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {productionReconcileDeps} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/deps';
import {ReconcileConfigError} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-support';
import {RECONCILE_PAIRS} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/pairs';
import {ReconcileError,runReconcile} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/run';
import type {ReconcileReceipt} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/run';
import {CYCLE_PAIR_IDS} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/types';
import type {CyclePairId} from '@/lib/dq/reconcile/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function publicReceipt(r:ReconcileReceipt){
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key}),cycle:r.cycle,
  members:r.members.map(m=>({issuerId:m.issuerId,market:m.market,outcome:m.outcome,...(m.counts?{counts:m.counts}:{}),...(m.code?{code:m.code.split(':')[0]}:{})})),hooks:r.hooks};
}
function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const pairs=new URL(request.url).searchParams.getAll('pair');
 const pair=pairs.length===1?pairs[0]:'';
 if(!(CYCLE_PAIR_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(pair)||!RECONCILE_PAIRS[pair as CyclePairId])return err('invalid_parameter:pair','pair must be one registered cycle pair',400);
 if(pair.startsWith('cn.')&&process.env.FACTS_CN_ENABLED!=='1')return err('cn_disabled','CN reconciliation is not enabled (FACTS_CN_ENABLED)',403);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const receipt=await runReconcile(productionReconcileDeps({deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion}),{pair:pair as CyclePairId,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',pair,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof ReconcileError||e instanceof ReconcileConfigError?e.code:'reconcile_failed','Reconcile failed',500);
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

```ts
// scripts/dq/reconcile.ts
/**
 * Runs one reconciliation pair (spec §5.5).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/reconcile.ts --pair <cycle pair id> [--issuer <ticker>...] [--apply]
 *
 * Without --apply: dry run — members + evaluate only (right documents go to an in-memory raw store, no
 * batch, no cycle, no result rows, no items); prints one JSON line per expected key
 * {issuer, market, natural_key, outcome, passed, action} and a summary. With --apply: one runReconcile
 * batch (triggered_by 'script', no deadline; code_version = VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or git HEAD, refused when
 * unavailable) and the full receipt as JSON. --issuer restricts which members are processed (tickers are
 * resolved with resolveIssuer as of today). Exit 0 ok, 1 when the batch is not success or a member failed,
 * 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../src/lib/entities/resolve';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {productionReconcileDeps} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/deps';
import {RECONCILE_PAIRS} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/pairs';
import {runReconcile} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/run';
import {CYCLE_PAIR_IDS} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/types';
import type {CyclePairId} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: reconcile.ts --pair <cycle pair id> [--issuer <ticker>...] [--apply]';

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let pair='',apply=false;const tickers:string[]=[];
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(x==='--pair'&&v){pair=v;i++;}
  else if(x==='--issuer'&&v){tickers.push(v);i++;}
  else if(x==='--apply')apply=true;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!(CYCLE_PAIR_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(pair)||!RECONCILE_PAIRS[pair as CyclePairId]){console.error(`${USAGE}\nregistered: ${Object.keys(RECONCILE_PAIRS).join(', ')}`);process.exit(2);}
 const sb=getAdminSupabase();const tables=supabaseTableClient(sb);const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const issuerIds:string[]=[];
 for(const t of tickers){const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:t},{today});if(!r){console.error(`unknown ticker: ${t}`);process.exit(2);}issuerIds.push(r.issuer_id);}
 const codeVersion=apply?resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true}):'dry-run';
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('code_version unavailable (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or git HEAD): refusing to apply');process.exit(2);}
 const base=productionReconcileDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion,admin:sb});
 const deps=apply?base:{...base,raw:memoryRawStore()};
 const receipt=await runReconcile(deps,{pair:pair as CyclePairId,triggeredBy:'script',dryRun:!apply,...(issuerIds.length?{issuerIds}:{})});
 if(!apply){
  let n=0;
  for(const m of receipt.dryRun??[])for(const r of m.results){n++;console.log(JSON.stringify({issuer:m.issuerId,market:m.market,natural_key:r.natural_key,outcome:r.outcome,passed:r.passed,action:r.action}));}
  console.log(JSON.stringify({pair,dry_run:true,members:receipt.dryRun?.length??0,keys:n}));
  process.exit(0);
 }
 console.log(JSON.stringify(receipt,null,1));
 process.exit(receipt.status==='success'&&receipt.members.every(m=>m.outcome!=='failed')?0:1);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
   ['equity_parent',null,'2024-12-31','USD','us-gaap:StockholdersEquity','both'],
   ['net_income_parent','2024-01-01','2024-12-31','USD','us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss','both'],
   ['rd_expense','2024-01-01','2024-12-31','USD','us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense','left'],
   ['revenue','2024-01-01','2024-12-31','USD','us-gaap:Revenues','both'],
   ['total_assets',null,'2024-12-31','USD','us-gaap:Assets','both'],
  ]);   // NetIncomeLoss 2023 belongs to another accession; Assets of entity 42, the 2009 Assets and the instant-context Revenues are not keys
  expect(f).toMatchObject({accn:ACCN,raw_sha256:input.companyfacts.sha256,is_inline_xbrl:true,submissions_category:'Non-accelerated filer'});
  expect(f.doc_sha256).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(usNaturalKey(CIK,ACCN,f.expected_keys[0])).toBe(`${CIK}:${ACCN}:cost_of_revenue:2024-01-01:2024-12-31:USD`);
 });
 it(`refuses a filing with fewer than ${MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE} keys on either side`,()=>{
  expect(()=>buildSampleFiling({...input,doc:new TextEncoder().encode(`${H}<body><ix:header><ix:resources>${ctx('d','<xbrli:startDate>2024-01-01</xbrli:startDate><xbrli:endDate>2024-12-31</xbrli:endDate>')}<xbrli:unit id="usd"><xbrli:measure>iso4217:USD</xbrli:measure></xbrli:unit></ix:resources></ix:header>${nf('NetIncomeLoss','d','100')}</body></html>`)})).toThrow(/sample_side_too_small:.*right=1/);
 });
 it('entityIs compares the SEC CIK identifier without leading zeros',()=>{
  expect(entityIs('http://www.sec.gov/CIK#0000320193','320193')).toBe(true);
  expect(entityIs('http://www.sec.gov/CIK#0000320194','320193')).toBe(false);
  expect(entityIs('http://example.com#320193','320193')).toBe(false);
 });
});

describe('validateUsSample',()=>{
 const good=():UsSample=>({schema:US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA,generated_at:'2026-11-05T00:00:00Z',selection:'fixture/1',issuers:[{cik:CIK,ticker:'ZIX',regime:'10-K',filings:[buildSampleFiling(input)]}]});
 it('accepts a well-formed manifest',()=>{expect(validateUsSample(good())).toEqual({ok:true,sample:good()});});
 it.each([
  ['schema',(s:UsSample)=>{(s as {schema:string}).schema='x';}],
  ['accn',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].accn='123';}],
  ['cik',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].cik='0320193';}],
  ['duplicate key',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].expected_keys.push({...s.issuers[0].filings[0].expected_keys[0]});}],
  ['unknown concept',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].expected_keys[0].concept='nope';}],
  ['side too small',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].expected_keys=s.issuers[0].filings[0].expected_keys.slice(0,3);}],
  ['doc_url host',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].doc_url='https://evil.example/x.htm';}],
  ['sha',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings[0].raw_sha256='abc';}],
  ['no filings',(s:UsSample)=>{s.issuers[0].filings=[];}],
 ])('rejects: %s',(_n,mutate)=>{const s=good();mutate(s);const r=validateUsSample(s);expect(r.ok).toBe(false);});
});

describe('pickSample (spec §5.3 sample rule)',()=>{
 const cand=(i:number,o:Partial<SampleCandidate>={}):SampleCandidate=>({ticker:`T${String(i).padStart(3,'0')}`,cik:String(1000+i),exchange:'NYSE',fiscalYearEnd:'1231',acceleration:'large_accelerated',...o});
 it('keeps required tickers, fills the rest at equal steps in ticker order, and meets every quota by swapping',()=>{
  const all=[...Array.from({length:60},(_,i)=>cand(i)),cand(100,{ticker:'AAPL',exchange:'Nasdaq',fiscalYearEnd:'0930'}),cand(101,{ticker:'MSFT',exchange:'Nasdaq',fiscalYearEnd:'0630'}),cand(102,{ticker:'ZNAS',exchange:'Nasdaq'}),cand(103,{ticker:'ZACC',acceleration:'accelerated'}),cand(104,{ticker:'ZNON',acceleration:'non_accelerated'})];
  const {picked,unmet}=pickSample(all,['AAPL','MSFT'],30);
  expect(picked).toHaveLength(30);expect(unmet).toEqual([]);
  expect(picked.map(p=>p.ticker)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['AAPL','MSFT','ZNAS','ZACC','ZNON']));
  expect(picked.filter(p=>p.exchange==='NYSE').length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
  expect(new Set(picked.map(p=>p.ticker)).size).toBe(30);
  expect(picked.map(p=>p.ticker)).toEqual([...picked.map(p=>p.ticker)].sort());
 });
 it('reports a quota that cannot be met instead of inventing candidates',()=>{
  const {picked,unmet}=pickSample(Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>cand(i)),[],30);
  expect(picked).toHaveLength(10);
  expect(unmet).toEqual(['nasdaq','fye_not_1231','not_large_accelerated']);
 });
});
```

```ts
 k('total_assets',I,'us-gaap:Assets','both'),            // 5000 vs 5001 → quarantine_left
 k('equity_parent',I,'us-gaap:StockholdersEquity','both'),// two values in the document → right_ambiguous
 k('operating_income',D,'us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss','left'),   // xsi:nil in the document → unsupported(nil)

const ctx=(id:string,period:string)=>`<xbrli:context id="${id}"><xbrli:entity><xbrli:identifier scheme="http://www.sec.gov/CIK">000${CIK}</xbrli:identifier></xbrli:entity><xbrli:period>${period}</xbrli:period></xbrli:context>`;

 +nf('OperatingIncomeLoss','d','','xsi:nil="true"')+nf('CostOfRevenue','d','700')+'</body></html>');

  readRepoFile:async p=>{if(p!==US_SAMPLE_PATH)throw new Error(p);return sampleBytes;},batchId:randomUUID(),dryRun:false};

}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/us-sample.ts
// US iXBRL sample manifest (spec §5.3; schema 'us-ixbrl-sample/1'). The manifest freezes members and expected
// keys of us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl. Expected keys are the UNION of two independent sources: (a) plan 2's
// companyfacts adapter on the accession's raw snapshot (candidates, ambiguous and odd-duration entries of that
// accession), (b) the iXBRL parser on the primary document (filer entity only, tag in FACT_CONCEPTS, unit kind
// and period nature matching the concept, period end >= sinceYear-01-01, highest-priority tag per key). A key
// from one source only is still expected — at run time it becomes left_missing or right_missing and exposes
// the adapter's or parser's gap instead of shrinking the denominator. Each side needs >= 4 keys. pickSample is
// the §5.3 selection: required (plan-2 gold) tickers, the rest at equal steps in ticker order up to n, then
// quota swaps (>= 3 NYSE, >= 3 Nasdaq, >= 2 fiscal year end not 12-31, >= 2 not large accelerated); a quota
// that cannot be met is reported, never faked.
import {FACT_CONCEPTS,conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {parseCompanyFacts,tagsOf} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import type {ConceptDef,FactCandidate,ParseResult,RawSnapshot} from '../../facts/types';
import {unitKindOf} from '../../facts/units';
import {parseInlineXbrl} from './ixbrl';
import type {IxbrlDocument} from './ixbrl';
import {sha256Hex} from './pair-support';

export const US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA='us-ixbrl-sample/1';
export const US_SAMPLE_PATH='src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/us-ixbrl-sample-v1.json';
export const MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE=4;
export type KeyOrigin='left'|'right'|'both';
export interface SampleKey{concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;unit:string;source_concept:string;origin:KeyOrigin}
export interface SampleFiling{accn:string;form:string;period_end:string|null;primary_document:string;doc_url:string;is_inline_xbrl:boolean|null;submissions_category:string|null;raw_sha256:string;doc_sha256:string;expected_keys:SampleKey[]}
export interface SampleIssuer{cik:string;ticker:string;regime:'10-K'|'20-F';filings:SampleFiling[]}
export interface UsSample{schema:typeof US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA;generated_at:string;selection:string;issuers:SampleIssuer[]}
type KeyCore=Omit<SampleKey,'origin'>;

export const usNaturalKey=(cik:string,accn:string,k:Pick<SampleKey,'concept'|'period_start'|'period_end'|'unit'>)=>`${cik}:${accn}:${k.concept}:${k.period_start??''}:${k.period_end}:${k.unit}`;
const kk=(k:Pick<SampleKey,'concept'|'period_start'|'period_end'|'unit'>)=>`${k.concept}|${k.period_start??''}|${k.period_end}|${k.unit}`;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const TAG_CONCEPT=(()=>{const m=new Map<string,ConceptDef>();for(const c of FACT_CONCEPTS)for(const t of tagsOf(c))if(!m.has(t))m.set(t,c);return m;})();

/** The context entity is the SEC CIK of the filer (identifier compared without leading zeros). */
export const entityIs=(entity:string,cik:string):boolean=>entity.startsWith('http://www.sec.gov/CIK#')&&entity.slice(entity.indexOf('#')+1).replace(/^0+/,'')===cik.replace(/^0+/,'');

export function companyfactsKeys(parse:ParseResult,accn:string):Map<string,KeyCore>{
 const out=new Map<string,KeyCore>();
 const add=(c:FactCandidate)=>{if(c.filingRef!==accn)return;const k={concept:c.concept,period_start:c.periodStart,period_end:c.periodEnd,unit:c.unit,source_concept:c.sourceConcept};if(!out.has(kk(k)))out.set(kk(k),k);};
 parse.candidates.forEach(add);parse.ambiguous.forEach(a=>a.candidates.forEach(add));parse.oddDuration.forEach(add);
 return out;
}
export function ixbrlKeys(doc:IxbrlDocument,cik:string,sinceDate:string):Map<string,KeyCore>{
 const out=new Map<string,KeyCore>();
 for(const f of doc.facts){
  if(!entityIs(f.entity,cik))continue;
  const c=TAG_CONCEPT.get(f.name);
  if(!c||unitKindOf(f.unit)!==c.unitKind||(c.nature==='duration')!==(f.periodStart!==null)||f.periodEnd<sinceDate)continue;
  const k={concept:c.id,period_start:f.periodStart,period_end:f.periodEnd,unit:f.unit,source_concept:f.name};
  const prev=out.get(kk(k));
  if(!prev||tagsOf(c).indexOf(f.name)<tagsOf(c).indexOf(prev.source_concept))out.set(kk(k),k);
 }
 return out;
}

export interface BuildFilingInput{cik:string;accn:string;form:string;period_end:string|null;primary_document:string;doc_url:string;is_inline_xbrl:boolean|null;submissions_category:string|null;companyfacts:RawSnapshot;doc:Uint8Array;doc_sha256?:string;sinceYear:number}
export function buildSampleFiling(i:BuildFilingInput):SampleFiling{
 const left=companyfactsKeys(parseCompanyFacts(i.companyfacts,{sinceYear:i.sinceYear}),i.accn);
 const right=ixbrlKeys(parseInlineXbrl(new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(i.doc)),i.cik,`${i.sinceYear}-01-01`);
 const keys:SampleKey[]=[];
 for(const [k,v] of left)keys.push({...v,origin:right.has(k)?'both':'left'});
 for(const [k,v] of right)if(!left.has(k))keys.push({...v,origin:'right'});
 keys.sort((a,b)=>cmp(kk(a),kk(b)));
 const nLeft=keys.filter(k=>k.origin!=='right').length,nRight=keys.filter(k=>k.origin!=='left').length;
 if(nLeft<MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE||nRight<MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE)throw new Error(`sample_side_too_small:${i.accn}:left=${nLeft}:right=${nRight}`);
 return {accn:i.accn,form:i.form,period_end:i.period_end,primary_document:i.primary_document,doc_url:i.doc_url,is_inline_xbrl:i.is_inline_xbrl,submissions_category:i.submissions_category,raw_sha256:i.companyfacts.sha256,doc_sha256:i.doc_sha256??sha256Hex(i.doc),expected_keys:keys};
}

const DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/,SHA=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/,ACCN=/^\d{10}-\d{2}-\d{6}$/;
export function validateUsSample(json:unknown):{ok:true;sample:UsSample}|{ok:false;errors:string[]}{
 const errors:string[]=[];const e=(m:string)=>{errors.push(m);};
 const s=json as Partial<UsSample>|null;
 if(!s||typeof s!=='object')return {ok:false,errors:['not_an_object']};
 if(s.schema!==US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA)e('schema');
 if(typeof s.generated_at!=='string'||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(s.generated_at)))e('generated_at');
 if(typeof s.selection!=='string'||s.selection==='')e('selection');
 if(!Array.isArray(s.issuers)||s.issuers.length===0)return {ok:false,errors:[...errors,'issuers']};
 const nks=new Set<string>();
 s.issuers.forEach((iss,ii)=>{
  const at=`issuers[${ii}]`;
  if(typeof iss?.cik!=='string'||!/^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(iss.cik))e(`${at}.cik`);
  if(typeof iss?.ticker!=='string'||iss.ticker==='')e(`${at}.ticker`);
  if(iss?.regime!=='10-K'&&iss?.regime!=='20-F')e(`${at}.regime`);
  if(!Array.isArray(iss?.filings)||iss.filings.length===0){e(`${at}.filings`);return;}
  iss.filings.forEach((f,fi)=>{
   const fa=`${at}.filings[${fi}]`;
   if(typeof f?.accn!=='string'||!ACCN.test(f.accn))e(`${fa}.accn`);
   if(typeof f?.form!=='string'||f.form==='')e(`${fa}.form`);
   if(f?.period_end!==null&&!(typeof f?.period_end==='string'&&DATE.test(f.period_end)))e(`${fa}.period_end`);
   if(typeof f?.primary_document!=='string'||f.primary_document==='')e(`${fa}.primary_document`);
   if(typeof f?.doc_url!=='string'||!f.doc_url.startsWith(`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/${iss.cik}/`))e(`${fa}.doc_url`);
   if(f?.is_inline_xbrl!==null&&typeof f?.is_inline_xbrl!=='boolean')e(`${fa}.is_inline_xbrl`);
   if(f?.submissions_category!==null&&typeof f?.submissions_category!=='string')e(`${fa}.submissions_category`);
   if(typeof f?.raw_sha256!=='string'||!SHA.test(f.raw_sha256))e(`${fa}.raw_sha256`);
   if(typeof f?.doc_sha256!=='string'||!SHA.test(f.doc_sha256))e(`${fa}.doc_sha256`);
   if(!Array.isArray(f?.expected_keys)){e(`${fa}.expected_keys`);return;}
   let nl=0,nr=0;
   f.expected_keys.forEach((k,ki)=>{
    const ka=`${fa}.expected_keys[${ki}]`;
    const def=typeof k?.concept==='string'?conceptById(k.concept):undefined;
    if(!def)e(`${ka}.concept`);
    if(k?.period_start!==null&&!(typeof k?.period_start==='string'&&DATE.test(k.period_start)))e(`${ka}.period_start`);
    if(typeof k?.period_end!=='string'||!DATE.test(k.period_end))e(`${ka}.period_end`);
    if(typeof k?.unit!=='string'||k.unit==='')e(`${ka}.unit`);
    if(typeof k?.source_concept!=='string'||k.source_concept==='')e(`${ka}.source_concept`);
    if(k?.origin!=='left'&&k?.origin!=='right'&&k?.origin!=='both')e(`${ka}.origin`);
    if(k?.origin!=='right')nl++;if(k?.origin!=='left')nr++;
    const nk=usNaturalKey(String(iss.cik),String(f.accn),k);
    if(nks.has(nk))e(`${ka}: duplicate ${nk}`);nks.add(nk);
   });
   if(nl<MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE||nr<MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE)e(`${fa}: fewer than ${MIN_KEYS_PER_SIDE} keys per side (left=${nl}, right=${nr})`);
  });
 });
 return errors.length>0?{ok:false,errors}:{ok:true,sample:s as UsSample};
}

export interface SampleCandidate{ticker:string;cik:string;exchange:string|null;fiscalYearEnd:string|null;acceleration:'large_accelerated'|'accelerated'|'non_accelerated'|null}
const QUOTAS:readonly {name:string;min:number;test:(c:SampleCandidate)=>boolean}[]=[
 {name:'nyse',min:3,test:c=>c.exchange==='NYSE'},
 {name:'nasdaq',min:3,test:c=>c.exchange!==null&&c.exchange.toLowerCase()==='nasdaq'},
 {name:'fye_not_1231',min:2,test:c=>c.fiscalYearEnd!==null&&c.fiscalYearEnd!=='1231'},
 {name:'not_large_accelerated',min:2,test:c=>c.acceleration!==null&&c.acceleration!=='large_accelerated'},
];
export function pickSample(candidates:readonly SampleCandidate[],required:readonly string[],n=30):{picked:SampleCandidate[];unmet:string[]}{
 const sorted=[...candidates].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ticker,b.ticker));
 const req=new Set(required);
 const picked=sorted.filter(c=>req.has(c.ticker));
 const others=sorted.filter(c=>!req.has(c.ticker));
 const k=Math.max(0,Math.min(n-picked.length,others.length));
 for(let i=0;i<k;i++)picked.push(others[Math.floor(i*others.length/k)]);
 const count=(q:typeof QUOTAS[number])=>picked.filter(q.test).length;
 for(const q of QUOTAS){
  while(count(q)<q.min){
   const incoming=sorted.find(c=>!picked.includes(c)&&q.test(c));
   if(!incoming)break;
   if(picked.length<n){picked.push(incoming);continue;}
   const out=[...picked.keys()].reverse().find(i=>!req.has(picked[i].ticker)&&!q.test(picked[i])&&QUOTAS.every(o=>o===q||!o.test(picked[i])||count(o)>o.min));
   if(out===undefined)break;
   picked.splice(out,1,incoming);
  }
 }
 return {picked:picked.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.ticker,b.ticker)),unmet:QUOTAS.filter(q=>count(q)<q.min).map(q=>q.name)};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-us-ixbrl.ts
// us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl (spec §5.2, §5.3, T1). Members and expected keys come ONLY from the frozen sample
// manifest (US_SAMPLE_PATH). Per accession, in this order:
//  1. no local filing (edgar, accn) → every key left_unlinked (the document is not fetched);
//  2. right document: is_inline_xbrl=false → unsupported(not_inline_xbrl); else GET doc_url with SEC pacing
//     (120 ms, User-Agent EDGAR_USER_AGENT/default, 429/5xx retried twice then THROWN = execution failure),
//     404 → unsupported(document_not_found), > 50 MB → unsupported(document_too_large); accepted bytes go to
//     reconcile-raw (content-addressed, sha256 = right_sha256) and are parsed; IxbrlParseError →
//     unsupported(parse_error:<code>); no ix element → unsupported(not_inline_xbrl);
//  3. left: read_filing_facts(filing, includeNonOk) filtered by activeRows (active generation, published,
//     ok|quarantined); an OPEN reconcile_mismatch item of the key pins its fact instead (explicit re-check,
//     any generation); 0 rows → left_missing, > 1 → left_ambiguous;
//  4. right match on the filer's facts (entity = CIK): the left row's source_concept in the same period and
//     unit, else the plan 2 fallback order (tagsOf) — first present tag, detail.tag_mismatch=true; none →
//     unsupported when the parser reported an unsupported fact of those tags for that period, else
//     right_missing; several distinct values → right_ambiguous (never quarantines);
//  5. exact comparison (tolerance 0: the iXBRL value is the filed value); action by actionFor (quarantine
//     only an ok left row, bound keys go back to their item). detail: left {fact_id, raw_hash, status,
//     precision.decimals = fraction digits of value_text}, right {document, sha256, path, locator {name,
//     contextRef, unitRef}, precision {decimals, scale}}, inputs_hash = computeInputsHash(left raw_hash, right
//     sha256, sample sha256, IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION).
// sec.filer_category is NOT recorded here: its single producer is scripts/dq/filer-categories.ts (Task 17b,
// spec §6.1; plan 3 接口对齐记录). filerClass stays exported for select-us-sample.ts.
import {conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS,tagsOf} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {createPacer,sleep} from '../../facts/providers/shared';
import type {FactRow} from '../../facts/types';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {compareDecimal} from './decimal';
import {computeInputsHash} from './inputs-hash';
import {IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION,IxbrlParseError,MAX_IXBRL_BYTES,indexIxFacts,ixFactKey,parseInlineXbrl} from './ixbrl';
import type {IxbrlDocument,IxFact} from './ixbrl';
import {ReconcileConfigError,actionFor,activeRows,comparedNumeric,factKeyOf,fractionDigits,mismatchItem,notCompared,openMismatches,readRepoJson} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import type {MemberPlan,PairContext,ReconcileOutcome,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';
import {US_SAMPLE_PATH,US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA,entityIs,usNaturalKey,validateUsSample} from './us-sample';
import type {SampleFiling,UsSample} from './us-sample';

const PAIR='us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl' as const;
const SIDES={left_source:'edgar.companyfacts',right_source:'edgar.ixbrl'};
const RESERVE_MS=10_000;
const pacer=createPacer(SEC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS);

export type DocFetch={status:'ok';bytes:Uint8Array}|{status:'not_found'}|{status:'too_large'};
export async function fetchSecDocument(url:string,ctx:PairContext):Promise<DocFetch>{
 const ua=process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
 for(let attempt=0;;attempt++){
  await pacer.admit({budget:ctx.budget,reserveMs:RESERVE_MS});
  const timeout=Math.min(60_000,ctx.budget.remainingMs()-RESERVE_MS);
  if(!(timeout>0))throw new Error('sec_unavailable:budget_exhausted');
  const res=await ctx.fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':ua,Accept:'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'},signal:AbortSignal.any([ctx.budget.signal,AbortSignal.timeout(timeout)])});
  if(res.status===404)return {status:'not_found'};
  if(res.status===429||res.status>=500){
   if(attempt<2){await sleep(1000*2**attempt,ctx.budget.signal);continue;}
   throw new Error(`sec_unavailable:http_${res.status}`);
  }
  if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`sec_unavailable:http_${res.status}`);
  if(Number(res.headers.get('content-length')??'0')>MAX_IXBRL_BYTES)return {status:'too_large'};
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
  return bytes.byteLength>MAX_IXBRL_BYTES?{status:'too_large'}:{status:'ok',bytes};
 }
}

/** §6.1 categories, case-insensitive; 'non-accelerated' is tested before 'accelerated'; SRC alone or unparseable → null. */
export function filerClass(text:string|null|undefined):'large_accelerated'|'accelerated'|'non_accelerated'|null{
 if(!text)return null;
 const t=text.toLowerCase();
 if(t.includes('large accelerated'))return 'large_accelerated';
 if(t.includes('non-accelerated')||t.includes('non accelerated'))return 'non_accelerated';
 if(t.includes('accelerated filer'))return 'accelerated';
 return null;
}

async function loadSample(ctx:PairContext):Promise<{sample:UsSample;sha256:string}>{
 const {json,sha256}=await readRepoJson(ctx,US_SAMPLE_PATH,'invalid_sample_file');
 const v=validateUsSample(json);
 if(!v.ok)throw new ReconcileConfigError('invalid_sample_file',v.errors.slice(0,5).join('; '));
 return {sample:v.sample,sha256};
}

type Right={kind:'ok';sha256:string;path:string;doc:IxbrlDocument;index:Map<string,{values:string[];facts:IxFact[]}>;shaMismatch:boolean}|{kind:'unsupported';reason:string;sha256:string};
async function rightSide(ctx:PairContext,f:SampleFiling,cik:string):Promise<Right>{
 if(f.is_inline_xbrl===false)return {kind:'unsupported',reason:'not_inline_xbrl',sha256:''};
 const got=await fetchSecDocument(f.doc_url,ctx);
 if(got.status!=='ok')return {kind:'unsupported',reason:got.status==='not_found'?'document_not_found':'document_too_large',sha256:''};
 const stored=await ctx.raw.put({kind:'sec-document',bytes:got.bytes,contentType:'text/html',meta:{url:f.doc_url,accn:f.accn}},ctx.budget);
 let doc:IxbrlDocument;
 try{doc=parseInlineXbrl(new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(got.bytes));}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof IxbrlParseError)return {kind:'unsupported',reason:`parse_error:${e.code}`,sha256:stored.sha256};throw e;}
 if(doc.unsupported.some(u=>u.reason==='not_inline_xbrl'))return {kind:'unsupported',reason:'not_inline_xbrl',sha256:stored.sha256};
 const filer=doc.facts.filter(x=>entityIs(x.entity,cik)).map(x=>({...x,entity:'filer'}));
 return {kind:'ok',sha256:stored.sha256,path:stored.path,doc,index:indexIxFacts(filer),shaMismatch:stored.sha256!==f.doc_sha256};
}

interface KeyLoc{cik:string;accn:string;concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;unit:string;source_concept:string;origin:string}

export function usCompanyfactsVsIxbrlPair():RegisteredPair{
 return {
  id:PAIR,kind:'numeric',left:'edgar.companyfacts',right:'edgar.ixbrl',
  inputs:{repoFile:US_SAMPLE_PATH,parserVersion:IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION,goldSchema:US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA},
  async members(ctx){
   const {sample}=await loadSample(ctx);
   const out:MemberPlan[]=[];
   for(const iss of sample.issuers){
    const [row]=await ctx.tables.select('issuers',{cik:iss.cik},{limit:1});
    if(!row)throw new ReconcileConfigError('issuer_unresolved',`cik ${iss.cik}`);
    out.push({issuerId:String(row.issuer_id),market:'US',expectedKeys:iss.filings.flatMap(f=>f.expected_keys.map(k=>({naturalKey:usNaturalKey(iss.cik,f.accn,k),locator:{cik:iss.cik,accn:f.accn,concept:k.concept,period_start:k.period_start,period_end:k.period_end,unit:k.unit,source_concept:k.source_concept,origin:k.origin}})))});
   }
   return out;
  },
  async evaluate(ctx,member){
   const {sample,sha256:sampleSha}=await loadSample(ctx);
   const open=await openMismatches(ctx.tables,PAIR,'US');
   const results:ReconcileResultInput[]=new Array(member.expectedKeys.length);
   const groups=new Map<string,number[]>();
   member.expectedKeys.forEach((k,i)=>{const loc=k.locator as unknown as KeyLoc;const g=`${loc.cik}|${loc.accn}`;groups.set(g,[...(groups.get(g)??[]),i]);});
   for(const [g,idxs] of groups){
    const [cik,accn]=g.split('|');
    const entry=sample.issuers.find(x=>x.cik===cik)?.filings.find(f=>f.accn===accn);
    const every=(outcome:Exclude<ReconcileOutcome,'compared'>,detail:Record<string,unknown>)=>{for(const i of idxs)results[i]=notCompared(member.expectedKeys[i].naturalKey,'numeric',outcome,SIDES,{accn,...detail});};
    if(!entry){every('unsupported',{reason:'sample_changed'});continue;}
    const filing=await ctx.db.findFilingBySourceRef('edgar',accn);
    if(!filing){every('left_unlinked',{});continue;}
    const right=await rightSide(ctx,entry,cik);
    const byKey=new Map<string,FactRow[]>();
    if(right.kind==='ok'||open.size>0)for(const r of activeRows(await ctx.db.readFilingFacts(filing.filing_id,true),filing)){const kf=factKeyOf(r);byKey.set(kf,[...(byKey.get(kf)??[]),r]);}
    for(const i of idxs){
     const k=member.expectedKeys[i];const loc=k.locator as unknown as KeyLoc;const nk=k.naturalKey;
     const bound=open.get(nk);
     const rows=bound?(await ctx.db.factsByIds([bound.factIds[0]])).slice(0,1):(byKey.get(factKeyOf(loc))??[]);
     const left=rows.length===1?rows[0]:null;
     const rightSha=right.sha256;
     const inputs_hash=computeInputsHash({left_raw_hash:left?.raw_hash??'',right_sha256:rightSha,gold_or_sample_sha256:sampleSha,parser_version:IXBRL_PARSER_VERSION});
     const base={accn,origin:loc.origin,unit:loc.unit,tolerance_rule:'exact/1',inputs_hash,
      left:left?{fact_id:left.fact_id,raw_hash:left.raw_hash,status:left.status,precision:{decimals:fractionDigits(left.value_text)}}:null};
     const backToItem=bound!==undefined&&left!==null;
     const nc=(outcome:Exclude<ReconcileOutcome,'compared'>,detail:Record<string,unknown>)=>notCompared(nk,'numeric',outcome,SIDES,{...base,...detail},{inputs_hash,...(left?{left_fact_id:left.fact_id}:{}),...(backToItem?{action:'quarantine_left' as const,item:mismatchItem(PAIR,nk,left!,null,{document:entry.doc_url,accn},inputs_hash)}:{})});
     if(right.kind==='unsupported'){results[i]=nc('unsupported',{reason:right.reason,right:{document:entry.doc_url,sha256:rightSha}});continue;}
     const rightBase={document:entry.doc_url,sha256:rightSha,path:right.path,...(right.shaMismatch?{doc_sha_mismatch:true}:{})};
     if(rows.length===0){results[i]=nc('left_missing',{right:rightBase});continue;}
     if(rows.length>1){results[i]=nc('left_ambiguous',{fact_ids:rows.map(r=>r.fact_id),right:rightBase});continue;}
     const l=left!;
     const def=conceptById(loc.concept);
     const tags=[l.source_concept,...(def?tagsOf(def):[]).filter(t=>t!==l.source_concept)];
     let hit:{values:string[];facts:IxFact[]}|undefined;let tag:string|undefined;
     for(const t of tags){const h=right.index.get(ixFactKey({name:t,entity:'filer',periodStart:loc.period_start,periodEnd:loc.period_end,unit:loc.unit}));if(h){hit=h;tag=t;break;}}
     if(!hit||tag===undefined){
      const u=right.doc.unsupported.find(x=>x.name!==undefined&&tags.includes(x.name)&&x.periodEnd===loc.period_end&&(x.periodStart??null)===loc.period_start);
      results[i]=u?nc('unsupported',{reason:u.reason,right:{...rightBase,locator:{name:u.name,contextRef:u.contextRef}}}):nc('right_missing',{right:rightBase});
      continue;
     }
     const first=hit.facts[0];
     const locator={name:tag,contextRef:first.contextRef,unitRef:first.unitRef};
     if(hit.values.length>1){results[i]=nc('right_ambiguous',{right:{...rightBase,locator,values:hit.values}});continue;}
     const rv=hit.values[0];
     const passed=compareDecimal(l.value,rv)===0;
     const action=actionFor({bound:bound!==undefined,leftStatus:l.status,compared:true,passed,onFail:'quarantine_left'});
     results[i]=comparedNumeric(nk,l.value,rv,{passed,tolerance:'0',sides:SIDES,inputs_hash,left_fact_id:l.fact_id,action,
      detail:{...base,right:{...rightBase,locator,precision:{decimals:first.decimals,scale:first.scale}},scale:first.scale,...(tag!==l.source_concept?{tag_mismatch:true}:{})},
      ...(action==='record'?{}:{item:mismatchItem(PAIR,nk,l,rv,{...locator,document:entry.doc_url},inputs_hash)})});
    }
   }
   return results;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/us-sample-v1.test.ts
// Offline consistency of the fixture sample v1 (no database): for every expected key of every filing, the
// companyfacts fixture value of that accession and the recorded iXBRL document value must be equal, and every
// key must be present on both sides — unless the key is listed with an explanation in
// us-ixbrl-sample-v1.exceptions.json. This is the cheap pre-check of the "all passed" assertion of
// ixbrl-pair.integration.test.ts; an exception is never added to make a test pass, only to register an
// explained, real discrepancy (each one is also written up in the E4 audit note).
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {parseCompanyFacts,tagsOf} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {snapshotOf} from '../../facts/providers/shared';
import {compareDecimal} from './decimal';
import {indexIxFacts,parseInlineXbrl} from './ixbrl';
import {US_SAMPLE_PATH,entityIs,usNaturalKey,validateUsSample} from './us-sample';

const read=(p:string)=>readFileSync(p);
const FIXTURE:Record<string,{companyfacts:string;doc:string}>={
 '0000320193-23-000106':{companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000320193.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/aapl-20230930.trimmed.htm'},
 '0000950170-23-035122':{companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000789019.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/msft-20230630.trimmed.htm'},
};
interface Exception{natural_key:string;outcome:string;explanation:string}
const EXCEPTIONS=JSON.parse(readFileSync('src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/us-ixbrl-sample-v1.exceptions.json','utf8')) as Exception[];

describe('us-ixbrl-sample-v1 (fixture sample, offline)',()=>{
 const v=validateUsSample(JSON.parse(readFileSync(US_SAMPLE_PATH,'utf8')));
 it('is a valid manifest with AAPL and MSFT FY2023 10-Ks',()=>{
  expect(v.ok).toBe(true);
  if(!v.ok)return;
  expect(v.sample.selection).toBe('fixture/1');
  expect(v.sample.issuers.map(i=>[i.ticker,i.filings.map(f=>f.accn)])).toEqual([['AAPL',['0000320193-23-000106']],['MSFT',['0000950170-23-035122']]]);
  for(const e of EXCEPTIONS)expect(e.explanation.trim().length,`${e.natural_key}: explanation`).toBeGreaterThan(20);
 });
 it('every expected key has equal values on both sides, except the registered, explained exceptions',()=>{
  if(!v.ok)throw new Error('invalid sample');
  const found:{natural_key:string;outcome:string}[]=[];
  for(const iss of v.sample.issuers)for(const f of iss.filings){
   const fx=FIXTURE[f.accn];
   const parse=parseCompanyFacts(snapshotOf(new Uint8Array(read(fx.companyfacts)),{source:'edgar'}),{sinceYear:2016});
   const left=new Map(parse.candidates.filter(c=>c.filingRef===f.accn).map(c=>[`${c.concept}|${c.periodStart??''}|${c.periodEnd}|${c.unit}`,c]));
   const doc=parseInlineXbrl(read(fx.doc).toString('utf8'));
   const idx=indexIxFacts(doc.facts.filter(x=>entityIs(x.entity,iss.cik)).map(x=>({...x,entity:'filer'})));
   for(const k of f.expected_keys){
    const nk=usNaturalKey(iss.cik,f.accn,k);
    const l=left.get(`${k.concept}|${k.period_start??''}|${k.period_end}|${k.unit}`);
    if(!l){found.push({natural_key:nk,outcome:'left_missing'});continue;}
    const def=conceptById(k.concept)!;
    const tags=[l.sourceConcept,...tagsOf(def).filter(t=>t!==l.sourceConcept)];
    const hit=tags.map(t=>idx.get([t,'filer',k.period_start??'',k.period_end,k.unit].join('|'))).find(h=>h!==undefined);
    if(!hit){
     const unsupported=doc.unsupported.some(u=>u.name!==undefined&&tags.includes(u.name)&&u.periodEnd===k.period_end&&(u.periodStart??null)===k.period_start);
     found.push({natural_key:nk,outcome:unsupported?'unsupported':'right_missing'});continue;
    }
    if(hit.values.length>1){found.push({natural_key:nk,outcome:'right_ambiguous'});continue;}
    if(compareDecimal(l.value,hit.values[0])!==0)found.push({natural_key:nk,outcome:'compared_failed'});
   }
  }
  expect(found).toEqual(EXCEPTIONS.map(({natural_key,outcome})=>({natural_key,outcome})));
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现样本脚本**

```ts
// scripts/dq/select-us-sample.ts
/**
 * Builds the US iXBRL sample manifest (spec §5.3).
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/dq/select-us-sample.ts --fixtures [--out src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/us-ixbrl-sample-v1.json] [--generated-at <ISO>]
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/select-us-sample.ts --live --universe <sp500 payload.json> --out <path> [--n 30]
 *
 * --fixtures (offline, deterministic): plan 2's companyfacts fixtures of AAPL and MSFT and the recorded trimmed
 * primary documents of their FY2023 10-Ks (record-ixbrl-fixture.ts) → selection 'fixture/1', sinceYear 2016.
 * doc_sha256 = the SOURCE document sha256 from the recording meta (the trimmed copy differs; the pair then marks
 * detail.right.doc_sha_mismatch); is_inline_xbrl, submissions_category and primary_document come from the
 * recorded submissions entry.
 * --live (network, never in CI): candidates = universe constituents ∩ SEC company_tickers.json (ticker → CIK);
 * required = the US tickers of plan2.json; per candidate the submissions JSON gives fiscalYearEnd, category,
 * exchanges and recent filings; pickSample(n) applies the quotas; per picked issuer: regime = latest annual form
 * (10-K or 20-F); filings = latest inline 10-K + latest inline 10-Q, or latest inline 20-F; companyfacts and each
 * primary document are fetched and buildSampleFiling derives the keys → selection 'live/1'. A filing whose sides
 * are too small is skipped with a warning; unmet quotas are printed and give exit code 1 (the file is still
 * written for review).
 * The manifest is validated before it is written. Exit 0 ok, 1 on failure or unmet quota, 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {fetchCompanyFacts} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {budgetFor,padCik,snapshotOf} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import {DEFAULT_USER_AGENT} from '../../src/lib/research/ingest/collectors/shared';
import {filerClass} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-us-ixbrl';
import {US_GOLD_PATH,usGoldEntries} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-us-gold';
import {US_SAMPLE_PATH,US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA,buildSampleFiling,pickSample,validateUsSample} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/us-sample';
import type {SampleCandidate,SampleFiling,SampleIssuer,UsSample} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/us-sample';

const USAGE='usage: select-us-sample.ts (--fixtures [--out <path>] [--generated-at <ISO>] | --live --universe <path> --out <path> [--n 30])';
const FIXTURE_SINCE_YEAR=2016;
const FIXTURES=[
 {ticker:'AAPL',cik:'320193',accn:'0000320193-23-000106',companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000320193.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/aapl-20230930.trimmed.htm'},
 {ticker:'MSFT',cik:'789019',accn:'0000950170-23-035122',companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000789019.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/msft-20230630.trimmed.htm'},
] as const;
interface RecordingMeta{source_url:string;source_sha256:string;submissions:{form:string|null;reportDate:string|null;primaryDocument:string;isInlineXBRL:boolean;category:string|null}}

function fixtureSample(generatedAt:string):UsSample{
 const issuers:SampleIssuer[]=FIXTURES.map(fx=>{
  const meta=JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${fx.doc}.meta.json`,'utf8')) as RecordingMeta;
  const filing=buildSampleFiling({cik:fx.cik,accn:fx.accn,form:meta.submissions.form??'10-K',period_end:meta.submissions.reportDate,primary_document:meta.submissions.primaryDocument,doc_url:meta.source_url,
   is_inline_xbrl:meta.submissions.isInlineXBRL,submissions_category:meta.submissions.category,companyfacts:snapshotOf(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(fx.companyfacts)),{source:'edgar'}),
   doc:new Uint8Array(readFileSync(fx.doc)),doc_sha256:meta.source_sha256,sinceYear:FIXTURE_SINCE_YEAR});
  return {cik:fx.cik,ticker:fx.ticker,regime:'10-K',filings:[filing]};
 });
 return {schema:US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA,generated_at:generatedAt,selection:'fixture/1',issuers};
}

const UA=process.env.EDGAR_USER_AGENT??DEFAULT_USER_AGENT;
const pause=(ms:number)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
async function get(url:string):Promise<Uint8Array>{
 await pause(150);
 const res=await fetch(url,{headers:{'User-Agent':UA},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(60_000)});
 if(!res.ok)throw new Error(`http_${res.status} ${url}`);
 return new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer());
}
const json=async<T>(url:string)=>JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await get(url))) as T;
interface Submissions{category?:string;fiscalYearEnd?:string;exchanges?:string[];filings?:{recent?:Record<string,unknown[]>}}
interface Recent{accn:string;form:string;filingDate:string;reportDate:string|null;primaryDocument:string;inline:boolean}
function recentOf(s:Submissions):Recent[]{
 const r=s.filings?.recent??{};const n=(r.accessionNumber??[]).length;const out:Recent[]=[];
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++)out.push({accn:String(r.accessionNumber![i]),form:String(r.form?.[i]??''),filingDate:String(r.filingDate?.[i]??''),reportDate:r.reportDate?.[i]?String(r.reportDate[i]):null,primaryDocument:String(r.primaryDocument?.[i]??''),inline:r.isInlineXBRL?.[i]===1||r.isInlineXBRL?.[i]===true});
 return out.sort((a,b)=>a.filingDate<b.filingDate?1:a.filingDate>b.filingDate?-1:0);
}

async function liveSample(universePath:string,n:number):Promise<{sample:UsSample;unmet:string[];warnings:string[]}>{
 const universe=JSON.parse(readFileSync(universePath,'utf8')) as {constituents:{ticker:string;exchange?:string}[]};
 const tickers=await json<Record<string,{cik_str:number;ticker:string}>>('https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json');
 const cikOf=new Map(Object.values(tickers).map(t=>[t.ticker.toUpperCase(),String(t.cik_str)]));
 const required=usGoldEntries(JSON.parse(readFileSync(US_GOLD_PATH,'utf8'))).entries.map(e=>e.ticker);
 const subs=new Map<string,Submissions>();const candidates:SampleCandidate[]=[];const warnings:string[]=[];
 for(const c of universe.constituents){
  const ticker=c.ticker.toUpperCase().replace(/\./g,'-');const cik=cikOf.get(ticker);
  if(!cik){warnings.push(`no CIK for ${c.ticker}`);continue;}
  const s=await json<Submissions>(`https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK${padCik(cik)}.json`).catch(e=>{warnings.push(`${ticker}: ${(e as Error).message}`);return null;});
  if(!s)continue;
  subs.set(cik,s);
  candidates.push({ticker,cik,exchange:c.exchange==='NASDAQ'?'Nasdaq':c.exchange??s.exchanges?.[0]??null,fiscalYearEnd:s.fiscalYearEnd??null,acceleration:filerClass(s.category)});
 }
 const {picked,unmet}=pickSample(candidates,required,n);
 const sinceYear=new Date().getUTCFullYear()-10;
 const issuers:SampleIssuer[]=[];
 for(const p of picked){
  const s=subs.get(p.cik)!;const recent=recentOf(s).filter(r=>r.inline);
  const annual=recent.find(r=>r.form==='10-K'||r.form==='20-F');
  if(!annual){warnings.push(`${p.ticker}: no inline 10-K/20-F in filings.recent`);continue;}
  const regime=annual.form as '10-K'|'20-F';
  const chosen=regime==='10-K'?[annual,recent.find(r=>r.form==='10-Q')].filter((x):x is Recent=>!!x):[annual];
  const companyfacts=await fetchCompanyFacts(padCik(p.cik),budgetFor(120_000));
  const filings:SampleFiling[]=[];
  for(const r of chosen){
   const url=`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/${p.cik}/${r.accn.replace(/-/g,'')}/${r.primaryDocument}`;
   try{filings.push(buildSampleFiling({cik:p.cik,accn:r.accn,form:r.form,period_end:r.reportDate,primary_document:r.primaryDocument,doc_url:url,is_inline_xbrl:r.inline,submissions_category:s.category??null,companyfacts,doc:await get(url),sinceYear}));}
   catch(e){warnings.push(`${p.ticker} ${r.accn}: ${(e as Error).message}`);}
  }
  if(filings.length>0)issuers.push({cik:p.cik,ticker:p.ticker,regime,filings});
 }
 return {sample:{schema:US_SAMPLE_SCHEMA,generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),selection:'live/1',issuers},unmet,warnings};
}

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let mode:''|'fixtures'|'live'='';let out='';let universe='';let n=30;let generatedAt=new Date().toISOString();
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(x==='--fixtures')mode='fixtures';
  else if(x==='--live')mode='live';
  else if(x==='--out'&&v){out=v;i++;}
  else if(x==='--universe'&&v){universe=v;i++;}
  else if(x==='--n'&&v&&/^\d{1,3}$/.test(v)){n=Number(v);i++;}
  else if(x==='--generated-at'&&v&&!Number.isNaN(Date.parse(v))){generatedAt=v;i++;}
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(mode===''||(mode==='live'&&(!universe||!out))){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 let sample:UsSample;let unmet:string[]=[];let warnings:string[]=[];
 if(mode==='fixtures'){sample=fixtureSample(generatedAt);out||=US_SAMPLE_PATH;}
 else ({sample,unmet,warnings}=await liveSample(universe,n));
 const v=validateUsSample(sample);
 if(!v.ok){console.error(JSON.stringify({invalid:v.errors}));process.exit(1);}
 writeFileSync(out,`${JSON.stringify(sample,null,1)}\n`);
 for(const w of warnings)console.error(`warning: ${w}`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({out,selection:sample.selection,issuers:sample.issuers.length,filings:sample.issuers.reduce((k,i)=>k+i.filings.length,0),keys:sample.issuers.reduce((k,i)=>k+i.filings.reduce((m,f)=>m+f.expected_keys.length,0),0),unmet}));
 process.exit(unmet.length>0?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```
