```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/ixbrl-pair.integration.test.ts
// Spec §9.3 (critical): us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl on real PostgreSQL with pgFactsDb + pgTableClient.
//  1. AAPL and MSFT FY2023 10-K fixtures (plan-2 companyfacts + recorded trimmed primary documents, re-keyed onto
//     synthetic CIKs/accessions) are synced and reconciled: every expected key has exactly one result row and
//     every key passes except the registered, explained exceptions (us-ixbrl-sample-v1.exceptions.json);
//  2. a synthetic issuer ZQZZ whose companyfacts revenue is injected (1001 vs the document's 1000): mismatch →
//     reconcile_mismatch item + left quarantined (one transaction) → invisible to read_facts → materialized
//     metrics drop the dependent ratio;
//  3. restore before a passing re-run → not_passing;
//  4. the right document is corrected (1001), a new cycle passes, latest_result.passed with inputs_hash equal to
//     the restore-side recomputation; a changed sample after the pass → not_passing; then restore_reconciled
//     promotes the row, it is current again and the metric comes back after materialize.
// The cases share state and run in order.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../../db/pg-table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {FORMULA_VERSION,materialize} from '../../facts/derive';
import {pgFactsDb} from '../../facts/pg-facts-db';
import {companyFactsUrl,parseCompanyFacts} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {ProviderError,snapshotOf} from '../../facts/providers/shared';
import {memorySnapshotStore} from '../../facts/snapshot-store';
import {makeBudget,runFactsSync} from '../../facts/sync';
import type {SyncDeps} from '../../facts/sync';
import type {FactsDb,RawSnapshot} from '../../facts/types';
import {startBatch} from '../batches';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../raw-store';
import {usCompanyfactsVsIxbrlPair} from './pair-us-ixbrl';
import {inputsHashNow} from './pairs';
import {runReconcile} from './run';
import type {ReconcileDeps} from './run';
import type {PairContext} from './types';
import {US_SAMPLE_PATH,buildSampleFiling} from './us-sample';
import type {UsSample} from './us-sample';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const PAIR='us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl' as const;
const ADMIN=randomUUID();
const enc=(s:string)=>new TextEncoder().encode(s);
const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

// ---- identity re-keying (bijective; keeps this suite disjoint from sync-us.integration.test.ts) ----
const rekeyCik=(cik:string)=>`99${cik}`;
const rekeyAccn=(a:string)=>{if(!/^00\d{8}-\d{2}-\d{6}$/.test(a))throw new Error(`unexpected accession ${a}`);return `99${a.slice(2)}`;};
const unkey=(nk:string)=>nk.replace(/^99(\d+):99(\d{8}-\d{2}-\d{6})/,(_m,c:string,a:string)=>`${c}:00${a}`);
function rekeyCompanyfacts(path:string,cik:string):Uint8Array{
 let t=readFileSync(path,'utf8');
 t=t.replace(/"accn"(\s*):(\s*)"(\d{10}-\d{2}-\d{6})"/g,(_m,a:string,b:string,accn:string)=>`"accn"${a}:${b}"${rekeyAccn(accn)}"`);
 const before=t;t=t.replace(new RegExp(`"cik"(\\s*):(\\s*)${cik}\\b`),(_m,a:string,b:string)=>`"cik"${a}:${b}${rekeyCik(cik)}`);
 if(t===before)throw new Error(`cik ${cik} not found in ${path}`);
 return enc(t);
}
const rekeyDoc=(path:string,cik:string)=>enc(readFileSync(path,'utf8').replaceAll(`>${cik.padStart(10,'0')}<`,`>${rekeyCik(cik).padStart(10,'0')}<`));

const REAL=[
 {ticker:'ZQAA',cik:'320193',companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000320193.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/aapl-20230930.trimmed.htm'},
 {ticker:'ZQMS',cik:'789019',companyfacts:'src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000789019.trimmed.json',doc:'src/lib/dq/fixtures/ixbrl/msft-20230630.trimmed.htm'},
] as const;
interface Exception{natural_key:string;outcome:string;explanation:string}
const EXCEPTIONS=JSON.parse(readFileSync('src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/us-ixbrl-sample-v1.exceptions.json','utf8')) as Exception[];

// ---- synthetic issuer with an injected companyfacts value ----
const ZZ={ticker:'ZQZZ',cik:'9990003',name:'ZQ Reconcile Co'};
const ZZ_ACCN='0009990003-25-000001';
const ZZ_URL=`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/${ZZ.cik}/${ZZ_ACCN.replace(/-/g,'')}/zq-20241231.htm`;
const cfe=(start:string|undefined,end:string,val:number)=>({...(start?{start}:{}),end,val,accn:ZZ_ACCN,fy:2024,fp:'FY',form:'10-K',filed:'2025-02-15'});
const zzCompanyfacts=()=>enc(JSON.stringify({cik:Number(ZZ.cik),entityName:ZZ.name,facts:{'us-gaap':{
 Revenues:{units:{USD:[cfe('2024-01-01','2024-12-31',1001)]}},            // injected: the filed document says 1000
 NetIncomeLoss:{units:{USD:[cfe('2024-01-01','2024-12-31',100)]}},
 Assets:{units:{USD:[cfe(undefined,'2024-12-31',5000)]}},
 StockholdersEquity:{units:{USD:[cfe(undefined,'2024-12-31',2000)]}},
}}}));
const H='<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:ix="http://www.xbrl.org/2013/inlineXBRL" xmlns:xbrli="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/instance" xmlns:iso4217="http://www.xbrl.org/2003/iso4217" xmlns:us-gaap="http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2024" xmlns:dei="http://xbrl.sec.gov/dei/2024">';
const zctx=(id:string,period:string)=>`<xbrli:context id="${id}"><xbrli:entity><xbrli:identifier scheme="http://www.sec.gov/CIK">000${ZZ.cik}</xbrli:identifier></xbrli:entity><xbrli:period>${period}</xbrli:period></xbrli:context>`;
const znf=(name:string,c:string,v:string)=>`<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:${name}" contextRef="${c}" unitRef="usd">${v}</ix:nonFraction>`;
const zzDoc=(revenue:string)=>enc(`${H}<body><ix:header><ix:resources>${zctx('d','<xbrli:startDate>2024-01-01</xbrli:startDate><xbrli:endDate>2024-12-31</xbrli:endDate>')}${zctx('i','<xbrli:instant>2024-12-31</xbrli:instant>')}<xbrli:unit id="usd"><xbrli:measure>iso4217:USD</xbrli:measure></xbrli:unit></ix:resources></ix:header>`
 +'<ix:nonNumeric name="dei:EntityFilerCategory" contextRef="d">Non-accelerated Filer</ix:nonNumeric>'
 +znf('Revenues','d',revenue)+znf('NetIncomeLoss','d','100')+znf('Assets','i','5,000')+znf('StockholdersEquity','i','2,000')+'</body></html>');

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('us.companyfacts_vs_ixbrl on real PostgreSQL (§9.3)',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let db:FactsDb;let tables:TableClient;
 const ids:Record<string,string>={};
 const docs=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();
 let sampleBytes=new Uint8Array();let firstCycle='';let scope:{issuer_id:string;fetch_key:string}[]=[];
 const fakeFetch=(async(url:string|URL)=>{const b=docs.get(String(url));return b?new Response(b,{status:200}):new Response('',{status:404});}) as unknown as typeof fetch;
 const readRepoFile=async(p:string)=>p===US_SAMPLE_PATH?sampleBytes:new Uint8Array(readFileSync(p));
 const rdeps=():ReconcileDeps=>({db,tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),fetch:fakeFetch,readRepoFile,now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:'test',pairs:{[PAIR]:usCompanyfactsVsIxbrlPair()}});
 const pairCtx=(over:Partial<PairContext>={}):PairContext=>({db,tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),now:()=>new Date(),budget:makeBudget(null),fetch:fakeFetch,readRepoFile,...over});
 const q=(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>admin.query(text,values).then(r=>r.rows);
 function buildSample(zzRevenue:string):Uint8Array{
  const v1=JSON.parse(readFileSync(US_SAMPLE_PATH,'utf8')) as UsSample;
  const issuers=v1.issuers.filter(i=>REAL.some(r=>r.cik===i.cik)).map(i=>({...i,cik:rekeyCik(i.cik),
   filings:i.filings.map(f=>({...f,accn:rekeyAccn(f.accn),doc_url:f.doc_url.replace(`/data/${i.cik}/`,`/data/${rekeyCik(i.cik)}/`).replace(f.accn.replace(/-/g,''),rekeyAccn(f.accn).replace(/-/g,''))}))}));
  const zz=buildSampleFiling({cik:ZZ.cik,accn:ZZ_ACCN,form:'10-K',period_end:'2024-12-31',primary_document:'zq-20241231.htm',doc_url:ZZ_URL,is_inline_xbrl:true,submissions_category:'Non-accelerated filer',
   companyfacts:snapshotOf(zzCompanyfacts(),{source:'edgar'}),doc:zzDoc(zzRevenue),sinceYear:2016});
  return enc(JSON.stringify({...v1,issuers:[...issuers,{cik:ZZ.cik,ticker:ZZ.ticker,regime:'10-K',filings:[zz]}]}));
 }
 const revFactId=async()=>(await q(`select fact_id from public.financial_facts where issuer_id=$1 and concept='revenue'`,[ids.ZZ]))[0].fact_id as string;
 const zzItem=async()=>(await q(`select id,status,dataset,detail,payload from public.dq_quarantine where reason_code='reconcile_mismatch' and detail->>'pair'=$1 and payload->'fact_ids'->>0=$2`,[PAIR,await revFactId()]))[0] as {id:string;status:string;dataset:string;detail:Record<string,any>;payload:Record<string,any>};
 const netMargin=async()=>(await db.metricsOfIssuer(ids.ZZ,'US',FORMULA_VERSION)).find(m=>m.metric==='net_margin'&&m.duration==='12M');

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});db=pgFactsDb(admin);tables=pgTableClient(admin);
  expect((await q(`select count(*)::int as n from public.dq_reconcile_cycles where pair=$1 and status='running'`,[PAIR]))[0].n,'a foreign running cycle of this pair (contract note 14)').toBe(0);
  const provision=async(ticker:string,cik:string,name:string)=>{
   await q(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,$2,'US') on conflict (ticker) do nothing`,[ticker,name]);
   await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en,country_code,cik) values($1,$2,'US',$3) on conflict do nothing`,[randomUUID(),name,cik]);
   const id=(await q(`select issuer_id from public.issuers where cik=$1`,[cik]))[0].issuer_id as string;
   await q(`insert into public.issuer_securities(issuer_id,ticker,share_class,is_primary,valid_from,source) values($1,$2,'common',true,'2000-01-01','test') on conflict do nothing`,[id,ticker]);
   return id;
  };
  const fixtures=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();
  for(const r of REAL){ids[r.ticker]=await provision(r.ticker,rekeyCik(r.cik),`${r.ticker} fixture copy`);fixtures.set(rekeyCik(r.cik).padStart(10,'0'),rekeyCompanyfacts(r.companyfacts,r.cik));}
  ids.ZZ=await provision(ZZ.ticker,ZZ.cik,ZZ.name);fixtures.set(ZZ.cik.padStart(10,'0'),zzCompanyfacts());
  scope=Object.entries(ids).map(([t,id])=>({issuer_id:id,fetch_key:(t==='ZZ'?ZZ.cik:rekeyCik(REAL.find(r=>r.ticker===t)!.cik)).padStart(10,'0')}));
  await db.reconcileScope('US',scope.map(x=>({...x,reasons:['test'],priority:10})));
  await q(`update public.fact_sync_scope set next_due_at='2999-01-01' where issuer_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[Object.values(ids)]);
  const deps:SyncDeps={db,tables,storage:memorySnapshotStore(),
   fetchUs:async(cik10:string):Promise<RawSnapshot>=>{const b=fixtures.get(cik10);if(!b)throw new ProviderError('no_companyfacts',cik10);return snapshotOf(b,{source:'edgar',url:companyFactsUrl(cik10)});},
   fetchCn:async()=>{throw new ProviderError('tushare_unavailable','not in this suite');},
   parseUs:(snapshot,o)=>parseCompanyFacts(snapshot,{sinceYear:o.sinceYear}),
   parseCn:()=>{throw new ProviderError('parse_error','not in this suite');},
   now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:'test'};
  const sync=await runFactsSync(deps,{market:'US',limit:10,issuerIds:Object.values(ids),dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script',mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN});
  expect(sync.detail).toMatchObject({published:Object.keys(ids).length,failed:0});
  for(const r of REAL){
   const meta=JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${r.doc}.meta.json`,'utf8')) as {source_url:string};
   const accn=meta.source_url.split('/')[7];   // 10+2+6 digits without dashes
   docs.set(meta.source_url.replace(`/data/${r.cik}/`,`/data/${rekeyCik(r.cik)}/`).replace(accn,`99${accn.slice(2)}`),rekeyDoc(r.doc,r.cik));
  }
  docs.set(ZZ_URL,zzDoc('1,000'));
  sampleBytes=buildSample('1,000');
 },180_000);
 afterAll(async()=>{
  if(db&&scope.length>0)await db.reconcileScope('US',scope.map(x=>({...x,reasons:[],priority:0}))).catch(()=>{});
  await admin?.end();
 });

 it('every expected key gets exactly one result; AAPL/MSFT copies pass except registered exceptions; the injected ZZ revenue is quarantined, invisible and rematerialized',async()=>{
  await materialize(db,ids.ZZ,'US');
  expect((await netMargin())?.value).toBe('0.0999000999');   // 100 / 1001 before reconciliation
  const r1=await runReconcile(rdeps(),{pair:PAIR,triggeredBy:'script'});
  firstCycle=r1.cycle!.cycleId;
  expect(r1.cycle).toMatchObject({created:true,settled:true});
  expect(r1.members.every(m=>m.outcome==='done')).toBe(true);
  const rows=await q(`select natural_key,outcome,passed,issuer_id from public.dq_reconciliations where pair=$1 and cycle_id=$2`,[PAIR,firstCycle]) as {natural_key:string;outcome:string;passed:boolean;issuer_id:string}[];
  expect(rows.length).toBe(r1.cycle!.expectedTotal);
  expect(new Set(rows.map(r=>r.natural_key)).size).toBe(rows.length);
  const byKey=(a:{natural_key:string},b:{natural_key:string})=>a.natural_key<b.natural_key?-1:1;
  const realFailures=rows.filter(r=>r.issuer_id!==ids.ZZ&&!r.passed).map(r=>({natural_key:unkey(r.natural_key),outcome:r.outcome==='compared'?'compared_failed':r.outcome})).sort(byKey);
  expect(realFailures).toEqual(EXCEPTIONS.map(({natural_key,outcome})=>({natural_key,outcome})).sort(byKey));
  expect(rows.filter(r=>r.issuer_id!==ids.ZZ).length).toBeGreaterThan(REAL.length*20);
  expect(r1.cycle!.status).toBe(EXCEPTIONS.some(e=>e.outcome!=='compared_failed')?'complete_with_gaps':'complete');
  const zzRows=rows.filter(r=>r.issuer_id===ids.ZZ).sort(byKey);
  expect(zzRows.map(r=>[r.natural_key.split(':')[2],r.outcome,r.passed])).toEqual([['equity_parent','compared',true],['net_income_parent','compared',true],['revenue','compared',false],['total_assets','compared',true]]);
  const item=await zzItem();
  expect(item).toMatchObject({status:'open',dataset:'facts.us'});
  expect(item.detail.hook.state).toBe('done');
  expect(item.detail.latest_result).toMatchObject({passed:false});
  expect((await q(`select status from public.financial_facts where fact_id=$1`,[await revFactId()]))[0].status).toBe('quarantined');
  const visible=await db.readFacts(ids.ZZ,'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:today()});
  expect(visible.rows.filter(r=>r.period_end==='2024-12-31')).toEqual([]);
  expect(await netMargin()).toBeUndefined();
  const [rev]=await db.stateRevs([ids.ZZ],'US');
  const metric=(await db.metricsOfIssuer(ids.ZZ,'US',FORMULA_VERSION))[0];
  if(metric)expect(metric.based_on_lineage).toEqual([{issuer_id:ids.ZZ,state_rev:rev.state_rev}]);
 },300_000);

 it('restore is refused while the latest result is not passing',async()=>{
  const item=await zzItem();
  const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'dq-resolver',dataset:'facts.us'});
  await expect(db.restoreReconciled(item.id,batchId,await inputsHashNow(pairCtx(),item),ADMIN)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'not_passing'});
  expect((await zzItem()).status).toBe('open');
 });

 it('a corrected right document passes in a new cycle; restore needs the current inputs hash, promotes the row and the metric returns',async()=>{
  docs.set(ZZ_URL,zzDoc('1,001'));sampleBytes=buildSample('1,001');
  const r2=await runReconcile(rdeps(),{pair:PAIR,triggeredBy:'script'});
  expect(r2.cycle).toMatchObject({created:true,settled:true});expect(r2.cycle!.cycleId).not.toBe(firstCycle);
  const item=await zzItem();
  expect(item.status).toBe('open');
  expect(item.detail.latest_result).toMatchObject({passed:true});
  const hashNow=await inputsHashNow(pairCtx(),item);
  expect(item.detail.latest_result.inputs_hash).toBe(hashNow);
  const changed=await inputsHashNow(pairCtx({readRepoFile:async p=>p===US_SAMPLE_PATH?enc(`${new TextDecoder().decode(sampleBytes)} `):new Uint8Array(readFileSync(p))}),item);
  expect(changed).not.toBe(hashNow);
  const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'dq-resolver',dataset:'facts.us'});
  await expect(db.restoreReconciled(item.id,batchId,changed,ADMIN)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'not_passing'});
  const res=await db.restoreReconciled(item.id,batchId,hashNow,ADMIN);
  expect(res).toEqual({promoted:1,skipped:[]});
  expect((await zzItem()).status).toBe('resolved_accept');
  const visible=await db.readFacts(ids.ZZ,'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:today()});
  expect(visible.rows.filter(r=>r.period_end==='2024-12-31'&&r.is_current).map(r=>r.value)).toEqual(['1001']);
  await materialize(db,ids.ZZ,'US');
  expect((await netMargin())?.value).toBe('0.0999000999');
 },300_000);
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/lineage.integration.test.ts
// Spec §9.3 (critical): facts.lineage_same_day on real PostgreSQL. Two synthetic issuers disclose FY2023
// revenue on the same day with different values; after set_merge(source → target) the lineage read reports the
// conflict and suppresses the current value; the pair writes a failed result and a lineage_conflict item;
// resolve_lineage_conflict keeps the target's row (the other is quarantined), the conflict disappears, the kept
// value is current again with its recorded issuer, and materialize writes metrics whose based_on_lineage holds
// both members' state revisions.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../../db/pg-table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '../../db/table-client';
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {FORMULA_VERSION,materialize} from '../../facts/derive';
import {pgFactsDb} from '../../facts/pg-facts-db';
import {companyFactsUrl,parseCompanyFacts} from '../../facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {ProviderError,snapshotOf} from '../../facts/providers/shared';
import {memorySnapshotStore} from '../../facts/snapshot-store';
import {runFactsSync} from '../../facts/sync';
import type {FactsDb,RawSnapshot} from '../../facts/types';
import {startBatch} from '../batches';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../raw-store';
import {lineageSameDayPair} from './pair-lineage';
import {runReconcile} from './run';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const PAIR='facts.lineage_same_day' as const;
const ADMIN=randomUUID();
const S={ticker:'ZQLS',cik:'9990011',name:'ZQ Lineage Source',accn:'0009990011-24-000001',revenue:1000};
const T={ticker:'ZQLT',cik:'9990012',name:'ZQ Lineage Target',accn:'0009990012-24-000001',revenue:1200};
const doc=(x:typeof S,withNetIncome:boolean)=>new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({cik:Number(x.cik),entityName:x.name,facts:{'us-gaap':{
 Revenues:{units:{USD:[{start:'2023-01-01',end:'2023-12-31',val:x.revenue,accn:x.accn,fy:2023,fp:'FY',form:'10-K',filed:'2024-02-15'}]}},
 ...(withNetIncome?{NetIncomeLoss:{units:{USD:[{start:'2023-01-01',end:'2023-12-31',val:120,accn:x.accn,fy:2023,fp:'FY',form:'10-K',filed:'2024-02-15'}]}}}:{}),
}}}));
const K='revenue:2023-01-01:2023-12-31:consolidated:USD';

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('facts.lineage_same_day on real PostgreSQL (§9.3)',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let db:FactsDb;let tables:TableClient;let s='';let t='';
 const q=(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>admin.query(text,values).then(r=>r.rows);
 const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const factOf=async(issuer:string)=>(await q(`select fact_id from public.financial_facts where issuer_id=$1 and concept='revenue'`,[issuer]))[0].fact_id as string;
 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});db=pgFactsDb(admin);tables=pgTableClient(admin);
  expect((await q(`select count(*)::int as n from public.dq_reconcile_cycles where pair=$1 and status='running'`,[PAIR]))[0].n,'a foreign running cycle of this pair (contract note 14)').toBe(0);
  const provision=async(x:typeof S)=>{
   await q(`insert into public.stocks_universe(ticker,name,market) values($1,$2,'US') on conflict (ticker) do nothing`,[x.ticker,x.name]);
   await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en,country_code,cik) values($1,$2,'US',$3) on conflict do nothing`,[randomUUID(),x.name,x.cik]);
   const id=(await q(`select issuer_id from public.issuers where cik=$1`,[x.cik]))[0].issuer_id as string;
   await q(`insert into public.issuer_securities(issuer_id,ticker,share_class,is_primary,valid_from,source) values($1,$2,'common',true,'2000-01-01','test') on conflict do nothing`,[id,x.ticker]);
   return id;
  };
  s=await provision(S);t=await provision(T);
  await db.reconcileScope('US',[{issuer_id:s,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:S.cik.padStart(10,'0')},{issuer_id:t,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:T.cik.padStart(10,'0')}]);
  await q(`update public.fact_sync_scope set next_due_at='2999-01-01' where issuer_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[[s,t]]);
  const bytes=new Map([[S.cik.padStart(10,'0'),doc(S,false)],[T.cik.padStart(10,'0'),doc(T,true)]]);
  const sync=await runFactsSync({db,tables,storage:memorySnapshotStore(),
   fetchUs:async(cik10:string):Promise<RawSnapshot>=>{const b=bytes.get(cik10);if(!b)throw new ProviderError('no_companyfacts',cik10);return snapshotOf(b,{source:'edgar',url:companyFactsUrl(cik10)});},
   fetchCn:async()=>{throw new ProviderError('tushare_unavailable','not in this suite');},
   parseUs:(snapshot,o)=>parseCompanyFacts(snapshot,{sinceYear:o.sinceYear}),
   parseCn:()=>{throw new ProviderError('parse_error','not in this suite');},
   now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:'test'},{market:'US',limit:10,issuerIds:[s,t],dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script',mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN});
  expect(sync.detail).toMatchObject({published:2,failed:0});
 },120_000);
 afterAll(async()=>{
  if(db&&s&&t)await db.reconcileScope('US',[{issuer_id:s,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:S.cik.padStart(10,'0')},{issuer_id:t,reasons:[],priority:0,fetch_key:T.cik.padStart(10,'0')}]).catch(()=>{});
  await admin?.end();
 });

 it('set_merge → the lineage read reports the same-day conflict and suppresses the current value',async()=>{
  await q(`update public.issuer_securities set valid_to=current_date, valid_to_method='curated' where issuer_id=$1 and valid_to is null`,[s]);
  expect(await db.setMerge(s,t,ADMIN)).toEqual({repointed:0});
  const lineage=await db.lineageOf(t);
  expect(lineage).toEqual([t,s]);
  const env=await db.readFactsLineage(lineage,'US',{concepts:['revenue','net_income_parent'],asOf:today()});
  expect(env.conflicts).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(new Set(env.conflicts[0].fact_ids)).toEqual(new Set([await factOf(s),await factOf(t)]));
  expect(env.rows.filter(r=>r.concept==='revenue'&&r.is_current)).toEqual([]);
  expect(env.rows.filter(r=>r.concept==='net_income_parent'&&r.is_current).map(r=>r.value)).toEqual(['120']);
 });

 it('the pair writes a failed numeric result and one lineage_conflict item; resolve_lineage_conflict restores one current value; metrics carry both lineage revisions',async()=>{
  const r=await runReconcile({db,tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),fetch:(async()=>{throw new Error('no network');}) as unknown as typeof fetch,readRepoFile:async()=>{throw new Error('no repo file');},
   now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:'test',pairs:{[PAIR]:lineageSameDayPair({targets:[t]})}},{pair:PAIR,triggeredBy:'script',issuerIds:[t]});
  expect(r.members).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({issuerId:t,market:'US',outcome:'done',counts:{compared_passed:0,compared_failed:1,not_compared:0}})]);
  const nk=`${t}:${K}:2024-02-15`;
  const [row]=await q(`select kind,outcome,passed,left_value::text as l,right_value::text as r from public.dq_reconciliations where pair=$1 and natural_key=$2`,[PAIR,nk]);
  expect(row).toMatchObject({kind:'numeric',outcome:'compared',passed:false});
  expect(new Set([row.l,row.r])).toEqual(new Set(['1000','1200']));
  const items=await q(`select id,status,dataset,payload from public.dq_quarantine where reason_code='lineage_conflict' and natural_key=$1`,[nk]);
  expect(items).toHaveLength(1);expect(items[0]).toMatchObject({status:'open',dataset:'facts.us'});
  const keep=await factOf(t);
  const {batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'dq-resolver',dataset:'facts.us'});
  expect(await db.resolveLineageConflict(items[0].id,keep,batchId,ADMIN)).toEqual({quarantined:1});
  expect((await q(`select status,detail from public.dq_quarantine where id=$1`,[items[0].id]))[0]).toMatchObject({status:'resolved_accept',detail:expect.objectContaining({chosen_fact_ids:[keep]})});
  expect((await q(`select status from public.financial_facts where fact_id=$1`,[await factOf(s)]))[0].status).toBe('quarantined');
  const env=await db.readFactsLineage([t,s],'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:today()});
  expect(env.conflicts).toEqual([]);
  expect(env.rows.filter(x=>x.is_current).map(x=>[x.issuer_id,x.value])).toEqual([[t,'1200']]);
  await materialize(db,t,'US');
  const revs=(await db.stateRevs([t,s],'US')).sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:1);
  const metrics=await db.metricsOfIssuer(t,'US',FORMULA_VERSION);
  expect(metrics.find(m=>m.metric==='net_margin'&&m.duration==='12M')?.value).toBe('0.1');
  for(const m of metrics)expect([...m.based_on_lineage].sort((a,b)=>a.issuer_id<b.issuer_id?-1:1)).toEqual(revs);
 },120_000);
});
```

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-cn-gold.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/pairs.ts`（登记 `cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold`）
- Modify: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/testing.ts`（追加 TEST-ONLY `goldRow`）
- Test: `src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn.schema.test.ts`、`src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-cn-gold.test.ts`

规则（全部进代码与测试）：
- 文件 `src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json`，`schema='gold/cn-annual/1'`。**本任务不创建该文件**（降级：无 `TUSHARE_TOKEN`、无抄录人）；pair 读不到文件 → `invalid_gold_file`，周期不建、批次 `failed`。
- 校验器拒绝：`rows` 不是 `tickers × fiscal_years × concepts` 的**精确乘积**（每组合恰一行、无多余行、无重复）；`tickers` 空或含非法 ticker（`^\d{6}\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$`）或重复；`fiscal_years` 不是 FY2022–FY2025（决策 E）；`concepts` 不是固定六科目；`printed_value` 不匹配 `^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$` 或小数位 ≠ `printed_decimals`；`printed_unit_multiplier ∉ {1, 1000, 10000, 1000000, 100000000}`；`eps_basic` 的 multiplier ≠ 1；`column ≠ '本期'`；缺/错 `source.page`（正整数）、`pdf_sha256`（64 hex）、`cninfo_announcement_id`、`announcement_date`、`document`、`table`、`pdf_url`；`tushare_source_ref` 不是 `<ts_code>:<YYYYMMDD>:<report_type>:<YYYYMMDD>`，或 `ts_code ≠ ticker`，或 `end_date ≠ <fy>1231`，或 `report_type` 段 ≠ 行的 `report_type`（缺省 1，契约问题 15）；`recorded_by == reviewed_by` 或不是代号（`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`）；`recorded_at` 不是时间戳。
- natural_key = `<ticker>:<fy>:<concept>:<report_type>`。
- **左侧绑定（T14）**：`filings(source='tushare', source_ref = tushare_source_ref)`；不存在 → `left_unlinked`；`filings.document_ref ≠ cninfo_announcement_id` 只记 `detail.document_ref_mismatch=true`，**不改变绑定、不替代**；事实经 `readFilingFacts(filing, true)` + `activeRows`，再按 (concept, 期间, duration, unit) 过滤（BS `INSTANT`、IS/CF `12M` 自 `<fy>-01-01`，eps `CNY/share`，其余 `CNY`）；0 → `left_missing`，>1 → `left_ambiguous`；open `reconcile_mismatch` 项钉住其事实。
- **印刷精度区间**：中心 = 印刷值 × multiplier，半径 = `0.5 × 10^(−printed_decimals) × multiplier`；`passed ⇔ |左 − 中心| ≤ 半径`（交叉相乘）；`tolerance = 半径 / max(|左|, |中心|, 1)`（20 位）；`detail.tolerance_rule='printed_precision/1'`。
- **自动隔离边界**：只有 `multiplier=1 且 printed_decimals=2` 时不一致才 `quarantine_left`；其余（千元/万元/百万元印刷）不一致 → `review_item`（`reconcile_review`，事实保持 `ok`）。E5 门禁的 passed 两种情形都计入。
- `inputs_hash = computeInputsHash(左 raw_hash, pdf_sha256, 黄金文件 sha256, 'gold-cn/1')`。

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn.schema.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS,GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,autoQuarantinable,cnGoldKey,cnPeriodOf,goldTemplate,pickCnSample,printedInterval,validateGoldCn} from './gold-cn';
import {goldRow} from './testing';

const TICKERS=['000001.SZ','600519.SH'];
const YEARS=[2022,2023,2024,2025];
const product=(tickers=TICKERS)=>tickers.flatMap(t=>YEARS.flatMap(fy=>CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.map(c=>goldRow(t,fy,c))));
const file=(rows=product(),o:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({schema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,tickers:TICKERS,fiscal_years:YEARS,concepts:[...CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS],recorded_by:'R1',reviewed_by:'R2',rows,...o});
const errorsOf=(j:unknown)=>{const r=validateGoldCn(j);return r.ok?[]:r.errors;};

describe('validateGoldCn (spec §5.4 validator)',()=>{
 it('accepts the exact tickers × 4 years × 6 concepts product',()=>{
  const r=validateGoldCn(file());
  expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
  if(r.ok)expect(r.file.rows).toHaveLength(2*4*6);
 });
 it.each([
  ['a missing combination',()=>file(product().slice(1))],
  ['a duplicate row',()=>file([...product(),goldRow('600519.SH',2024,'total_assets')])],
  ['an extra ticker row',()=>file([...product(),goldRow('600000.SH',2024,'total_assets')])],
  ['empty tickers',()=>file([],{tickers:[]})],
  ['an invalid ticker',()=>file(product(),{tickers:['600519','000001.SZ']})],
  ['fiscal years other than FY2022–FY2025',()=>file(product(),{fiscal_years:[2023,2024,2025]})],
  ['concepts other than the fixed six',()=>file(product(),{concepts:[...CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.slice(1),'revenue']})],
  ['recorded_by == reviewed_by',()=>file(product(),{reviewed_by:'R1'})],
  ['a printed value with thousands separators',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,printed_value:'1,234,567.89'}:r))],
  ['decimals not matching printed_decimals',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,printed_value:'1234567.8'}:r))],
  ['eps with a multiplier',()=>file(product().map(r=>r.concept==='eps_basic'?{...r,printed_unit_multiplier:10000}:r))],
  ['an unknown multiplier',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,printed_unit_multiplier:100}:r))],
  ['column other than 本期',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,column:'上期' as '本期'}:r))],
  ['a missing page',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,source:{...r.source,page:0}}:r))],
  ['a malformed pdf sha256',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,source:{...r.source,pdf_sha256:'abc'}}:r))],
  ['a missing announcement id',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,source:{...r.source,cninfo_announcement_id:''}}:r))],
  ['a missing announcement date',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,source:{...r.source,announcement_date:'2025/04/03'}}:r))],
  ['a missing tushare_source_ref',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,tushare_source_ref:''}:r))],
  ['a source ref of another ticker',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,tushare_source_ref:r.tushare_source_ref.replace(/^\d{6}\.\w{2}/,'600000.SH')}:r))],
  ['a source ref of another period',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,tushare_source_ref:r.tushare_source_ref.replace(/:\d{8}:/,':20230630:')}:r))],
  ['a report_type segment that differs from the row',()=>file(product().map((r,i)=>i===0?{...r,report_type:5}:r))],
 ])('rejects %s',(_n,make)=>{expect(errorsOf(make()).length).toBeGreaterThan(0);});
 it('natural key is <ticker>:<fy>:<concept>:<report_type>',()=>{
  expect(cnGoldKey(goldRow('600519.SH',2024,'revenue_operating'))).toBe('600519.SH:2024:revenue_operating:1');
 });
});

describe('printed-precision interval and the review/quarantine boundary',()=>{
 it.each([
  ['1234567.89',1,2,'1234567.89','0.005'],
  ['123.46',10000,2,'1234600','50'],
  ['1235',1000000,0,'1235000000','500000'],
  ['-12.3',1000,1,'-12300','50'],
  ['49.93',1,2,'49.93','0.005'],
 ])('%s × %d (%d decimals) → center %s radius %s',(v,m,d,center,radius)=>{
  expect(printedInterval({printed_value:v,printed_unit_multiplier:m,printed_decimals:d})).toEqual({center,radius});
 });
 it('only exact printing (multiplier 1, two decimals) may quarantine automatically',()=>{
  expect(autoQuarantinable({printed_unit_multiplier:1,printed_decimals:2})).toBe(true);
  expect(autoQuarantinable({printed_unit_multiplier:10000,printed_decimals:2})).toBe(false);
  expect(autoQuarantinable({printed_unit_multiplier:1,printed_decimals:0})).toBe(false);
 });
 it('periods and units per concept: BS instant, IS/CF 12M from Jan 1, eps per share',()=>{
  expect(cnPeriodOf(2024,'total_assets')).toEqual({period_start:null,period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'INSTANT',unit:'CNY'});
  expect(cnPeriodOf(2024,'revenue_operating')).toEqual({period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'12M',unit:'CNY'});
  expect(cnPeriodOf(2024,'eps_basic')).toEqual({period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31',duration:'12M',unit:'CNY/share'});
 });
});

describe('sample selection and transcription template',()=>{
 it('pickCnSample: valid unique tickers ascending, first min(n, N)',()=>{
  expect(pickCnSample(['600519.SH','000001.SZ',null,'600519.SH','bad','300750.SZ'],2)).toEqual(['000001.SZ','300750.SZ']);
  expect(pickCnSample([],30)).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('goldTemplate is the exact product with <pending> fields and fails validation until transcribed',()=>{
  const t=goldTemplate(['600519.SH']);
  expect(t.rows).toHaveLength(4*6);
  expect(t.rows[0]).toMatchObject({ticker:'600519.SH',fiscal_year:2022,concept:CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS[0],printed_value:'<pending>',tushare_source_ref:'<pending>'});
  expect(validateGoldCn(t).ok).toBe(false);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-cn-gold.test.ts
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '../../facts/memory-facts-db';
import {makeBudget} from '../../facts/sync';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../raw-store';
import {divDecimal} from './decimal';
import {computeInputsHash} from './inputs-hash';
import {CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS,CN_GOLD_PARSER,CN_GOLD_PATH,GOLD_CN_SCHEMA} from './gold-cn';
import type {GoldCnRow} from './gold-cn';
import {sha256Hex} from './pair-support';
import {cnTushareVsGoldPair} from './pair-cn-gold';
import {RECONCILE_PAIRS} from './pairs';
import {goldRow,reconcileTables,seedPublished} from './testing';
import type {PairContext,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

const TICKER='600519.SH',REF='600519.SH:20241231:1:20250403';
const D={period_start:'2024-01-01',period_end:'2024-12-31'},I={period_start:null,period_end:'2024-12-31'};
const OVERRIDE:Record<string,Partial<GoldCnRow>>={
 revenue_operating:{printed_value:'1234567.89'},                                         // exact, equal → passed
 net_income_parent:{printed_value:'1234567.89'},                                         // exact, left .90 → quarantine_left
 total_assets:{printed_value:'123.46',printed_unit_multiplier:10000},                    // 万元: |1234567.89 − 1234600| = 32.11 ≤ 50 → passed
 equity_parent:{printed_value:'123.46',printed_unit_multiplier:10000},                   // 万元: |1234700 − 1234600| = 100 > 50 → review_item
 operating_cash_flow:{printed_value:'1.00'},                                             // no fact → left_missing
 eps_basic:{printed_value:'49.93'},
};
function goldBytes(){
 const rows=[2022,2023,2024,2025].flatMap(fy=>CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.map(c=>goldRow(TICKER,fy,c,fy===2024?OVERRIDE[c]:{})));
 return new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({schema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,tickers:[TICKER],fiscal_years:[2022,2023,2024,2025],concepts:[...CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS],recorded_by:'R1',reviewed_by:'R2',rows}));
}
async function setup(){
 const tables=reconcileTables();const db=memoryFactsDb(tables);const issuer=randomUUID();
 await tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id:issuer,status:'active',merged_into:null,cik:null,lei:null,usci:null,canonical_name_en:null,canonical_name_zh:'贵州茅台'});
 await tables.insert('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:issuer,ticker:TICKER,valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_to:null,is_primary:true,share_class:'A',isin:null,figi:null});
 const seeded=await seedPublished(db,{issuer,market:'CN',sourceRef:REF,availableDate:'2025-04-03',facts:[
  {concept:'revenue_operating',value:'1234567.89',...D},{concept:'net_income_parent',value:'1234567.9',...D},
  {concept:'total_assets',value:'1234567.89',...I},{concept:'equity_parent',value:'1234700',...I},
  {concept:'eps_basic',value:'49.93',...D,unit:'CNY/share'}]});
 const bytes=goldBytes();
 const ctx:PairContext={db,tables,raw:memoryRawStore(),now:()=>new Date('2026-11-05T00:00:00Z'),budget:makeBudget(null),fetch:(async()=>{throw new Error('no network');}) as unknown as typeof fetch,
  readRepoFile:async p=>{if(p!==CN_GOLD_PATH)throw new Error(`missing ${p}`);return bytes;}};
 const facts=new Map((await db.factsByIds(seeded.factIds)).map(f=>[f.concept,f]));
 return {db,tables,ctx,issuer,seeded,facts,goldSha:sha256Hex(bytes)};
}
const byKey=(res:ReconcileResultInput[],concept:string,fy=2024)=>res.find(r=>r.natural_key===`${TICKER}:${fy}:${concept}:1`)!;

describe('cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold',()=>{
 it('is registered with the gold file and parser version',()=>{
  expect(RECONCILE_PAIRS['cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold']?.inputs).toEqual({repoFile:CN_GOLD_PATH,parserVersion:CN_GOLD_PARSER,goldSchema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA});
 });
 it('one result per gold row: printed-precision interval, quarantine only for exact printing, review item for rounded printing',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();
  const pair=cnTushareVsGoldPair();
  const [m]=await pair.members(s.ctx);
  expect(m).toMatchObject({issuerId:s.issuer,market:'CN'});expect(m.expectedKeys).toHaveLength(24);
  const res=await pair.evaluate(s.ctx,m);
  expect(res).toHaveLength(24);
  const rev=byKey(res,'revenue_operating');
  expect(rev).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:true,action:'record',left_value:'1234567.89',right_value:'1234567.89',tolerance:divDecimal('0.005','1234567.89',20)});
  expect(rev.detail).toMatchObject({tolerance_rule:'printed_precision/1',interval:{center:'1234567.89',radius:'0.005'},document_ref_mismatch:true});
  expect(rev.inputs_hash).toBe(computeInputsHash({left_raw_hash:s.facts.get('revenue_operating')!.raw_hash,right_sha256:'c'.repeat(64),gold_or_sample_sha256:s.goldSha,parser_version:CN_GOLD_PARSER}));
  const ni=byKey(res,'net_income_parent');
  expect(ni).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:false,action:'quarantine_left',left_value:'1234567.9',right_value:'1234567.89',left_fact_id:s.facts.get('net_income_parent')!.fact_id});
  expect(ni.item?.natural_key).toBe(`cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold:${TICKER}:2024:net_income_parent:1:${s.facts.get('net_income_parent')!.fact_id}`);
  expect(byKey(res,'total_assets')).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:true,action:'record',right_value:'1234600',tolerance:divDecimal('50','1234600',20)});
  const eq=byKey(res,'equity_parent');
  expect(eq).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:false,action:'review_item',left_value:'1234700',right_value:'1234600'});
  expect(eq.item?.payload).toMatchObject({fact_ids:[s.facts.get('equity_parent')!.fact_id]});
  expect(eq.detail.auto_quarantine).toBe(false);
  expect(byKey(res,'operating_cash_flow')).toMatchObject({outcome:'left_missing',action:'record'});
  expect(byKey(res,'eps_basic')).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:true});
  expect(byKey(res,'total_assets',2023)).toMatchObject({outcome:'left_unlinked',passed:false});
  expect(res.filter(r=>r.outcome==='left_unlinked')).toHaveLength(18);
 });
 it('binds by the verified tushare_source_ref only: a matching document_ref clears the mismatch flag, a different one never rebinds',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();
  await s.db.updateFilingLink(s.seeded.filingId,{document_ref:`ann-${TICKER}-2024`,document_url:null,link_attempts:1});
  const pair=cnTushareVsGoldPair();const [m]=await pair.members(s.ctx);
  const rev=byKey(await pair.evaluate(s.ctx,m),'revenue_operating');
  expect(rev.detail.document_ref_mismatch).toBeUndefined();
  await s.db.updateFilingLink(s.seeded.filingId,{document_ref:'some-correction-announcement',document_url:null,link_attempts:2});
  const again=byKey(await pair.evaluate(s.ctx,m),'revenue_operating');
  expect(again).toMatchObject({outcome:'compared',passed:true,left_fact_id:s.facts.get('revenue_operating')!.fact_id,detail:expect.objectContaining({document_ref_mismatch:true})});
 });
 it('a missing or invalid gold file refuses the run (degraded path: the file does not exist yet)',async()=>{
  const s=await setup();
  const pair=cnTushareVsGoldPair();
  await expect(pair.members({...s.ctx,readRepoFile:async()=>{throw new Error('ENOENT');}})).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'invalid_gold_file'});
  await expect(pair.members({...s.ctx,readRepoFile:async()=>new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({schema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,tickers:[],rows:[]}))})).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'invalid_gold_file'});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn.ts
// A-share annual-report gold set (spec §5.4, T14; schema 'gold/cn-annual/1'), validator and the printed-precision
// rules. Fixed: the six concepts of the annual report table 主要会计数据和财务指标 (BS concepts INSTANT, IS/CF 12M,
// eps CNY/share with multiplier 1), fiscal years FY2022–FY2025 (owner decision E), only the 本期 column, recorder
// and reviewer as code names that must differ. The validator rejects anything that is not the EXACT product
// tickers × fiscal_years × concepts. Every row carries tushare_source_ref = <ts_code>:<end_date>:<report_type>:<ann_date>,
// independently verified by recorder and reviewer to be the same version as the PDF (pdf_sha256); the pair binds the
// left side ONLY through it (filings.document_ref is a cross-check). Interval: center = printed × multiplier,
// radius = 0.5 × 10^-decimals × multiplier; automatic quarantine only for exact printing (multiplier 1, two
// decimals), rounded printing gets a review item. goldTemplate builds the transcription template (every printed and
// source field '<pending>', so it fails validation until transcribed); pickCnSample is §5.4's sample rule.
import {conceptById} from '../../facts/concepts';
import {canonicalDecimal} from '../../facts/json-numbers';
import {mulDecimal} from './decimal';

export const GOLD_CN_SCHEMA='gold/cn-annual/1';
export const CN_GOLD_PATH='src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json';
export const CN_GOLD_PARSER='gold-cn/1';
export const CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS=['revenue_operating','net_income_parent','total_assets','equity_parent','operating_cash_flow','eps_basic'] as const;
export type CnGoldConcept=typeof CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS[number];
export const CN_GOLD_FISCAL_YEARS:readonly number[]=[2022,2023,2024,2025];
export const CN_GOLD_MULTIPLIERS:readonly number[]=[1,1000,10000,1000000,100000000];
export interface GoldCnSource{document:string;cninfo_announcement_id:string;announcement_date:string;pdf_url:string;pdf_sha256:string;page:number;table:string}
export interface GoldCnRow{ticker:string;fiscal_year:number;concept:CnGoldConcept;printed_value:string;printed_unit_multiplier:number;printed_decimals:number;column:'本期';report_type?:number;source:GoldCnSource;tushare_source_ref:string;recorded_at:string}
export interface GoldCnFile{schema:typeof GOLD_CN_SCHEMA;tickers:string[];fiscal_years:number[];concepts:string[];recorded_by:string;reviewed_by:string;rows:GoldCnRow[]}

const TICKER=/^\d{6}\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/,CODE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/,DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/,SHA=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/,PRINTED=/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/;
const REF=/^(\d{6}\.(?:SH|SZ|BJ)):(\d{8}):(\d+):(\d{8})$/;
const str=(v:unknown):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim()!=='';
const fraction=(v:string)=>{const i=v.indexOf('.');return i<0?0:v.length-i-1;};

export const cnGoldKey=(r:Pick<GoldCnRow,'ticker'|'fiscal_year'|'concept'|'tushare_source_ref'>)=>`${r.ticker}:${r.fiscal_year}:${r.concept}:${r.tushare_source_ref.split(':')[2]??''}`;

export function validateGoldCn(json:unknown):{ok:true;file:GoldCnFile}|{ok:false;errors:string[]}{
 const errors:string[]=[];const e=(m:string)=>{errors.push(m);};
 const f=json as Partial<GoldCnFile>|null;
 if(!f||typeof f!=='object')return {ok:false,errors:['not_an_object']};
 if(f.schema!==GOLD_CN_SCHEMA)e('schema');
 const tickers=Array.isArray(f.tickers)?f.tickers:[];
 if(tickers.length===0)e('tickers: empty');
 if(tickers.some(t=>typeof t!=='string'||!TICKER.test(t)))e('tickers: invalid ticker');
 if(new Set(tickers).size!==tickers.length)e('tickers: duplicate');
 const years=Array.isArray(f.fiscal_years)?f.fiscal_years:[];
 if(JSON.stringify([...years].sort())!==JSON.stringify([...CN_GOLD_FISCAL_YEARS]))e('fiscal_years: must be FY2022–FY2025');
 const concepts=Array.isArray(f.concepts)?f.concepts:[];
 if(concepts.length!==CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.length||!CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.every(c=>concepts.includes(c)))e('concepts: must be the fixed six');
 if(!str(f.recorded_by)||!CODE.test(f.recorded_by))e('recorded_by: code name');
 if(!str(f.reviewed_by)||!CODE.test(f.reviewed_by))e('reviewed_by: code name');
 if(f.recorded_by===f.reviewed_by)e('recorded_by == reviewed_by');
 const rows=Array.isArray(f.rows)?f.rows:[];
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
  const at=`rows[${i}]`;
  if(!r||typeof r!=='object'){e(`${at}: not an object`);return;}
  const combo=`${r.ticker}|${r.fiscal_year}|${r.concept}`;
  if(!tickers.includes(r.ticker)||!years.includes(r.fiscal_year)||!(CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS as readonly string[]).includes(r.concept))e(`${at}: ${combo} outside the product`);
  if(seen.has(combo))e(`${at}: duplicate ${combo}`);seen.add(combo);
  if(typeof r.printed_value!=='string'||!PRINTED.test(r.printed_value))e(`${at}.printed_value`);
  else if(!Number.isInteger(r.printed_decimals)||r.printed_decimals<0||r.printed_decimals>6||fraction(r.printed_value)!==r.printed_decimals)e(`${at}.printed_decimals`);
  if(!CN_GOLD_MULTIPLIERS.includes(r.printed_unit_multiplier))e(`${at}.printed_unit_multiplier`);
  if(r.concept==='eps_basic'&&r.printed_unit_multiplier!==1)e(`${at}: eps multiplier must be 1`);
  if(r.column!=='本期')e(`${at}.column`);
  const s=(r.source??{}) as Partial<GoldCnSource>;
  if(!Number.isInteger(s.page)||(s.page as number)<1)e(`${at}.source.page`);
  if(typeof s.pdf_sha256!=='string'||!SHA.test(s.pdf_sha256))e(`${at}.source.pdf_sha256`);
  if(!str(s.cninfo_announcement_id))e(`${at}.source.cninfo_announcement_id`);
  if(typeof s.announcement_date!=='string'||!DATE.test(s.announcement_date))e(`${at}.source.announcement_date`);
  if(!str(s.document))e(`${at}.source.document`);
  if(!str(s.table))e(`${at}.source.table`);
  if(typeof s.pdf_url!=='string'||!/^https?:\/\//.test(s.pdf_url))e(`${at}.source.pdf_url`);
  const m=typeof r.tushare_source_ref==='string'?REF.exec(r.tushare_source_ref):null;
  if(!m)e(`${at}.tushare_source_ref`);
  else{
   if(m[1]!==r.ticker)e(`${at}.tushare_source_ref: ts_code ${m[1]} != ${r.ticker}`);
   if(m[2]!==`${r.fiscal_year}1231`)e(`${at}.tushare_source_ref: end_date ${m[2]} != ${r.fiscal_year}1231`);
   if(m[3]!==String(r.report_type??1))e(`${at}.tushare_source_ref: report_type ${m[3]} != ${r.report_type??1}`);
  }
  if(typeof r.recorded_at!=='string'||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(r.recorded_at)))e(`${at}.recorded_at`);
 });
 for(const t of tickers)for(const y of years)for(const c of CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS)if(!seen.has(`${t}|${y}|${c}`))e(`missing ${t}|${y}|${c}`);
 return errors.length>0?{ok:false,errors}:{ok:true,file:f as GoldCnFile};
}

export function printedInterval(r:Pick<GoldCnRow,'printed_value'|'printed_unit_multiplier'|'printed_decimals'>):{center:string;radius:string}{
 const mult=String(r.printed_unit_multiplier);
 return {center:mulDecimal(canonicalDecimal(r.printed_value),mult),radius:mulDecimal(canonicalDecimal(`5e-${r.printed_decimals+1}`),mult)};
}
export const autoQuarantinable=(r:Pick<GoldCnRow,'printed_unit_multiplier'|'printed_decimals'>):boolean=>r.printed_unit_multiplier===1&&r.printed_decimals===2;
export function cnPeriodOf(fy:number,concept:string):{period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:'12M'|'INSTANT';unit:'CNY'|'CNY/share'}{
 const def=conceptById(concept);if(!def)throw new Error(`unknown_concept:${concept}`);
 const instant=def.nature==='instant';
 return {period_start:instant?null:`${fy}-01-01`,period_end:`${fy}-12-31`,duration:instant?'INSTANT':'12M',unit:def.unitKind==='per_share'?'CNY/share':'CNY'};
}

/** §5.4 sample: valid unique tickers ascending, the first min(n, N). */
export function pickCnSample(tickers:readonly (string|null)[],n=30):string[]{
 return [...new Set(tickers.filter((t):t is string=>typeof t==='string'&&TICKER.test(t)))].sort().slice(0,Math.max(0,n));
}
/** Transcription template: the exact product, every printed/source field '<pending>' (fails validateGoldCn until filled). */
export function goldTemplate(tickers:readonly string[]):Omit<GoldCnFile,'rows'>&{rows:Record<string,unknown>[]}{
 const P='<pending>';
 return {schema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,tickers:[...tickers],fiscal_years:[...CN_GOLD_FISCAL_YEARS],concepts:[...CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS],recorded_by:P,reviewed_by:P,
  rows:tickers.flatMap(ticker=>CN_GOLD_FISCAL_YEARS.flatMap(fiscal_year=>CN_GOLD_CONCEPTS.map(concept=>({ticker,fiscal_year,concept,printed_value:P,printed_unit_multiplier:concept==='eps_basic'?1:P,printed_decimals:P,column:'本期',
   source:{document:P,cninfo_announcement_id:P,announcement_date:P,pdf_url:P,pdf_sha256:P,page:P,table:'主要会计数据和财务指标'},tushare_source_ref:P,recorded_at:P}))))};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/reconcile/pair-cn-gold.ts
// cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold (spec §5.4, T14, owner decision D). Members = the gold file's tickers resolved to
// issuers (CN); expected keys = its rows (<ticker>:<fy>:<concept>:<report_type>). Left binding ONLY through the
// verified tushare_source_ref: filings(source tushare, source_ref) — absent → left_unlinked; a document_ref that
// differs from cninfo_announcement_id is recorded as detail.document_ref_mismatch and never rebinds or substitutes
// (the plan-2 linker may point type-1 filings at a correction or the next year's report). Facts: read_filing_facts
// filtered by activeRows and by the concept's period/duration/unit; an open reconcile_mismatch item pins its fact.
// passed ⇔ left ∈ [center − radius, center + radius] (cross-multiplication); tolerance = radius / max(|l|,|center|,1).
// A failure quarantines the ok left row only for exact printing (multiplier 1, two decimals); rounded printing opens a
// reconcile_review item and the fact stays ok — whether a difference is rounding or data is a human call.
// Degraded path (no TUSHARE_TOKEN, no transcriber yet): the gold file does not exist, members() → invalid_gold_file;
// no CN cron (vercel.json) and the route refuses cn.* without FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1.
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../entities/resolve';
import type {FactRow} from '../../facts/types';
import {divDecimal,maxAbsDecimal,withinRadius} from './decimal';
import {CN_GOLD_PARSER,CN_GOLD_PATH,GOLD_CN_SCHEMA,autoQuarantinable,cnGoldKey,cnPeriodOf,printedInterval,validateGoldCn} from './gold-cn';
import type {GoldCnFile} from './gold-cn';
import {computeInputsHash} from './inputs-hash';
import {ReconcileConfigError,actionFor,activeRows,comparedNumeric,fractionDigits,mismatchItem,notCompared,openMismatches,readRepoJson,todayOf} from './pair-support';
import type {RegisteredPair} from './pair-support';
import type {MemberPlan,PairContext,ReconcileResultInput} from './types';

const PAIR='cn.tushare_vs_cninfo_pdf_gold' as const;
const SIDES={left_source:'tushare',right_source:'cninfo.pdf.gold'};

async function loadGold(ctx:PairContext):Promise<{file:GoldCnFile;sha256:string}>{
 const {json,sha256}=await readRepoJson(ctx,CN_GOLD_PATH,'invalid_gold_file');
 const v=validateGoldCn(json);
 if(!v.ok)throw new ReconcileConfigError('invalid_gold_file',v.errors.slice(0,5).join('; '));
 return {file:v.file,sha256};
}

export function cnTushareVsGoldPair():RegisteredPair{
 return {
  id:PAIR,kind:'numeric',left:'tushare',right:'cninfo.pdf.gold',
  inputs:{repoFile:CN_GOLD_PATH,parserVersion:CN_GOLD_PARSER,goldSchema:GOLD_CN_SCHEMA},
  async members(ctx){
   const {file}=await loadGold(ctx);
   const out:MemberPlan[]=[];
   for(const ticker of [...file.tickers].sort()){
    const r=await resolveIssuer(ctx.tables,{ticker},{today:todayOf(ctx)});
    if(!r)throw new ReconcileConfigError('issuer_unresolved',ticker);
    const rows=file.rows.filter(x=>x.ticker===ticker).sort((a,b)=>a.fiscal_year-b.fiscal_year||a.concept.localeCompare(b.concept));
    out.push({issuerId:r.issuer_id,market:'CN',expectedKeys:rows.map(x=>({naturalKey:cnGoldKey(x),locator:{ticker,fiscal_year:x.fiscal_year,concept:x.concept,tushare_source_ref:x.tushare_source_ref}}))});
   }
   return out;
  },
  async evaluate(ctx,member){
   const {file,sha256:goldSha}=await loadGold(ctx);
   const current=new Map(file.rows.map(r=>[cnGoldKey(r),r]));
   const open=await openMismatches(ctx.tables,PAIR,'CN');
   const out:ReconcileResultInput[]=[];
   for(const k of member.expectedKeys){
    const row=current.get(k.naturalKey);
    if(!row){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','incomplete_gold',SIDES,{reason:'row_removed'}));continue;}
    const filing=await ctx.db.findFilingBySourceRef('tushare',row.tushare_source_ref);
    if(!filing){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_unlinked',SIDES,{tushare_source_ref:row.tushare_source_ref}));continue;}
    const docMismatch=filing.document_ref!==row.source.cninfo_announcement_id;
    const p=cnPeriodOf(row.fiscal_year,row.concept);
    const bound=open.get(k.naturalKey);
    const rows:FactRow[]=bound?(await ctx.db.factsByIds([bound.factIds[0]])).slice(0,1)
     :activeRows(await ctx.db.readFilingFacts(filing.filing_id,true),filing).filter(f=>f.concept===row.concept&&f.period_end===p.period_end&&f.period_start===p.period_start&&f.duration===p.duration&&f.unit===p.unit);
    const flag=docMismatch?{document_ref_mismatch:true}:{};
    if(rows.length===0){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_missing',SIDES,{filing_id:filing.filing_id,...flag}));continue;}
    if(rows.length>1){out.push(notCompared(k.naturalKey,'numeric','left_ambiguous',SIDES,{fact_ids:rows.map(r=>r.fact_id),...flag}));continue;}
    const left=rows[0];
    const {center,radius}=printedInterval(row);
    const passed=withinRadius(left.value,center,radius);
    const tolerance=divDecimal(radius,maxAbsDecimal(left.value,center,'1'),20);
    const auto=autoQuarantinable(row);
    const action=actionFor({bound:bound!==undefined,leftStatus:left.status,compared:true,passed,onFail:auto?'quarantine_left':'review_item'});
    const inputs_hash=computeInputsHash({left_raw_hash:left.raw_hash,right_sha256:row.source.pdf_sha256,gold_or_sample_sha256:goldSha,parser_version:CN_GOLD_PARSER});
    const locator={document:row.source.document,cninfo_announcement_id:row.source.cninfo_announcement_id,pdf_url:row.source.pdf_url,page:row.source.page,table:row.source.table,column:row.column};
    out.push(comparedNumeric(k.naturalKey,left.value,center,{passed,tolerance,sides:SIDES,inputs_hash,left_fact_id:left.fact_id,action,
     detail:{left:{fact_id:left.fact_id,raw_hash:left.raw_hash,status:left.status,precision:{decimals:fractionDigits(left.value_text)}},
      right:{document:row.source.document,sha256:row.source.pdf_sha256,locator,precision:{printed_decimals:row.printed_decimals,multiplier:row.printed_unit_multiplier}},
      unit:p.unit,interval:{center,radius},tolerance_rule:'printed_precision/1',auto_quarantine:auto,inputs_hash,report_type:row.report_type??1,...flag},
     ...(action==='record'?{}:{item:mismatchItem(PAIR,k.naturalKey,left,center,locator,inputs_hash)})}));
   }
   return out;
  },
 };
}
```

```ts
// scripts/dq/select-cn-sample.ts
/**
 * A-share gold-set sample and transcription template (spec §5.4; owner decisions C, E, H).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/select-cn-sample.ts [--count 30] [--out docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/cn-gold-template.json]
 *
 * tickers = the primary A-share ticker (plan 2 chooseCnTicker over the issuer's CURRENT issuer_securities rows) of
 * every fact_sync_scope row with market CN and priority > 0, ascending, the first min(count, N). The output is a
 * transcription TEMPLATE (gold-cn.ts goldTemplate): the exact tickers × FY2022–FY2025 × six-concept product with
 * every printed and source field '<pending>'. It fails validateGoldCn by design; recorder and reviewer fill it from
 * the cninfo annual-report PDFs (docs/runbooks/cn-gold-transcription.md) and only the completed, reviewed file is
 * committed as src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json. The template holds tickers and primary-document locators
 * only — no selection reasons, no names (decision H).
 * N = 0 → nothing is written and exit 1 ("F3-6 cannot start": recorded, never faked). Exit 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {selectAll,supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '../../src/lib/entities/resolve';
import {chooseCnTicker} from '../../src/lib/facts/scope';
import {goldTemplate,pickCnSample} from '../../src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: select-cn-sample.ts [--count <1..200>] [--out <path.json>]';

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let count=30;let out='docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/cn-gold-template.json';
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i+=2){
  const k=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(k==='--count'&&v&&/^\d{1,3}$/.test(v)&&Number(v)>=1&&Number(v)<=200)count=Number(v);
  else if(k==='--out'&&v&&v.endsWith('.json'))out=v;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 const tables=supabaseTableClient(getAdminSupabase());const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const scope=(await selectAll(tables,'fact_sync_scope',{market:'CN'},'issuer_id')).filter(r=>Number(r.priority)>0);
 const tickers:(string|null)[]=[];const unresolved:string[]=[];
 for(const s of scope){
  const secs=(await selectAll(tables,'issuer_securities',{issuer_id:String(s.issuer_id)},'ticker')).filter(r=>isCurrentSecurity(r,today));
  const c=chooseCnTicker(secs);
  if('ticker' in c)tickers.push(c.ticker);else{tickers.push(null);unresolved.push(`${String(s.issuer_id)}:${c.reason}`);}
 }
 const picked=pickCnSample(tickers,count);
 if(picked.length===0){console.error(JSON.stringify({scope:scope.length,picked:0,unresolved,message:'F3-6 cannot start: no CN issuer in scope (N = 0)'}));process.exit(1);}
 writeFileSync(out,`${JSON.stringify(goldTemplate(picked),null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({out,scope:scope.length,picked:picked.length,rows:picked.length*24,unresolved}));
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

（选项名用 `--count` 而不是 `--n`：仓库提交钩子会拦截同一命令里任何 `-n` 记号，避免文档示例与提交命令混用时误触。）

```ts
// scripts/dq/gold-pdf.ts
/**
 * Verifies and uploads the annual-report PDFs referenced by an A-share gold file (spec §3.1 bucket reconcile-raw, §5.4).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/gold-pdf.ts --gold <gold.json> --pdf-dir <dir> [--upload]
 *
 * For every distinct rows[].source.pdf_sha256 of the gold file (read leniently, so PDFs can be uploaded while the
 * transcription is still in progress; '<pending>' hashes are skipped and counted): finds the local *.pdf in --pdf-dir
 * whose bytes hash to it. Without --upload it only reports {sha256, file, announcement_ids}. With --upload each
 * matched PDF goes to reconcile-raw as kind 'cn-gold-pdf' (content-addressed; an existing object is 'exists') and the
 * stored sha256 must equal the gold file's value. A PDF that is missing locally, or a stored hash that differs, makes
 * the exit code 1; nothing is ever renamed or rewritten. Exit 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {supabaseRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {budgetFor} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: gold-pdf.ts --gold <gold.json> --pdf-dir <dir> [--upload]';
const SHA=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let gold='',dir='',upload=false;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(x==='--gold'&&v){gold=v;i++;}else if(x==='--pdf-dir'&&v){dir=v;i++;}else if(x==='--upload')upload=true;else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!gold||!dir){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 const json=JSON.parse(readFileSync(gold,'utf8')) as {rows?:{source?:{pdf_sha256?:unknown;cninfo_announcement_id?:unknown}}[]};
 const wanted=new Map<string,Set<string>>();let pending=0;
 for(const r of json.rows??[]){
  const sha=r.source?.pdf_sha256;
  if(typeof sha!=='string'||!SHA.test(sha)){pending++;continue;}
  const ids=wanted.get(sha)??new Set<string>();if(typeof r.source?.cninfo_announcement_id==='string')ids.add(r.source.cninfo_announcement_id);wanted.set(sha,ids);
 }
 const local=new Map<string,string>();
 for(const name of readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')).sort()){
  const p=join(dir,name);local.set(createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(p)).digest('hex'),p);
 }
 const raw=upload?supabaseRawStore(getAdminSupabase()):null;
 let failed=0;
 for(const [sha,ids] of [...wanted.entries()].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:1)){
  const file=local.get(sha);
  if(!file){failed++;console.log(JSON.stringify({sha256:sha,status:'missing_locally',announcement_ids:[...ids]}));continue;}
  if(!raw){console.log(JSON.stringify({sha256:sha,status:'found',file,announcement_ids:[...ids]}));continue;}
  const stored=await raw.put({kind:'cn-gold-pdf',bytes:new Uint8Array(readFileSync(file)),contentType:'application/pdf',meta:{announcement_ids:[...ids].join(',')}},budgetFor(120_000));
  if(stored.sha256!==sha){failed++;console.log(JSON.stringify({sha256:sha,status:'hash_mismatch',stored:stored.sha256,file}));continue;}
  console.log(JSON.stringify({sha256:sha,status:stored.status,path:stored.path,file}));
 }
 console.log(JSON.stringify({gold,distinct_pdfs:wanted.size,pending_rows:pending,failed,uploaded:upload}));
 process.exit(failed>0?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 写抄录指引草稿**

`docs/runbooks/cn-gold-transcription.md`：

```markdown
# A 股黄金集抄录指引（草稿，计划三 Task 16b；规格三 §5.4）

> 适用：`src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json`（`schema: gold/cn-annual/1`）。抄录人 R1、复核人 R2 用代号，二者不得相同（owner 决策 C）。

## 1. 范围
- 发行人：`scripts/dq/select-cn-sample.ts` 生成模板时 `fact_sync_scope(market='CN', priority>0)` 的主 A 股 ticker，升序取前 min(30, N)（决策 E、H）。N=0 时不开始。
- 期间：FY2022、FY2023、FY2024、FY2025 四个年报；每份只抄"主要会计数据和财务指标"表的**本期**列。
- 科目（固定六个）：营业收入 `revenue_operating`、归属于上市公司股东的净利润 `net_income_parent`、总资产 `total_assets`、归属于上市公司股东的净资产 `equity_parent`、经营活动产生的现金流量净额 `operating_cash_flow`、基本每股收益 `eps_basic`。
- 文件必须是 `tickers × 4 × 6` 的**精确乘积**：一个组合一行，不多不少；缺一行即整份文件无效。

## 2. 每行怎么填
| 字段 | 填法 |
|---|---|
| `printed_value` | 表中数字原样去掉千分位逗号，保留印刷的小数位与负号；不换算、不四舍五入。例：`1,505,600,000.00` → `"1505600000.00"`；`(3.21)` 写 `"-3.21"` |
| `printed_decimals` | `printed_value` 小数点后的位数（与印刷一致；`"1505600000.00"` → 2） |
| `printed_unit_multiplier` | 表头单位：元=1、千元=1000、万元=10000、百万元=1000000、亿元=100000000；每股收益一律 1（元/股） |
| `column` | 固定 `"本期"`；不抄"上年同期""调整后""调整前"等列 |
| `source.document` | 公告标题原文（例："贵州茅台 2024 年年度报告"） |
| `source.cninfo_announcement_id` | 巨潮公告 ID |
| `source.announcement_date` | 公告日期 `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `source.pdf_url` | 巨潮 PDF 下载地址 |
| `source.pdf_sha256` | 下载得到的 PDF 字节的 sha256（`shasum -a 256 <file>`）；上传后由 `gold-pdf.ts` 再核一次 |
| `source.page` | 该表所在的 PDF 页码（阅读器显示的物理页，从 1 起） |
| `source.table` | 固定 `"主要会计数据和财务指标"` |
| `tushare_source_ref` | 见第 3 节 |
| `report_type` | 原始年报不填（=1）；只有专门为"变更前原数"（type-5）建的行才填 5，并且必须有它自己核实的源文档 |
| `recorded_at` | 抄录时刻 ISO 时间戳 |

## 3. `tushare_source_ref` 的核实（规格 T14，最容易出错的一步）
- 形式 `<ts_code>:<end_date>:<report_type>:<ann_date>`，取自计划二 `filings.source_ref`（例：`600519.SH:20241231:1:20250403`）。
- **R1 与 R2 各自独立核实**它与本行 PDF（`pdf_sha256`）是同一版本：PDF 封面/公告日期与该引用的 `ann_date`（或 `f_ann_date`）一致；PDF 是**原始年报**，不是更正公告、不是次年年报的比较列。
- 不得用 `filings.document_ref` 代替核实：计划二挂接器在存在 type-5 时会把 type-1 指向更正公告，type-4 会指向次年年报；`document_ref` 只用于交叉核对（不一致时对账行记 `document_ref_mismatch=true`，不改绑定）。
- 找不到与 PDF 同版本的引用 → 该行**不提交**，整份文件因此不完整、暂不进入 F3-6；不得挑一个相近的引用凑数。

## 4. 复核
- R2 逐行对照 PDF 页面核对 `printed_value/printed_decimals/printed_unit_multiplier/page` 与第 3 节的引用；有异议的行由 R1 改，R2 再核。`recorded_by`/`reviewed_by` 写代号。
- 校验：`npx tsx -e "import('./src/lib/dq/reconcile/gold-cn.ts').then(m=>{const r=m.validateGoldCn(require('./src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json'));console.log(r.ok?'ok':r.errors.join('\\n'))})"` 必须打印 `ok`。
- PDF 上传：`node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/gold-pdf.ts --gold src/lib/dq/fixtures/gold/cn-annual-v1.json --pdf-dir <下载目录> --upload`，退出码 0 才算完成。

## 5. 对账怎么用这些行（供理解，不需要操作）
- 右侧值 = `printed_value × printed_unit_multiplier`，区间半径 = `0.5 × 10^(−printed_decimals) × multiplier`；Tushare 原文值落在区间内即通过。
- 只有"以元、两位小数"印刷（multiplier=1 且 decimals=2）的不一致才自动隔离 Tushare 值；千元/万元等舍入印刷的不一致只建人工复核项（`reconcile_review`），由人判断是舍入差还是数据差。
- 一行抄错 → 对账失败 → 隔离或复核 → 改 json 并经复核 → 重跑通过（`inputs_hash` 随文件 sha256 改变）→ 管理员恢复。

## 6. 进入 CI 与 cron 的条件（T15）
`gold-cn.integration.test.ts` 只有在真实录制并留存的 Tushare 三表、巨潮挂接与 `disclosure_date` 响应都存在且核对通过后才创建；CN 对账 cron 同时以 `FACTS_CN_ENABLED=1` 与黄金核实完成为门。在此之前 E5 记"未达成（CN 降级）"，不报数字。
```

### Task 17a: 日历规则 `src/lib/dq/calendar.ts`（C7，纯函数）

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/dq/calendar.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/dq/calendar.test.ts`
- Modify: `docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/verification.md`（追加"SEC 假日与 Rule 0-3"一节；文件不存在则创建，首行 `# 数据底座三 · 实施核对记录`）
- Modify: `docs/audits/2026-11-05-data-foundation-3/implementation-log.md`（追加本任务条目）

规则要点（全部写进代码与测试，实施者无需再读规格）：
- 申报人类别按财年：财年 N 的各期（N 的 10-Q 与 N 的 10-K）用**财年 N−1** 的 10-K 封面类别；没有 N−1 行 → `deadline_state='no_rule'`、`due_rule='none.no_category_for_fy/1'`、`detail.no_category=true`。财年标签 = 财年末日期最近的月末所在日历年（`fiscalYearOfPeriodEnd`），17b 写 `issuer_filer_categories.fiscal_year` 用同一函数。
- 期限表：10-K 大型加速 60/40 天（`us.laf/1`）、加速 75/40（`us.acc/1`）、非加速 90/45（`us.non/1`）；20-F 财年末后 4 个月（月末锚定，`us.20f/1`），无季报期望；40-F `no_rule`（`none.40f/1`）；CN 年报次年 4-30、Q1 4-30、H1 8-31、Q3 10-31（`cn.<kind>/1`），A 股不顺延。美股期限按 Rule 0-3 顺延到下一个 SEC 营业日。
- 期望期间：以年报月为锚的季度月末网格上最近 **6 个已结束**（期末 < today）的槽；20-F/40-F 的非年报槽不产生行；CN 锚 12 月。锚月：最近一份已收到年报的实际期末（最近月末的月份）优先于 submissions `fiscalYearEnd`，不一致 → 每行 `detail.fye_mismatch=true`。无 `fiscal_year_end` → 不出行。
- 52/53 周（`week52_pattern`）：每个槽的期末 = 同位置（同锚月）最近一次观测到的实际期末（已收到的 filing ∪ SEC submissions `reportDate`）+ 364 天，若结果不在锚月再 +7；逐年推进；无观测 → 该槽月末。`period_end_estimated=true`、`deadline_state='estimated'`、`due_rule` 加 `/est`；估计行**永不 `overdue`**，到期未收到为 `pending` + `detail.estimated_due_passed=true`。收到的 filing 与估计期末相差 ≤ 7 天 → 以实际期末替换该行（非估计、按法定）。
- 状态：`received` = 存在 `form_type` 恰为该种类（修订件 `/A` 不算）、所属运行 `published`、`mapping_gen>0`、期末匹配的 filing，取最早 `available_date`；`> due_date` → `received_late`；`no_rule` 行收到即 `received`。未收到：`upstream_lookup='unavailable'` → `unknown_upstream`；上游有（US：同 `form`、`reportDate` 与期末相差 ≤ 7 天，取最早 `filingDate`；CN：同 `end_date` 中 `ann_date` 最大行的 `actual_date` 非空）→ `filed_not_ingested`（`upstream_filed_date`）；否则 `today > due_date` 且 `statutory` → `overdue`，其余 `pending`。CN `expected_date` = 同 `end_date` 中 `ann_date` 最大行的 `pre_date`，`modify_date` 非空 → `detail.schedule_modified=true`。

```ts
  expect(est.detail).toMatchObject({estimated_due_passed:true,estimate_basis:{source:'filing',from:'2025-06-28'}});
  expect(r.some(x=>x.disclosure_state==='overdue')).toBe(false);
  expect(at(r,'2025-09-27')).toMatchObject({deadline_state:'statutory',disclosure_state:'received'});
 });
 it('a received filing within ±7 days of the estimate replaces it with the actual period end',()=>{
  const actual=filing('10-Q','2026-06-27','2026-07-31');
  const r=run({profile:wk(),filings:[...history,actual],categories:[cat(2024,'large_accelerated'),cat(2025,'large_accelerated')]});
  expect(at(r,'2026-06-27')).toMatchObject({period_end_estimated:false,deadline_state:'statutory',due_rule:'us.laf/1',disclosure_state:'received',received_filing_id:actual.filing_id});
  const off=filing('10-Q','2026-07-06','2026-08-01');   // 9 days off the estimate: not this period
  expect(at(run({profile:wk(),filings:[...history,off]}),'2026-06-27').period_end_estimated).toBe(true);
 });
 it('+364 per missing year, +7 when the step leaves the anchor month; no observation → the month end',()=>{
  expect(estimatePeriodEnd('2023-09-30',[{date:'2022-09-24',source:'filing'}])).toEqual({periodEnd:'2023-09-23',basis:{source:'filing',from:'2022-09-24'}});
  expect(estimatePeriodEnd('2026-09-30',[{date:'2024-09-28',source:'filing'}]).periodEnd).toBe('2026-09-26');
  expect(estimatePeriodEnd('2025-01-31',[{date:'2024-02-03',source:'filing'}]).periodEnd).toBe('2025-02-08');
  expect(estimatePeriodEnd('2026-03-31',[])).toEqual({periodEnd:'2026-03-31',basis:{source:'month_end'}});
 });
 it('uses SEC submissions reportDate as an estimation basis when no filing is stored',()=>{
  const up:CalendarUpstream={lookup:'ok',us:[{form:'10-Q',reportDate:'2025-06-28',filingDate:'2025-08-01',accessionNumber:'a1'}]};
  const r=run({profile:wk(),upstream:up});
  expect(at(r,'2026-06-27').detail.estimate_basis).toEqual({source:'sec_submissions',from:'2025-06-28'});
  expect(at(r,'2025-06-30')).toMatchObject({disclosure_state:'filed_not_ingested',period_end_estimated:true,upstream_filed_date:'2025-08-01'});   // no earlier June observation: month-end estimate, upstream entry within ±7 days
 });
});

 });
```
