```ts
// scripts/dq/calendar-sync.ts
/**
 * Filing calendar from the command line (spec §6.2). Preview by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/dq/calendar-sync.ts --market US|CN [--issuer <uuid>]... [--limit n] [--apply]
 *   node --import tsx scripts/dq/calendar-sync.ts --market US --no-db --cik 320193 [--cik ...]
 *
 * Preview: previewCalendar over the market scope (or the given issuers): fetches upstream, computes
 * the rows and prints them; no batch, no pass, no profile, no bucket write (memory raw store).
 * --apply runs the pass protocol exactly like the cron (claims the market pass, processes members,
 * settles it when done) with an 8-minute budget, below the 10-minute pass lease; run it again to
 * continue a pass. --issuer is preview-only (a pass always works on its frozen members).
 * --no-db (US, with --cik): memory stores, synthetic issuer ids, no stored filings; filer categories
 * are first derived from the live 10-K covers (syncFilerCategories into the memory tables), so the
 * printed rows show real deadlines and every SEC-listed report as filed_not_ingested — a network-only
 * check of the rules against AAPL/COST/WMT-style filers (spec §14 question 5).
 * Exit 0 on success, 1 when the batch failed (or a preview issuer had errors), 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {memoryTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import {fetchSubmissions} from '../../src/lib/entities/identifiers/sec-submissions';
import {productionCalendarDeps} from '../../src/lib/dq/calendar-deps';
import {previewCalendar,runCalendarSync} from '../../src/lib/dq/calendar-sync';
import type {CalendarSyncDeps} from '../../src/lib/dq/calendar-sync';
import {fetchSecDocument,submissionsView,syncFilerCategories} from '../../src/lib/dq/filer-categories';
import {filingsWindowStart} from '../../src/lib/dq/calendar';
import {memoryRawStore} from '../../src/lib/dq/raw-store';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {padCik} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import {makeBudget} from '../../src/lib/facts/sync';
import type {Market,ScopeRow} from '../../src/lib/facts/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: calendar-sync.ts --market US|CN [--issuer <uuid>]... [--limit n] [--apply] | --market US --no-db --cik <cik> [--cik ...]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const APPLY_BUDGET_MS=8*60_000;
interface Args{market:Market;issuers:string[];ciks:string[];limit:number;apply:boolean;noDb:boolean}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={market:'US',issuers:[],ciks:[],limit:200,apply:false,noDb:false};let market:string|undefined;
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--')){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}return v;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--market')market=next(i++);
  else if(x==='--issuer'){const v=next(i++);if(!UUID.test(v)){console.error('--issuer takes an issuer_id uuid');process.exit(2);}a.issuers.push(v);}
  else if(x==='--cik')a.ciks.push(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else if(x==='--no-db')a.noDb=true;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(market!=='US'&&market!=='CN'){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 a.market=market;
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>5000){console.error('--limit must be 1..5000');process.exit(2);}
 if(a.apply&&a.issuers.length>0){console.error('--issuer is preview-only');process.exit(2);}
 if(a.noDb&&(a.apply||a.market!=='US'||a.ciks.length===0||a.issuers.length>0)){console.error('--no-db needs --market US and --cik, and excludes --apply/--issuer');process.exit(2);}
 if(!a.noDb&&a.ciks.length>0){console.error('--cik is only for --no-db');process.exit(2);}
 if(a.ciks.some(c=>!/^\d{1,10}$/.test(c))){console.error('--cik must be digits');process.exit(2);}
 return a;
}

async function noDbDeps(ciks:string[],codeVersion:string):Promise<CalendarSyncDeps>{
 const tables=memoryTableClient({issuer_filer_categories:['issuer_id','fiscal_year'],issuer_filing_profiles:['issuer_id','market']});
 const raw=memoryRawStore();const budget=makeBudget(null);const now=()=>new Date();
 const scope:ScopeRow[]=[];
 for(const [i,c] of ciks.entries()){
  const issuer_id=`00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(i+1).padStart(12,'0')}`;
  await tables.insert('issuers',{issuer_id,canonical_name_en:`CIK ${c}`,status:'active'});
  await tables.insert('fact_sync_scope',{issuer_id,market:'US',priority:10,fetch_key:padCik(c)});
  scope.push({issuer_id,market:'US',reasons:['cli'],priority:10,fetch_key:padCik(c),next_due_at:now().toISOString(),lease_until:null,lease_batch_id:null,state_rev:0,last_attempt_at:null,last_success_at:null,last_batch_id:null,last_status:null});
 }
 const submissions=async(cik10:string,b:typeof budget)=>submissionsView(await fetchSubmissions(cik10,{fetch:globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis),raw,budget:b},{coverFrom:filingsWindowStart(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10))}));
 // Real covers → memory issuer_filer_categories, so the preview shows real deadlines.
 await syncFilerCategories({tables,db:{scopeAll:async()=>scope},raw,submissions,fetchDocument:(u,b)=>fetchSecDocument(u,b),now,budget,codeVersion},{limit:ciks.length,dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script'});
 return {tables,raw,db:{filingsForCalendar:async()=>[]},
  passes:{claimPass:async()=>null,replaceExpectations:async()=>0,failMember:async()=>{},finishPass:async()=>'complete'},
  submissions,disclosureDate:async()=>{throw new Error('CN not supported with --no-db');},now,budget,codeVersion};
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??(args.apply?null:'dry-run');
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('code version unavailable; refusing --apply');process.exit(2);}
 if(args.noDb){
  const deps=await noDbDeps(args.ciks,codeVersion);
  const out=await previewCalendar(deps,{market:'US',limit:args.ciks.length});
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'preview --no-db (memory stores; stored filings are empty)',out},null,1));
  process.exit(out.some(o=>o.errors.length>0)?1:0);
 }
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 if(!args.apply){
  const deps={...productionCalendarDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion,admin}),raw:memoryRawStore()};
  const out=await previewCalendar(deps,{market:args.market,issuerIds:args.issuers.length?args.issuers:undefined,limit:args.limit});
  console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'preview (nothing written; pass --apply)',market:args.market,out},null,1));
  process.exit(out.some(o=>o.errors.length>0)?1:0);
 }
 const deps=productionCalendarDeps({deadline:new Date(Date.now()+APPLY_BUDGET_MS),codeVersion,admin});
 const receipt=await runCalendarSync(deps,{market:args.market,limit:args.limit,triggeredBy:'script'});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:'apply',market:args.market,codeVersion,...receipt},null,1));
 process.exit(receipt.status==='success'?0:1);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/calendar.integration.test.ts
// F3-7 (spec §6.1/§6.2, §9.3; critical): the filing calendar end to end on real PostgreSQL — the
// migration-one pass functions (claim / replace / fail / finish), pgFactsDb.filingsForCalendar, profile
// writes and the rules: filed_not_ingested (a staged filing is not received), unknown_upstream (SEC
// down → stored profile; CN without a Tushare token), a 52/53-week estimated row replaced by the actual
// period end on the next pass, and a second worker that cannot take an active pass (the old lease
// holder is fenced out after the takeover). Rows are never cleaned up: test:db creates a fresh
// database per run and every test uses its own issuers.
// The calendar pass is global per market and test:db runs files in parallel: this suite holds the
// session advisory lock CALENDAR_TEST_LOCK for its whole run (every suite that claims calendar passes
// must do the same, plan 3 Part E contract note 7) and first drains any pass another suite left open.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import type {PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {TushareError} from '../data/sources/tushare';
import {pgFactsDb} from '../facts/pg-facts-db';
import type {Market} from '../facts/types';
import {expectationArgs,runCalendarSync,toCalendarPassError} from './calendar-sync';
import type {CalendarPassDb,CalendarPassToken,CalendarReceipt,CalendarSyncDeps} from './calendar-sync';
import type {SubmissionsEntryView,SubmissionsView} from './filer-categories';
import {memoryRawStore} from './raw-store';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const CALENDAR_TEST_LOCK=724_311_001;
const NOW=new Date('2026-11-05T01:00:00Z');

/** The four pass functions over node-postgres, errors mapped exactly like the Supabase adapter. */
function pgPasses(pool:Pool):CalendarPassDb{
 const fn=async<T>(call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>{
  try{return (await pool.query(`select ${call} as v`,values)).rows[0].v as T;}
  catch(e){throw toCalendarPassError(e as {message?:string});}
 };
 return {
  claimPass:(market,batch)=>fn<CalendarPassToken|null>('public.claim_calendar_pass($1,$2)',[market,batch]),
  replaceExpectations:(issuer,market,rows,token)=>fn<number>('public.replace_filing_expectations($1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4::jsonb)',[issuer,market,JSON.stringify(expectationArgs(rows)),JSON.stringify(token)]).then(Number),
  failMember:async(token,issuer,error)=>{await fn('public.fail_calendar_member($1::jsonb,$2,$3)',[JSON.stringify(token),issuer,error]);},
  finishPass:(token)=>fn<'complete'|'complete_with_failures'>('public.finish_calendar_pass($1::jsonb)',[JSON.stringify(token)]),
 };
}
const entry=(form:string,reportDate:string,filingDate:string,accn=randomUUID()):SubmissionsEntryView=>({accessionNumber:accn,filingDate,reportDate,form,primaryDocument:`${accn}.htm`,isInlineXBRL:true});

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('F3-7 filing calendar on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let lock:PoolClient;
 const q=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await admin.query(text,values)).rows as Record<string,any>[];
 const newBatch=async(producer:string,dataset:string)=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,$2,$3)`,[id,producer,dataset]);return id;};
 const newIssuer=async(name:string)=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) values($1,$2)`,[id,name]);return id;};
 const inScope=(market:Market,issuer:string,fetchKey:string)=>q(`insert into public.fact_sync_scope(issuer_id,market,reasons,priority,fetch_key) values($1,$2,'["test"]'::jsonb,10,$3)`,[issuer,market,fetchKey]);
 const category=(issuer:string,fy:number,acceleration='large_accelerated')=>q(`insert into public.issuer_filer_categories(issuer_id,fiscal_year,acceleration,smaller_reporting,category_raw,source,accession,evidence_sha256,as_of) values($1,$2,$3,null,'Large Accelerated Filer','ixbrl_dei',$4,$5,'2026-11-01')`,[issuer,fy,acceleration,`acc-${fy}`,'e'.repeat(64)]);
 /** One run for the issuer: lease → begin → stage filings (+ one fact each) → publish and release, or leave staged. */
 async function filingRun(issuer:string,filings:{form:string;periodEnd:string;available:string}[],publish:boolean):Promise<string[]>{
  const b=await newBatch('facts-sync','facts.us');
  expect((await q(`select public.claim_fact_sync_lease($1,'US',$2,600) v`,[issuer,b]))[0].v).toBe(true);
  const run=(await q(`select public.begin_sync_run($1,'US',$2,1) v`,[issuer,b]))[0].v as string;
  const rows=filings.map(f=>({filing_id:randomUUID(),source:'edgar',origin:'sec',form_type:f.form,fiscal_year:null,fiscal_period:null,period_end:f.periodEnd,available_date:f.available,source_ref:randomUUID(),url:null}));
  const map=(await q(`select public.stage_filings($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[run,JSON.stringify(rows)]))[0].v as Record<string,string>;
  const ids=rows.map(r=>map[r.source_ref]);
  const facts=rows.map((r,i)=>({fact_id:randomUUID(),filing_id:ids[i],concept:'total_assets',source_concept:'Assets',statement:'BS',period_start:null,period_end:r.period_end,duration:'INSTANT',value:'1',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:r.available_date,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',raw_hash:'h'}));
  await q(`select public.stage_facts($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[run,JSON.stringify(facts)]);
  if(publish){
   await q(`select public.publish_sync_run($1,$2::uuid[]) v`,[run,ids]);
   await q(`select public.release_fact_sync_lease($1,'US',$2,'success',now() + interval '7 days')`,[issuer,b]);
  }
  return ids;
 }
 const deps=(submissions:Record<string,SubmissionsView>):CalendarSyncDeps=>({
  tables:pgTableClient(admin),db:pgFactsDb(admin),passes:pgPasses(admin),raw:memoryRawStore(),
  submissions:async(cik10)=>{const v=submissions[cik10];if(!v)throw new Error('sec_unavailable: not in fixture');return v;},
  disclosureDate:async()=>{throw new TushareError(-1,'TUSHARE_TOKEN not configured');},
  now:()=>NOW,budget:{remainingMs:()=>3_600_000,signal:new AbortController().signal},codeVersion:'c'.repeat(40),
 });
 /** Expire any open pass lease of the market (we hold CALENDAR_TEST_LOCK) and run until the pass settles. */
 async function drain(market:Market,d:CalendarSyncDeps):Promise<CalendarReceipt>{
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
   await q(`update public.dq_calendar_passes set claim_until = clock_timestamp() - interval '1 second' where market = $1 and finished_at is null`,[market]);
   const r=await runCalendarSync(d,{market,limit:1000,triggeredBy:'script'});
   if(r.passStatus==='complete'||r.passStatus==='complete_with_failures')return r;
  }
  throw new Error(`calendar pass for ${market} did not settle`);
 }
 const rows=async(issuer:string)=>q(`select report_kind, period_end::text, period_end_estimated, deadline_state, due_date::text, due_rule, upstream_lookup, upstream_filed_date::text, disclosure_state, received_filing_id, detail from public.dq_filing_expectations where issuer_id = $1 order by period_end desc`,[issuer]);
 const at=(rs:Record<string,any>[],pe:string)=>{const r=rs.find(x=>x.period_end===pe);if(!r)throw new Error(`no row ${pe}: ${rs.map(x=>x.period_end).join(',')}`);return r;};

 let X:string,Y:string,Z:string,W:string;let xPublished:string;
 const CIK={X:'0000000901',Y:'0000000902',Z:'0000000903'};
 const coverage=entry('10-Q','2023-09-30','2023-11-01');   // proves the upstream list reaches back before every expected period
 const submissions:Record<string,SubmissionsView>={};

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
  lock=await admin.connect();
  await lock.query('select pg_advisory_lock($1)',[CALENDAR_TEST_LOCK]);
  for(const m of ['US','CN'] as Market[])
   if((await q(`select 1 from public.dq_calendar_passes where market = $1 and finished_at is null`,[m])).length)await drain(m,deps({}));
  // X: month-end filer; Q2 2026 received, Q1 2026 only staged but listed by SEC.
  X=await newIssuer('ZZ Calendar X');await inScope('US',X,CIK.X);await category(X,2024);await category(X,2025);
  [xPublished]=await filingRun(X,[{form:'10-Q',periodEnd:'2026-06-30',available:'2026-08-03'}],true);
  await filingRun(X,[{form:'10-Q',periodEnd:'2026-03-31',available:'2026-05-01'}],false);
  submissions[CIK.X]={cik10:CIK.X,sha256:'sub-x',category:'Large accelerated filer',fiscalYearEnd:'1231',entries:[entry('10-Q','2026-06-30','2026-08-03'),entry('10-Q','2026-03-31','2026-05-01'),entry('10-K','2025-12-31','2026-02-20'),coverage]};
  // Y: SEC unavailable, a profile stored by an earlier run.
  Y=await newIssuer('ZZ Calendar Y');await inScope('US',Y,CIK.Y);await category(Y,2024);await category(Y,2025);
  await q(`insert into public.issuer_filing_profiles(issuer_id,market,category_raw_current,regime,fiscal_year_end,week52_pattern,source,source_sha256,as_of) values($1,'US',null,'10-K','1231',false,'sec_submissions','old','2026-10-01')`,[Y]);
  // Z: 52/53-week filer (fiscal year ends late September).
  Z=await newIssuer('ZZ Calendar Z');await inScope('US',Z,CIK.Z);await category(Z,2024);await category(Z,2025);
  await filingRun(Z,[{form:'10-K',periodEnd:'2025-09-27',available:'2025-10-31'},{form:'10-Q',periodEnd:'2025-06-28',available:'2025-08-01'},{form:'10-Q',periodEnd:'2025-03-29',available:'2025-05-02'},{form:'10-Q',periodEnd:'2024-12-28',available:'2025-01-31'}],true);
  submissions[CIK.Z]={cik10:CIK.Z,sha256:'sub-z',category:'Large accelerated filer',fiscalYearEnd:'0927',entries:[entry('10-K','2025-09-27','2025-10-31'),entry('10-Q','2025-06-28','2025-08-01'),coverage]};

  const fresh=(await q(`select detail from public.dq_freshness where dataset = 'dq.calendar.us'`))[0];
  expect(fresh.detail.pass_id).toBe(tokenA.pass_id);
 },120_000);
```

**服务器计算的 `restorable`（接口对齐记录 #12）**：`quarantine.rows` 中每个 `reason_code='reconcile_mismatch'` 的行多一个布尔 `restorable` = `detail.latest_result.passed===true` 且 `detail.latest_result.inputs_hash` 等于 `inputsHashNow(row)`（Task 14c 的 `restoreInputsHashNow`，与隔离路由恢复时用的同一函数；返回 null 或抛错 → false）。`loadDqDashboard` 新增可选第四参数 `opts:{inputsHashNow?:InputsHashNow}`（不传 → 全部 false）；路由传入真实函数。页面只按 `restorable` 启用"恢复"，SQL 仍是最终裁决（409 `not_passing`）。

响应新字段（规格 §7）：`calendar:{overdueByMarket, filedNotIngestedByMarket, unknownUpstreamByMarket, noRuleByMarket, estimatedByMarket, rows(≤100：逾期 + 已申报未入库 + 7 日内到期 + 上游不可查，按此顺序再按应披露日), noRuleRows(≤50)}`（各 `ByMarket` 恒为两市场计数，不受 `market` 筛选影响；`rows/noRuleRows` 受筛选）、`claims:{rows(pending，最新 50), total, securitiesByIssuer(只为 evidence_only 行的发行人)}`、`reconciliationsByPair:{<pair>:{failed, lastCycle|null}}`（全部 7 个 pair；只有周期 pair 有 `lastCycle`）。

```ts
// src/lib/dq/dashboard-view.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {amendBody,claimMode,disclosureTone,overdueDays,quarantineAcceptBody,quarantineControl,suggestedOp,sumByMarket} from './dashboard-view';

describe('calendar view rules',()=>{
 it.each([['overdue','text-danger'],['filed_not_ingested','text-warn'],['unknown_upstream','text-text-muted italic'],['pending','text-text-dim'],['received_late','text-warn'],['received',''],['other','text-text-dim']])('%s → %j',(s,tone)=>{expect(disclosureTone(s)).toBe(tone);});
 it('overdue days only for overdue rows with a due date',()=>{
  expect(overdueDays({disclosure_state:'overdue',due_date:'2026-08-10'},'2026-11-05')).toBe(87);
  expect(overdueDays({disclosure_state:'pending',due_date:'2026-08-10'},'2026-11-05')).toBeNull();
  expect(overdueDays({disclosure_state:'overdue',due_date:null},'2026-11-05')).toBeNull();
  expect(sumByMarket({US:2,CN:3})).toBe(5);expect(sumByMarket(undefined)).toBe(0);
 });
});

describe('claims view rules',()=>{
 it('legacy is SQL-only, evidence_only needs an amendment, others accept directly',()=>{
  expect(claimMode('legacy')).toBe('sql_only');expect(claimMode('evidence_only')).toBe('amend');expect(claimMode('set_identifier')).toBe('accept');
 });
 it('builds the amend body per op and rejects incomplete forms',()=>{
  const base={issuerId:'i',ticker:'NEW',validFrom:'2026-01-01'};
  expect(amendBody({...base,op:'backdate_window',date:'2025-12-15',method:'ticker_change'})).toEqual({ok:true,body:{status:'accepted',amend:{op:'backdate_window',target:{issuer_id:'i',ticker:'NEW',valid_from:'2026-01-01'},params:{new_valid_from:'2025-12-15',valid_from_method:'ticker_change'}}}});
  expect(amendBody({...base,op:'close_security',date:'2026-03-01',method:'delisting'})).toMatchObject({ok:true,body:{amend:{params:{valid_to:'2026-03-01',valid_to_method:'delisting'}}}});
  expect(amendBody({...base,ticker:'',op:'close_security',date:'2026-03-01',method:'delisting'})).toEqual({ok:false,error:'amend_security'});
  expect(amendBody({...base,op:'close_security',date:'03/01/2026',method:'delisting'})).toEqual({ok:false,error:'amend_date'});
  expect(amendBody({...base,op:'close_security',date:'2026-03-01',method:'listing_date'})).toEqual({ok:false,error:'amend_method'});
  expect(suggestedOp({params:{suggested_op:'close_security'}})).toBe('close_security');expect(suggestedOp({})).toBe('backdate_window');
 });
});

describe('quarantine inline controls',()=>{
 it('ambiguous_value lists candidates and accepts only a listed index',()=>{
  const c=quarantineControl({reason_code:'ambiguous_value',payload:{candidates:[{value:'100',unit:'USD',sourceConcept:'Revenues',filingRef:'acc-1'},{value:'101',unit:'USD',sourceConcept:'SalesRevenueNet',filingRef:'acc-1'}]}});
  expect(c).toEqual({kind:'candidates',options:[{index:0,label:'100 USD · Revenues · acc-1'},{index:1,label:'101 USD · SalesRevenueNet · acc-1'}]});
  expect(quarantineAcceptBody(c,1)).toEqual({status:'resolved_accept',chosen_candidate_index:1});
  expect(quarantineAcceptBody(c,2)).toBeNull();expect(quarantineAcceptBody(c,null)).toBeNull();
 });
 it('lineage_conflict pairs fact ids with values (by fact_id, else by position) and accepts only a listed fact',()=>{
  const c=quarantineControl({reason_code:'lineage_conflict',payload:{fact_ids:['f1','f2'],values:[{issuer_id:'A',filing:'x',value:'1'},{fact_id:'f2',issuer_id:'B',filing:'y',value:'2'}]}});
  expect(c).toEqual({kind:'lineage',options:[{factId:'f1',label:'1 · A · x'},{factId:'f2',label:'2 · B · y'}]});
  expect(quarantineAcceptBody(c,'f2')).toEqual({status:'resolved_accept',keep_fact_id:'f2'});
  expect(quarantineAcceptBody(c,'f9')).toBeNull();
 });
 it('reconcile_mismatch restore is enabled only by a passing latest_result with server-computed restorable',()=>{
  expect(quarantineControl({reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',restorable:true,detail:{latest_result:{passed:true}}})).toEqual({kind:'restore',enabled:true,reason:'passing'});
  expect(quarantineControl({reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',restorable:false,detail:{latest_result:{passed:true}}})).toEqual({kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'inputs_changed'});
  expect(quarantineControl({reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',detail:{latest_result:{passed:true}}})).toEqual({kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'inputs_changed'});
  const off=quarantineControl({reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',detail:{latest_result:{passed:false}}});
  expect(off).toEqual({kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'not_passing'});
  expect(quarantineAcceptBody(off,null)).toBeNull();
  expect(quarantineControl({reason_code:'reconcile_mismatch',detail:{}})).toEqual({kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'no_result'});
  expect(quarantineControl({reason_code:'same_day_conflict'})).toEqual({kind:'plain'});
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现新模块**

```ts
// src/lib/dq/dashboard-blocks.ts
// The plan-3 blocks of GET /api/admin/dq (spec §7 table): the filing calendar (per-market counts
// that never depend on the market filter, plus the attention rows and the no-rule rows for the
// selected market), pending identifier claims (with the securities an evidence_only amendment can
// target), and reconciliation failures by pair with each cycle pair's latest cycle. Reads go
// through TableClient (equality + range filters only); every list is bounded.
import {selectAll} from '../db/table-client';
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {Market} from '../facts/types';
import {CYCLE_PAIR_IDS,RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS} from './reconcile/types';

export const MARKETS:readonly Market[]=['US','CN'];
export const CALENDAR_ROWS_MAX=100;
export const CALENDAR_NO_RULE_MAX=50;
export const CLAIMS_MAX=50;
export const DUE_SOON_DAYS=7;
export type ByMarket=Record<Market,number>;
export interface CalendarBlock{overdueByMarket:ByMarket;filedNotIngestedByMarket:ByMarket;unknownUpstreamByMarket:ByMarket;noRuleByMarket:ByMarket;estimatedByMarket:ByMarket;rows:Row[];noRuleRows:Row[]}
export interface ClaimsBlock{rows:Row[];total:number;securitiesByIssuer:Record<string,Row[]>}
export type ReconciliationsByPair=Record<string,{failed:number;lastCycle:{cycle_id:string;status:string;finished_at:string|null}|null}>;

const addDaysIso=(iso:string,n:number)=>new Date(Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`)+n*86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
async function byMarket(client:TableClient,match:Row):Promise<ByMarket>{
 const [us,cn]=await Promise.all(MARKETS.map(m=>client.count('dq_filing_expectations',{...match,market:m})));
 return {US:us,CN:cn};
}
/** Attention order: overdue, filed-not-ingested, due within 7 days, unknown upstream; then due date (none last), period end. */
const RANK:Record<string,number>={overdue:0,filed_not_ingested:1,pending:2,unknown_upstream:3};
const rowKey=(r:Row)=>`${r.issuer_id}|${r.market}|${r.report_kind}|${r.period_end}`;

export async function loadCalendarBlock(client:TableClient,market:Market|undefined,now:Date):Promise<CalendarBlock>{
 const today=now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const scope:Row=market?{market}:{};
 const list=(match:Row,orderBy:string,extra:{gte?:Record<string,string>;lt?:Record<string,string>}={})=>client.select('dq_filing_expectations',{...scope,...match},{orderBy,limit:CALENDAR_ROWS_MAX,...extra});
 const [overdueByMarket,filedNotIngestedByMarket,unknownUpstreamByMarket,noRuleByMarket,estimatedByMarket,overdue,filed,soon,unknown,noRuleRows]=await Promise.all([
  byMarket(client,{disclosure_state:'overdue'}),byMarket(client,{disclosure_state:'filed_not_ingested'}),byMarket(client,{disclosure_state:'unknown_upstream'}),
  byMarket(client,{deadline_state:'no_rule'}),byMarket(client,{period_end_estimated:true}),
  list({disclosure_state:'overdue'},'due_date'),list({disclosure_state:'filed_not_ingested'},'due_date'),
  list({disclosure_state:'pending'},'due_date',{gte:{due_date:today},lt:{due_date:addDaysIso(today,DUE_SOON_DAYS+1)}}),
  list({disclosure_state:'unknown_upstream'},'period_end'),
  client.select('dq_filing_expectations',{...scope,deadline_state:'no_rule'},{orderBy:'period_end',desc:true,limit:CALENDAR_NO_RULE_MAX}),
 ]);
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 const rows=[...overdue,...filed,...soon,...unknown].filter(r=>{const k=rowKey(r);if(seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true;})
  .sort((a,b)=>(RANK[String(a.disclosure_state)]??9)-(RANK[String(b.disclosure_state)]??9)||String(a.due_date??'9999').localeCompare(String(b.due_date??'9999'))||String(b.period_end).localeCompare(String(a.period_end)))
  .slice(0,CALENDAR_ROWS_MAX);
 return {overdueByMarket,filedNotIngestedByMarket,unknownUpstreamByMarket,noRuleByMarket,estimatedByMarket,rows,noRuleRows};
}

export async function loadClaimsBlock(client:TableClient):Promise<ClaimsBlock>{
 const [rows,total]=await Promise.all([
  client.select('issuer_identifier_claims',{status:'pending'},{orderBy:'created_at',desc:true,limit:CLAIMS_MAX}),
  client.count('issuer_identifier_claims',{status:'pending'}),
 ]);
 const issuers=[...new Set(rows.filter(r=>r.op==='evidence_only').map(r=>String(r.issuer_id)))];
 const lists=await Promise.all(issuers.map(id=>selectAll(client,'issuer_securities',{issuer_id:id},'valid_from')));
 const securitiesByIssuer=Object.fromEntries(issuers.map((id,i)=>[id,lists[i].map(s=>({ticker:s.ticker,valid_from:s.valid_from,valid_to:s.valid_to??null,valid_from_method:s.valid_from_method??null,is_primary:s.is_primary===true}))]));
 return {rows,total,securitiesByIssuer};
}

export async function loadReconciliationsByPair(client:TableClient):Promise<ReconciliationsByPair>{
 const cyclePairs=new Set<string>(CYCLE_PAIR_IDS);
 const entries=await Promise.all(RECONCILE_PAIR_IDS.map(async pair=>{
  const [failed,cycles]=await Promise.all([
   client.count('dq_reconciliations',{pair,passed:false}),
   cyclePairs.has(pair)?client.select('dq_reconcile_cycles',{pair},{orderBy:'started_at',desc:true,limit:1}):Promise.resolve([] as Row[]),
  ]);
  const c=cycles[0];
  return [pair,{failed,lastCycle:c?{cycle_id:String(c.cycle_id),status:String(c.status),finished_at:c.finished_at==null?null:String(c.finished_at)}:null}] as const;
 }));
 return Object.fromEntries(entries);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/dashboard-view.ts
// Pure view rules for the /admin/dq panels (spec §7.2), kept out of the client component so they are
// unit-tested (the repo has no component-test setup: vitest runs src/**/*.test.ts in node). Tones are
// existing tokens only (text-danger / text-warn / text-text-muted / text-text-dim); no new colours.
export type Tone=''|'text-danger'|'text-warn'|'text-text-dim'|'text-text-muted'|'text-text-muted italic';
const DISCLOSURE_TONE:Record<string,Tone>={overdue:'text-danger',filed_not_ingested:'text-warn',unknown_upstream:'text-text-muted italic',pending:'text-text-dim',received_late:'text-warn',received:''};
export const disclosureTone=(state:string):Tone=>DISCLOSURE_TONE[state]??'text-text-dim';
/** Whole days past the due date for an overdue row; null otherwise (never for estimated / no_rule rows). */
export function overdueDays(row:{disclosure_state?:unknown;due_date?:unknown},today:string):number|null{
 if(row.disclosure_state!=='overdue'||typeof row.due_date!=='string')return null;
 const d=Math.round((Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00Z`)-Date.parse(`${row.due_date}T00:00:00Z`))/86_400_000);
 return Number.isFinite(d)&&d>0?d:null;
}
export const sumByMarket=(b:{US:number;CN:number}|undefined)=>b?b.US+b.CN:0;

/** Claims panel: what the accept control does for a row. */
export type ClaimMode='accept'|'amend'|'sql_only';
export const claimMode=(op:unknown):ClaimMode=>op==='legacy'?'sql_only':op==='evidence_only'?'amend':'accept';

export interface AmendForm{op:'backdate_window'|'close_security';issuerId:string;ticker:string;validFrom:string;date:string;method:string}
export const AMEND_METHODS={backdate_window:['listing_date','ticker_change','curated'],close_security:['delisting','ticker_change','curated']} as const;
const ISO=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
/** POST /api/admin/dq/claims/[id] body for an evidence_only acceptance (spec §4.2.1 target/params per op), or an error key. */
export function amendBody(f:AmendForm):{ok:true;body:{status:'accepted';amend:{op:AmendForm['op'];target:{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string};params:Record<string,string>}}}|{ok:false;error:'amend_security'|'amend_date'|'amend_method'}{
 if(!f.ticker||!ISO.test(f.validFrom))return {ok:false,error:'amend_security'};
 if(!ISO.test(f.date))return {ok:false,error:'amend_date'};
 if(!(AMEND_METHODS[f.op] as readonly string[]).includes(f.method))return {ok:false,error:'amend_method'};
 const params:Record<string,string>=f.op==='backdate_window'?{new_valid_from:f.date,valid_from_method:f.method}:{valid_to:f.date,valid_to_method:f.method};
 return {ok:true,body:{status:'accepted',amend:{op:f.op,target:{issuer_id:f.issuerId,ticker:f.ticker,valid_from:f.validFrom},params}}};
}
/** The suggested op stored by the producer (params.suggested_op), defaulting to backdate_window. */
export const suggestedOp=(detail:unknown):AmendForm['op']=>{
 const op=(detail as {params?:{suggested_op?:unknown}}|null)?.params?.suggested_op;
 return op==='close_security'?'close_security':'backdate_window';
};

/** Quarantine inline interactions (spec §7.2): which control a row shows. */
export type QuarantineControl={kind:'candidates';options:{index:number;label:string}[]}|{kind:'lineage';options:{factId:string;label:string}[]}|{kind:'restore';enabled:boolean;reason:'passing'|'not_passing'|'no_result'|'inputs_changed'}|{kind:'plain'};
const str=(v:unknown)=>v===null||v===undefined?'—':String(v);
export function quarantineControl(row:{reason_code?:unknown;payload?:unknown;detail?:unknown;restorable?:unknown}):QuarantineControl{
 const payload=(row.payload??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
 if(row.reason_code==='ambiguous_value'&&Array.isArray(payload.candidates))
  return {kind:'candidates',options:(payload.candidates as Record<string,unknown>[]).map((c,index)=>({index,label:`${str(c.value)} ${str(c.unit)} · ${str(c.sourceConcept)} · ${str(c.filingRef)}`}))};
 if(row.reason_code==='lineage_conflict'&&Array.isArray(payload.fact_ids)){
  const values=Array.isArray(payload.values)?payload.values as Record<string,unknown>[]:[];
  return {kind:'lineage',options:(payload.fact_ids as unknown[]).map((id,i)=>{const v=values.find(x=>x.fact_id===id)??values[i]??{};return {factId:String(id),label:`${str(v.value)} · ${str(v.issuer_id)} · ${str(v.filing)}`};})};
 }
 if(row.reason_code==='reconcile_mismatch'){
  const latest=((row.detail??{}) as {latest_result?:{passed?:unknown}}).latest_result;
  if(!latest)return {kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'no_result'};
  if(latest.passed!==true)return {kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'not_passing'};
  // server-computed (loadDqDashboard): passed AND latest inputs_hash === inputsHashNow(row)
  return row.restorable===true?{kind:'restore',enabled:true,reason:'passing'}:{kind:'restore',enabled:false,reason:'inputs_changed'};
 }
 return {kind:'plain'};
}
/** POST /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id] body for an accept with a selection (spec §4.4, §4.6). */
export function quarantineAcceptBody(c:QuarantineControl,choice:number|string|null):{status:'resolved_accept';chosen_candidate_index?:number;keep_fact_id?:string}|null{
 if(c.kind==='candidates'){if(typeof choice!=='number'||!c.options.some(o=>o.index===choice))return null;return {status:'resolved_accept',chosen_candidate_index:choice};}
 if(c.kind==='lineage'){if(typeof choice!=='string'||!c.options.some(o=>o.factId===choice))return null;return {status:'resolved_accept',keep_fact_id:choice};}
 if(c.kind==='restore'&&!c.enabled)return null;
 return {status:'resolved_accept'};
}
```

```ts
/** Server-side restore eligibility of a reconcile_mismatch item (spec §7.2): passing latest_result AND its inputs_hash equals the CURRENT inputs hash. */
export async function restorableOf(row:Row,hashNow?:InputsHashNow):Promise<boolean>{
 const latest=((row.detail??{}) as {latest_result?:{passed?:unknown;inputs_hash?:unknown}}).latest_result;
 if(!hashNow||latest?.passed!==true||typeof latest.inputs_hash!=='string')return false;
 try{return (await hashNow(row))===latest.inputs_hash;}catch{return false;}
}
```

签名改为 `export async function loadDqDashboard(client:TableClient,query:DqQuery,now:Date,opts:{inputsHashNow?:InputsHashNow}={}):Promise<DqDashboard>`；返回对象里 `quarantine:{rows:quarantineRows,…}` 的 `rows` 改为 `rows:await Promise.all(quarantineRows.map(async r=>r.reason_code==='reconcile_mismatch'?{...r,restorable:await restorableOf(r,opts.inputsHashNow)}:r))`。`dashboard.test.ts` 加一个用例：两条 `reconcile_mismatch` 行（`latest_result:{passed:true,inputs_hash:'h'}`），`inputsHashNow` 对第一条返回 `'h'`、第二条返回 `'x'` → `restorable` 依次 `true/false`；不传 `opts` → 都为 `false`；非 `reconcile_mismatch` 行没有 `restorable` 键。

```tsx
// Shared building blocks of the /admin/dq page (moved out of AdminDqClient.tsx unchanged, plan 3
// Task 19b) so the new panels reuse them. Existing tokens only.
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

export type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
export type Col = { label: string; num?: boolean };
export type T = (key: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>) => string;

export const s = (v: unknown) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' ? '—' : String(v));
export const pct = (v: unknown) => (v === null || v === undefined || !Number.isFinite(Number(v)) ? '—' : `${(Number(v) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
export const count = (row: Row, key: string) => s((row.counts as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.[key] ?? 0);
// Fixed semantic tones: never text-up/text-down, which flip with the market colour scheme.
export const STATUS_TONE: Record<string, string> = {
  fresh: '', success: '', stale: 'text-warn', partial: 'text-warn', running: 'text-text-dim',
  missing: 'text-text-muted', error: 'text-danger', failed: 'text-danger', rejected: 'text-danger',
  complete: '', complete_with_gaps: 'text-warn', complete_with_failures: 'text-warn',
};
// Tailwind 3 cannot apply an opacity modifier to a var() colour, so mix it explicitly.
export const DANGER_BG = 'bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--danger)_10%,transparent)]';
export const td = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5';
export const num = `${td} text-right tabular-nums`;
export const btn = 'min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border px-3 disabled:opacity-40';

export function Pill({ value, tone }: { value: string; tone?: string }) {
  return <span className={`rounded border border-border bg-bg-card px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[11px] ${tone ?? STATUS_TONE[value] ?? 'text-text-dim'}`}>{value}</span>;
}

export function Tile({ label, value, note, tone }: { label: string; value: ReactNode; note?: ReactNode; tone?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-elevated p-3">
      <div className="truncate text-[11px] text-text-dim" title={label}>{label}</div>
      <div className={`mt-1 text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums ${tone ?? ''}`}>{value}</div>
      {note ? <div className="mt-1 truncate text-[11px] text-text-muted">{note}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Table({ head, children, empty }: { head: Col[]; children: ReactNode[]; empty: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border">
      <table className="w-full min-w-[560px] text-left text-xs tabular-nums">
        <thead className="bg-bg-card text-text-dim"><tr>{head.map((h) => <th key={h.label} scope="col" className={`whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5 font-medium ${h.num ? 'text-right' : ''}`}>{h.label}</th>)}</tr></thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
          {children.length ? children : <tr><td colSpan={head.length} className="px-2 py-3 text-text-muted">{empty}</td></tr>}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Detail({ value, className }: { value: unknown; className?: string }) {
  const json = JSON.stringify(value ?? {});
  return (
    <details className={className}>
      <summary className="cursor-pointer truncate font-mono text-text-muted">{json}</summary>
      <pre className="mt-1 max-h-64 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-all rounded border border-border bg-bg-card p-2 font-mono text-[11px]">{JSON.stringify(value ?? {}, null, 2)}</pre>
    </details>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// src/app/(app)/admin/dq/panels.tsx
// Plan-3 panels of /admin/dq (spec §7.2; layout per the Claude Design canvas named in the Task 19b
// brief): filing calendar, identifier claims (evidence_only amendment form), reconciliation counts
// by pair. Pure rules live in src/lib/dq/dashboard-view.ts; tokens and components are the existing ones.

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Panel } from '@/components/ui';
import type { CalendarBlock, ClaimsBlock, ReconciliationsByPair } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard-blocks';
import { AMEND_METHODS, amendBody, claimMode, disclosureTone, overdueDays, suggestedOp } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard-view';
import type { AmendForm } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard-view';
import { Detail, Pill, STATUS_TONE, Table, btn, num, s, td } from './primitives';
import type { Row, T } from './primitives';

export type MarketFilter = '' | 'US' | 'CN';
const display = (r: Row) => (r.detail as { display?: { ticker?: unknown; name?: unknown } } | null)?.display ?? {};

export function CalendarPanel({ t, calendar, market, onMarket, today, busy }: { t: T; calendar: CalendarBlock | undefined; market: MarketFilter; onMarket: (m: MarketFilter) => void; today: string; busy: boolean }) {
  const rows = calendar?.rows ?? [];
  const noRule = calendar?.noRuleRows ?? [];
  const cols = ['issuer', 'market', 'reportKind', 'periodEnd', 'deadlineState', 'dueDate', 'dueRule', 'expectedDate', 'upstreamFiled', 'disclosureState', 'overdueDays'];
  return (
    <Panel title={t('sections.calendar')}>
      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-text-dim">
          <span>{t('calendar.market')}</span>
          <select value={market} disabled={busy} onChange={(e) => onMarket(e.target.value as MarketFilter)} className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-2 font-mono text-text">
            <option value="">{t('calendar.allMarkets')}</option><option value="US">US</option><option value="CN">CN</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <span className="text-text-muted">{t('calendar.legend')}</span>
      </div>
      <Table empty={t('calendar.empty')} head={cols.map((c) => ({ label: t(`calendar.columns.${c}`), num: c === 'overdueDays' }))}>
        {rows.map((r) => {
          const d = display(r);
          const late = overdueDays(r, today);
          return (
            <tr key={`${s(r.issuer_id)}|${s(r.market)}|${s(r.report_kind)}|${s(r.period_end)}`}>
              <td className={td}><span className="font-mono">{s(d.ticker)}</span> <span className="text-text-dim">{s(d.name)}</span></td>
              <td className={td}>{s(r.market)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.report_kind)}</td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.period_end)}{r.period_end_estimated === true ? <span className="ml-1 text-text-muted" title={t('calendar.estimatedHint')}>{t('calendar.estimatedMark')}</span> : null}</td>
              <td className={td}>{t(`calendar.deadline.${s(r.deadline_state)}`)}</td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.due_date)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono text-text-dim`}>{s(r.due_rule)}</td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.expected_date)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.upstream_filed_date)}</td>
              <td className={td}><Pill value={s(r.disclosure_state)} tone={disclosureTone(String(r.disclosure_state))} /></td>
              <td className={`${num} ${late ? 'text-danger' : ''}`}>{late ?? '—'}</td>
            </tr>
          );
        })}
      </Table>
      <details className="mt-3 text-xs">
        <summary className="cursor-pointer text-text-dim">{t('calendar.noRuleTitle', { n: noRule.length })}</summary>
        <div className="mt-2">
          <Table empty={t('calendar.noRuleEmpty')} head={['issuer', 'market', 'reportKind', 'periodEnd', 'dueRule', 'disclosureState'].map((c) => ({ label: t(`calendar.columns.${c}`) }))}>
            {noRule.map((r) => (
              <tr key={`${s(r.issuer_id)}|${s(r.market)}|${s(r.report_kind)}|${s(r.period_end)}`}>
                <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(display(r).ticker)}</td><td className={td}>{s(r.market)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.report_kind)}</td>
                <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.period_end)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono text-text-dim`}>{s(r.due_rule)}</td>
                <td className={td}><Pill value={s(r.disclosure_state)} tone={disclosureTone(String(r.disclosure_state))} /></td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </Table>
        </div>
      </details>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t('notes.calendar')}</p>
    </Panel>
  );
}

export function ClaimsPanel({ t, claims, busy, pending, time, onResolve }: { t: T; claims: ClaimsBlock | undefined; busy: boolean; pending: string | null; time: (v: unknown) => string; onResolve: (id: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) => void }) {
  const [amending, setAmending] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rows = claims?.rows ?? [];
  const title = claims && claims.total > rows.length ? `${t('sections.claims')} · ${t('claims.latest', { shown: rows.length, total: claims.total })}` : t('sections.claims');
  const controls = (r: Row) => {
    const id = String(r.id);
    const mode = claimMode(r.op);
    if (mode === 'sql_only') return <span className="text-text-muted">{t('claims.sqlOnly')}</span>;
    return (
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} className={`${btn} text-accent`} aria-label={`${t('accept')} ${id}`}
          onClick={() => (mode === 'amend' ? setAmending(amending === id ? null : id) : onResolve(id, { status: 'accepted' }))}>{mode === 'amend' ? t('claims.amendAccept') : t('accept')}</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} className={`${btn} text-danger`} aria-label={`${t('reject')} ${id}`} onClick={() => onResolve(id, { status: 'rejected' })}>{t('reject')}</button>
      </div>
    );
  };
  const cells = (r: Row) => {
    const detail = (r.detail ?? {}) as { evidence_kind?: unknown };
    return [time(r.created_at), s(r.issuer_id).slice(0, 8), s(r.op), s(r.id_type), s(r.value), s(detail.evidence_kind), s(r.source)];
  };
  return (
    <Panel title={title}>
      <div className="divide-y divide-border rounded-md border border-border sm:hidden">
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <div key={String(r.id)} className={`space-y-1 p-3 text-xs ${pending === String(r.id) ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}>
            <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 font-mono"><span>{s(r.op)} · {s(r.id_type)}</span><span className="text-text-dim">{time(r.created_at)}</span></div>
            <div className="break-all font-mono">{s(r.value)}</div>
            <Detail value={r.detail} className="min-w-0" />
            <div className="py-1">{controls(r)}</div>
            {amending === String(r.id) ? <AmendFormView t={t} row={r} securities={claims?.securitiesByIssuer[String(r.issuer_id)] ?? []} busy={busy} onSubmit={(body) => { setAmending(null); onResolve(String(r.id), body); }} /> : null}
          </div>
        ))}
        {rows.length === 0 ? <div className="p-3 text-xs text-text-muted">{t('claims.empty')}</div> : null}
      </div>
      <div className="hidden sm:block">
        <Table empty={t('claims.empty')} head={['time', 'issuer', 'op', 'idType', 'value', 'evidenceKind', 'source', 'detail', 'actions'].map((c) => ({ label: t(`claims.columns.${c}`) }))}>
          {rows.flatMap((r) => {
            const id = String(r.id);
            const main = (
              <tr key={id} className={pending === id ? 'opacity-50' : undefined}>
                {cells(r).map((c, i) => <td key={i} className={`${td} ${i > 0 && i < 5 ? 'font-mono' : ''}`}>{c}</td>)}
                <td className="max-w-[16rem] px-2 py-1.5 align-top"><Detail value={r.detail} /></td>
                <td className={td}>{controls(r)}</td>
              </tr>
            );
            if (amending !== id) return [main];
            return [main, (
              <tr key={`${id}-amend`}><td colSpan={9} className="px-2 py-2">
                <AmendFormView t={t} row={r} securities={claims?.securitiesByIssuer[String(r.issuer_id)] ?? []} busy={busy} onSubmit={(body) => { setAmending(null); onResolve(id, body); }} />
              </td></tr>
            )];
          })}
        </Table>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t('notes.claims')}</p>
    </Panel>
  );
}

function AmendFormView({ t, row, securities, busy, onSubmit }: { t: T; row: Row; securities: Row[]; busy: boolean; onSubmit: (body: Record<string, unknown>) => void }) {
  const [op, setOp] = useState<AmendForm['op']>(suggestedOp(row.detail));
  const [security, setSecurity] = useState(securities[0] ? `${s(securities[0].ticker)}|${s(securities[0].valid_from)}` : '');
  const [date, setDate] = useState('');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<string>(AMEND_METHODS[op][0]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ticker, validFrom] = security.split('|');
  const field = 'min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-2 font-mono text-text';
  return (
    <form className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card p-2 text-xs"
      onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); const r = amendBody({ op, issuerId: String(row.issuer_id), ticker: ticker ?? '', validFrom: validFrom ?? '', date, method }); if (!r.ok) { setError(t(`claims.errors.${r.error}`)); return; } setError(null); onSubmit(r.body); }}>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-text-dim">{t('claims.amend.op')}
        <select value={op} onChange={(e) => { const next = e.target.value as AmendForm['op']; setOp(next); setMethod(AMEND_METHODS[next][0]); }} className={field}>
          <option value="backdate_window">backdate_window</option><option value="close_security">close_security</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-text-dim">{t('claims.amend.security')}
        <select value={security} onChange={(e) => setSecurity(e.target.value)} className={field}>
          {securities.map((x) => { const v = `${s(x.ticker)}|${s(x.valid_from)}`; return <option key={v} value={v}>{s(x.ticker)} · {s(x.valid_from)} → {s(x.valid_to)}</option>; })}
        </select>
      </label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-text-dim">{op === 'backdate_window' ? t('claims.amend.newValidFrom') : t('claims.amend.validTo')}
        <input type="date" value={date} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)} className={field} />
      </label>
      <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-text-dim">{t('claims.amend.method')}
        <select value={method} onChange={(e) => setMethod(e.target.value)} className={field}>
          {AMEND_METHODS[op].map((m) => <option key={m} value={m}>{m}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      <button type="submit" disabled={busy || securities.length === 0} className={`${btn} text-accent`}>{t('claims.amend.submit')}</button>
      {securities.length === 0 ? <span className="text-text-muted">{t('claims.amend.noSecurities')}</span> : null}
      {error ? <span role="alert" className="text-danger">{error}</span> : null}
    </form>
  );
}

export function ReconciliationPairs({ t, byPair }: { t: T; byPair: ReconciliationsByPair | undefined }) {
  const entries = Object.entries(byPair ?? {});
  return (
    <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-[11px]">
      {entries.map(([pair, v]) => (
        <div key={pair} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-2 py-1">
          <span className="font-mono">{pair}</span>
          <span className={`tabular-nums ${v.failed > 0 ? 'text-danger' : 'text-text-dim'}`}>{t('reconciliation.failed', { n: v.failed })}</span>
          {v.lastCycle ? <span className={STATUS_TONE[v.lastCycle.status] ?? 'text-text-dim'} title={v.lastCycle.cycle_id}>{t('reconciliation.lastCycle', { status: v.lastCycle.status })}</span> : <span className="text-text-muted">{t('reconciliation.noCycle')}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

有提交 → 用 `git diff main -- 'src/app/(app)/admin/dq/AdminDqClient.tsx'` 读改动，下面的新版本已经兼容 `data.datasets`；若 Task 2 还改了别的行为，把它并入下面的版本。然后把文件整体替换为：

```tsx
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Panel } from '@/components/ui';
import type { DqSummary } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard';
import type { CalendarBlock, ClaimsBlock, ReconciliationsByPair } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard-blocks';
import { quarantineAcceptBody, quarantineControl, sumByMarket } from '@/lib/dq/dashboard-view';
import { CalendarPanel, ClaimsPanel, ReconciliationPairs } from './panels';
import type { MarketFilter } from './panels';
import { DANGER_BG, Detail, Pill, Table, Tile, btn, count, num, pct, s, td } from './primitives';
import type { Row } from './primitives';

interface DqResponse {
  summary: DqSummary;
  batches24hTruncated: boolean;
  batches: Row[];
  freshness: (Row & { status: string; stored_status: string })[];
  quarantine: { rows: Row[]; page: number; pageSize: number; total: number };
  reconciliations: Row[];
  datasets?: string[];
  calendar: CalendarBlock;
  claims: ClaimsBlock;
  reconciliationsByPair: ReconciliationsByPair;
  refreshedAt: string;
}
type Resolution = 'resolved_accept' | 'resolved_reject';

export function AdminDqClient() {
  const t = useTranslations('admin.dq');
  const locale = useLocale();
  const [dataset, setDataset] = useState('');
  const [market, setMarket] = useState<MarketFilter>('');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<DqResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState<Record<string, number | string>>({});
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  const reload = useCallback(() => setTick((n) => n + 1), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page) });
    if (dataset) qs.set('dataset', dataset);
    if (market) qs.set('market', market);
    setLoading(true);
    fetch(`/api/admin/dq?${qs}`, { signal: controller.signal, cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(async (r) => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`); return r.json() as Promise<DqResponse>; })
      .then((d) => {
        setData(d); setError(null); setLoading(false);
        // A resolve can empty the last page; step back to the new last page and refetch.
        const lastPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(d.quarantine.total / d.quarantine.pageSize));
        if (d.quarantine.rows.length === 0 && d.quarantine.total > 0 && page > lastPage) setPage(lastPage);
      })
      .catch((e) => { if (e instanceof Error && e.name === 'AbortError') return; setError(t('loadFailed')); setLoading(false); });
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [dataset, market, page, tick, t]);

  const time = (v: unknown) => {
    const d = new Date(String(v ?? ''));
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? '—' : d.toLocaleString(locale, { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  };

  /** One POST helper for quarantine and claims; 409 bodies carry a code shown as a notice. */
  async function post(url: string, id: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) {
    setPending(id); setError(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), cache: 'no-store' });
      if (r.ok) {
        const j = (await r.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { restore?: { restore_note?: string } };
        if (j.restore?.restore_note === 'no_rows_promoted') setNotice(t('quarantine.noRowsPromoted'));
        reload();
      } else if (r.status === 409) {
        // Both routes answer 409 with {error:<code>, id} (plan 3 接口对齐记录 #9); the quarantine route keeps {outcome} and may add
        // detail.restore_note (reconcile_wiring_missing / inputs_unavailable); landed plan-2 409s carry only {id, outcome}.
        const j = (await r.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; outcome?: string; detail?: { restore_note?: string } };
        const code = j.detail?.restore_note ?? j.error ?? j.outcome;
        setNotice(code && t.has(`conflicts.${code}`) ? t(`conflicts.${code}`) : t('alreadyResolved'));
        reload();
      } else if (r.status === 404) { setError(t('notFound')); reload(); }
      else setError(t('resolveFailed'));
    } catch {
      setError(t('resolveFailed'));
    } finally {
      setPending(null);
    }
  }
  const resolve = (id: string, body: { status: Resolution; chosen_candidate_index?: number; keep_fact_id?: string }) => post(`/api/admin/dq/quarantine/${id}`, id, body);
  const resolveClaim = (id: string, body: Record<string, unknown>) => post(`/api/admin/dq/claims/${id}`, id, body);

  const busy = loading || pending !== null;
  const sm = data?.summary;
  const q = data?.quarantine;
  const cal = data?.calendar;
  const today = (data?.refreshedAt ?? new Date().toISOString()).slice(0, 10);
  const pages = q ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(q.total / q.pageSize)) : 1;
  // Registry inventory (Task 2) ∪ what this response loaded ∪ the current selection, so it never disappears.
  const datasets = Array.from(new Set([
    ...(data?.datasets ?? []),
    ...[...(data?.freshness ?? []), ...(data?.batches ?? []), ...(q?.rows ?? [])].map((r) => String(r.dataset)),
    ...(dataset ? [dataset] : []),
  ])).sort();
  const by = sm?.batchesByStatus ?? {};
  const batchTotal = Object.values(by).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const recShown = data?.reconciliations.length ?? 0;
  const recTotal = sm?.failedReconciliationsTotal ?? 0;
  const recTitle = recTotal > recShown
    ? `${t('sections.reconciliations')} · ${t('sections.reconciliationsLatest', { shown: recShown, total: recTotal })}`
    : t('sections.reconciliations');
  const overdue = sumByMarket(cal?.overdueByMarket);

  return (
    <div data-density="data" className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-4">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-dim">{t('subtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {data ? <span className="rounded border border-border bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('refreshedAt', { time: new Date(data.refreshedAt).toLocaleTimeString(locale, { hour12: false }) })}</span> : null}
          <button type="button" onClick={reload} disabled={busy} className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-elevated px-3 text-xs hover:text-accent disabled:opacity-50">{loading ? t('loading') : t('refresh')}</button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {notice ? <div role="status" className="rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-3 py-2 text-xs text-warn">{notice}</div> : null}
      {error ? <div role="alert" className={`rounded-md ${DANGER_BG} px-3 py-2 text-xs text-danger`}>{error}</div> : null}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <Tile label={t('tiles.notFresh')} value={sm ? `${sm.notFresh.length} / ${sm.freshnessTotal}` : '—'}
          tone={sm && sm.notFresh.length > 0 ? 'text-warn' : undefined}
          note={sm ? t('tiles.notFreshNote', sm.notFreshByStatus) : null} />
        <Tile label={t('tiles.overdue')} value={cal ? overdue : '—'} tone={overdue > 0 ? 'text-danger' : undefined}
          note={cal ? t('tiles.overdueNote', { us: cal.overdueByMarket.US, cn: cal.overdueByMarket.CN, filed: sumByMarket(cal.filedNotIngestedByMarket), unknown: sumByMarket(cal.unknownUpstreamByMarket) }) : null} />
        <Tile label={t('tiles.openQuarantine')} value={sm ? sm.openQuarantineTotal : '—'} note={t('tiles.openQuarantineNote')} />
        <Tile label={t('tiles.failedReconciliations')} value={sm ? sm.failedReconciliationsTotal : '—'}
          tone={sm && sm.failedReconciliationsTotal > 0 ? 'text-danger' : undefined} />
        <Tile label={t('tiles.batches24h')} value={sm ? `${data?.batches24hTruncated ? '≥' : ''}${batchTotal}` : '—'}
          note={sm ? t('tiles.batchesNote', { success: by.success ?? 0, partial: by.partial ?? 0, failed: by.failed ?? 0 }) : null} />
      </div>

      <Panel title={t('sections.freshness')}>
        <Table empty={t('empty')} head={[{ label: t('columns.dataset') }, { label: t('columns.cadence') }, { label: t('columns.lastOk') }, { label: t('columns.status') }, { label: t('columns.stored') }]}>
          {(data?.freshness ?? []).map((f) => (
            <tr key={String(f.dataset)}>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(f.dataset)}</td><td className={td}>{s(f.expected_cadence)}</td>
              <td className={td}>{time(f.last_ok_at)}</td><td className={td}><Pill value={f.status} /></td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono ${f.status !== f.stored_status ? 'text-warn' : 'text-text-dim'}`}>{f.status !== f.stored_status ? `≠ ${f.stored_status}` : f.stored_status}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t('notes.freshness')}</p>
      </Panel>

      <CalendarPanel t={t} calendar={cal} market={market} onMarket={(m) => setMarket(m)} today={today} busy={busy} />

      <Panel title={t('sections.batches')}>
        <Table empty={t('empty')} head={[{ label: t('columns.started') }, { label: t('columns.dataset') }, { label: t('columns.producer') }, { label: t('columns.batchStatus') }, { label: t('columns.inserted'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.quarantined'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.failed'), num: true }]}>
          {(data?.batches ?? []).map((b) => (
            <tr key={String(b.batch_id)}>
              <td className={td}>{time(b.started_at)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(b.dataset)}</td><td className={td}>{s(b.producer)}</td>
              <td className={td}><Pill value={String(b.status)} /></td>
              <td className={num}>{count(b, 'inserted')}</td><td className={num}>{count(b, 'quarantined')}</td><td className={num}>{count(b, 'failed')}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Panel>

      <Panel title={t('sections.quarantine')}>
        <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-text-dim">
            <span>{t('columns.dataset')}</span>
            <select value={dataset} disabled={pending !== null} onChange={(e) => { setDataset(e.target.value); setPage(1); }} className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-bg-card px-2 font-mono text-text">
              <option value="">{t('all')}</option>
              {datasets.map((d) => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-text-dim">
            <span className="tabular-nums">{t('page', { page: q?.page ?? page, pages, total: q?.total ?? 0 })}</span>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)} className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border px-2 disabled:opacity-40">{t('prev')}</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)} className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-border px-2 disabled:opacity-40">{t('next')}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="divide-y divide-border rounded-md border border-border sm:hidden">
          {(q?.rows ?? []).map(quarantineCard)}
          {q && q.rows.length === 0 ? <div className="p-3 text-xs text-text-muted">{t('empty')}</div> : null}
        </div>
        <div className="hidden sm:block">
          <Table empty={t('empty')} head={[{ label: t('columns.time') }, { label: t('columns.dataset') }, { label: t('columns.table') }, { label: t('columns.naturalKey') }, { label: t('columns.reason') }, { label: t('columns.detail') }, { label: t('columns.actions') }]}>
            {(q?.rows ?? []).map((r) => (
              <tr key={String(r.id)} className={pending === String(r.id) ? 'opacity-50' : undefined}>
                <td className={td}>{time(r.created_at)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.dataset)}</td><td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.table_name)}</td>
                <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.natural_key)}</td><td className={td}>{s(r.reason_code)}</td>
                <td className="max-w-[16rem] px-2 py-1.5 align-top"><Detail value={r.detail} /></td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 align-top">{actions(r)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </Table>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t('notes.quarantine')}</p>
      </Panel>

      <ClaimsPanel t={t} claims={data?.claims} busy={busy} pending={pending} time={time} onResolve={resolveClaim} />

      <Panel title={recTitle}>
        <ReconciliationPairs t={t} byPair={data?.reconciliationsByPair} />
        <Table empty={t('empty')} head={[{ label: t('columns.pair') }, { label: t('columns.kind') }, { label: t('columns.outcome') }, { label: t('columns.naturalKey') }, { label: t('columns.leftValue'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.rightValue'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.relDiff'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.tolerance'), num: true }, { label: t('columns.detail') }]}>
          {(data?.reconciliations ?? []).map((r) => (
            <tr key={String(r.id)}>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.pair ?? r.dataset)}</td><td className={td}>{s(r.kind)}</td><td className={td}>{s(r.outcome)}</td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono`}>{s(r.natural_key)}</td>
              <td className={num}>{s(r.left_value)}</td><td className={num}>{s(r.right_value)}</td>
              <td className={`${num} ${r.passed === false ? 'text-danger' : ''}`}>{pct(r.rel_diff)}</td><td className={num}>{pct(r.tolerance)}</td>
              <td className="max-w-[16rem] px-2 py-1.5 align-top"><Detail value={r.detail} /></td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Panel>
    </div>
  );

  function actions(row: Row) {
    const id = String(row.id);
    const key = s(row.natural_key);
    const control = quarantineControl(row);
    const plain = (
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button type="button" disabled={busy || (control.kind === 'restore' && !control.enabled)} aria-label={`${t('accept')} ${key}`}
          title={control.kind === 'restore' && !control.enabled ? t(`quarantine.restore.${control.reason}`) : undefined}
          onClick={() => resolve(id, { status: 'resolved_accept' })} className={`${btn} text-accent`}>{control.kind === 'restore' ? t('quarantine.restore.action') : t('accept')}</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} aria-label={`${t('reject')} ${key}`} onClick={() => resolve(id, { status: 'resolved_reject' })} className={`${btn} text-danger`}>{t('reject')}</button>
      </div>
    );
    if (control.kind === 'candidates' || control.kind === 'lineage') {
      const options = control.kind === 'candidates' ? control.options.map((o) => ({ value: o.index as number | string, label: o.label })) : control.options.map((o) => ({ value: o.factId as number | string, label: o.label }));
      const body = quarantineAcceptBody(control, choice[id] ?? null);
      return (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <fieldset className="space-y-1 text-xs">
            <legend className="text-text-dim">{control.kind === 'candidates' ? t('quarantine.chooseCandidate') : t('quarantine.keepRow')}</legend>
            {options.map((o) => (
              <label key={String(o.value)} className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                <input type="radio" name={`choice-${id}`} checked={choice[id] === o.value} onChange={() => setChoice((c) => ({ ...c, [id]: o.value }))} disabled={busy} />
                <span className="break-all">{o.label}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || body === null} onClick={() => body && resolve(id, body)} className={`${btn} text-accent`}>
              {control.kind === 'candidates' ? t('quarantine.adopt', { n: typeof choice[id] === 'number' ? Number(choice[id]) : '—' }) : t('quarantine.keep')}
            </button>
            {plain}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (control.kind === 'restore') {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          {plain}
          <div className={`text-[11px] ${control.enabled ? 'text-text-dim' : 'text-text-muted'}`}>{t(`quarantine.restore.${control.reason}`)}</div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return plain;
  }

  function quarantineCard(row: Row) {
    return (
      <div key={String(row.id)} className={`space-y-1 p-3 text-xs ${pending === String(row.id) ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}>
        <div className="flex justify-between gap-2 font-mono"><span>{s(row.dataset)} · {s(row.table_name)}</span><span className="text-text-dim">{time(row.created_at)}</span></div>
        <div className="break-all font-mono">{s(row.natural_key)}</div>
        <div className="text-text-dim">{s(row.reason_code)}</div>
        <Detail value={row.detail} className="min-w-0" />
        <div className="py-1">{actions(row)}</div>
      </div>
    );
  }
}
```

````markdown
### 9.7 隔离项的新处置（`POST /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]`）

| 原因 | 接受 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ambiguous_value` | 带 `chosen_candidate_index` → `adopt_candidate` | 不带索引的接受 = 确认知晓（计划二路径）；`stale_evaluation` 自动重评一次后 409 |
| `reconcile_mismatch` | `restore_reconciled` | 要求最近一次对账通过且当前输入哈希相同，否则 409 `not_passing`（先重跑对账）；`promoted=0` → 200 + `restore_note='no_rows_promoted'` |
| `lineage_conflict` | 带 `keep_fact_id` → `resolve_lineage_conflict` | 结束后该键该日在谱系内恰一个 `ok` 值，否则回滚 `unresolved` |
| `reconcile_review` | 只改状态 | 舍入印刷的 A 股差异，人工判断 |

### 9.8 日历运维

- 遍：每市场同一时刻至多一个未完成遍，租约 10 分钟；成员冻结于建遍时；成员失败 3 次为终态，遍以 `complete_with_failures` 结束（新鲜度 `ok:false`）。查看：`select market, pass_id, status, started_at, finished_at, claimed_by, claim_until from dq_calendar_passes order by started_at desc limit 5;`、`select state, count(*) from dq_calendar_pass_members where market='US' and pass_id='<id>' group by 1;`、失败原因 `select issuer_id, attempts, last_error from dq_calendar_pass_members where state='failed' and pass_id='<id>';`。
- 遍卡住（租约持有者崩溃）：等 10 分钟租约过期，下一次 cron/脚本自动接管；**不要**手工改成员状态。
- 状态含义：`overdue` 只来自法定期限已知、期末为实际值、上游查得到且未申报；`filed_not_ingested` = SEC/巨潮已申报但本库未入库（查 facts-sync）；`unknown_upstream` = 上游不可查；`no_rule` = 期限未知（无 N−1 财年封面类别、40-F、表外年份）。估计期末（52/53 周）不计逾期，`detail.estimated_due_passed=true` 表示估计期限已过。
- **每年 12 月**：在 `src/lib/dq/calendar.ts::SEC_HOLIDAYS` 补次年联邦假日（OPM 表），并按 SEC 公告补 `SEC_CLOSURES`；表外年份的行为 `no_rule`（`none.holiday_table_missing/1`）。
- 申报人类别每季度跑一次 `filer-categories.ts --apply`（新 10-K 出现后）；没有 N−1 财年封面类别的发行人在回执 `no_category` 计数里。
````
